candidates.source:
It's a dangerous world out there, right?  So we fight to survive.  I'm on your side, and I'll stick with you, but if I think the situation is too dangerous, I'll be honest, I'm going to run.
  You can't tell me not to run, because I'm going to flee if things are bad, but you can tell me a safe place to retreat by using the zones manager (keybind 'Y').  I'll run toward the closest place you've designated - and you can set zones on vehicles, so if you've got a car, you could tell me to retreat there.
  If I see you running but I think it's safe, I'll stay and fight, but you can tell me run with you and I'll stick by you as best I can.
  You can give me some instructions on when I should attack, but I'll make my own decisions about who - I'll try to defend myself and you, but if you tell me to stay in one place I'll stay there.
  I'll use guns and grenades if I have them, but you can tell me to not use grenades or not use loud weapons or to not use ranged weapons at all.  If I'm shooting, you can tell me how much to aim and whether to try to avoid shooting you or not.  I'm not so good at recognizing safe shots, so stay out of my line of fire no matter what.
  I'll respect your rules for what types of weapons to use, but I'll choose what to use from my stuff.
  You can also tell me to hold the line and fight at chokepoints, but I'm not great at recognizing them so I may go off to fight something elsewhere anyway.
candidates.target:
外面的世界很危险，对吧？所以我们要为生存而战。我站在你这边，会和你一起战斗，但如果我觉得情况太危险，实在不行，我会诚实地告诉你我要跑。

你不能告诉我不要跑，因为如果情况糟糕，我会逃跑，但你可以用区域管理器（快捷键 'Y'）告诉我一个安全的撤退地点。我会朝你指定的最近地点跑，而且你可以在车辆上设置区域，所以如果你有车，可以告诉我退到那里。

如果我看到你在跑，但我觉得安全，我会留下来战斗，但你可以告诉我和你一起跑，我会尽量和你在一起。

你可以给我一些指示什么时候该攻击，但我会自己决定攻击谁。我会尽力保护自己和你，但如果你告诉我待在一个地方，我会待在那里。

我会使用枪和手雷，如果我有的话，但你可以告诉我不要使用手雷，不要使用响亮的武器，或者根本不要使用远程武器。如果我在射击，你可以告诉我瞄准多少，以及是否尝试避免射中你。我不擅长辨认安全的射击时机，所以无论如何，请避开我的射击范围。

我会尊重你关于使用哪些武器的规则，但我会从我的装备中选择使用什么。

你也可以告诉我坚守阵地，在关键点战斗，但我不擅长识别这些，所以我可能还是会去别的地方战斗。

candidates.source:
Each faction camp starts with the companion surveying the land and constructing a bulletin board, with the exception of the bare bones camp, where it is up to you to construct the board yourself anywhere within the camp's perimeter.  You can then 'e'xamine the bulletin board to get a list of available missions with descriptions, and to assign a companion to work on a mission.  The bulletin board is the primary way to access the camp.
  If both you and a companion have two-way radios, you can assign missions to the companion remotely by talking on the radio.
  When you ask a companion to start a camp they'll survey the land and mark it as a faction camp (visible on the overmap) to establish it.  The companion will also build a bulletin board for all faction camps except the bare bones one.  A faction camp has a central tile where the bulletin board is, and possibly one or more expansions that are in adjacent tiles.
  All of your faction camps can be stocked with food, and your companions will eat from that food when performing camp missions, or even when they're just hungry and near the camp.
  Currently, the bare bones faction camp can be created anywhere, while the modular hub ones can be built in fields, and the evac shelter one in all evac shelters.  In addition to those, there are faction camps that can be built in fire stations, mansions, fire lookout towers, helipads, lighthouses, military outposts, pottery cottages, radio towers, and small sealabs, and I may have forgotten some.  You can start a faction camp by talking to a companion who is standing on a suitable terrain, asking about faction camps, and then telling the companion to build a faction camp.  They'll immediately survey the tile and make the bulletin board (bare bones leaves the bulletin board location and construction up to you).  You'll be able to ask the companion for a list of suitable starting sites.
candidates.target:
每个派系营地都从伙伴勘察地形和建造公告板开始，除了基础营地，你需要自己在该营地范围内建造公告板。你可以“检查”公告板以获取可用的任务列表及其描述，并指派伙伴执行任务。公告板是访问营地的主要方式。

如果你和伙伴都拥有对讲机，可以通过对讲机远程指派任务给伙伴。

当你要求伙伴建立营地时，他们会勘察地形并在地图上标记为派系营地（在总地图上可见），以建立营地。伙伴还会在所有派系营地（除基础营地外）建造公告板。派系营地有一个中央区域，公告板位于其中，可能还有一个或多个扩展区域在相邻的区域。

你可以为所有派系营地储存食物，伙伴在执行营地任务时或只是当他们饿了并在营地附近时，会吃这些食物。

目前，基础营地可以在任何地方建立，模块化中心营地可以在田野中建造，避难所营地可以在所有避难所中建造。此外，还有可以在消防站、豪宅、消防瞭望塔、直升机坪、灯塔、军事哨所、陶艺小屋、无线电塔和小海实验室等地点建立的派系营地，可能还有我忘记提到的。你可以通过与站在合适地形上的伙伴交谈，询问关于派系营地的信息，然后告诉伙伴建立派系营地来开始营地。他们会立即勘察该区域并制作公告板（基础营地则留给你自行决定公告板的位置和建造）。你可以向伙伴询问合适的起始地点列表。

candidates.source: Well an surely, fruit gum!  How'd ye be twigged by a pop-an-squeak?  Or as y'r tassed, a treasure hunt?  Mayhap this be a chance to show y'self a true, for Rubik's got sommat to ask yet again.  The way o' the Exode is t'shimmy an' wobble, an' on thislike wobble, a few bits wobbled off, kennit?  'Tis rightful common, alack.  One such is hidden for our escolts an' our screeds.  Mayhap as y'know the lands, ye'd have a see of it?  Aye, ye kennit well.  'Tis a store-cabin, mayhap the likes you've seen.  This'n be older'n most, clade o' iron and crete-stone.  Abreast the ceil, high atop, there be a steely jut, piercin' the heavens.  In times ordinary, Great Grey could call out and screed the jut, kennit, and send aloft an escolt to razz 'er.  Oft times, the jut is wibbled on the wobble, an' it be coals'n coke.  Ol' Rubik can give you'n a dandy to pop 'er back aloft, and that's a fig and a fiddle.
candidates.target: 当然是水果软糖！你怎么会被一个爆米花和挤压玩具给发现？或者，根据你的说法，是一次寻宝游戏？也许这是一个展示你真实自我的机会，因为鲁比克还有事情要问。出埃及记的路径是摇摇晃晃的，在这摇晃中，一些东西晃掉了，你知道吗？这很常见，不幸的是。有一个这样的东西被隐藏起来，为了我们的护送和信条。也许你熟悉这片土地，可以去看看吗？是的，你知道得很清楚。这是一个储藏室，也许你见过类似的。这个比大多数都要老，由铁和混凝土建造。在顶部的天花板上，高高在上，有一个钢制的突起，刺向天空。在普通情况下，大灰可以呼喊并用信条控制突起，你知道的，并派遣一个护送人员去修理它。很多时候，突起在摇晃中晃动，并且是煤和焦炭。老鲁比克可以给你一个好东西把它放回去，这是一个简单的任务。

The trailer opens with a distorted rendition of "It's a Long Way to Tipperary," with a muddy trench, piled high with the bodies of dead soldiers, filling the scene and a dense layer of yellowish gas obscuring much from direct sight.  Zooming down into the dugout, the camera focuses on the mangled face of a dead infantryman sprawled in bloody water, his jaw blown off and shrapnel embedded in its place.  Clouds of flies crawl over his visage, dispersing in swarms as the music builds and the dead man's bloodshot eyes open.  Staggering to his feet, the soldier shambles down the trench, other corpses unsteadily rising in his wake.  The view pans out beyond the trench and past the layer of gas, revealing hundreds of staggering silhouettes moving in uneven, shambling lines before the escalating music peeks and the scene smash cuts to an overhead view of 19th-century Paris.

Hordes of zombies pour into the city, flashes of gunfire and artillery strikes lighting up the chaotic scene as a line of soldiers attempt to fend off the undead.  With the line breaking after a few seconds of frantic combat, the camera zooms down on a solitary soldier freshly brought to the ground in the midst of the surging wave of zombies, struggling to fend off gnashing teeth and clawing hands.  Seeming to make eye contact with the camera, the man lifts a hand in slow motion, revealing the pulled pins of several grenades before the view is consumed by an explosion.

With a fully fledged orchestral tidal wave scoring the scene, the trailer cuts to a bird's-eye shot of the soldier frantically climbing a ladder, one of his legs missing, and a child clinging to his back as a swarm of undead climb over one another at the structure's foot.  As the infantryman climbs, the view pulls out further and further, eventually depicting the landscape of France, with most man-made lights absent from view and the entire landmass awash with the flashes of heavy guns and detonations.  As the music reaches a heart-throbbing crescendo, bullet holes spray across the scene, spelling out,

"No Man's Land, coming to cinemas June 15th!"

预告片以扭曲的《莫里森小调》开场，画面中充满了泥泞的战壕，堆满了死士兵的尸体，浓浓的黄色气体遮蔽了视线。镜头逐渐拉近，聚焦在一个死步兵的残破面孔，他躺在血水中，下巴被炸飞，碎片嵌入其位置。苍蝇群在他的脸上爬行，随着音乐渐强，死人的血红眼睛睁开。士兵艰难地站起身，摇摇晃晃地沿着战壕走去，身后其他尸体也逐渐站起。镜头逐渐拉远，超越战壕和气体层，揭示了数百个摇摇晃晃的身影在混乱中移动，在音乐达到高潮前，画面突然切换到19世纪的巴黎鸟瞰图。

成群的僵尸涌入城市，枪声和炮火闪烁，照亮了混乱的场景，一排士兵试图抵御不死生物。几秒钟的激烈战斗后，防线崩溃，镜头聚焦在一个孤零零的士兵，被涌来的僵尸群击倒，他奋力抵御着咬合的牙齿和抓挠的手。似乎与镜头对视，男子慢动作地举起手，露出几枚拔掉引信的手榴弹，随后画面被爆炸吞没。

随着完全成熟的管弦乐潮流伴随场景，预告片切入士兵俯视镜头，他拼命爬上梯子，一条腿已缺失，一个孩子背着他，一群僵尸在结构底部互相攀爬。当士兵爬行时，镜头逐渐拉远，最终展现出法国的地形，大部分人造光线消失，整个土地被重炮闪光和爆炸照亮。当音乐达到心跳般的高潮，子弹孔在画面中喷射，拼出：“无人区，6月15日登陆影院！”

You tell me to guard, I'll stay where I am and guard it - unless I'm in a vehicle, in which case I'll stick with the vehicle.  I might not be able to stop a horde of zombies, but I can keep people other people from stealing our stuff.  Well, unless they try to kill me.
  Also, I'm not a potted plant, so if I hear something dangerous happening, I'm going to go see what it is instead of getting jumped in the dark.  If you want me to stay put, tell me not to investigate noises - but if I get shot by some bandit because I can't see where he is and you don't want me to go looking, I won't be happy.
  You can also use the zone manager (keybind 'Y') to set up no-investigate zone, so if there's some monsters behind a door that you know about, I can ignore them.  You can also set up an investigate-only zone, and I won't investigate noises coming from outside the zone.  The no-investigate zone takes precedence over the investigate-only, if there's a noise coming from some place in both zones.  And if you've got an investigate-only zone set anywhere, even if it's far away, I won't investigate noises coming from outside of it, so be careful with those zones.  Like I said, I don't want to get sniped by some bandit because you told me not to go looking for him - but I also don't want to go investigate something pounding at door only to find out it's some horrible monster you forgot to warn me about.

你让我守卫，我就会留在原地守卫，除非我在车上，那我会跟着车辆。我可能无法阻止一大群僵尸，但我可以防止其他人偷我们的东西。当然，除非他们试图杀死我。

我不是盆栽植物，所以如果我听到危险的事情发生，我会去看看情况，而不是被黑暗中的人偷袭。如果你想让我原地不动，就告诉我不要调查声音，但如果我因为看不见而遭到强盗枪击，而你又不让我去寻找，我可不会高兴。

你也可以使用区域管理器（快捷键 'Y'）来设置禁止调查区域，这样如果你知道门后有怪物，我就可以忽略它们。你还可以设置仅调查区域，我不会调查来自该区域外面的声音。禁止调查区域优先于仅调查区域，如果有声音来自两个区域中的某个地方。如果你设置了任何仅调查区域，即使很远，我也不会调查该区域外的声音，所以要小心这些区域。就像我说的，我不想被强盗狙击，因为你让我不要去寻找他，但我也不想去调查敲门的声音，结果发现是你忘记警告我的可怕怪物。

You like folk and the blues, friend?  Well, that was my bag and I sure could please my own ear with em, anyway.  Folks who's bein' generous might also say it pleased theirs.  Problem is, I seem to be between guitars right now, you know?  Temporarily guitar-light, if you get my saying.  Problem is, in the run for my life, I had to use old Jasmine as a bit of a billy club.  Had to curb some rowdy dudes on my way here.  It was her or me, you understand?  You wouldn't begrudge a man breakin' his instrument to save his life, would ya?

candidates.source:
The footage opens with an angled view of a rumpled picnic blanket, surrounded by the trunks and gnarled roots of trees and verdant shrubbery crowding the extremities.  The blanket is nearly obscured by the dozing profile of a young woman and three large dogs, one curled around her head like a pillow and the others sprawled across her body.

"Here, ladies and gentlemen of America," speaks a young man's voice into the microphone, "we view a feral Annaliese in her natural habitat: buried under several kilos of dog."  A light chuckle accompanies the remark as the man shifts the view, the camera panning and bringing more of the environment into sight.  The film's transit pauses as a young boy seated upon a bench comes into frame, his face a slack, glass-eyed mask of indifference, a rivulet of drool dribbling from his hanging mouth.  A small dog is perched atop his knees, nuzzling at the child's motionless form and whimpering.

A solitary, strangled yelp escapes the little dog's muzzle as the boy seizes its snout and throat, deftly breaking its neck.  As a stunned "holy mother of God!" can be heard from the cameraman, the view growing lopsided as he evidently fumbles the device, a mix of emotions blossoms across the boy's face.  The child's eyes well with tears, his mouth simultaneously twisting in a smile as he systematically sets to snapping the dead dog's bones.  Amidst the flurry of growls and barks emanating from the couple's recently awoken dogs and a muttered, "Anna, get the dogs and get to the truck; we better leave," audible in the background, the video's final shot depicts the boy staring straight into the camera, a goofy grin plastered across his face.  He waves the dead canine's broken arm in a grotesque farewell.
candidates.target:
镜头以一个倾斜的角度展现了一条皱巴巴的野餐布，周围是树干和扭曲的树根，以及密集的绿化带挤满了边缘。这条布几乎被一位打盹的年轻女子和三条大狗遮住了，其中一条狗像枕头一样蜷缩在她的头下，另外两条狗横陈在她的身上。

“在这里，美国的同胞们，”一个年轻男子的声音对着麦克风说，“我们看到野生的阿纳利丝在她的自然栖息地：被几公斤的狗埋没。”一阵轻微的笑声伴随着他的话语，男人移动了镜头，摄像机左右摇摆，将更多的环境展现在眼前。

当一个坐在长椅上的小男孩进入镜头时，影片的过渡暂停了，他的脸上挂着松弛、玻璃般的冷漠表情，嘴里流下一串唾液。一只小狗坐在他的膝盖上，蹭着这个不动的小男孩，低声呜咽。

小狗从男孩手中发出一声压抑的尖叫，男孩抓住了它的鼻子和喉咙，灵活地折断了它的脖子。当摄像师惊呼“天啊！”时，镜头变得歪斜，显然他慌乱中操作失误，一阵复杂的情感在男孩的脸上闪过。孩子的眼睛充满了泪水，嘴角同时上扬，露出一丝微笑，他有条不紊地开始折断死狗的骨头。

在情侣的狗最近醒来发出的低吼和吠叫声中，以及背景中低声传来的“安娜，把狗带走，我们最好离开”的声音中，视频的最后画面展示了男孩直视镜头，他脸上挂着傻乎乎的笑容。他挥舞着死狗断裂的前腿，做出一个可怕的告别手势。

The blanket is nearly obscured by the dozing profile of a young woman and three large dogs, one curled around her head like a pillow and the others sprawled across her body.

"Here, ladies and gentlemen of America," speaks a young man's voice into the microphone, "we view a feral Annaliese in her natural habitat: buried under several kilos of dog."  A light chuckle accompanies the remark as the man shifts the view, the camera panning and bringing more of the environment into sight.  The film's transit pauses as a young boy seated upon a bench comes into frame, his face a slack, glass-eyed mask of indifference, a rivulet of drool dribbling from his hanging mouth.  A small dog is perched atop his knees, nuzzling at the child's motionless form and whimpering.

A solitary, strangled yelp escapes the little dog's muzzle as the boy seizes its snout and throat, deftly breaking its neck.  As a stunned "holy mother of God!" can be heard from the cameraman, the view growing lopsided as he evidently fumbles the device, a mix of emotions blossoms across the boy's face.  The child's eyes well with tears, his mouth simultaneously twisting in a smile as he systematically sets to snapping the dead dog's bones.  Amidst the flurry of growls and barks emanating from the couple's recently awoken dogs and a muttered, "Anna, get the dogs and get to the truck; we better leave," audible in the background, the video's final shot depicts the boy staring straight into the camera, a goofy grin plastered across his face.  He waves the dead canine's broken arm in a grotesque farewell.

画面以倾斜视角开场：一张凌乱的野餐垫置于前景，四周被树木粗壮的树干和扭曲的根系、茂密的绿色灌木丛所包围。野餐垫几乎被一位年轻女子的睡姿和三条大狗完全遮挡：其中一条蜷缩在她头旁，像枕头一样；另外两条则 sprawled 在她身上。

“各位美国的女士们、先生们，”一个年轻男子的声音对着麦克风说道，“我们来看看野生的安娜莉丝在自然栖息地中的样子：被几公斤重的狗压着。”话音伴随一阵轻笑，男子调整了镜头，相机平移，将更多环境纳入视野。影片画面暂停，一个坐在长椅上的小男孩进入画面，他的表情是一副松弛、眼神空洞的冷漠面具，口水从垂下的嘴角滴落。一只小狗蹲坐在他膝盖上，亲昵地蹭着孩子僵直的身体，发出呜咽声。

当男孩一把抓住小狗的鼻子和喉咙，利落地折断其脖颈时，小狗从口中发出一声被扼住的尖叫。随着摄影师惊愕地喊出“天哪，我的天啊！”，画面因他显然手忙脚乱地操作设备而变得倾斜，男孩的脸上随即绽放出复杂的情绪。他的眼中蓄满泪水，嘴角却同时扭曲成笑容，开始系统地啃咬那只死狗的骨头。背景中，这对夫妇刚醒来的狗发出阵阵低吼和吠叫，同时隐约传来低语：“安娜，去把狗弄开，去卡车那边；我们最好走了。”视频的最后一帧定格在男孩直视镜头，脸上挂着傻笑，他挥舞着那只死狗断裂的肢体，做出一种怪诞的告别。

镜头以倾斜角度开启：皱巴巴的野餐垫周围盘踞着扭曲的树根，茂密灌木丛挤压着画面边缘。垫子上几乎看不见年轻女子的轮廓——她与三条大狗相拥而眠，其中一条蜷在她头侧当枕头，另两条横压在她身上。

“各位美国观众请看，”年轻男声对着麦克风解说，“这就是野生安娜丽丝的自然生活状态：埋在十几斤的大狗中间。”镜头随着轻笑移动，展现出更多环境细节。画面突然定格：长椅上坐着个眼神呆滞的男孩，口水从张开的嘴角垂落。他膝头趴着的小狗正呜咽着拱动他僵硬的身躯。

男孩突然掐住狗的口鼻扭断其脖颈，摄像机随后传来惊呼，“圣母啊！”。镜头剧烈晃动间，男孩脸上浮现出诡异的神情：泪水充盈眼眶，嘴角却扭曲成微笑，开始有条不紊地折断死狗的骨头。背景里充斥着惊醒的大狗们的狂吠，“安娜！带狗上皮卡！快走！”。视频最后定格在男孩直视镜头的画面——他晃动着狗尸断裂的前肢，露出痴呆般的笑容。

candidates.source: Rubik's not the finest dandy to yark it, an I'm ken, but this'n'll do best as can.  Ol' Rubik an' the stompy-clanker gang be shiny an' fine as can be, for y'see so well, but on the wind-up, the guts be nigh so fleshy as they were afore, twixt as they be with wire and steel.  Ain't none so left as remembers precise how it all goes, and much is boggled from bits and drabs o' a dozen elsewheres.  'Tis a marked fine they work at all, though work they do, and nicely.  Still, 'tis hard to know what'll crumple out from the can.  Those as return, they be… less well made as ol' Rubik.  Some as did work themselves, even, and mayhap against the good old ways.
candidates.target: 鲁比克不是最精致的玩意儿来玩它，我知道，但这个会是尽可能最好的。老鲁比克和他的那帮大块头机器人看起来很闪亮，很精致，你看得很清楚，但当他们启动时，他们的内部结构几乎和以前一样肉眼可见，尽管他们现在是电线和钢材。没有人精确地记得所有细节，很多东西都是从其他十几个地方拼凑来的。他们能工作已经很不错了，而且工作得很好，但还是很难知道从罐子里会冒出什么。那些回来的人，他们……比老鲁比克做得差远了。有些甚至自己工作，甚至可能违背了老传统。

As the video opens, your eyes are all but affronted by the medley of bright hues that range across the screen like a star's unfurling corona: vibrant orange tablecloths and emerald grass winking up at you from their position under the protective arm of an outdoor gazebo.  The structure's fabric apertures have been tied back, allowing volumes of light to spill in and gently touch upon the huddle of people that stand poised in the foreground, arrayed about a sizable table, and who are, to an attendee, livening the film's audio with the multi-voiced stanzas of "HAPPY BIRTHDAY!"  Crouched at the heart of this conflagration sits the delicious, if rather crude, depiction of a Sherman tank cast in chocolate and green icing, the vehicle's turret alight with six candles and its skittle armaments aimed at a small child held aloft at the table's head by a fondly grinning man.  With their tiny hand clutching a massive cake knife, the child's smiling happily, and, as the singing reaches its peak, they puff up their small chest and direct a valiant blow towards the candles (all be it still with the discreet assistance of a handful of the partygoers).  In a glint of silver, the blade's brought down upon the tank's hull, and the last few shots are of various plates of chocolate tank armor being distributed to the party's guests.

Zombies are clumsy and stupid so we lead them across bushes and things to trip and stumble.  We take high ground and let them plough into ladders like idiots while we stick 'em with spears from above.  Mostly, though, we try not to be seen.  We use bikes instead of cars because they don't make noise and don't need gas, plus we can take forest trails and things and avoid traffic jams.  Those things are suicide.  We try to avoid the cities, and when we do go close, we stick to the outskirts and raid the outlying houses.  In those, we keep crouched and try to get deep into the building fast, or down into the basement, so that little noises don't carry much and nothing from outside can see us.  Also, zombies being idiots, closing the blinds is a great move.  I always keep a crowbar for opening doors and windows, but I try not to use it if I can avoid it.  Darius can pick locks, which is slower but doesn't make noise.  We get a lot more mileage from raiding gas stations and other rural sites, where if there are a few zombies, we can usually lead them away.
candidates.target: 当然，我猜是这样的。我不知道我是否知道你不知道的东西，你看起来能独自处理一切。我到现在能活着，是因为尽量避免战斗。我不可能杀光所有的僵尸。达里乌斯和我尽量避免战斗，如果不能避免，我们总是试图占据优势。人数、武器、地形。僵尸很笨拙，我们会把它们引到灌木丛中让它们绊倒。我们占据制高点，让它们像傻瓜一样撞上梯子，我们则从上用长矛刺杀它们。大部分时间，我们尝试不被看见。我们骑自行车而不是开车，因为自行车不吵，不需要汽油，而且我们可以走森林小径，避免交通堵塞。那是自杀行为。我们尽量避开城市，如果必须靠近，我们待在郊区，掠夺外围的房屋。在那些地方，我们蹲着，尽快深入建筑内部，或者下到地下室，这样小声音不会传播太远，外面也看不到我们。另外，由于僵尸很傻，拉上窗帘是一个好主意。我总是带着一把撬棍开门窗，但如果可以避免，我不会用它。达里乌斯会开锁，虽然慢但不会发出声音。我们从加油站和其他乡村地点掠夺，如果有几个僵尸，我们通常可以把它们引开。

candidates.source: Well an surely, fruit gum!  For an' such as ye've done us a good.  How'd ye be twigged by a pop-an-squeak?  Or as y'r tassed, a treasure hunt?  'Tis a store-cabin, mayhap the likes you've seen.  This'n be older'n most, clade o' iron and crete-stone.  Abreast the ceil, high atop, there be a steely jut, piercin' the heavens.  In times ordinary, Great Grey could call out and screed the jut, kennit, and send aloft an escolt to razz 'er.  Oft times, the jut is wibbled on the wobble, an' it be coals'n coke. candidates.source:
You give me something to carry, I'll carry it.  But I only have so many pockets and I'm only so strong, so I'll drop stuff that's too big to carry.
  I'll also wear stuff - I'll decide what I want to wear, but you can take stuff from me.  If I'm wearing something I shouldn't, you can bump into me and sort my armor to get me to take if off.
  I don't like wearing a lot of gear, so if you give me a lot of bulky stuff and things that don't fit, I'm going to take them off and probably drop them.
  Also, since we're friends, I'll give you anything I'm carrying, no questions asked.
  Oh, yeah, if I'm hungry or thirsty and I'm carrying food, I'll eat it.  Same if I need to recharge my bionics and I have some fuel.  So you might want to watch what you give me, y'know?
candidates.target:
你让我携带东西，我就携带。但我的口袋有限，力量也有限，所以我会丢下太大或太重的东西。

我也会穿戴东西——我会决定穿什么，但你可以从我这里拿走东西。如果我穿了不该穿的东西，你可以撞到我，整理我的装备让我脱下来。

我不喜欢穿戴太多装备，所以如果你给我很多笨重或不合身的东西，我会脱下来可能还会被我丢掉。

另外，既然我们是朋友，我会无条件地给你我携带的任何东西。

哦，对了，如果我饿了或渴了，而且我携带了食物，我就会吃掉它。如果我需要为我的生物工程充电，而且我有燃料，也会用掉它。所以你最好注意给我什么，知道吗？

我会自行决定穿戴物品，如果我穿了不该穿的东西，你可以通过整理装束、让我脱掉它。
我不喜欢穿戴太多，如果你给我的东西太笨重或者不合适，我会把脱下它们甚至直接丢掉。
当然，我会把任何携带物品交易给你，我们是朋友，没问题。
哦对了，如果饿了、渴了，我会吃掉我携带着的饮食。同理也会消耗燃料为生化插件充能。所以也许你应该注意下你给我的物品，是吧？

candidates.source:
This is an archived voice message, seemingly received on the eve of the Cataclysm from a number saved as "Mandy."

The sound of ragged, unsuccessfully stifled breaths fills the recording, with hiccupped whimpers emitted at barely above a whisper as, in the background, a man's shouting cadence and a woman's pleading sobs are audible.

"Jonas," sniffs a teen girl's voice.  "I… I don't know what's happened, but dad's gone crazy.  He's tied Mom to the radiator for the last hour, and… oh God!  Jona, I think he's stripped her, and he's been turning on and off the radiator and sometimes I hear him crooning about how much he loves her, even as he's beating her and she's screaming.  I tried calling 911, but nobody's answering, and he's locked me in the basement, and I"

The girl's speech dissolves into sob-clogged gasps as the woman's voice escalates into a blood-curdling shriek, the scream growing sodden and gurgling as the liquid spray of gushing viscera grows to dominate it.  Heavy footfalls grow audible as the distant, gore-choked death rattle fades, replaced by the burble of viscous fluids and the girl's uneven breaths.

"Ooh, little Manatee," calls a man's sing-song voice as the muffled click of an opening door and the thump of bare feet on stairs register in the recording.  "Come on, sweety, it'll be easier if you just work with me."

For a few moments, all that can be heard are the girl's desperately muffled breaths and her father's searching footfalls.

The recording is suddenly filled with the girl's terrified shrieks and the swish of a struggling body being violently hauled across the floor, the sounds growing distorted as the phone tumbles to the ground.  Swiftly gagged, the daughter's weeping pleas are muffled, replaced by the retching of lungs clawing for air as the man's monstrously soothing voice filters through the recording.  "There, there, little manatee," he croons, the sound of fingers being comfortingly stroked through hair in contrast with the nauseous gurgling of a throat freshly choking on vomit.  "Don't fight it.  Go to sleep now.  Soon, you'll be happy with Mom.  There, there.  Go to sleep, darling.  I loved you.  I love you."

The last few minutes of the recording are occupied by silence before the father's voice returns.  He's weeping.

这是一条存档的语音留言，似乎是在末日来临前从一个名为“曼迪”的号码收到的。

录音中充满了急促、未成功压抑的喘息声，一个少女的声音在几乎是低语的情况下发出抽搐的呜咽，背景中可以听到一个男人的咆哮和女人的哀求声。

“乔纳斯”，一个少女的声音抽泣道，“我…我不知道发生了什么，但爸爸疯了。他把妈妈绑在暖气片上已经一个小时了，而且…天啊！乔纳，我觉得他把她的衣服都扒了，他一直在开关暖气片，有时候我能听到他在哼唱他多么爱她，即使他在打她，她也在尖叫。我试着打911，但没人接听，他把我锁在地下室，我…”

女孩的话语变成了抽泣声，女人的声音升级成令人毛骨悚然的尖叫，尖叫声变得湿润和嘶哑，因为喷涌的内脏液开始占据主导。沉重的脚步声逐渐清晰，远处的血腥死亡呜咽声逐渐消退，被粘稠液体的嘶嘶声和女孩不均匀的呼吸所取代。

“哦，小海牛”，一个男人的唱腔声音响起，打开门的闷声和赤脚在楼梯上行走的声音在录音中记录下来。“来吧，亲爱的，如果你配合我会更容易。”

几分钟内，能听到的只有女孩绝望地掩饰的呼吸声和她父亲寻找脚步的声音。

录音突然充满了女孩惊恐的尖叫声和挣扎的身体被暴力拖过地面的声音，随着电话掉落到地上，声音变得扭曲。迅速被捂住嘴巴，女儿的哭求被掩盖，取而代之的是肺部呕吐的嘈杂声，一个怪物般温柔的男声穿透录音。“在那里，在那里，小海牛”，他哼唱着，手指在头发上轻轻抚摸的声音与喉咙被呕吐物堵塞的恶心嘶嘶声形成鲜明对比。“不要挣扎。现在去睡觉。很快，你会和妈妈一起开心。在那里，在那里。去睡觉，亲爱的。我爱你。我爱你。”

录音的最后几分钟是沉默，然后是父亲的声音再次出现。他在哭泣。

录音的最后几分钟是寂静，然后父亲的声音再次响起。他正在哭泣。

The sound of ragged, unsuccessfully stifled breaths fills the recording, with hiccupped whimpers emitted at barely above a whisper as, in the background, a man's shouting cadence and a woman's pleading sobs are audible.

"Jonas," sniffs a teen girl's voice.  "I… I don't know what's happened, but dad's gone crazy.  He's tied Mom to the radiator for the last hour, and… oh God!  Jona, I think he's stripped her, and he's been turning on and off the radiator and sometimes I hear him crooning about how much he loves her, even as he's beating her and she's screaming.  I tried calling 911, but nobody's answering, and he's locked me in the basement, and I"

The girl's speech dissolves into sob-clogged gasps as the woman's voice escalates into a blood-curdling shriek, the scream growing sodden and gurgling as the liquid spray of gushing viscera grows to dominate it.  Heavy footfalls grow audible as the distant, gore-choked death rattle fades, replaced by the burble of viscous fluids and the girl's uneven breaths.

"Ooh, little Manatee," calls a man's sing-song voice as the muffled click of an opening door and the thump of bare feet on stairs register in the recording.  "Come on, sweety, it'll be easier if you just work with me."

For a few moments, all that can be heard are the girl's desperately muffled breaths and her father's searching footfalls.

The recording is suddenly filled with the girl's terrified shrieks and the swish of a struggling body being violently hauled across the floor, the sounds growing distorted as the phone tumbles to the ground.  Swiftly gagged, the daughter's weeping pleas are muffled, replaced by the retching of lungs clawing for air as the man's monstrously soothing voice filters through the recording.  "There, there, little manatee," he croons, the sound of fingers being comfortingly stroked through hair in contrast with the nauseous gurgling of a throat freshly choking on vomit.  "Don't fight it.  Go to sleep now.  Soon, you'll be happy with Mom.  There, there.  Go to sleep, darling.  I loved you.  I love you."

The last few minutes of the recording are occupied by silence before the father's voice returns.  He's weeping.

Downloads/how_to_train_your_nightmares_trailer.mp4

The trailer starts with a surreal violin score: a deathly pale woman in a lab coat kneeling on a basement floor.  Head bowed over a collection of engraved silver glyphs, her crimson hair drenched in rivulets of blood, and eyes closed, she chants under her breath as a British cadenced voice, the same as hers, speaks over the scene.  "There are things stalking beyond the abysses that drive the sane to madness."  Letting blood spatter upon the glyphs from wounds hidden by her hair, the woman's breathing quickens as the objects begin to sizzle, the view zooming upon her heavily scarred face as her eyes slowly open and the music escalates.  "But when insanity rains," fully opening her eyes, the woman's irises are revealed to be burned scarlet, the perspective filled by a view of one of them as the narration concludes, "the only thing left… is to transcend."

After a moment of tense freeze frame, the music grows to a dynamic bass-drum rhythm, the view zooming out and revealing the eyes of a tall, robed figure stalking through the deserted mezzanine level of a shopping plaza.  With their face lost in the shadow of a hood, their limbs bend in disturbingly inhuman ways as they stride, moments before a clawed hand bursts from beneath and whips them from the corridor.  Encircled by a throng of nightmarish, slavering monstrosities, the figure rests still for a moment before their robe bursts apart, revealing them to be an anthropoid composed of intertwining tentacles.  Machine pistols clutched at the ends of their many limbs, they latch to the ceiling and, in a hail of bullets, swing from the floor and towards the view.

The perspective shifts to a scene of the woman, wielding a bayonet-equipped battle rifle, riding astride a motorcycle.  Weaving through a street crowded with writhing eldritch abominations, she stabs from the bike as a viperine creature wings behind her, the pair cutting a bloody swath through the crowd before the view changes.

Dozing in the back of a covered wagon within a barn, the woman rests, the barn's doors wide open.  A spidery creature made from tentacles creeps in through the opening, the camera shifting to its perspective as it crawls towards the wagon.  Laying a leg upon the vehicle's lip, the view glances up, only to reveal the viperine beast crouching atop the cart.  A still second passes before the winged monstrosity dives, the view filled by its gaping maw, before fleshy words bleed across the screen.

"How to Train Your Nightmares, coming to cinemas April 22nd!"

Encircled by a throng of nightmarish, slavering monstrosities, the figure rests still for a moment before their robe bursts apart, revealing them to be an anthropoid composed of intertwining tentacles.  Machine pistols clutched at the ends of their many limbs, they latch to the ceiling and, in a hail of bullets, swing from the floor and towards the view.

The perspective shifts to a scene of the woman, wielding a bayonet-equipped battle rifle, riding astride a motorcycle.  Weaving through a street crowded with writhing eldritch abominations, she stabs from the bike as a viperine creature wings behind her, the pair cutting a bloody swath through the crowd before the view changes.

Dozing in the back of a covered wagon within a barn, the woman rests, the barn's doors wide open.  A spidery creature made from tentacles creeps in through the opening, the camera shifting to its perspective as it crawls towards the wagon.  Laying a leg upon the vehicle's lip, the view glances up, only to reveal the viperine beast crouching atop the cart.  A still second passes before the winged monstrosity dives, the view filled by its gaping maw, before fleshy words bleed across the screen.

"How to Train Your Nightmares, coming to cinemas April 22nd!"

视角切换至另一场景：女子手持装有刺刀的突击步枪，跨骑摩托车疾驰。她在挤满扭动不可名状之物的街道上穿梭，从车身上刺出利刃；一条蛇形生物在她身后振翅追击。二者在人群中撕开一道血路，随即画面转换。

女子在谷仓内一辆篷车的后厢中沉睡，谷仓大门敞开。一只由触手构成的蜘蛛状生物从门缝中悄然爬入，镜头切换至其视角，缓缓逼近篷车。它将一条腿搭在车沿，镜头向上瞥去，却见那条蛇形巨兽正蹲伏于车顶。一秒死寂之后，翼状怪物俯冲而下，画面被其张开的巨口填满，随即血肉般的文字在屏幕上渗出。

“《如何驯养你的噩梦》，4 月 22 日登陆影院！”

The trailer starts with a surreal violin score: a deathly pale woman in a lab coat kneeling on a basement floor.  Head bowed over a collection of engraved silver glyphs, her crimson hair drenched in rivulets of blood, and eyes closed, she chants under her breath as a British cadenced voice, the same as hers, speaks over the scene.  "There are things stalking beyond the abysses that drive the sane to madness."  Letting blood spatter upon the glyphs from wounds hidden by her hair, the woman's breathing quickens as the objects begin to sizzle, the view zooming upon her heavily scarred face as her eyes slowly open and the music escalates.  "But when insanity rains," fully opening her eyes, the woman's irises are revealed to be burned scarlet, the perspective filled by a view of one of them as the narration concludes, "the only thing left… is to transcend."

After a moment of tense freeze frame, the music grows to a dynamic bass-drum rhythm, the view zooming out and revealing the eyes of a tall, robed figure stalking through the deserted mezzanine level of a shopping plaza.  With their face lost in the shadow of a hood, their limbs bend in disturbingly inhuman ways as they stride, moments before a clawed hand bursts from beneath and whips them from the corridor.  Encircled by a throng of nightmarish, slavering monstrosities, the figure rests still for a moment before their robe bursts apart, revealing them to be an anthropoid composed of intertwining tentacles.  Machine pistols clutched at the ends of their many limbs, they latch to the ceiling and, in a hail of bullets, swing from the floor and towards the view.

The perspective shifts to a scene of the woman, wielding a bayonet-equipped battle rifle, riding astride a motorcycle.  Weaving through a street crowded with writhing eldritch abominations, she stabs from the bike as a viperine creature wings behind her, the pair cutting a bloody swath through the crowd before the view changes.

Dozing in the back of a covered wagon within a barn, the woman rests, the barn's doors wide open.  A spidery creature made from tentacles creeps in through the opening, the camera shifting to its perspective as it crawls towards the wagon.  Laying a leg upon the vehicle's lip, the view glances up, only to reveal the viperine beast crouching atop the cart.  A still second passes before the winged monstrosity dives, the view filled by its gaping maw, before fleshy words bleed across the screen.

"How to Train Your Nightmares, coming to cinemas April 22nd!"

candidates.source:
Inject subject with 10 ml of 29x-"Noonien" compound
Physical activity regimen: standard US Armed Forces Army Fitness Test
Results: Subject, previously in the 60% percentile for AFT results, placed in the 99% percentile on three consecutive days of taking the test.  On the fourth day, subject complained of muscle soreness and was placed under observation and ordered to perform only light activity the following day.  On the fifth day, subject expressed eagerness to try again and once again scored in the 99% percentile.  However, a physical examination following the testing period revealed a sprained ankle; the subject repeatedly expressed a wish to continue trying and that there was no need for medical treatment.  Subject was placed on light activity for the remainder of the observation period.
Long term effects: on the first day the subject did not eat at all.  Following a continued disinterest in eating they were placed on a standard diet on following days, modified to a high-calorie diet when they continually left meals unfinished.  Recipients of 29x-"Noonien" will require strict dietary instructions in order to obtain proper nutrition.  Seven days after initial application of 29x-"Noonien", subject complained of serious ankle pain and requested painkillers, which were provided.
candidates.target:
给试验对象注射10毫升29x-"诺奥尼恩"化合物。

体能训练计划：美国军队标准体能测试

结果：试验对象原本在军队体能测试中处于60%的分位数，在连续三天进行测试后，进入99%的分位数。在第四天，试验对象抱怨肌肉酸痛，被安排进行观察，并命令在第二天只进行轻度活动。在第五天，试验对象表达了再次尝试的渴望，并再次在测试中进入99%的分位数。然而，在测试结束后进行的体检发现试验对象踝关节扭伤；试验对象反复表达了继续尝试的愿望，并认为没有必要进行医疗治疗。试验对象在剩余的观察期间被安排进行轻度活动。

长期影响：第一天，试验对象完全没有进食。在持续对进食缺乏兴趣后，他们在接下来的几天被安排标准饮食，当他们持续留下未吃完的食物时，饮食被调整为高热量饮食。接受29x-"诺奥尼恩"的对象需要严格的饮食指示以获得适当的营养。在最初使用29x-"诺奥尼恩"七天后，试验对象抱怨严重的踝关节疼痛并请求止痛药，止痛药被提供。

candidates.source:
Here's the list of shouted commands I'll respond to:
  - Order me to guard, and I'll stay where I am and watch out for danger.  I'll investigate suspicious noises unless you told me not to.
  - Order me to follow, and I'll stop guarding and go back to following you.
  - Order me to stay awake, and I'll stay awake until I'm too tired to keep my eyes open.
  - Order me to sleep when tired, and I'll nap when I get tired.  I'll try to tell you when I'm off to bed unless you don't want to hear it.
  - Order me to flee, and I'll stick close to you when you run from danger.  I won't go running off on my own - though if things really bad, I might be running away already!
  - Order me to stop running, and I'll evaluate the danger myself and might go off and fight something while you're doing other things.
  - Ordering me to prepare for danger is special: it's an override command.  That means I'm going to follow certain instructions, even if you've given me other instructions earlier.  Specifically, I'm going to flee with you, I'm not going to open or close doors, I'm not going to sleep until I'm exhausted, and I'm going to try to hold any chokepoints that you're fighting at.
  - Ordering me to relax from danger is another special command, and it will clear any overrides I currently have and I'll go back to whatever instructions I had before you told me to prepare for danger.
candidates.target:
以下是我会响应的口令清单：

- 命令我“守卫”，我会保持原地不动，警惕危险。我会调查可疑声音，除非你告诉我不要这样做。
- 命令我“跟随”，我会停止守卫并回到你的身边。
- 命令我“保持清醒”，我会尽可能地保持清醒，直到太累以至于无法睁开眼睛。
- 命令我“疲劳时入睡”，我会在疲劳时小睡。我会尽量告诉你我要去睡觉，除非你不想听。
- 命令我“逃离”，我会在你逃离危险时紧跟在你身边。我不会独自逃跑，但如果情况真的很糟，我可能已经在逃跑了！
- 命令我“停止奔跑”，我会自己评估危险，可能会在你做其他事情时去对抗某些东西。
- 命令我“准备应对危险”是一个特殊口令，这意味着我会遵循某些指令，即使你之前给过我其他指令。具体来说，我会和你一起逃离，不会打开或关闭门，不会在精疲力尽前入睡，并尝试守卫你正在战斗的关键位置。
- 命令我“解除危险”是另一个特殊口令，它会清除我当前的任何覆盖指令，并让我回到在你告诉我准备应对危险之前收到的指令。

candidates.source:
This appears to have been a segment of let's play footage, a face-cam section occupying the film's upper corner and depicting an unshaven man sitting within a windowed bedroom.  Maintaining an enthused monolog, the youth's upbeat commentary plods along for most of the video, undisturbed by intermittent, inhuman screams and distant detonations.  Indeed, even when the sky beyond his window abruptly darkens, the man shows little reaction save for moving to turn on an adjacent lamp, his commentary swiftly resuming despite the device failing to turn on.

Minutes pass, and, following a particularly violent glitch, an amorphous, white shape can be seen suspended in the gloom, some distance beyond the window.  A chain of malfunctions suddenly begins, each glitch rendering the screen dark.  With every glitch, the form grows steadily closer until its visage is suddenly pressed against the glass.  Bearing the shape of a woman, with patches of fish-like scales knitting between jagged rows of protruding teeth that emerge from its skin, the naked aberration grins with a mouth full of slithering tentacles, its eye sockets replaced by gnashing maws, and many dozens of staring eyes sunken into its undulating flesh.  Another malfunction darkens the screen, only for the view to be nearly subsumed by the nightmare's writhing face when vision returns, the creature's rotten, bloated body merging straight through the still-babbling man's trunk.  A final malfunction robs the footage of visuals, and when it returns, only the man can be seen—sitting quietly alone, his bloodied, empty eye sockets staring at the camera, his toothless maw gaping.  The film goes black, and for the final minutes, only the man's soft crying can be heard.
candidates.target:
这似乎是一段游戏实况视频的片段，画面右上角有一个面部摄像头部分，显示一名未刮胡子的男子坐在一个有窗户的卧室里。青年人充满热情地独白着，他的积极评论在视频的大部分时间里持续着，即使偶尔出现非人的尖叫声和远处的爆炸声也未打断。事实上，即使天空中突然变暗，男子几乎没有反应，只是转过身去开了旁边的一盏灯，尽管灯没有亮，他的评论很快又继续了。

几分钟过去了，在特别暴力的一个卡顿之后，可以在窗外黑暗中看到一个无定形的白色物体悬浮着。一连串的故障突然开始，每次卡顿都会使屏幕变暗。随着每个故障，物体的形状逐渐靠近，直到它的面容突然贴在玻璃上。这个裸体的异形生物长着女人的形状，鱼鳞状的斑块缝合在尖锐的牙齿之间，这些牙齿从它的皮肤中突出，它满口是蠕动的触手，眼窝被咬合的口腔取代，还有许多眼睛沉浸在它起伏的肉中。另一个故障使屏幕变暗，当视野恢复时，几乎被这个扭曲的面孔占据，生物腐烂的、肿胀的身体直接融入了仍在喋喋不休的男子的身体。最后一次故障夺走了视频的画面，当画面恢复时，只能看到男子独自坐着，他的带血的空眼窝盯着摄像头，没有牙齿的口腔张开着。影片变黑，在最后几分钟里，只能听到男子轻微的哭声。

Tinged by the scarlet light of a sun all but sunken on the horizon, long shadows play across the view of concrete high-rises juxtaposed with historical facades: an expansive boulevard laying several stories below the camera's perspective and winding just beyond a vast structure that thrusts into the darkening sky.  It takes you multiple seconds of blankly staring before you realize that the sizable building in question is, or rather, used to be, the Sagrada Familia.  The vast sheets of resinous growths that cocoon the historical landmark and which almost seem to have been organically grown from ground to spire-top make it look like a vast, throbbing organ rising above the Barcelona skyline.

As you watch, the view zooms out from the defaced structure, revealing a concrete rooftop upon which, crouching, laying, and kneeling behind a low parapet, a handful of soldiers dressed in Spanish army fatigues bustle about a squat, mortar-like piece of ordinance while an officer discreetly peers over the barrier with a pair of binoculars.  As the soldiers prepare the portable artillery, the rasping growl of high-speed jet engines grows audible through the tinny audio, resolving into a sonic boom that cracks through the soundscape as, following a gesture from the officer, the mortar discharges with a low thwump.  A plume of red follows the flare shell as it streaks into the sky in a looping ark, detonating in a bright swirl of color that bathes the Sagrada Familia in a relief of crimson and prompting its plasticky coating to refract myriads of ruby shades.  In the heartbeat before multi-role fighter jets dive from the sky, the flair's sputtering life casts into stark relief many hundreds of unclear silhouettes that team about and within the structure like ants.  To a speck, they collectively pause as though in confusion, moments before dozens of incendiary warheads spear through the structure and detonate in a shockwave of rubble: a vast flower violently spreading petals of fire.

As the landmark implodes and flames dance across the skyline, the last few seconds of the video are centered on the soldiers.  Having abandoned their cover in favor of observing the awesome destruction unfolding below, the ragged men and women stand in a disheveled line, quietly gazing out at the inferno engulfing the megalithic building and slowly spreading to immolate surrounding structures.  As the last jet rolls free of its bombing run and thunders overhead, the little squad's officer solemnly takes off his beret and holds it to his heart as he watches the fire and, to the assembly's right, you can see two men mutely hugging one another.  As the video closes, atop that roof, there isn't a single pair of eyes or cheeks blackened from drifting ash that are dry as the soldiers watch their city burn.

被即将落入地平线的夕阳染成绯红色的光芒笼罩，长长的阴影在混凝土高楼上舞动，这些高楼与历史悠久的建筑交相辉映：一条宽阔的大道从摄像机视角下向下延伸数层，蜿蜒穿过一个巨大的建筑，这个建筑直插黑暗的天空。你凝视了好几秒钟，才意识到这个庞大的建筑是，或者说曾经是，圣家堂。包裹着历史地标的巨大树脂生长片，仿佛是从地面到尖塔顶端有机生长的一样，让它看起来像一个巨大的、跳动的器官，耸立在巴塞罗那的天际线上。

当你观察时，画面从被破坏的建筑拉远，揭示了一个混凝土屋顶，几名身着西班牙军装的士兵在低矮的护栏后蹲着、躺着和跪着，忙碌地操作着一个像迫击炮一样的短小武器，而一名军官悄悄地用双筒望远镜望着障碍物外。当士兵们准备好便携式火炮时，高速喷气式飞机的嘶吼声通过刺耳的音频逐渐清晰，形成了一个声震，撕裂了声音的空间，随着军官的手势，迫击炮发出低沉的轰鸣声。一股红色的烟雾随着焰火弹飞向天空，划过天空，在明亮的色彩漩涡中爆炸，将圣家堂沐浴在赤红的色彩中，使其塑料外壳折射出无数红宝石的色调。在多功能战斗机从天而降的瞬间，焰火的颤抖生命将建筑周围和内部的许多模糊剪影投射得格外清晰，它们像蚂蚁一样忙碌。在数十枚燃烧弹刺穿建筑并在震耳欲聋的爆炸中爆炸之前的一瞬间，它们集体停顿，仿佛陷入了困惑。

当地标建筑坍塌，火焰在天际线上跳跃时，视频的最后几秒钟聚焦在士兵们身上。他们放弃了掩体，转而观察下面展开的壮观景象，这些衣衫褴褛的男女士兵静静地站成一排，凝视着大火吞噬着这栋巨型建筑，并逐渐蔓延到周围的建筑。当最后一架飞机完成轰炸后飞过头顶时，小分队的军官庄严地摘下贝雷帽，握在胸前，注视着大火，在队伍的右边，你可以看到两个人默默地拥抱着。当视频结束时，在屋顶上，没有一双眼睛或脸颊因飘散的灰烬而变黑，士兵们凝视着城市燃烧，他们的眼中充满了悲伤。

candidates.source:
Tinged by the scarlet light of a sun all but sunken on the horizon, long shadows play across the view of concrete high-rises juxtaposed with historical facades: an expansive boulevard laying several stories below the camera's perspective and winding just beyond a vast structure that thrusts into the darkening sky.  It takes you multiple seconds of blankly staring before you realize that the sizable building in question is, or rather, used to be, the Sagrada Familia.  The vast sheets of resinous growths that cocoon the historical landmark and which almost seem to have been organically grown from ground to spire-top make it look like a vast, throbbing organ rising above the Barcelona skyline.

As you watch, the view zooms out from the defaced structure, revealing a concrete rooftop upon which, crouching, laying, and kneeling behind a low parapet, a handful of soldiers dressed in Spanish army fatigues bustle about a squat, mortar-like piece of ordinance while an officer discreetly peers over the barrier with a pair of binoculars.  As the soldiers prepare the portable artillery, the rasping growl of high-speed jet engines grows audible through the tinny audio, resolving into a sonic boom that cracks through the soundscape as, following a gesture from the officer, the mortar discharges with a low thwump.  A plume of red follows the flare shell as it streaks into the sky in a looping ark, detonating in a bright swirl of color that bathes the Sagrada Familia in a relief of crimson and prompting its plasticky coating to refract myriads of ruby shades.  In the heartbeat before multi-role fighter jets dive from the sky, the flair's sputtering life casts into stark relief many hundreds of unclear silhouettes that team about and within the structure like ants.  To a speck, they collectively pause as though in confusion, moments before dozens of incendiary warheads spear through the structure and detonate in a shockwave of rubble: a vast flower violently spreading petals of fire.

As the landmark implodes and flames dance across the skyline, the last few seconds of the video are centered on the soldiers.  Having abandoned their cover in favor of observing the awesome destruction unfolding below, the ragged men and women stand in a disheveled line, quietly gazing out at the inferno engulfing the megalithic building and slowly spreading to immolate surrounding structures.  As the last jet rolls free of its bombing run and thunders overhead, the little squad's officer solemnly takes off his beret and holds it to his heart as he watches the fire and, to the assembly's right, you can see two men mutely hugging one another.  As the video closes, atop that roof, there isn't a single pair of eyes or cheeks blackened from drifting ash that are dry as the soldiers watch their city burn.
candidates.target:
在夕阳几乎沉入地平线，染成猩红色的光芒中，长长的阴影投射在水泥摩天大楼与历史建筑并置的景象上：一条宽阔的大道在相机视线下方数层楼，蜿蜒延伸至一座直插昏暗天空的巨大建筑之外。你需要花几秒钟空白地凝视，才意识到那座引人注目的建筑，或者说，曾经是圣家堂。覆盖着这座历史地标的巨大树脂状物，仿佛是从地面生长到尖顶，让它看起来像一个巨大的、搏动着的器官，耸立在巴塞罗那的天际线上。

随着观看，画面拉远，显示出混凝土屋顶上，一群身穿西班牙军队迷彩服的士兵蹲伏、躺卧、跪在矮墙后面，忙碌地操作着一个类似迫击炮的装置，而一位军官则通过双筒望远镜谨慎地探视着。当士兵们准备好便携式火炮时，高速喷气发动机的嘶哑咆哮声通过微弱的音频传出，最终演变成一道撕裂声景的音爆。在军官示意后，迫击炮发射，发出低沉的“砰”的一声。一支红色烟幕追随着信号弹，划过天空，形成一个弧线，并在空中爆炸，形成一片明亮的色彩漩涡，将圣家堂笼罩在一片绯红色的光芒中，并使它塑料化的外层折射出无数的红宝石色调。在多用途战斗机从天空中俯冲而下之前，信号弹的微弱生命将数百个模糊的剪影映衬得格外清晰，这些剪影像蚂蚁一样在建筑内部和周围忙碌着。在数十个燃烧弹穿透建筑并爆炸成瓦砾冲击波之前，他们仿佛困惑地停顿了下来：一朵巨大的花，猛烈地绽放出火焰的花瓣。

当地标建筑坍塌，火焰在天际线上舞动时，视频的最后几秒钟的焦点集中在士兵们身上。他们放弃了掩护，转而观察着下方正在展开的巨大破坏，一群衣衫褴褛的男女并排站立，静静地凝视着吞噬着宏伟建筑的火焰，并逐渐蔓延到焚烧周围的建筑物。随着最后一架战斗机完成轰炸并呼啸而过，这个小队的军官庄严肃穆地摘下贝雷帽，紧贴在胸前，同时他看着火焰，而在集结地右侧，你可以看到两个男人默默地拥抱在一起。当视频结束时，在屋顶上，没有一双眼睛或因漂浮的灰烬而变黑的脸颊是干燥的，因为士兵们看着他们的城市燃烧。

随着镜头拉远，被毁损的建筑逐渐显露：在一处混凝土屋顶上，几名身着西班牙陆军作战服的士兵蹲伏、匍匐或跪在一道低矮的女儿墙后，围绕一门矮胖的迫击炮忙碌；一名军官则 discreetly 透过双筒望远镜从屏障后窥视。当士兵们准备便携式火炮时，高速喷气引擎的嘶哑轰鸣透过刺耳的音频逐渐清晰，最终化作一道音爆，撕裂声景；随着军官的手势，迫击炮发出一声低沉的闷响。一枚红色信号弹拖着红烟划破长空，划出一道环状弧线，在空中炸裂成绚烂的彩色漩涡，将圣家堂笼罩在深红的辉光之中，使其塑料般的涂层折射出万千红宝石般的色泽。在多用途战斗机俯冲而下前的瞬息之间，信号弹闪烁的余晖将数百个模糊的剪影映照得格外清晰，它们如蚁群般在建筑内外穿梭。刹那间，所有身影仿佛因困惑而集体停驻；紧接着，数十枚燃烧弹如长矛般刺入建筑，在碎石激起的冲击波中引爆：一朵巨大的火焰之花，暴力地绽开火舌般的瓣片。

随着地标建筑内爆，火焰在天际线上舞动，视频的最后几秒聚焦于那些士兵。他们已放弃掩体，转而凝视脚下正在展开的骇人毁灭；这群衣衫褴褛的男女排成凌乱的队列，静静凝望着吞噬这座巨石建筑的烈焰，以及正缓慢蔓延、将周边建筑一并焚毁的火海。当最后一架战机完成投弹、轰鸣着掠过天际，小队军官肃穆地摘下贝雷帽，将其按在胸前，目送火光；在队伍右侧，可见两名男子默默相拥。视频落幕之际，在那屋顶之上，没有一双眼睛、没有一张脸颊因飘落的灰烬而熏黑却仍保持干燥——士兵们注视着他们的城市在烈火中燃烧。

candidates.source:
Tinged by the scarlet light of a sun all but sunken on the horizon, long shadows play across the view of concrete high-rises juxtaposed with historical facades: an expansive boulevard laying several stories below the camera's perspective and winding just beyond a vast structure that thrusts into the darkening sky.  It takes you multiple seconds of blankly staring before you realize that the sizable building in question is, or rather, used to be, the Sagrada Familia.  The vast sheets of resinous growths that cocoon the historical landmark and which almost seem to have been organically grown from ground to spire-top make it look like a vast, throbbing organ rising above the Barcelona skyline.

As you watch, the view zooms out from the defaced structure, revealing a concrete rooftop upon which, crouching, laying, and kneeling behind a low parapet, a handful of soldiers dressed in Spanish army fatigues bustle about a squat, mortar-like piece of ordinance while an officer discreetly peers over the barrier with a pair of binoculars.  As the soldiers prepare the portable artillery, the rasping growl of high-speed jet engines grows audible through the tinny audio, resolving into a sonic boom that cracks through the soundscape as, following a gesture from the officer, the mortar discharges with a low thwump.  A plume of red follows the flare shell as it streaks into the sky in a looping ark, detonating in a bright swirl of color that bathes the Sagrada Familia in a relief of crimson and prompting its plasticky coating to refract myriads of ruby shades.  In the heartbeat before multi-role fighter jets dive from the sky, the flair's sputtering life casts into stark relief many hundreds of unclear silhouettes that team about and within the structure like ants.  To a speck, they collectively pause as though in confusion, moments before dozens of incendiary warheads spear through the structure and detonate in a shockwave of rubble: a vast flower violently spreading petals of fire.

As the landmark implodes and flames dance across the skyline, the last few seconds of the video are centered on the soldiers.  Having abandoned their cover in favor of observing the awesome destruction unfolding below, the ragged men and women stand in a disheveled line, quietly gazing out at the inferno engulfing the megalithic building and slowly spreading to immolate surrounding structures.  As the last jet rolls free of its bombing run and thunders overhead, the little squad's officer solemnly takes off his beret and holds it to his heart as he watches the fire and, to the assembly's right, you can see two men mutely hugging one another.  As the video closes, atop that roof, there isn't a single pair of eyes or cheeks blackened from drifting ash that are dry as the soldiers watch their city burn.

夕阳几乎沉入地平线，将天际染成猩红。长长的阴影投射在混凝土高楼与历史立面交错的视野中：一条宽阔的林荫大道位于镜头下方数层楼高，蜿蜒穿过一座巨大的建筑，伸向逐渐暗下来的天空。你凝视良久，才猛然意识到，眼前这座体量庞大的建筑，或者说曾经矗立于此的，正是圣家堂。包裹着这座历史地标的树脂状生长物层层叠叠，仿佛从地面自然生长至塔尖，使其宛如一座巨大的、搏动的器官，从巴塞罗那的天际线上空升起。

随着镜头拉远，残损的建筑逐渐显露全貌：在低矮的防墙上，几名身着西班牙陆军迷彩服的士兵或蹲或卧或跪，围绕着一门矮小的迫击炮忙碌操作；一名军官则透过双筒望远镜，谨慎地越过屏障窥视。当士兵们准备这门便携式火炮时，画外音中传来喷气式发动机高速运转的刺耳轰鸣，最终化作一道震耳欲聋的音爆，撕裂了声景。在军官的手势示意下，迫击炮发出一声低沉的闷响，发射出一枚照明弹。一道红色的尾焰如回旋的方舟般划破夜空，在空中炸开绚烂的漩涡，将圣家堂笼罩在一片猩红之中，其塑料般的涂层折射出无数红宝石般的光泽。在多用途战斗机俯冲投弹前的那一瞬，照明弹闪烁的余晖将数百个模糊的身影映照得格外清晰——它们如同蚂蚁般在建筑内外穿梭奔忙。刹那间，全体戛然而止，仿佛陷入困惑；随即，数十枚燃烧弹头穿透建筑，在废墟的冲击波中引爆：一朵巨大的花，正以暴烈之势展开火焰的花瓣。

随着地标建筑坍塌，烈焰在天际线间舞动，视频的最后几秒聚焦于士兵们。他们已放弃掩体，转而目睹下方那场令人震撼的毁灭景象。这些衣衫褴褛的男女排成一列，神情肃穆，静静凝视着吞噬这座巨型建筑的烈火，火势正缓慢蔓延，即将将周边建筑一并焚毁。当最后一架战机脱离轰炸航线，在头顶轰鸣而过时，小队军官庄重地摘下贝雷帽，将其贴于胸口，注视着火光；而在队伍右侧，你可以看到两名男子无声地紧紧相拥。随着视频落幕，在那片屋顶之上，没有一双眼睛或脸颊因飘落的灰烬而焦黑——唯有士兵们，眼睁睁看着他们的城市在烈火中燃烧。

血色的夕阳浸染天际，混凝土高楼与古迹残影在暮光中交错——镜头下方，宽阔的林荫道盘旋数层，延伸至一座刺入暗沉苍穹的巨型建筑。你怔忡数秒才惊觉，那座被树脂状增生体从地基到尖顶层层包裹、犹如搏动脏器般耸立于巴塞罗那地平线的庞然之物，竟是圣家堂的残骸。

画面骤然拉远，露出水泥屋顶上一队西班牙陆军士兵。他们蜷伏在矮墙后，围着迫击炮般的武器忙碌，军官则举着望远镜窥探。随着便携火炮准备就绪，喷气引擎的尖啸刺破杂音，音爆骤响的瞬间，军官挥手示意，炮口发出沉闷的“砰”声。曳光弹划出猩红弧线，在圣家堂上空炸开绚烂火环，将胶质外壳折射成万千血晶。闪光熄灭前的刹那，数百模糊身影如蚁群在建筑内外躁动——下一秒，数十枚燃烧弹贯穿穹顶，冲击波掀起烈焰花瓣，整座地标在火浪中崩塌。

视频末尾聚焦于这群士兵。他们弃了掩体，衣衫褴褛地站成一列，凝视火海吞噬巨石建筑并向四周蔓延。最后一架战机呼啸掠过时，军官肃然摘下贝雷帽按在胸前，右侧两名士兵正无声相拥。镜头渐暗，屋顶上每张沾满飘灰的面孔都泪痕斑驳，他们望着故乡在烈火中沉沦。

candidates.source: Why were you looking though?  I kid, I know she is hard to miss!  In English, the special package she is a woman no?  No.  I see.  And so do you it seems.  Yes.  There was such a clown, a clown of enormous physical beauty.  The pale, perfect skin, the ruby red lips, amazing hair, and what a sense of humor.  I laugh still, though I have lost everything.  My pants, my money, my many illegal imported triple magnum condoms I stole from a priest.  All lost to that one beautiful night.  The candles, the balloons, the singing.  It was the most romantic children's birthday party you could hope to imagine.  I would do it all again, and there was so much we did.  It was the end of that party, but the beginning of something beautiful, for several hours in that open minivan we found.  But you do not want to hear of such pleasures, I do not want to get you excited, for what can I do when I look so foolish, and lack the protection needed for more serious excitement.  Though and you must understand, Alonso's tongue is good for more than just the telling of long and saucy stories yes?

My pants, my money, my many illegal imported triple magnum condoms I stole from a priest.  All lost to that one beautiful night.  The candles, the balloons, the singing.  It was the most romantic children's birthday party you could hope to imagine.  I would do it all again, and there was so much we did.  It was the end of that party, but the beginning of something beautiful, for several hours in that open minivan we found.  But you do not want to hear of such pleasures, I do not want to get you excited, for what can I do when I look so foolish, and lack the protection needed for more serious excitement.  Though and you must understand, Alonso's tongue is good for more than just the telling of long and saucy stories yes?
candidates.target: 你为什么会看呢？我开玩笑的，我知道她很难不被注意到！用英语说，那个特别的包裹，她是个女人，对吧？不对。我明白了。看来你也是这么想的。是的。那真像个小丑，一个拥有巨大外貌美的小丑。苍白的完美肌肤，红宝石般的嘴唇，令人惊叹的头发，还有那幽默感。即使我失去了一切，我仍然会笑。我的裤子，我的钱，我从神父那里偷来的许多非法进口的超大号避孕套。全都输给了那个美好的夜晚。蜡烛，气球，歌声。那简直是你所能想象到的最浪漫的儿童生日派对了。我会重蹈覆辙，而且我们做了很多事情。那是派对的结束，却是某件美好事情的开始，就在我们找到的那辆敞篷面包车里度过了几个小时。但是你不想听这些快乐的事情，我也不想让你兴奋，因为我看起来这么傻，而且缺乏更刺激的保护措施。不过你必须明白，阿隆索的舌头不仅仅是用来讲长篇而又辛辣的故事的，对吧？

candidates.source: Well an surely, fruit gum!  How'd ye be twigged by a pop-an-squeak?  Or as y'r tassed, a treasure hunt?  'Tis a store-cabin, mayhap the likes you've seen.  This'n be older'n most, clade o' iron and crete-stone.  Abreast the ceil, high atop, there be a steely jut, piercin' the heavens.  In times ordinary, Great Grey could call out and screed the jut, kennit, and send aloft an escolt to razz 'er.  Oft times, the jut is wibbled on the wobble, an' it be coals'n coke.  Ol' Rubik can give you'n a dandy to pop 'er back aloft, and that's a fig and a fiddle.

This'n be older'n most, clade o' iron and crete-stone.  Abreast the ceil, high atop, there be a steely jut, piercin' the heavens.  In times ordinary, Great Grey could call out and screed the jut, kennit, and send aloft an escolt to razz 'er.  Oft times, the jut is wibbled on the wobble, an' it be coals'n coke.  Ol' Rubik can give you'n a dandy to pop 'er back aloft, and that's a fig and a fiddle.
candidates.target: 嗯，没错，就是水果糖！你怎么会被一个‘砰砰叫’的东西发现的？或者说，像你们说的，是寻宝游戏吗？这地方可能是个仓库，或许你见过类似的。这个比较古老，是铁和混凝土建造的。天花板上方高处，有一块钢铁突出物，直插云霄。在平常的日子里，大灰会出声呼喊并从瞭望台发出信号，你知道的，然后派人上去骚扰它。很多时候，那个突出物会摇摇晃晃，里面是煤和焦炭。老鲁比克可以给你一个好办法把它重新推上去，那可是小事一桩。

candidates.source: Peering down from what appears to be a security camera mount, this monochromatic segment of footage is focused on a section of airport taxiway.  A solitary, desert-drab plane rests upon the stretch of concrete, its boarding stairs lowered, and its twin engines whining as it idles, the drone of its motors almost eclipsing the distant screams and gunfire occasionally conveyed through the crackling audio.  Minutes into the tape, a small group of ragged people burst into view: assorted individuals in civilian garb flanked by a scattering of soldiers, all running headlong towards the aircraft.  A small child can be seen at the rear of the group, half carried by a serviceman and lagging behind the main body.  Suddenly, a violent flutter of gossamer wings fills the view as a dog-sized insectoid lunges past the camera, the colorful wasp alighting on the child's back and snapping large mandibles about them.  As a sickening, writhing carpet of wasps swarms into view and the group's front-runners begin to hurry up the aircraft's steps, a terrible game of tug of war ensues between the soldier and the ever-growing number of frenzied parasitoids, culminating in the man reeling back, showered in spurting blood, and clutching the child's chewed-off arm.  As the screaming child is subsumed beneath a twitching carapace of legs and pulsating ovipositors and the soldier is forced up the stairs, he pulls a pistol and fires wildly into the swarm, the ammunition depleting before he's dragged into the aircraft.  The last thing that the camera records is a spherical object being flung from the plane's closing door—the item pinging off the taxiing aircraft's wing and rolling into the frenzied crowd.  The plane powers out of sight, moments before the footage goes white.
candidates.target: 从一个看起来是安保摄像头的位置向下望去，这段单色画面聚焦在机场滑行道的某一段。一架颜色朴素的飞机静止在混凝土跑道上，其登机梯已放下，双引擎在低速运转时发出刺耳的嗡嗡声，几乎盖过了远处传来的尖叫声和枪声。几分钟后，一个小团体突然出现在画面中：一群穿着便装的人被零星的士兵簇拥着，全都朝飞机狂奔而去。队伍最后面可以看到一个小孩，被一个士兵半抱着，落在了队伍后面。突然，一只狗大小的类似昆虫的生物迅速从镜头前掠过，这只色彩斑斓的黄蜂落在孩子背上，大颚紧紧地咬住了孩子。当一群愤怒的寄生虫不断地涌入画面，前面的几个人开始匆忙登上飞机的楼梯，士兵和越来越多的狂暴生物之间展开了一场可怕的拉锯战，最终士兵被逼退，身上淋满了喷射的鲜血，紧紧抱着孩子被咬掉的手臂。当尖叫的孩子被蠕动的、满是触角的生物群吞没，士兵被推上楼梯，他拔出手枪向生物群乱射，子弹用尽前他被拖进了飞机。摄像头最后记录下的是一件球形物体从飞机关闭的门被抛出——物品撞在滑行飞机的机翼上，滚入狂乱的人群中。飞机消失在视线之外，紧接着画面变白。

candidates.target: 从似乎是监控摄像头支架上俯视，这段黑白影像聚焦于机场滑行道的一段区域。一架沙漠迷彩的飞机静静地停靠在水泥跑道上，登机梯已放下，双引擎发出嗡鸣，引擎的轰鸣几乎盖过了偶尔通过噼啪作响的音频传来的远处尖叫和枪声。几分钟后，一群衣衫褴褛的人冲入视野：穿着便衣的各色人等，夹杂着零星的士兵，全都朝着飞机狂奔。在队伍的后方，可以看到一个小孩，被一名士兵半抱着，落在队伍的主体后面。突然，一阵剧烈的薄翼颤动填满了视野，一只体型如狗的昆虫状生物从摄像头前扑过，一只色彩鲜艳的黄蜂落在孩子背上，张开大颚。随着令人作呕的、蠕动的黄蜂地毯涌入视野，队伍的前锋开始加快速度登上飞机的舷梯，一场可怕的拔河游戏在士兵和日益增多的狂躁寄生虫之间展开，最终，士兵向后踉跄，浑身喷溅着鲜血，紧紧抓住孩子被咬断的手臂。当尖叫的孩子被扭动的甲壳和搏动的卵管所吞噬时，士兵被迫登上舷梯，他掏出一把手枪，疯狂地向蜂群射击，弹药耗尽之前，他被拖进了飞机。摄像头记录下的最后画面是一件球状物体从飞机的关闭舱门被抛出——这个物体弹射到正在滑行的飞机机翼上，然后滚入狂热的人群中。飞机消失在视线之外，就在影像变成一片白色之前。

The roof of a pickup truck slopes out of sight at the lowest extremities of the video's view, with the rumble of the idling vehicle's engine all but lost under the angered uproar of the veritable sea of people that crowd, stomp, and chant for as far as the eye can see.  What appears to be a nuclear reactor facility looms in the background, the mob's front ranks pressed against the shuddering security fence encompassing the compound, a number of nervous-looking, rifle-clutching guards standing behind the barrier.  Interspersed among the horde are various people waving handmade signs, fleeting glances at the boards affording a view of a painted, plant-like anthropoid brandishing a sword towards a stylized mushroom cloud.  The chant, "FUCK OSWALD, FUCK NUCLEAR POWER, FUCK YOUR MOTHER!" resounds through the crackling audio, eventually dissolving into a tumult of enraged shrieks as the guardsmen raise their rifles and fire a volley of warning shots over the heads of the throng.  To a man, the crowd surges forward in heightened fervor, flinging themselves against the fence line, with a handful even attempting to scale the barrier.  Any further observation is cut short as the truck's engine roars and the vehicle barrels forward, the cameraman flung from the pickup's roof and rolling beneath the chassis.  The footage captures a brief blur of speeding metal and the sickening sound of several tons of vehicle crushing bodies before the tremendous crash of collapsing girders and a series of savage, approving screams resound.  Lopsided and glitching, the final moments of footage tapes a rush of legs storming past, the audio capturing a rattle of frantic gunfire, triumphant and terrified shrieks, and the meaty, splitting tear of limbs being forcibly wrenched from their sockets.

视频视野的最低边缘，一辆皮卡车顶倾斜消失在视线之外，车辆怠速的引擎声几乎被眼前这片怒吼的人海淹没。背景中，一个看起来像核反应堆的设施若隐若现，人群的前排挤在颤抖的安保围栏上，几名握着步枪、看起来很紧张的守卫站在围栏后面。人群中，一些人挥舞着手工制作的标语牌，偶尔能看到牌子上画着一个像植物一样的人形生物，手握着一把剑，指向一个风格化的蘑菇云。

“去死吧奥斯瓦尔德，去死吧核能，去死吧你妈！”的口号声在嘈杂的声音中回荡，最终演变成愤怒的尖叫声，守卫们举起步枪，向人群开了几枪示警。整个人群像一窝蜂一样冲了上去，更加激动，将自己扔向围栏，甚至有少数人试图翻越围栏。

正当进一步观察时，卡车引擎发出咆哮，车辆冲了出去，摄像师从皮卡车顶上摔了下来，在车底下滚动。这段视频捕捉到了一片模糊的金属加速画面，以及几吨车辆压碎身体的恶心声音，然后是横梁倒塌的巨大撞击声，以及一系列野蛮的、满意尖叫声。

视频的最后几秒，画面歪斜且闪烁，记录了一群人奔跑而过，声音中夹杂着慌乱的枪声、胜利和恐惧的尖叫声，以及肢体被强行从关节处扯下的血肉分离的声音。

candidates.source:
Swirling with a head-spinning meld of spurting reds and fleshy pinks, the sky looms over a windswept street, the jittering view seemingly recorded by a private property's security camera.  Bulging and receding, as though it were the face of a storm-ravaged ocean, a road-facing lawn fills the foreground.  A school bus rocks beyond the distorted greenery, the giggles of children clear over the squeals of the vehicle's suspension and the deformed whispers that tickle the edges of audibility.  The bus is coated in a carpet of writhing, flopping, and quivering torsos and limbs, all seemingly from children.  Rolling, through some indeterminate agency, along the vehicle's sides, wiggling across its roof, and at times merging straight through the metal, the bleeding body parts frolic across the bus.  Smiling and laughing, the heads attached to the torsos revolve in ways that would break regular necks, their jaws clamping about the faces of cohorts that they wriggle into, both parties gnawing at each other's skulls before they merge strait through one another.

As the road buckles and an abyssal vortex twists into being beyond the bus, all the flailing legs assemble beneath the chassis and lift the vehicle from the ground, the children's eyes bursting from their sockets and wriggling to the bus's front as the rest of the body parts assume positions upon the seats.  The red-splattered distortion of children on a field trip sprints into the portal, the children's heads still laughing.
candidates.target:
天空中漩涡般的红色和肉色交织在一起，令人眼花缭乱，仿佛是某个私有财产的监控摄像头记录下的景象。一个面向街道的草坪像暴风雨肆虐后的海洋般起伏荡漾，占据了前景。一辆校车在扭曲的绿地上摇摇晃晃地开过，孩子们的欢笑声清晰地盖过了车辆悬挂系统的尖叫声和那些轻微的低语声，那些低语声拂过听觉的边缘。校车上覆盖着一层扭动、翻滚和颤抖的躯干和肢体，全都是孩子们的。这些肢体沿着车辆的侧面滚动，在车顶上蠕动，有时甚至直接穿透金属，鲜血淋漓的身体部位在车上嬉戏。那些头部微笑着、大笑着，以一种会使正常脖子断裂的方式旋转，它们的下巴紧咬着它们蠕动过去的伙伴的脸，双方互相啃咬对方的头骨，然后直接融合在一起。

当道路变形，一个深渊般的漩涡在校车后扭曲出现时，所有挥舞的腿聚集在底盘下方，将车辆从地面抬起，孩子们的眼睛从眼窝中爆裂出来，向着车头蠕动，与此同时，其他身体部位在座位上占据位置。这群孩子们在远足时，被鲜血染红，他们冲进了那个传送门，孩子们的头部仍在笑着。

当道路塌陷，校车之外裂开一道深渊般的漩涡，所有挥舞的腿足汇聚于底盘之下，将车辆从地面托起；孩童的眼球从眼眶中迸裂，扭动着滚向车头，其余肢体则就位坐于座椅之上。这场被猩红泼溅、扭曲变形的郊游孩童群，疾驰冲入传送门，而孩童们的头颅仍在狂笑。

candidates.source:
Swirling with a head-spinning meld of spurting reds and fleshy pinks, the sky looms over a windswept street, the jittering view seemingly recorded by a private property's security camera.  Bulging and receding, as though it were the face of a storm-ravaged ocean, a road-facing lawn fills the foreground.  A school bus rocks beyond the distorted greenery, the giggles of children clear over the squeals of the vehicle's suspension and the deformed whispers that tickle the edges of audibility.  The bus is coated in a carpet of writhing, flopping, and quivering torsos and limbs, all seemingly from children.  Rolling, through some indeterminate agency, along the vehicle's sides, wiggling across its roof, and at times merging straight through the metal, the bleeding body parts frolic across the bus.  Smiling and laughing, the heads attached to the torsos revolve in ways that would break regular necks, their jaws clamping about the faces of cohorts that they wriggle into, both parties gnawing at each other's skulls before they merge strait through one another.

As the road buckles and an abyssal vortex twists into being beyond the bus, all the flailing legs assemble beneath the chassis and lift the vehicle from the ground, the children's eyes bursting from their sockets and wriggling to the bus's front as the rest of the body parts assume positions upon the seats.  The red-splattered distortion of children on a field trip sprints into the portal, the children's heads still laughing.
candidates.target: 天空在飞溅的鲜红与肉粉色漩涡中翻涌，笼罩着一条被风肆虐的街道，这晃动的景象仿佛被某处私人物业的监控摄像头所记录。前景是一片起伏的草坪，如同风暴摧残后的海洋表面。一辆校车在扭曲的绿植后方摇晃，孩子们的欢笑声清晰可闻，盖过了车辆悬挂系统的吱嘎声，以及那些在听觉边缘轻挠耳膜的变形低语。校车表面覆盖着一层扭动、翻滚、颤栗的躯干与四肢，看似皆出自孩童之身。在某种不可名状的机制驱使下，这些肢体沿着车身滚动，在车顶蠕动，时而径直穿透金属，这些渗血的躯体部件在车身上嬉戏。头部与躯干相连，它们以常人颈椎无法承受的方式旋转，下颌紧紧钳住同伴的面部，双方互相啃噬对方的颅骨，最终径直融合彼此。随着路面塌陷，一个深渊般的漩涡在校车后方形成，所有挥舞的腿肢在底盘下方集结，将车辆从地面托起；孩子们的眼珠从眼眶中迸出，扭动至校车前方，而其余肢体则纷纷占据座位。那辆沾满血迹、扭曲变形的校车——载着郊游的孩子们——冲入 portal，孩子们的脸庞依旧在欢笑。

血色漩涡与肉粉色云团在扭曲的天幕中翻涌，狂风呼啸的街道上方，监控摄像头正记录着这幅诡谲画面。如暴风雨肆虐的海面般起伏不定的草坪占据前景，一辆校车在畸变的绿植后方剧烈摇晃。孩童的嬉笑盖过了悬挂系统的呻吟，以及那些在听觉边缘蠕动的低语。

无数扭动的躯干与肢体如活体地毯覆盖着校车表面——全都像是来自孩子。这些渗血的残肢以不可名状的方式滚动着：沿着车身爬行，在车顶蠕动，时而直接穿透金属结构。连接在躯干上的头颅以足以折断常人颈椎的角度旋转，大笑着将下颚嵌进同伴的面部。在彼此穿透融合前，双方都在啃噬对方的颅骨。

candidates.source:
Scrolling through the device's video storage, you come across an archived video message received, apparently, through a chat app a few days after the first mass-spread portal storms.  Evidently taped through the low-grade camera of a smartphone, the footage shows the interior view of a small room bathed in darkness, a door visible in the background with several heavy-duty dead bolts drawn, and the grime-caked face of a balding man hovering in the foreground.  Quivering like a particularly well-bearded leaf, the man's gaze continually darts around as he mutters into the microphone in a horse cadence, barely above a whisper.

"Denis, I don't have a clue if you and Lorence are still alive; fuck knows, after the shit that's been going on, I don't know how anyone can still be alive, but, in the name of hell and Jesus Christ, I hope you are, because you need to come get me, man; you really, really need to come get me out of here.  Something's gotten into my house.  I don't know what it wants; it hasn't hurt me yet, but it's not leaving, it's not letting me leave, it just watches me all day and all night, watching and following.  I managed to lock myself in the broom closet.  I don't think it can get in, but you need to come get me.  Please.  Please, for the love of God.  Send somebody."

As the man's babbling trails onwards, your eyes are increasingly drawn to the space over the door, where a slight quivering in the wall is steadily growing more pronounced.  Suddenly, yellowed, rat-like incisors burst through the space, furiously and swiftly gnawing a softball-sized hole through the wood.  Noiselessly withdrawing, the fangs' place is taken by a disturbingly slender arm that limply drapes itself through the aperture, the unnaturally long hand at its end feeling along the wall with fingers that tangle like the leaves of a spider plant.  The cameraman only grows wise to the spaghetti-thin limb's intrusion as the fingers lightly cascade over his shoulders, moments before the arm entwines about him with tentacle-like deftness.

The view's sent spiraling to the ground as the limb constricts and whips him rearwards, a sickening series of crunches and pained wails audible as the man's slammed against the heavy door with machine gun rapidity.  The last few shots consist of the man being yanked through a freshly splintered hole in the door as, upside down, a horrifically bloated head slithers down the wall.  Domed like the cranium of an infant, sparsely furred, inset with anglerfish-like eyes, and far too large for the ragged straw of flesh that composes its neck, the being's skull passively observes the blooded, screaming mess of a body that it's trying to feed through the watermelon-sized gap.  It succeeds… eventually.
candidates.target:
在翻看设备的视频存储时，你发现了一条几天前通过聊天应用收到的存档视频消息。显然，这段视频是用一部低端智能手机的摄像头拍摄的，画面显示了一个小房间内部，房间被笼罩在黑暗中，背景中可以看到一扇装有多个沉重门栓的门，前景中一个光头男子肮脏的面孔在闪烁。他像一片长满胡子的叶子般颤抖着，目光不断地闪烁，低声嘟囔着。

“丹尼斯，我不知道你和洛伦斯是否还活着；天知道，经历了那些事，我不知道还有谁能活着，但为了地狱和耶稣基督，我希望你们还活着，因为你们需要来救我；你们真的、真的需要来救我出这个地方。有东西闯入了我的家。我不知道它想要什么；它还没有伤害我，但它不肯离开，不让我离开，它只是整天整夜地看着我，看着和跟着我。我设法把自己锁在了储藏室里。我想它进不来，但你们需要来救我。求求你们。求求上帝，请派个人来。”

随着男子的胡言乱语继续，你的目光越来越被门上方的空间所吸引，那里墙壁上微弱的颤动逐渐变得更加明显。突然，一排黄色的、像老鼠一样的门牙从空间中冲出，疯狂地、迅速地咬出一个软球大小的洞。无声地后退，牙的位子被一个令人不安的瘦长手臂所取代，手臂松散地穿过洞口，它不自然地长手在末尾沿着墙壁摸索，手指像蜘蛛植物的叶子般交织。摄像师只意识到那根细如意大利面的手臂侵入时，手指轻轻地落在他的肩膀上，几秒钟前，手臂像触手般灵活地缠绕在他身上。

画面随着手臂收紧和抽打而螺旋状地落向地面，可以听到令人作呕的骨头断裂声和痛苦的呻吟声，男子被重重地砸向沉重的门，速度之快如机关枪扫射。最后几幕是男子被拉过门上新鲜的木桩洞，倒挂着，一个可怕肿胀的头沿着墙壁滑落。像婴儿颅骨一样圆顶，稀疏地长着毛发，嵌入像钓鱼鱼眼，对于组成它脖子的那根粗糙的肉茎来说，太大了，这个生物的头骨静静地观察着它试图通过西瓜大小的缝隙喂食的满是鲜血、尖叫的身体。它最终成功了。

浏览设备上的视频存储，你偶然发现了一条存档的视频信息，显然是通过聊天应用在第一次大规模传送风暴发生后的几天收到的。这段视频显然是用智能手机低劣的摄像头拍摄的，显示了一个小房间的内部景象，背景中有一扇门，上面安装了多把重型锁扣，而一个秃顶男子的满脸污垢的脸庞出现在前景中。他像一片胡须浓密的树叶一样颤抖着，目光不停地四处游移，用一种嘶哑的语调对着麦克风喃喃自语，几乎低到听不见。

“丹尼斯，我不知道你和洛伦斯是否还活着；老天知道，发生这么多事之后，我不知道还有谁能活着，但，以天与主的圣名，我希望你们还活着，因为你们需要来救我，伙计；你们真的，真的需要把我从这里救出去。有些东西闯进了我的房子。我不知道它想要什么；它还没有伤害我，但它没有离开，它不让我离开，它只是整天整夜地看着我，看着和跟踪着。我设法把自己锁在了壁橱里。我不认为它能进来，但你们需要来救我。求求你。求求你，为了上帝的缘故。派人来。”

视野随着肢体的收紧和抽动而旋转到地面，一阵令人作呕的咔嚓声和痛苦的尖叫声清晰可闻，当男子以机枪般的频率被撞向沉重的门时。最后几段镜头显示男子被拉过门上新开的、木屑四溅的洞，一个恐怖地肿胀的头颅倒挂着滑下墙壁。它像婴儿的头颅一样穹顶状，稀疏地长有毛发，镶嵌着像灯笼鱼一样的眼睛，而且脖子由破烂的肉质组成，远远大于其尺寸。这个生物的头骨被动地观察着它试图通过西瓜大小的缝隙喂食的血淋淋、尖叫的身体……最终，它成功了。

candidates.source:
Scrolling through the device's video storage, you come across an archived video message received, apparently, through a chat app a few days after the first mass-spread portal storms.  Evidently taped through the low-grade camera of a smartphone, the footage shows the interior view of a small room bathed in darkness, a door visible in the background with several heavy-duty dead bolts drawn, and the grime-caked face of a balding man hovering in the foreground.  Quivering like a particularly well-bearded leaf, the man's gaze continually darts around as he mutters into the microphone in a horse cadence, barely above a whisper.

"Denis, I don't have a clue if you and Lorence are still alive; fuck knows, after the shit that's been going on, I don't know how anyone can still be alive, but, in the name of hell and Jesus Christ, I hope you are, because you need to come get me, man; you really, really need to come get me out of here.  Something's gotten into my house.  I don't know what it wants; it hasn't hurt me yet, but it's not leaving, it's not letting me leave, it just watches me all day and all night, watching and following.  I managed to lock myself in the broom closet.  I don't think it can get in, but you need to come get me.  Please.  Please, for the love of God.  Send somebody."

As the man's babbling trails onwards, your eyes are increasingly drawn to the space over the door, where a slight quivering in the wall is steadily growing more pronounced.  Suddenly, yellowed, rat-like incisors burst through the space, furiously and swiftly gnawing a softball-sized hole through the wood.  Noiselessly withdrawing, the fangs' place is taken by a disturbingly slender arm that limply drapes itself through the aperture, the unnaturally long hand at its end feeling along the wall with fingers that tangle like the leaves of a spider plant.  The cameraman only grows wise to the spaghetti-thin limb's intrusion as the fingers lightly cascade over his shoulders, moments before the arm entwines about him with tentacle-like deftness.

The view's sent spiraling to the ground as the limb constricts and whips him rearwards, a sickening series of crunches and pained wails audible as the man's slammed against the heavy door with machine gun rapidity.  The last few shots consist of the man being yanked through a freshly splintered hole in the door as, upside down, a horrifically bloated head slithers down the wall.  Domed like the cranium of an infant, sparsely furred, inset with anglerfish-like eyes, and far too large for the ragged straw of flesh that composes its neck, the being's skull passively observes the blooded, screaming mess of a body that it's trying to feed through the watermelon-sized gap.  It succeeds… eventually.

随着男子语无伦次的呓语继续，你的目光逐渐被门上方的空间吸引，那里墙壁出现了一丝细微的颤动，且越来越明显。突然，几颗泛黄、鼠齿般的尖牙从缝隙中破出，疯狂而迅速地啃噬出一个棒球大小的木洞。无声退去后，那位置被一只令人不安地纤细的手臂占据，它无力地穿过孔洞垂下，末端那只异常长的手指沿着墙壁摸索，指节纠缠如蜘蛛草的叶片。摄像师直到那根如意大利面般纤细的肢体轻轻滑过他的肩膀才察觉其入侵，紧接着，手臂便以触手般的灵巧将他缠绕。

随着肢体收紧并猛地将他向后甩去，画面随之坠落。令人作呕的碎裂声与痛苦的哀嚎交织响起，男子被重重撞向那扇沉重的门，速度之快如机关枪点射。最后几帧画面显示，男子被从门上新裂开的、布满木刺的孔洞中被硬生生拽出，而一个恐怖地臃肿的头颅则倒挂下来，顺着墙壁缓缓滑下。那头颅圆顶如婴儿的颅骨，毛发稀疏，嵌着类似鮟鱇鱼的眼睛，其体积相对于构成脖子的破烂稻草状肉体而言大得离谱。这生物的头颅被动地注视着那具被鲜血浸透、尖叫不止的躯体，正试图通过西瓜般大小的缝隙将其吞噬。它成功了……最终。

candidates.source:
Scrolling through the device's video storage, you come across an archived video message received, apparently, through a chat app a few days after the first mass-spread portal storms.  Evidently taped through the low-grade camera of a smartphone, the footage shows the interior view of a small room bathed in darkness, a door visible in the background with several heavy-duty dead bolts drawn, and the grime-caked face of a balding man hovering in the foreground.  Quivering like a particularly well-bearded leaf, the man's gaze continually darts around as he mutters into the microphone in a horse cadence, barely above a whisper.

"Denis, I don't have a clue if you and Lorence are still alive; fuck knows, after the shit that's been going on, I don't know how anyone can still be alive, but, in the name of hell and Jesus Christ, I hope you are, because you need to come get me, man; you really, really need to come get me out of here.  Something's gotten into my house.  I don't know what it wants; it hasn't hurt me yet, but it's not leaving, it's not letting me leave, it just watches me all day and all night, watching and following.  I managed to lock myself in the broom closet.  I don't think it can get in, but you need to come get me.  Please.  Please, for the love of God.  Send somebody."

As the man's babbling trails onwards, your eyes are increasingly drawn to the space over the door, where a slight quivering in the wall is steadily growing more pronounced.  Suddenly, yellowed, rat-like incisors burst through the space, furiously and swiftly gnawing a softball-sized hole through the wood.  Noiselessly withdrawing, the fangs' place is taken by a disturbingly slender arm that limply drapes itself through the aperture, the unnaturally long hand at its end feeling along the wall with fingers that tangle like the leaves of a spider plant.  The cameraman only grows wise to the spaghetti-thin limb's intrusion as the fingers lightly cascade over his shoulders, moments before the arm entwines about him with tentacle-like deftness.

The view's sent spiraling to the ground as the limb constricts and whips him rearwards, a sickening series of crunches and pained wails audible as the man's slammed against the heavy door with machine gun rapidity.  The last few shots consist of the man being yanked through a freshly splintered hole in the door as, upside down, a horrifically bloated head slithers down the wall.  Domed like the cranium of an infant, sparsely furred, inset with anglerfish-like eyes, and far too large for the ragged straw of flesh that composes its neck, the being's skull passively observes the blooded, screaming mess of a body that it's trying to feed through the watermelon-sized gap.  It succeeds… eventually.

画面随着肢体收紧并猛地将他向后甩动而旋转坠落，伴随着令人作呕的碎裂声与痛苦的哀嚎，男人的身体被重重砸向厚重的门板，频率如同机枪扫射。最后几帧显示，男人被猛地拽过门上刚刚崩裂的孔洞，而倒挂的他，一个恐怖肿胀的脑袋正沿着墙壁滑行。它的头颅圆如婴儿的颅骨，毛发稀疏，嵌着鮟鱇鱼般的眼睛，其体积相对于那由粗糙稻草般血肉构成的颈部而言大得离谱；这个生物的头颅被动地凝视着下方那具鲜血淋漓、尖叫不止的残躯，试图通过那个西瓜大小的缺口将其吞噬。它成功了……最终成功了。

“丹尼斯，不知道你和劳伦斯还活着没…去他妈的，这鬼世道能活下来的都是怪物…但看在撒旦和耶稣份上，你们得来救我…必须来！有东西闯进我家了。不知道它要什么…还没伤害我…可它不走…也不让我走…日夜盯着我…我躲进了扫具间…门应该能顶住…求你们…”

男人絮叨时，你的目光不自觉被门框上方的异样吸引——墙面正泛起越来越明显的波纹。突然，几颗发黄的鼠类门齿刺穿墙体，飞速啃出垒球大小的破洞。利齿无声退去后，取而代之的是条畸形细臂，末端蜘蛛兰叶片般的手指正摸索墙面。当那些手指拂过拍摄者肩膀时，他才惊觉这条意大利面粗细的肢体已如触手般缠上脖颈。

画面天旋地转——那条胳膊将他猛拽向加固门，机枪般的撞击声与惨叫中，最后几个镜头记录着：男人被拖过新鲜破开的门洞时，天花板上正滑下颗肿胀头颅。那像婴儿头骨般隆起的巨大颅顶稀稀拉拉长着毛发，颈部却只有束破烂的肉茎支撑，鮟鱇鱼似的眼珠冷静注视着正在西瓜大破洞处挣扎的血肉大餐…它最终得逞了。

candidates.source:
Gettin' there a mite tricky, but not so tangled as jumpin' this whole castle.  They're less dear to go to an' fro, so t'speak, which is odd itself, I s'pose.

Down below, ye'll find a ring o' metal, wi' a terminal us'n has just set up.  Ol' Rubik set the words by hand, in preparation, so ye should ken it well enough.  Ye'll be a free - a volunteer to escolt it.  Good for you, good for we - more metal for you, and sell extras to we, aye?  Ye're free to go an' make use of it.  Keep mind 'at once you jump, the ring'll need a full five day rest afore it'll take ye again.

First time'll leave ya' addled, though, spin o' the boat race.  If ye've the grit, passes quick enough.
candidates.target:
到达那里有点棘手，但比跳过整个城堡要简单。去来去往，相对容易，这本身就有点奇怪，我想。

下面，你会发现一个金属环，一个终端刚刚设置好。老鲁比克亲手写了字，做准备，所以你应该很熟悉它。你将是自由的——一个志愿者来护送它。对你好，对我们好——更多的金属给你，你可以把多余的卖给我们，对吧？你可以自由地去使用它。记住，一旦你跳了，环需要完整休息五天，才能再带你。

第一次会让你头晕，就像船赛一样。如果你有勇气，很快就会过去。

candidates.source:
Peering over the crumbling lip of a building's parapet and capturing the sight of a heavily cratered cul-de-sac lit in the pale light of dawn, the video's opening shots tilt hither and dither as the camera's carefully adjusted and a low voice murmurs in the background.

"Well, it's day 4 of the apocalypse; the internet's still running somehow, and that's my cue to post another video, so welcome back, y'all.  I never thought that I'd be using YouTube as a way to try reaching out to people during a fucking zombie cataclysm, but here we are, so… yeah.  If you're watching, I guess, sound off in the comments that you're still around and, I don't know, like and subscribe to your daily coverage of hell."

The video's frame settles on the view of a modestly sized storefront, or, more precisely, half of a storefront.  The establishment's been supplemented by the addition of a semi-truck resting nose first through the shop's merchandise window, and, as you watch, you can make out a faint staring of movement from within the building.

"It's 9 in the morning.  I figured that y'all may as well join me as I see who around here wants a sample of Grampa's cure-all, and it looks like, folks, we have a taker."

The barrel of a large-caliber rifle edges into the frame, escorted by the rattle of a bolt being cycled and the slightly more unsettling tempo of the cameraman softly humming, "Another one bites the dust."  Thankfully for your musical sensibilities, the humming dissolves into a surprised breath as the rifle's sharply retreated from the parapet, the camera's jostled rearwards, and, from the ruins of the store, a ragged woman clambers over the debris and slides down upon the hood of the equally battered semi.  With her eyes bloodshot and misted over with an unblinking glaze, the woman staggers to her feet, an inflamed and seeping, purplish-red mass evident in her leg that speaks to unhealed fractures.  Hoisting the concrete-dusted bundle of a blanket and plushie to her chest as she all but collapses off the vehicle, the footage zooms in on the survivor as she limps about the truck's trailer and fumbles with the rear gate's locking latch, haltingly swinging the barrier down with a rusted shriek.  Disappearing within the container, a faint rattling announces the woman's eventual reemergence as she teeters behind the push-bar of a baby stroller.  A wan smile touches the corner of her slack lips as she parks the carriage by the truck, crumples to her knees, and fusses over the basket, tucking the plush toy within before enveloping the contents within the coverlet.

As the woman drags herself to the steering position and unsteadily sets off down the street, the film focuses on the stroller's interior.  The plastic toy of a baby is swaddled within.  Only its staring eyes and jagged sneer are visible across the shattered wreckage of the doll's face, and it's dressed in a set of baby clothes.  You've never seen a garment so completely crusted with dried blood.
candidates.target:
俯瞰着一座建筑破败的护墙上，视频的镜头捕捉到了一个布满坑洞的死胡同在破晓微光的照耀下，镜头摇晃着，随着摄像机仔细调整，背景中传来一个低沉的声音。

“嗯，这是世界末日第四天，互联网出乎意料地还在运行，这提醒我该发另一条视频了，所以欢迎回来，各位。我从没想过我会在僵尸启示录期间用YouTube来尝试与人们联系，但我们现在就是这样，所以……是的。如果你在看，我想，在评论区留言你还活着，我不知道，点赞并订阅你每天的地狱报道吧。”

视频的画面定格在一家小店的景象上，更准确地说，是半边店面。这家店被一辆半挂式卡车补充了，卡车头先撞进了商店的橱窗，当你观看时，你可以看到建筑物内微弱的动静。

“现在是早上9点。我想你们可能也想和我一起看看这里有谁想要尝尝爷爷的万能药，看起来，各位，我们有位顾客了。”

一把大口径步枪的枪管进入画面，伴随着拉枪栓的声响和摄像师轻声哼唱“又一个咬尘埃”的节奏，后者让人感觉更不舒服。感谢你的音乐感官，哼唱声变成了惊讶的呼吸，步枪迅速从护墙上撤回，摄像机被推向后，从商店的废墟中，一个满是灰尘的女人爬过瓦砾，滑落到同样破旧的卡车车头上。她的眼睛充血，被一种不眨眼的迷雾笼罩，女人摇摇晃晃地站起来，她腿上一个肿胀的紫红色肿块表明了未愈合的骨折。她把一捆沾满混凝土灰尘的毯子和毛绒玩具抱在胸前，几乎从车上摔了下来，视频放大了幸存者的画面，她跛行到卡车拖车旁，摸索着后门的锁扣，艰难地把栅栏向下推，发出刺耳的生锈声。在容器内消失后，微弱的声响宣告了女人的再次出现，她摇摇晃晃地站在婴儿车推杆后面。一个苍白的微笑触及她松弛的嘴唇的角落，她把婴儿车停在卡车旁，跪下，开始忙活篮子，把毛绒玩具放进去，然后用毯子包裹住。

当女人拖着自己到驾驶位置并摇摇晃晃地开车上路时，镜头聚焦在婴儿车内部。一个塑料婴儿玩具被包裹在里面。只有它直视的前线和破碎的娃娃脸上的锯齿状微笑是可见的，它穿着一套完全被干血凝固的婴儿衣服。你从未见过这样完全被血迹覆盖的衣服。
