The barrel of a large-caliber rifle edges into the frame, escorted by the rattle of a bolt being cycled and the slightly more unsettling tempo of the cameraman softly humming, "Another one bites the dust."  Thankfully for your musical sensibilities, the humming dissolves into a surprised breath as the rifle's sharply retreated from the parapet, the camera's jostled rearwards, and, from the ruins of the store, a ragged woman clambers over the debris and slides down upon the hood of the equally battered semi.  With her eyes bloodshot and misted over with an unblinking glaze, the woman staggers to her feet, an inflamed and seeping, purplish-red mass evident in her leg that speaks to unhealed fractures.  Hoisting the concrete-dusted bundle of a blanket and plushie to her chest as she all but collapses off the vehicle, the footage zooms in on the survivor as she limps about the truck's trailer and fumbles with the rear gate's locking latch, haltingly swinging the barrier down with a rusted shriek.  Disappearing within the container, a faint rattling announces the woman's eventual reemergence as she teeters behind the push-bar of a baby stroller.  A wan smile touches the corner of her slack lips as she parks the carriage by the truck, crumples to her knees, and fusses over the basket, tucking the plush toy within before enveloping the contents within the coverlet.

As the woman drags herself to the steering position and unsteadily sets off down the street, the film focuses on the stroller's interior.  The plastic toy of a baby is swaddled within.  Only its staring eyes and jagged sneer are visible across the shattered wreckage of the doll's face, and it's dressed in a set of baby clothes.  You've never seen a garment so completely crusted with dried blood.
candidates.target:
俯瞰着建筑残垣的破碎边缘，镜头捕捉到一条布满弹坑的死胡同，在黎明微光中显得格外惨白。视频开篇的镜头左右摇晃，相机似乎经过精心调整，而背景里传来低沉的喃喃声。

“好吧，今天是末日第四天；互联网居然还在运行，这给了我发布新视频的契机，欢迎大家回来。我从未想过，竟要用 YouTube 在丧尸大灾难中尝试联系他人，但如今我们已身处此地，所以……是的。如果你正在观看，请在评论区留言表明你依然安好，并且，我不知道，或许可以点赞并订阅你每日的地狱实况报道。”

画面稳定下来，对准一家规模不大的店面，更准确地说，是店面的一半。这家店铺被一辆半挂卡车头朝前撞穿商品橱窗后“补充”了新的元素；随着镜头推移，你能隐约看见建筑内部有微弱的动静。

“现在是上午九点。我想大家不妨跟我一起看看，这里还有谁想要尝尝‘爷爷’的万能灵药。看样子，各位，我们找到了一位‘顾客’。”

一把大口径步枪的枪口探入画面，伴随着拉栓的咔哒声，以及摄像师略显不安的低哼：“又一个倒下了。”幸运的是，出于对音乐审美的考虑，那哼唱很快被一声惊愕的吸气取代——步枪迅速从墙沿收回，相机也被向后猛推，而从废墟般的店铺中，一名衣衫褴褛的女子翻过瓦砾，滑落到同样伤痕累累的半挂车车顶上。她双眼充血，蒙着一层无法眨动的浑浊光晕，踉跄着站起，腿上有一团红肿渗液、呈紫红色的肿块，显然骨折尚未愈合。她几乎瘫倒在车上，将裹满灰尘的毯子和一个毛绒玩具紧紧抱在胸前。镜头拉近，聚焦于这名幸存者：她拖着伤腿在卡车拖车旁蹒跚而行，笨拙地摆弄后门的锁扣，艰难地摇下那道屏障，发出刺耳的锈蚀尖啸。她消失在集装箱内，随后一阵轻微的 rattling 宣告了她的再次出现——她摇晃着出现在婴儿推车的推杆后方。当她把推车停在卡车旁时，嘴角泛起一丝苍白的笑意，随即双膝跪地，俯身照料篮中的东西，将毛绒玩具塞进去，再用毯子将其包裹。

当这名女子拖曳着身体挪到驾驶位，摇摇晃晃地驶离街道时，镜头转向婴儿车内部。一个塑料婴儿玩偶被包裹其中。只有它空洞的眼睛和参差不齐的狞笑显露在破碎的玩偶脸上，它身穿一套婴儿服。你从未见过如此彻底被干涸血迹覆盖的衣物。

画面最终定格在一间中等规模的店铺前——准确说是半间。这家店的橱窗被一辆半挂卡车撞得粉碎，车头直接怼进了货架区。仔细观察的话，能发现建筑物内有微弱的动静。

大口径步枪的枪管突然入画，伴随拉栓的金属碰撞声，还有拍摄者哼着小调的阴森节奏：“又一位壮烈牺牲”。好在枪管突然从墙头缩回时，哼唱变成了倒抽冷气的声音。镜头剧烈晃动后移，只见废墟里钻出个衣衫褴褛的女人，她翻过瓦砾滑到同样伤痕累累的卡车引擎盖上。那双布满血丝的眼睛直勾勾盯着前方，腿上溃烂的紫红色肿块明显是未愈合的骨折伤。她紧抱着沾满水泥灰的毯子玩具包，几乎是滚下车的。镜头推近时，这个幸存者正跛着脚绕到挂车后方，哆哆嗦嗦地摆弄后门锁扣，生锈的闸门在刺耳声响中缓缓落下。

The modular field camp is the second most flexible kind of camp, but they require a lot of time and resources to build.  There are actually two different versions with slightly different layouts.  With both versions you start with an empty field which can be a field, hay field, farm field, or dirt road on a field, and build up from nothing.  You have a range of different building materials available from which buildings can be constructed, and different sections can be constructed from different materials to make the most of what you have available.
  You start by building a lean-to and a bed in the northeast corner of the central camp, and then typically add a cooking facility to it, and expand out until you have a small shelter for two people.  When the first building is complete, you can expand the camp in a variety of ways:
  1.  Version 1 allows building up to 5 more rooms or shacks with a maximum of 3 on each side of the camp that increases to a total of 8 with version 2.
  2.  You can build a central building in the south half of the camp, between the rooms in version 1, with version 2 having the central building in the center, shaping the camp into an 'H'.  The central building will act as a command center, allowing your camp to perform hunting, recruiting, and combat patrol missions.
  3.  In version 1 only you can dig trenches on all sides of the camp, which can possibly connect to the rooms on the sides to minimize the amount of trenching you need to do.
  4.  You can build various small features such as root cellars to preserve food or a radio tower to make it easier to recruit more companions.
  With each new construction in a modular camp can being able to be made from a different material you aren't constrained by what you start with.  If limited by resources, tents are a fast alternative way to provide shelter, but fragile and likely to get destroyed by the first zombie stumbling in, however the central building must still be made from a 'real' building material.
candidates.target:
模块化野营地是第二灵活的野营地类型，但建造需要大量时间和资源。实际上有两种略有不同的布局版本。在两种版本中，你都从一片空地开始，可以是田地、草场、农田或田间小道，然后从零开始建造。你有一系列可用的建筑材料，可以根据可用资源最大化地建造不同部分的建筑。

你从在野营地中央偏东北的角落建造一个简易棚和床开始，然后通常会添加一个烹饪设施，并继续扩展，直到有一个可容纳两个人的小避难所。当第一个建筑完成后，你可以以多种方式扩展野营地：

1. 第一版本允许建造多达5个额外的房间或小屋，每个营地两侧最多3个，第二版本增加到总共8个。
2. 你可以在营地南部一半的中心建造一个中央建筑，第一版本在房间之间，第二版本在中心，使野营地形成一个“H”形。中央建筑将作为指挥中心，使你的野营地能够执行狩猎、招募和战斗巡逻任务。
3. 只有在第一版本中，你可以在营地所有侧面挖掘战壕，可能与侧面的房间连接，以减少需要挖掘的战壕数量。
4. 你可以建造各种小设施，如根窖来保存食物或无线电塔，以更容易地招募更多同伴。

在模块化野营地中，每次新的建造都可以使用不同的材料，所以你不会受到开始时拥有的材料的限制。如果资源有限，帐篷是提供庇护的快速替代方法，但脆弱，可能会被第一个闯入的僵尸摧毁，然而中央建筑仍然必须使用“真实”的建筑材料建造。

3. 只有版本1可以在营地四周挖掘堑壕，堑壕可以与房间连接以减少挖掘量。
4. 可以建造各种小型设施，如用于保存食物的地下室，或招募新成员的无线电塔。
模块化营地的每个新建筑都可以用不同的材料建造，不再受起始材料的限制。如果受资源所限，帐篷能够提供快捷、廉价的居所，但极为脆弱。但是，中央建筑仍然必须以“真正”的建筑材料建造。

"Please state your name for the record."

"Fuck off."

"You are in possession of a fake driver's license issued to one Jonathan Smith, which is the alias you applied for employment with in our facility.  We will find out your real name in time, but I'll refer to you as Mr. Smith for this interview.  Is that acceptable, Mr. Smith?"

"Fuck off.  I want to talk to my lawyer."

"You don't have a lawyer."

"I know my rights, shithead.  You won't get a word out of me before I talk to my lawyer."

"You seem to be confused about your situation, Mr. Smith.  As far as the world is concerned you stopped existing the moment you entered this facility, and as far as we are concerned you stopped having rights as soon as you tried to access areas above your provisional clearance.  Let me present your options going forward:  You continue withholding information from us and you will suffer a meticulously-documented accident leaving no doubt to your demise even though no body will ever be found.  Or you cooperate fully and without hesitation, in which case you will get to see the sky again and act like nothing has happened.  Am I understood?"

"…yes."

"Please state your name for the record."

"M-my name is Thomas Wright.  I'm a, uh, a freelance journalist."

"What were you trying to accomplish in this facility, Mr. Wright?"

"There was th-this guy offering good money for some pictures from the inside of this place."

"I don't suppose this man told you his name?"

"No, no… He just handed me the application forms and the license, paid quarter up front, and said to bring the pictures to the same spot in a week's time."

"What did he say to expect here?"

"This place is… look, you can't expect people not to talk about it, right?  You can't just put up a warehouse of a shipping company nobody's heard of practically overnight and act like it was always here.  He said you guys were a, uh, top secret prison for political prisoners."

"That explains your attempts to clumsily pick the first closed door you came across.  How did your employer contact you?"

"A friend of a friend gave him my number, at least according to him.  If you haven't noticed in here times are tough, so I couldn't really afford to be picky about work even before he started throwing cash around."

"Very well.  While we verify that account my colleagues here will take you through a tour of our facility:  You will take photographs with your "hidden" camera when and where they instruct you to.  You will submit these pictures for review and remain in our custody until we can be certain of your compliance.  You will be released and at the appointed time you will hand over the pictures to your employer.  You will not mention this conversation to them, or to anybody outside of this room.  You will enjoy your well-earned payment, far away from this facility.  Am I understood?"

"Yes, sir, I can do that."

"Excellent, Mr. Wright.  I look forward to never seeing you again."
candidates.target:
“请为记录报上你的名字。”

“去你的。”

“你持有伪造的驾驶执照，名字是乔纳森·史密斯，这也是你在我们设施这里申请工作时使用的化名。我们最终会查出你真实的名字，但在这次谈话中，我会称你为史密斯先生。可以吗，史密斯先生？”

“去你的。我要见我的律师。”

“你没有律师。”

“我知道我的权利，混蛋。在我见了律师之前，你别想从我这里得到任何信息。”

“你似乎对你的处境很困惑，史密斯先生。就这个世界而言，你进入这里的一刻起就消失了；就我们而言，你试图进入超出你临时许可的区域那一刻，你就失去了权利。让我向你展示你以后的选择：你继续隐瞒信息，你将遭遇一个精心策划的意外，尽管不会找到尸体，但会让人们确信你已经死亡。或者你完全、毫不犹豫地配合我们，这样你就能再次看到天空，就像什么都没发生过一样。你明白了吗？”

“...明白了。”

“请为记录报上你的名字。”

“我...我叫托马斯·赖特。我是一个...嗯...自由记者。”

“你试图在这个设施里达到什么目的，赖特先生？”

“有个人愿意花大价钱买一些这个地方内部的照片。”

“我猜这个人没有告诉你他的名字？”

“没有，没有...他只是给了我申请表和驾照，预付了四分之一的费用，让我一周后把照片带到同一个地方。”

“他告诉你在这里会遇到什么吗？”

“这个地方是...看，你不能指望人们不谈论它，对吧？你不能在一夜之间建起一个几乎没有人听说过的货运公司的仓库，然后假装它一直都存在。他说你们这里是一个秘密的政治犯监狱。”

“这解释了你试图强行打开第一个遇到的关闭的门的原因。你的雇主是如何联系你的？”

“一个朋友的朋友给了他我的号码，至少据他说是这样。如果你没注意到，这里的时间很紧迫，所以即使他在扔钱之前，我也不能挑三拣四地选择工作。”

“好吧。在我们核实这个说法的时候，我的同事会带你参观我们的设施：当他们指示你的时候，你用你的“隐藏”相机拍照。你将提交这些照片供我们审查，并在我们确信你配合之前一直由我们监管。你将被释放，并在指定的时间把照片交给你的雇主。你不会把这次谈话告诉他们，也不会告诉这个房间以外的人。你将享受你辛苦赚来的报酬，远离这个设施。明白了吗？”

“是的，先生，我可以做到。”

“太好了，赖特先生。我期待着永远不会再见到你。”

“有，有这么一个人，他为从这里拍些照片提供优厚的报酬。”

candidates.source: Ok, ladies and gentlemen, this is DJ Dustbowl, you're tuned into Dark Days Radio, and if you're hearing this, then let's have an amen because it means we all made it out of the storm.  That is, if the storm was a widespread thing and not just neatly centered atop my head.  If that's the case and y'all didn't catch my broadcast, the bottom line's that reality was breaking, just like when this nonsense started.  Now, I don't know if it'll happen again, but let's use today's survival tip slot to see what we can learn from it.  Number one, folks, if reality's shitting the bed, don't try to fight anything that appears.  If you're caught outside, my advice is to just run for cover, and you'd be best served by snuggling underground.  Failing that, closing all the curtains and barricading the doors will work in a pinch.  Most importantly, people, if you hear something outside, regardless of what it might be, stuff your ears and ignore it.  You'll hear things that will make you want to open the front door.  I heard… I opened up.  You don't want to see what'll be waiting for you.
candidates.target: 好了，女士们、先生们，我是DJ尘埃碗，你们收听的是黑暗时代电台。如果你们能听到这段话，那就让我们一起说声“阿门”，因为这意味着我们都从风暴中活了下来。也就是说，如果这场风暴是普遍性的，而不仅仅是集中在我头顶上。如果情况是这样，而你们没有听到我的广播，那么底线是现实正在崩溃，就像这个荒唐事开始时一样。现在，我不知道它是否会再次发生，但让我们利用今天的生存技巧时段来看看我们能从中学到什么。第一，朋友们，如果现实正在崩溃，不要试图抵抗任何出现的东西。如果你在户外，我的建议是赶快找掩体，最好是躲到地下。如果做不到，关上所有窗帘，堵住门也会有帮助。最重要的是，人们，如果你在外面听到什么，无论是什么，都塞住耳朵，忽略它。你会听到一些让你想打开前门的声音。我听到过...我打开了门。你可不想看到门外在等着你的东西。

This appears to be somebody's saved to-do list, with a green checkmark rounding off each entry, save for the last.

To-do:

Pack the car with a few weeks worth of provisions: clothes and shoes, toiletries and medications, electronics and games, a portable steamer, and camping equipment (tents, a cooking set, sleeping bags, a propane cooker, and some tanks).  Dig out dad's Vietnam AK47 from the packing boxes in the basement and hunt around for his old reloading equipment (look up how it works).  If the kids ask, just say it's for hunting.

File for extended leave from work and withdraw the kids from school.  If Erith complains about having to leave uni and her girlfriend, say it's only temporary.

Take the car and stop by the supermarket for some pre-packed camping meals before heading to pick up the kids.

Head into Scofield's on the way out of town to pick up some bullets.  Should probably ask Julian for advice and help; he plays videogames with this sort of stuff. candidates.source:
The entire view pitches and rocks unsteadily, with the top bar of a ship's guardrail visible at the frame's base and a frothing ocean stretching for as far as the eye can see.  A muddled mix of desperate liturgies and shouts meld with the background rattle of gunfire; the sounds all but drown beneath the ear-splitting shriek of the video's subject: an enormous, writhing mass of gelatinous tentacles breaching the water and tussling with the bows of a military transport.  Floundering in the midground, the transport's all but subsumed beneath the megalithic limbs, rows of hooked barbs digging into the steel plating, the appendages connected to a gargantuan, scaly form that thrashes beneath the waves.  As the vessel is hoisted from the water and the tiny silhouettes of soldiers are dragged into the various slavering maws lining the tentacles like masses of krill, small specks appear in the sky on the horizon.

A sonic boom resounds and the specks resolve into a flight of low-flying fighter jets.  Bellies laden with ordinance, the aircraft dive towards the struggle, harpoon missiles streaking free of their armament bays before they steeply climb.  Columns of water and yellowish ichor spurt skyward as the weapons find their mark, sending chunks of quivering flesh showering across the scene as the pummeled ship crashes back into the water.  As the behemoth's corpse slips beneath the waves, two jets bank around and sweep low, depositing depth charges over the creature's liquid grave.

As the subsurface bombs detonate in a wave of bloody water, the final shot depicts the wrecked ship as it joins its attacker beneath the waves, a solitary soldier clinging to the uppermost reaches of the vessel as it sinks into the abyss.
candidates.target:
整个画面摇晃着，不稳定地起伏着，船栏杆的上沿在画框底部可见，一望无际的海洋翻滚着白浪。一阵混乱的祈祷声和喊叫声与背景中枪声的嗡嗡声混杂在一起；这些声音几乎被视频主题的刺耳尖叫声淹没：一只巨大的、挣扎着的、像凝胶一样的触手从水中跃出，与一艘军用运输船的船头缠斗。运输船在画面中间挣扎着，几乎被这些巨大的肢体所吞没，一排排钩状的刺深入钢板中，这些触手连接着一只巨大的、鳞片覆盖的生物，它在波浪下翻滚。当船只从水中升起，士兵们被拖入触手上像群居甲壳类动物一样的巨大口中时，天空中地平线处出现了一些小点。

音速轰鸣声响起，这些小点变成了一群低空飞行的战斗机。飞机带着满载的武器俯冲向这场搏斗，鱼叉式导弹从它们的武器舱中射出，然后陡然爬升。当武器命中目标时，水柱和黄色的液体喷射向天空，震耳欲聋，将颤抖的肉块洒满整个场景，被殴打的船只再次坠入水中。当这只巨兽的尸体沉入波浪时，两架飞机转弯，低空飞行，在生物的液体坟墓上投下了深度炸弹。

当水下炸弹在血水浪潮中爆炸时，最后一幕展示了这艘被摧毁的船只，它加入了攻击者的行列，沉入深渊，一名士兵独自一人紧握着船只的最高处，随着它沉入深渊。

The entire view pitches and rocks unsteadily, with the top bar of a ship's guardrail visible at the frame's base and a frothing ocean stretching for as far as the eye can see.  A muddled mix of desperate liturgies and shouts meld with the background rattle of gunfire; the sounds all but drown beneath the ear-splitting shriek of the video's subject: an enormous, writhing mass of gelatinous tentacles breaching the water and tussling with the bows of a military transport.  Floundering in the midground, the transport's all but subsumed beneath the megalithic limbs, rows of hooked barbs digging into the steel plating, the appendages connected to a gargantuan, scaly form that thrashes beneath the waves.  As the vessel is hoisted from the water and the tiny silhouettes of soldiers are dragged into the various slavering maws lining the tentacles like masses of krill, small specks appear in the sky on the horizon.

A sonic boom resounds and the specks resolve into a flight of low-flying fighter jets.  Bellies laden with ordinance, the aircraft dive towards the struggle, harpoon missiles streaking free of their armament bays before they steeply climb.  Columns of water and yellowish ichor spurt skyward as the weapons find their mark, sending chunks of quivering flesh showering across the scene as the pummeled ship crashes back into the water.  As the behemoth's corpse slips beneath the waves, two jets bank around and sweep low, depositing depth charges over the creature's liquid grave.

As the subsurface bombs detonate in a wave of bloody water, the final shot depicts the wrecked ship as it joins its attacker beneath the waves, a solitary soldier clinging to the uppermost reaches of the vessel as it sinks into the abyss.
candidates.target:
整个视野摇摇晃晃，令人不安。画面的底部可见军舰栏杆顶端，眼前尽是一望无际的翻滚海洋。绝望的祷文和呼喊声与背景中的枪声混杂在一起，几乎都被视频主角那震耳欲聋的尖叫声淹没：一个巨大的、蠕动的、胶状触手团从水中冲出，与军用运输船的船头搏斗。在画面中景中挣扎的运输船几乎完全被巨大的肢体吞噬，一排排倒钩般的棘刺深深嵌入钢板上，这些附肢连接着一个巨大的、鳞片状的躯体，在水下剧烈地抽搐。当船只被从水中抬起，士兵们微小的身影被拖入触手上一个个贪婪的血盆大口，如同磷虾一样，天空中地平线上出现了小小的亮点。

随着水下炸弹掀起血浪，最后一个镜头记录下残破的运输船追随袭击者沉入深渊。当船体坠向无底黑暗时，唯剩一名士兵死死攀附在最高处的桅杆上。

This appears to be a civil-protection video, published by the Federal Emergency Management Agency a handful of days before the official evacuation order was declared.  Within the clip, standing within a plain-featured, well-lit room behind a steel table, a close-shaven redhead in a light olive shirt demonstrates the proper donning and doffing procedure for a gas mask, as well as providing general tips and information for proper NBC conduct.  Mask in hand and with an assortment of cylindrical filters arrayed upon the table, she demonstrates dawning, screwing in the proper filter, pressurizing the mask for an airtight seal, and repeatedly encouraging the viewer to "Remember, gentlemen, shave your chin first before even thinking about trying to put on a mask.  That goes for you as well, ladies.  All that hair—ponytails, pigtails, bangs, whatever—needs to go right out the window.  You can keep the eyebrows, though."

At the video's conclusion, the instructor outlines several tactics for protecting one's self from biological contaminants, including several methods for distilling water, sealing the edges of doors and window frames with masking tape, and formulating a makeshift NBC suit from multi-layered water-proof rubber storm coats, waders, gloves, and a liberal amount of duct tape.  Ultimately, the clip rounds off with a solemn warning that "all the equipment in the world won't protect you from negligence and stupidity, for all the keyboard warriors and self-proclaimed preppers watching.  All this gear is only meant to allow you to evacuate to a safer area, and that's all it'll do.  It won't let you ride out a catastrophe indefinitely, so it's still important that you keep your heads down and proceed to an evacuation gathering point if and when the call goes out."

这似乎是一部民防视频，由联邦紧急事务管理署在官方疏散命令发布前几天发布。在视频中，一个光头红发女子穿着浅橄榄色衬衫，站在光线明亮、朴素的房间里，身后有一张钢制桌子，她演示了正确佩戴和摘除防毒面具的程序，并提供了关于适当核生化防护的一般提示和信息。她手里拿着防毒面具，桌上摆放着各种圆柱形过滤器，演示了如何佩戴面具、安装正确的过滤器、为确保密封而加压面具，并一再提醒观众：“记住，先生们，在考虑戴面具之前，先把胡子刮掉。女士们也一样。所有的头发——马尾、双马尾、刘海，不管是什么——都必须完全剪掉。不过，眉毛可以留着。”

在视频的结尾，指导员概述了几种保护自己免受生物污染的方法，包括几种蒸馏水的办法、用遮蔽胶带密封门窗边框，以及如何用多层防水橡胶雨衣、雨裤、手套和大量胶带制作临时核生化防护服。最后，视频以一个严肃的警告结束：“世界上所有的设备都无法保护你免受疏忽和大意的影响，所有的键盘侠和自封的准备者们，请注意。所有这些装备只是让你能够疏散到更安全的地区，它们只能做到这一点。它们不会让你无限期地度过灾难，所以如果疏散命令下达，你仍然要保持警惕，前往疏散集结点。”

The background of this recording is underscored by a bazaar of swirling noise and muffled cracks emanating through the audio, causing a faint and inexplicable tingling sensation to prickle at the roots of your teeth.  "Dear Diary," mumbles a child's voice.  "It's been a few hours since all the weirdness started, and there are still noises outside, so I guess it isn't over.  We're still hiding in the armory building, and…"

"Hey, kid," interjects a woman's horse voice.  "We need to save that thing's charge, so, mind not draining it all."

Muttering a reluctant apology, a light thwack and swish jostle the audio as some manner of cover is lowered over the recording device and the child slides it to the floor, the feed still unterminated.  Moments pass, during which only the disquieting sounds of a world in unnatural flux can be heard, accompanied by the clinking of various small metal objects being toyed with next to the microphone.  Eventually, the uncomfortable silence is broken as the woman clears her voice.

"Listen… I'm sorry.  Honestly, I don't really care about it too much: it's just that… I'm just as scared as you are."

"I thought soldiers didn't get scared."

Any form of reply is cut off as a frantic banging suddenly batters into the soundscape: with a man's muffled shrieks for help audible as the child, alarm raising their voice by several octaves, cries, "That's dad!  We've got to open the door!"

A scramble ensues, eventually culminating in the child's yelling protests as they're evidently restrained.

"Listen to me," the woman's voice barks.  "Kid, you can't open that door.  The thing out there ain't your dad."

"What're you talking about?" the youth sobs.  The soldier's cadence softens with no small measure of sadness as she audibly pulls the struggling child to a sitting position by the microphone.

"No one knows we're in here," she replies.  "Nobody would be begging to be let in.  Plus, no one could have lasted this long outside.  Just, cover your ears.  It'll stop once it realizes it's not fooling anyone."

As the screams and pleas grow increasingly distorted, eventually verging on a blood-curdling wail, the youth sniffles, "Then, what is it?"

Long moments pass, during which the child's weeping grows muted as they're pulled into an evident embrace.  "Not a person," the woman eventually whispers.  "Definitely not a person."

这段录音的背景充斥着一种令人不安的嘶嘶声和模糊的裂纹，从音频中传出，让你的牙齿根部感到一阵阵微弱而难以解释的刺痛感。

“亲爱的日记，”一个孩子的声音低声说道。“奇怪的事情已经持续了几个小时，外面仍然有声音，所以我想它还没有结束。我们仍然藏在军火库里，和…”

“嘿，小鬼，”一个女人的嘶哑声音打断了孩子。“我们需要节省这个东西的电量，所以，别把它用光。”

孩子不情愿地道歉后，轻微的拍打和沙沙声搅动了音频，某种遮盖物被盖在录音设备上，孩子把它滑到地上，音频信号仍然未中断。片刻之间，只能听到一个世界在不自然变化中发出的令人不安的声音，伴随着各种小金属物体在麦克风旁边被玩弄时发出的叮当声。最终，不舒服的沉默被女人清嗓子的声音打破了。

“听着……我很抱歉。老实说，我其实不太在意它：只是……我和你一样害怕。”

“我以为士兵不会害怕。”

一个男人压低声音绝望地呼救，孩子惊慌地提高了几度音调，喊道：“那是爸爸！我们必须打开门！”

混乱中，孩子明显被制止了。

“听我说，”女人的声音严厉地说。“小鬼，你不能打开那扇门。外面那东西不是你的爸爸。”

“你在说什么？”年轻人抽泣着。士兵的语气变得柔和，带着不小的悲伤，她明显地把挣扎的孩子拉到麦克风旁边坐下。

“没有人知道我们在这里，”她回答。“没有人会乞求被放进来。加上，没有人能在外面坚持这么久。只是，捂住你的耳朵。它会停止，一旦它意识到它骗不了任何人。”

随着尖叫和求救声越来越扭曲，最终变成令人毛骨悚然的哀嚎，年轻人抽泣着，“那么，它是什么？”

长时间过去了，孩子的哭声变得微弱，显然被拥入怀中。“不是人，”女人最终低声说道。“绝对不是人。”

The background of this recording is underscored by a bazaar of swirling noise and muffled cracks emanating through the audio, causing a faint and inexplicable tingling sensation to prickle at the roots of your teeth.  "Dear Diary," mumbles a child's voice.  "It's been a few hours since all the weirdness started, and there are still noises outside, so I guess it isn't over.  We're still hiding in the armory building, and…"

"Hey, kid," interjects a woman's horse voice.  "We need to save that thing's charge, so, mind not draining it all."

Muttering a reluctant apology, a light thwack and swish jostle the audio as some manner of cover is lowered over the recording device and the child slides it to the floor, the feed still unterminated.  Moments pass, during which only the disquieting sounds of a world in unnatural flux can be heard, accompanied by the clinking of various small metal objects being toyed with next to the microphone.  Eventually, the uncomfortable silence is broken as the woman clears her voice.

"Listen… I'm sorry.  Honestly, I don't really care about it too much: it's just that… I'm just as scared as you are."

"I thought soldiers didn't get scared."

Any form of reply is cut off as a frantic banging suddenly batters into the soundscape: with a man's muffled shrieks for help audible as the child, alarm raising their voice by several octaves, cries, "That's dad!  We've got to open the door!"

A scramble ensues, eventually culminating in the child's yelling protests as they're evidently restrained.

"Listen to me," the woman's voice barks.  "Kid, you can't open that door.  The thing out there ain't your dad."

"What're you talking about?" the youth sobs.  The soldier's cadence softens with no small measure of sadness as she audibly pulls the struggling child to a sitting position by the microphone.

"No one knows we're in here," she replies.  "Nobody would be begging to be let in.  Plus, no one could have lasted this long outside.  Just, cover your ears.  It'll stop once it realizes it's not fooling anyone."

As the screams and pleas grow increasingly distorted, eventually verging on a blood-curdling wail, the youth sniffles, "Then, what is it?"

Long moments pass, during which the child's weeping grows muted as they're pulled into an evident embrace.  "Not a person," the woman eventually whispers.  "Definitely not a person."

这段录音的背景充斥着漩涡般的杂音和沉闷的爆裂声，透过音频传来，令人的牙根泛起一阵微弱而难以名状的刺痛感。“亲爱的日记，”一个孩子的声音喃喃道，“自从那些怪事开始已经过去几个小时了，外面仍然有声音，看来还没结束。我们还在军械库大楼里躲着，而且……"

“嘿，孩子，”一个女人的声音插了进来，语调有些嘶哑，“得省着点那东西的电量，别把它全耗光了。”

孩子不情愿地低声道歉，伴随着一声轻微的拍打和摩擦声，某种遮盖物被拉到了录音设备上，孩子将它推到了地板上，录音并未中断。片刻之后，耳边只剩下这个异常动荡的世界所发出的令人不安的声响，以及麦克风旁摆弄各种小型金属物件时发出的叮当声。最终，令人不适的寂静被打破，女人清了清嗓子。

“听着……对不起。说实话，我其实没那么在意：只是……我也和你一样害怕。”

“我以为士兵不会害怕。”

任何回应都被突然爆发的疯狂敲击声打断：男人的闷哼求救声隐约可闻，孩子惊恐地提高了几个八度喊道：“那是爸爸！我们必须开门！”

一阵慌乱随之展开，最终以孩子被明显束缚住时的哭喊抗议告终。

“听我说，”女人的声音严厉地响起，“孩子，你不能开那扇门。外面的东西根本不是你的爸爸。”

“你在说什么？”少年抽泣着问。士兵的语调软化下来，带着不小的伤感，她显然在麦克风旁将挣扎的孩子拉到了坐姿。

“没人知道我们在里面，”她回答，“没人会求着进来。而且，也没人能撑这么久在外面。只是，捂住耳朵。等它意识到骗不了人，就会停下来的。”

随着尖叫和哀求声愈发扭曲，最终接近令人毛骨悚然的嚎叫，少年抽着鼻子问：“那它是什么？”

漫长的沉默过后，孩子的哭声逐渐微弱，因为他被拉进了一个明显的拥抱中。“不是人，”女人最终低语道，“绝对不是人。”

When you assign a companion to a faction camp mission, they'll disappear while they go do whatever you want them to do.  When the duration of the mission has elapsed, you'll see a new mission on the bulletin board to have them return and complete the mission by upgrading your camp, returning their hunting kills, dropping off whatever they were crafting, or whatever else the mission results are.
  There are all kinds of faction camp missions: building up the camp, recruiting new allies, hunting and trapping game, scrounging for materials, farming, disassembling cars, and more.  Not all activities can be done at every camp - you may need to build some additional buildings, or expand the camp, to get access to some missions.
  Some faction camp missions can be duplicated by companion activities, but building up the camp can only be done via faction camp missions, as only completion of camp construction missions are recognized as fulfillment of those goals.
  You assign missions by interacting with the bulletin board.  You'll see a list of available missions for your central camp tile.  If your camp has expansions, you can tab through the expansions to see the available missions at each expansion.
  Remember, companions on camp missions need to be fed, and will become angry if they complete a mission but there isn't any food in the larder.
  There is one special mission called 'Emergency Recall'.  You can use this to retrieve any companion on a faction camp mission, but this cancels the mission and wastes any resources used on it.  Only use it to recover allies when something has gone really wrong with your camp and you can't get them to come back any other way.
candidates.target:
当你派遣伙伴执行派系营地任务时，他们会暂时消失，去完成你分配的任务。当任务时间结束时，你会在布告板上看到新的任务，让他们返回并完成任务，比如升级营地、带回猎物、交付他们制作的物品，或者其他任务结果。

有各种各样的派系营地任务：建设营地、招募新盟友、狩猎和捕获野生动物、收集材料、耕种、拆卸汽车等。并非所有活动都可以在每个营地进行——你可能需要建造一些额外建筑，或者扩展营地，才能解锁一些任务。

有些派系营地任务可以通过伙伴活动重复完成，但建设营地只能通过派系营地任务来实现，因为只有完成营地建设任务才能被视为达成这些目标。

你可以通过与布告板互动来分配任务。你会看到一份可用的中央营地瓷砖任务列表。如果你的营地有扩展，你可以切换到扩展部分，查看每个扩展的可用任务。

记住，执行营地任务的伙伴需要食物，如果完成任务时营地没有食物，他们会变得愤怒。

有一个特殊任务叫做“紧急召回”。你可以使用它来召回任何执行派系营地任务的伙伴，但这会取消任务并浪费已使用的资源。只有在营地出现严重问题，其他方法无法让伙伴返回时，才使用这个任务。

派系营地任务种类繁多：建设营地、招募新盟友、狩猎和设置陷阱捕捉动物、搜寻材料、耕种、拆卸汽车等等。并非所有活动都可以在每个营地进行——你可能需要建造一些额外的建筑，或者扩展营地，才能获得某些任务。

一些派系营地任务可以通过同伴活动复制，但建设营地只能通过派系营地任务完成，因为只有完成营地建设任务才会被视为完成了这些目标。

你可以通过与公告板互动来指派任务。你将看到中央营地地砖上可用的任务列表。如果你的营地有扩展区，你可以切换扩展区来查看每个扩展区可用的任务。

请记住，执行营地任务的同伴需要喂食，如果他们完成任务但食物储藏室里没有食物，他们会变得愤怒。

有一个特殊的任务叫做“紧急召回”。你可以用它来召回任何执行派系营地任务的同伴，但这会取消任务并浪费掉其中使用的任何资源。只有在你营地出现严重问题，无法通过其他方式让他们返回时，才使用它来回收盟友。

candidates.source:
When you assign a companion to a faction camp mission, they'll disappear while they go do whatever you want them to do.  When the duration of the mission has elapsed, you'll see a new mission on the bulletin board to have them return and complete the mission by upgrading your camp, returning their hunting kills, dropping off whatever they were crafting, or whatever else the mission results are.
  There are all kinds of faction camp missions: building up the camp, recruiting new allies, hunting and trapping game, scrounging for materials, farming, disassembling cars, and more.  Not all activities can be done at every camp - you may need to build some additional buildings, or expand the camp, to get access to some missions.
  Some faction camp missions can be duplicated by companion activities, but building up the camp can only be done via faction camp missions, as only completion of camp construction missions are recognized as fulfillment of those goals.
  You assign missions by interacting with the bulletin board.  You'll see a list of available missions for your central camp tile.  If your camp has expansions, you can tab through the expansions to see the available missions at each expansion.
  Remember, companions on camp missions need to be fed, and will become angry if they complete a mission but there isn't any food in the larder.
  There is one special mission called 'Emergency Recall'.  You can use this to retrieve any companion on a faction camp mission, but this cancels the mission and wastes any resources used on it.  Only use it to recover allies when something has gone really wrong with your camp and you can't get them to come back any other way.

阵营营地任务种类繁多：包括建设营地、招募新盟友、狩猎与设陷阱获取猎物、搜寻材料、耕种、拆解车辆等。并非所有活动都能在任意营地执行——您可能需要建造某些额外建筑或扩展营地，才能解锁部分任务。

部分阵营营地任务可由同伴的日常活动重复完成，但“建设营地”类任务只能通过阵营营地任务来完成，因为只有完成营地建设类任务才会被认定为达成相应目标。

您通过互动公告板来分配任务。您将看到中央营地地块可用的任务列表；若营地已扩展，可切换至各扩展区域，查看该区域可用的任务。

当你指派同伴执行营地任务时，他们会凭空消失并去执行任务。当任务完成后，你会在公告板上看到一个新的任务，让他们返回并真正的完成任务：例如升级营地，送回猎物，放下制造完的物品，或者其他的任务结果。
营地任务的种类很多：建造营地建筑，招募新同伴，打猎和设置陷阱，寻找材料，干农活，拆卸载具等等。不是每个营地都包含所有的任务，你可能需要建造一些额外的建筑物，或建造营地扩展区，来解锁新任务。

请记住，外出执行营地任务的同伴仍然需要食物，当他们完成了任务返回，而食物储备中又没有任何食物的话，他们会生气的。

candidates.source: It be a right coddle to yark, but ol' Rubik'll do as can.  Them as we send a'far, what I'd assert as 'escolts'… explorers?  They's escolted a place with a mite o' promise, an I'm ken.  A wall o' crete-stone, abreast a rattlin' clunker… a 'bunker'.  Not so odd in a deadlands alas, but this'n gots the comin's and goin's.  Sommat's still in there, an' ol' Rubik wonders who.  Be they friend or foe?  What say ye t'helpin' with a mite o' escoltin' y'self?
candidates.target: 这是一个值得探索的地方，但老鲁比克会尽他最大的努力。我们派去的那些人，我称之为“护送者”……探索者？他们护送了一个有潜力的地方，我知道。一个混凝土墙，旁边有一辆吱吱作响的破车……一个“掩体”。在荒地上这并不稀奇，但这个有进出的人。里面还有东西，老鲁比克想知道是谁。他们是友军还是敌人？你愿意帮忙一起探索吗？

candidates.source:
Peeking down from a pole mount, this segment of security camera footage films the apex of a bridge overpass's boarding ramp.  A number of large police and military vehicles loom at the concrete incline's foot, with a low line of sandbags forming a makeshift checkpoint behind which several armed national guardsmen and police officers stand at attention.  The view, however, is mainly taken up by a veritable metal wall of civilian vehicles crawling in a haphazard line across the bridge, disheveled groups of exhausted men, women, and children flitting alongside the slow procession of evacuating vehicles.  The footage proceeds in this fashion for several minutes, with new groups of refugees being waved through by the soldiers, before a distant sonic boom resounds through the audio.  Gradually coming to a halt, with the heads of civilians and personnel alike inclined skyward and tense expressions adorning unkempt faces, the stream stands in collective puzzlement as the sound of powerful jet engines can be heard in the background, steadily rising in volume.  The collective apathy dissolves into utter, terrified pandemonium as a large shadow rapidly darkens the overpass and an officer suddenly screams, "CLEAR THE BRIDGE!"

With a number of fresh whistling sounds dominating the newly overwhelmed soundscape, soldiers grab those they can and race clear of the checkpoint as panicked civilians fling themselves off the overpass, rapidly joined by the occupants of those vehicles on the edges of the stagnated convoy.  In the last few shots, you can see the drivers of cars at the procession's heart struggle to abandon their vehicles before a sleek form streaks from the sky, the start of an ear-splitting explosion rips through the muddled audio, and the view goes white.
candidates.target:
从杆上向下窥视，这段监控录像拍摄了桥梁上坡道顶端的情况。在混凝土坡道的脚下，停放着多辆大型警车和军车，低矮的沙袋排成一线，形成了一个临时检查站，几名全副武装的国民警卫队员和警察站立在检查站后面。然而，画面主要被一辆接一辆的民用车辆占据，它们在桥上缓慢移动，混乱的人群中，疲惫的男女老少在缓慢的撤离车辆旁边穿梭。录像以这种方式持续了几分钟，士兵们挥手让新的难民通过，然后远处传来一声震耳欲聋的声爆。

逐渐停下来，平民和人员的头都抬向天空，紧张的表情在凌乱的面孔上显现，人群集体陷入困惑，因为可以听到强大喷气式发动机的声音从背景中逐渐升起。集体冷漠转变为完全的恐惧和混乱，一个巨大的阴影迅速笼罩住桥梁，一名军官突然大喊：“清空桥梁！”

伴随着新的尖锐的哨声主导了新的混乱声景，士兵们抓住他们能抓住的人，迅速跑离检查站，惊慌失措的平民从桥梁上跳下，很快加入了停在边缘的车辆上的人们。在最后几帧中，可以看到车在队伍中心的人们努力放弃他们的车辆，然后一个光滑的物体从天而降，震耳欲聋的爆炸声撕裂了混乱的音效，画面变白。

candidates.target:
从一个杆架上俯视，这段安全摄像头录像拍摄了桥梁立交桥的登桥坡顶。许多警车和军用车辆停在混凝土斜坡的脚下，低矮的沙袋墙形成了一个临时检查站，几个武装国民警卫队队员和警察站在那里，纹丝不动。然而，画面主要被一堵由民用车辆组成的金属墙占据，这些车辆杂乱无章地沿着桥面缓慢爬行，疲惫不堪的人们、妇女和儿童在疏散车辆的缓慢队伍中穿梭。录像以这种方式持续了数分钟，士兵们示意新的一批难民通过，然后远处传来一声声波轰鸣。随着人们的头——无论是平民还是人员——都仰望天空，脸上带着紧张的表情，这支队伍陷入了集体困惑之中，背景中可以听到强大的喷气式发动机的声音，声音越来越大。随着一个巨大的阴影迅速笼罩立交桥，一个军官突然尖叫道：“清空桥梁！”

伴随着许多新的哨声主宰了新的声音景观，士兵们抓住他们能抓住的人，并迅速远离检查站，而惊慌失措的平民则从立交桥上跳下，很快就被那些停在队伍边缘的车辆的乘客加入了进来。在最后几张镜头中，你可以看到队伍中心车辆的司机努力放弃他们的车辆，然后一个光滑的物体从天空中划过，一声震耳欲聋的爆炸撕裂了混乱的声音，画面一片雪白。

Peeking down from a pole mount, this segment of security camera footage films the apex of a bridge overpass's boarding ramp.  A number of large police and military vehicles loom at the concrete incline's foot, with a low line of sandbags forming a makeshift checkpoint behind which several armed national guardsmen and police officers stand at attention.  The view, however, is mainly taken up by a veritable metal wall of civilian vehicles crawling in a haphazard line across the bridge, disheveled groups of exhausted men, women, and children flitting alongside the slow procession of evacuating vehicles.  The footage proceeds in this fashion for several minutes, with new groups of refugees being waved through by the soldiers, before a distant sonic boom resounds through the audio.  Gradually coming to a halt, with the heads of civilians and personnel alike inclined skyward and tense expressions adorning unkempt faces, the stream stands in collective puzzlement as the sound of powerful jet engines can be heard in the background, steadily rising in volume.  The collective apathy dissolves into utter, terrified pandemonium as a large shadow rapidly darkens the overpass and an officer suddenly screams, "CLEAR THE BRIDGE!"

With a number of fresh whistling sounds dominating the newly overwhelmed soundscape, soldiers grab those they can and race clear of the checkpoint as panicked civilians fling themselves off the overpass, rapidly joined by the occupants of those vehicles on the edges of the stagnated convoy.  In the last few shots, you can see the drivers of cars at the procession's heart struggle to abandon their vehicles before a sleek form streaks from the sky, the start of an ear-splitting explosion rips through the muddled audio, and the view goes white.

candidates.source: 'Tis as simple as comes to a wobble.  Our vestment be oft made from the fine clothes and hides of the land, and our jibber tears the stuff o' life apart here and there when us'n travel.  For as some can be saved if care be taken, there be no case to store nigh enough o' this.  That, an' our manuc-makers run as hot as a sunstone, no spit'n taste for that which we don't use usselves.

F'r to wax religious, eh?

*Rubik pauses for a while.  When they start talking again, their voice is slow and more serious than usual.*

This'n can't tell ye, rightly, but those what have a bottle an' a cork what fits it, they yark about the Enemy.  Most folks got a story like that in their ol' hearth-tales, an I'm ken.  A bad way, from times old, come back.  Ol' Rubik don't know much about that, but something makes them bodies walk and moan, and it don't seem to be somethin' of the way o' our kin.  How it gets in, well, that be anyone's for a guess.  It can come the way we came, wibbling and wobbling, but it don't always.  How it be'd the end for your deadland, Rubik can't say for ye.

candidates.source:
Gazing into a canvas of darkness, this tape seems to have originated from a highway speed camera.  Utterly deserted, the thoroughfare stretches from one end of the choppy frame to the other, the audio devoid of any sound save for the death-rattle rasp of the wind.  Presently, footfalls and exhausted breathing join the soundscape as two men stagger upon the scene, one hunched and bearing the blood-soaked profile of the other.

Clad in the remains of riot gear, the starlight glistening over the red wells of bullet holes flowering across his back, the limply carried officer is clearly dead.  His bearer, a slighter man with bloodshot, vacant eyes, stumbles as he walks, his quivering lips moving as he maintains a hoarsely-whispered, one-sided dialogue.  "Don't worry, Kev," he wheezes.  "Carlhaven's just a couple miles up ahead.  I'm sure we'll find someone there who can help you, and after you're better, we can go to my place on the lake and wait for all this to die down.  I'll get us there, I promise.  You just need to talk to me.  Please.  Tell me something."

Catching his foot in a pothole, the man staggers to the concrete, the corpse sprawling atop him as he lies face down.  "I'm going to get us there.  I promise.  I promise.  I just want you to wake up.  Please, Kev.  I've got to get us there."

As the man wretchedly whimpers, various figures begin to shamble up from the same direction he came from.  Futilely trying to rise, the man only succeeds in rolling himself into a sitting position as his crying grows harder.  "Please Kev… please.  I don't want to die alone," he bawls.  "Please, wake up and don't let me die alone."

As the first zombie stumbles to within a few meters of the man, his sobs grow quiet as he makes eye contact with the inhuman monster ushering in his destruction.  Closing his eyes, he pulls the policeman's corpse into a tight hug and lowers his head, planting a tender kiss on the dead man's lips.  The embrace never breaks, even as the zombies descend upon him.
candidates.target:
凝视着一片漆黑的画布，这盘录像似乎来自高速公路的速拍相机。这条完全荒凉的大路从画框的一端延伸到另一端，除了风的死亡般的呼啸声，音轨上几乎没有其他声音。此刻，脚步声和疲惫的喘息声加入到声音的场景中，两个男人摇摇晃晃地出现在画面中，其中一个弯腰背着另一个浑身是血的人。

他们穿着防暴装备的残骸，星光在遍布背部、鲜血浸透的弹孔中闪烁，被背着的警察显然已经死亡。他的背负者是一个体格较小的男人，血红的眼睛空洞无神，走路时踉跄不稳，颤抖的嘴唇在保持着低声的单向对话。"别担心，凯夫，"他喘息着说，"卡尔哈文就在几英里前头。我确定我们能在那里找到人帮你，等你好了之后，我们可以去我湖边的家里等待这一切平息。我会带我们去那里，我保证。你只需要和我说话。求求你。告诉我点什么。"

这个人踩进一个坑里，他摔倒在混凝土上，尸体在他面前散落一地。"我会带我们去那里。我保证。我只是希望你能醒来。求求你，凯夫。我必须带我们去那里。"

当这个人痛苦地呜咽时，几个身影从他来的方向缓缓走来。他试图站起来，但只成功地滚成坐姿，哭声越来越大。"求求你，凯夫…求求你。我不想独自一人死去，"他大喊。"求求你醒来，别让我独自一人死去。"

当第一个僵尸走到离男人几米远的地方时，他的抽泣声变得安静，因为他与这个导致他毁灭的非人怪物对视。闭上眼睛，他把警察的尸体紧紧拥入怀中，低下头，在死者的嘴唇上轻轻一吻。即使僵尸群扑向他，这个拥抱也从未中断。

男人绊倒在坑洼中，跌倒在水泥地上，尸体倒在他身上，他面朝下。 “我会把你送到那里。我保证。我保证。我只是想让你醒来。拜托，凯夫。我必须把你送到那里。”

当男人痛苦地呜咽时，各种人物从他走来的方向蹒跚地走过来。男人徒劳地试图站起来，只成功地把自己滚到坐着的姿势，哭声越来越大。“拜托凯夫……拜托。我不想独自死去，”他大声喊道。“请醒来，不要让我独自死去。”

当第一个僵尸踉跄地走到男人几米远的地方时，他的哭声渐渐平息，他与引导他毁灭的不人道怪物进行眼神交流。闭上眼睛，他将警官的尸体紧紧地抱住，低下头，亲吻了死者的嘴唇。拥抱从未松开，即使僵尸们向他涌来。

candidates.source:
Gazing into a canvas of darkness, this tape seems to have originated from a highway speed camera.  Utterly deserted, the thoroughfare stretches from one end of the choppy frame to the other, the audio devoid of any sound save for the death-rattle rasp of the wind.  Presently, footfalls and exhausted breathing join the soundscape as two men stagger upon the scene, one hunched and bearing the blood-soaked profile of the other.

Clad in the remains of riot gear, the starlight glistening over the red wells of bullet holes flowering across his back, the limply carried officer is clearly dead.  His bearer, a slighter man with bloodshot, vacant eyes, stumbles as he walks, his quivering lips moving as he maintains a hoarsely-whispered, one-sided dialogue.  "Don't worry, Kev," he wheezes.  "Carlhaven's just a couple miles up ahead.  I'm sure we'll find someone there who can help you, and after you're better, we can go to my place on the lake and wait for all this to die down.  I'll get us there, I promise.  You just need to talk to me.  Please.  Tell me something."

Catching his foot in a pothole, the man staggers to the concrete, the corpse sprawling atop him as he lies face down.  "I'm going to get us there.  I promise.  I promise.  I just want you to wake up.  Please, Kev.  I've got to get us there."

As the man wretchedly whimpers, various figures begin to shamble up from the same direction he came from.  Futilely trying to rise, the man only succeeds in rolling himself into a sitting position as his crying grows harder.  "Please Kev… please.  I don't want to die alone," he bawls.  "Please, wake up and don't let me die alone."

As the first zombie stumbles to within a few meters of the man, his sobs grow quiet as he makes eye contact with the inhuman monster ushering in his destruction.  Closing his eyes, he pulls the policeman's corpse into a tight hug and lowers his head, planting a tender kiss on the dead man's lips.  The embrace never breaks, even as the zombies descend upon him.

凝视着一片漆黑的画面，这段影像似乎源自高速公路上的测速摄像头。道路空无一人，在颠簸的画幅中从一端延伸至另一端，音频中除风声那如临终喘息般的嘶哑声外，别无他响。此刻，脚步声与疲惫的喘息声加入这片声景：两名男子踉跄登场，其中一人佝偻着背，背负着另一人血染的侧影。

被背负者身着残破的防暴装备，星光在他背部绽开的累累弹孔上闪烁，那些弹孔如血井般深红；他显然已无生息。背负他的是一名身形瘦削的男子，双眼布满血丝、空洞无神，步履蹒跚，颤抖的嘴唇不断开合，维持着一段嘶哑低语的单方面对话。“别担心，凯夫，”他喘息着说，“卡尔黑文就在前方几英里处。我确信那里会有人能帮你，等你康复后，我们可以去我在湖边的住处，等这一切平息下来。我会带我们到那里的，我保证。你只需要和我说话。求你了。告诉我点什么吧。”

他的脚绊进一个坑洼，整个人跌倒在混凝土路面上，尸体压在他身上，他面朝下趴着。“我会带我们到那里的。我保证。我保证。我只希望你能醒过来。求你了，凯夫。我必须带我们到那里。”

随着男子痛苦地呜咽，各种身影开始从他来的方向蹒跚逼近。他徒劳地试图起身，却只勉强滚坐起来，哭声愈发凄厉。“求你了，凯夫……求你了。我不想独自死去，”他嚎啕道，“求你醒来，别让我独自死去。”

当第一具丧尸踉跄至距他仅数米之处，他的抽泣渐趋微弱，目光与那带来毁灭的非人怪物相遇。他闭上双眼，将警察的尸体紧紧拥入怀中，低下头，在死者唇上印下温柔一吻。即便丧尸群蜂拥而至，这拥抱也未曾松开。

candidates.source: Blinker than a bat, but downer than a cat.  Razzin' up the bits be a trick and some.  The draw-make automates can manufactorize the outer shell, and there be automates for the most o' the tools.  Some bits be more a breakfast o' rats, an' for them, us'n has some artisanals.  Us'n b'ain't on the solid now, so 'tis a longer down.
candidates.target: 比蝙蝠更快，但比猫更懒。 收集零部件是一项挑战。 机器可以制造外壳，大多数工具也有机器生产。 有些部件更复杂，我们有手工工具来处理它们。 我们现在不稳定，所以需要更长的时间。

candidates.source: Right so, a fine notice.  Rubik's mother-twice, she were a woman o'th'old kind.  And were her mate, and Rubik's father-twice.  Rubik's father-mother, she were a gran, a fitty bit of ol' London-Town, right so, but Rubik had a jaryi and a taita and a tamoi." Rubik's voice goes distant for a moment.  "An' they was all there, right to the end.  Standin' by, we were, one and all." They pause, then seem to snap back.  "No time for stories, kennit?  Back to the here an' now.
candidates.target: 好的，一个好消息。魔方母亲两次，她是老一辈的妇女。她的伴侣，也是魔方父亲两次。魔方父亲的母亲，她是一个老伦敦城的老奶奶，就是这样，但魔方有一个姐姐，一个哥哥，和一个妹妹。”魔方的声音暂时变远了。“他们都在，直到最后。我们都站在那里，全体。”他们停顿了一下，然后似乎又回过神来。“没有时间讲故事吗？回到现在吧。

candidates.target: 好吧，一个通知。鲁比克的母亲——两次，她是个老派的女人。他的配偶，以及鲁比克的父亲——两次。鲁比克的父亲，他的母亲，她是个老伦敦人，相当地，但鲁比克却有了一个贾里伊，一个泰塔，和一个塔莫伊。” 鲁比克的嗓音一瞬间变得遥远。“而且他们都在那里，直到最后。我们都在旁边支持着，个个如此。” 他们停顿了一下，然后似乎又回到了现实。“没时间讲故事，知道吗？回到当下。”

To obtain a moonstruck pearl, you will need the skull of a March Lord, a bunch of glass shards, a handful of faewild dust, ten kilograms of Fae meat, enough bones to make a makeshift skeleton for that meat, some silver and the heart of a mythic monster.  The skull must be one of a March lord, for only they are resilient enough to contain the tremendous energies you will soon harness.

Once the revenant's effigy is completed, place it outdoors and wait until the full moon shines brightly in the sky.  Only then will you take it in your arms and utter the last few words of the ritual before the Luna-Attuned Revenant rises and reappears near you.

This revenant is a powerful foe, directly fueled by the moon itself and blessed with the ability to always see its foes.  Its attacks are very destructive and hard to dodge but you can severely weaken it by luring it anywhere the moon cannot reach it.  If you do this be warned that it will violently lash out at anything standing between itself and the moon.

Fortunately, the revenant cannot regenerate and its flesh lacks any kind of protection other than needing to be extremely heavily damaged to cause it to decohere and die, granting you the moonstruck pearl.

Remember to quickly kill it, for the sun's rays will instantly slay the revenant, preventing you from obtaining the pearl.  Also keep in mind that the revenant will attempt to take revenge on you for its current state and is likely to priorize attacking you over its own wellbeing.

当亡灵像完成后，将其放在户外，等到满月高挂天空。只有在那时，你才能将其拥入怀中，念出仪式的最后几个词，月调和亡灵就会升起并出现在你身边。

一旦亡灵的替身完成，将其置于户外，等待满月高悬、光辉普照之时。唯有此刻，你才能将其拥入怀中，念出仪式的最后几句咒语，随后月调亡灵便会苏醒并出现在你身旁。

此亡灵是强大的敌人，直接由月亮本身供能，并拥有始终能看见敌人的天赋。它的攻击极具破坏力且难以闪避，但你可以通过将其引诱至月光无法触及之处来严重削弱它。若你如此行事，务必警惕：它会猛烈地攻击任何挡在它和月亮之间的目标。

幸运的是，该亡灵无法再生，其肉体除需遭受极其严重的损伤才会崩解死亡外，并无其他防护。一旦将其击杀，你将获得月狂珍珠。

切记要迅速将其击杀，因为阳光会瞬间消灭亡灵，使你无法获得珍珠。同时请记住，亡灵会因自身当前的状态而向你复仇，极有可能将攻击你置于自身安危之上。

candidates.source:
To obtain a moonstruck pearl, you will need the skull of a March Lord, a bunch of glass shards, a handful of faewild dust, ten kilograms of Fae meat, enough bones to make a makeshift skeleton for that meat, some silver and the heart of a mythic monster.  The skull must be one of a March lord, for only they are resilient enough to contain the tremendous energies you will soon harness.

Once the revenant's effigy is completed, place it outdoors and wait until the full moon shines brightly in the sky.  Only then will you take it in your arms and utter the last few words of the ritual before the Luna-Attuned Revenant rises and reappears near you.

This revenant is a powerful foe, directly fueled by the moon itself and blessed with the ability to always see its foes.  Its attacks are very destructive and hard to dodge but you can severely weaken it by luring it anywhere the moon cannot reach it.  If you do this be warned that it will violently lash out at anything standing between itself and the moon.

Fortunately, the revenant cannot regenerate and its flesh lacks any kind of protection other than needing to be extremely heavily damaged to cause it to decohere and die, granting you the moonstruck pearl.

Remember to quickly kill it, for the sun's rays will instantly slay the revenant, preventing you from obtaining the pearl.  Also keep in mind that the revenant will attempt to take revenge on you for its current state and is likely to priorize attacking you over its own wellbeing.
candidates.target:
要获得月光珍珠，你需要：一位三月领主（March Lord）的头骨、一束玻璃碎片、一把野尘、十公斤妖精肉、足以拼凑成该肉块临时骨架的骨头、一些银饰，以及一个神话级怪物的心脏。头骨必须是三月领主的，因为只有他们足够坚韧，能够容纳你即将驾驭的巨大能量。

当亡灵雕像完成后，将其置于户外，等待满月高悬于天际。唯有此时，你才能将其抱入怀中，念出仪式的最后几句咒语，随后“月之共鸣亡灵”将苏醒并重新出现在你附近。

这只亡灵是强大的敌人，其力量直接源自月亮本身，并拥有始终能看见敌人的能力。它的攻击极具破坏力且难以闪避，但你可以通过引诱它进入月亮无法触及的区域来严重削弱它。若你这样做，请警惕：它会猛烈攻击任何挡在它与月亮之间的物体。

幸运的是，这只亡灵无法再生，其肉体除需要遭受极重度伤害以使其解离死亡外，并无其他形式的防护，死亡后将赐予你月光珍珠。

务必迅速击杀它，因为阳光会瞬间将其消灭，从而阻止你获得珍珠。此外，请记住这只亡灵会因自身现状而试图向你复仇，它很可能优先攻击你而非保全自己。

若要获得一颗月惑珍珠，你将需要一枚边境领主的头骨、一捧玻璃碎片、一把妖境之尘、十公斤妖精的肉、足以给这些血肉搭成一副临时骨架的骸骨、些许白银，以及一颗神话怪物的心脏。头骨必须是边境领主的，唯有他们的头骨才足够坚韧，能容纳你即将驾驭的磅礴能量。

当还魂尸的塑像完成后，将其置于户外，静待一轮满月高悬夜空，皎洁明亮。唯有此时，你方可将其抱入怀中，吟诵仪式的最后咒文。随后，月契还魂尸便会苏生，并重新出现在你身旁。

此还魂尸乃是劲敌，其力量直接源于月亮，并蒙受祝福，能时刻洞悉敌踪。它的攻击极具破坏力且难以闪避，但若将其引诱至任何月光无法企及之处，便可极大地削弱它。倘若你如此行事，务必警惕，它会狂暴地撕碎任何胆敢阻隔它与月光之物。

幸运的是，此还魂尸无法再生，其血肉除需承受极其沉重的伤害方会崩解消亡外，并无任何防护。杀死它，你便能获得月惑珍珠。

切记速战速决，因太阳的光芒会瞬间诛杀此还魂尸，令你与珍珠失之交臂。另请铭记，还魂尸会因其当下的处境而向你寻仇，它很可能会不顾自身安危，优先攻击你。

candidates.source:
"(Spell Name) RECIPE V3
---
Rare Ingredients:
- 17 drams owl's blood - less no effect, more turns bear into large owl
- 1 gastrolith, large American alligator
- 3 teeth or claws from a honey badger
- 8 pounds bear meat, preferably polar bear, grizzly will suffice
Bring a large pot (meat must fully submerge) filled about half way with potion starter fluid (high grade) to a boil.  Add gastrolith and teeth/claws after boiling, add the blood, stir counterclockwise for a minute while chanting standard polymorph spell.  Continue until concoction has a slight glow.  Add the bear meat, remove from heat, cover for 24 hours.
Bear MUST eat all 8 pounds of the meat (claws and gastrolith optional).
---
*I've finally gotten my hands on enough polar bear meat.  The grizzly variations are a bit lackluster.*
There are flecks of blood on the page."
candidates.target:
"（配方名称）V3
---
稀有材料：
- 17 钱猫头鹰血 - 少了无效，多了会把熊变成大猫头鹰
- 1 块胃石，大型美国鳄鱼
- 3 颗蜂獾的牙或爪
- 8 磅熊肉，最好是北极熊，灰熊也可以
将一个大锅（肉必须完全浸没）装满约一半的药水启动液（高档）煮沸。 沸腾后加入胃石和牙/爪，然后加入血液，逆时针搅拌一分钟，同时念出标准的变形咒语。 继续搅拌直到混合物微微发光。 加入熊肉，离火，盖上24小时。
熊必须吃完所有的8磅肉（爪和胃石可选）。
---
*我终于弄到了足够的北极熊肉。 灰熊的变种有点乏味。*
页面上有血迹。"

熊必须吃掉全部 8 磅熊肉（利爪与胃石为可选）。
---
*我终于凑齐了足够的北极熊肉。灰熊版的成品略显平淡。*
页面上沾有几点血迹。

"(Spell Name) RECIPE V3
---
Rare Ingredients:
- 17 drams owl's blood - less no effect, more turns bear into large owl
- 1 gastrolith, large American alligator
- 3 teeth or claws from a honey badger
- 8 pounds bear meat, preferably polar bear, grizzly will suffice
Bring a large pot (meat must fully submerge) filled about half way with potion starter fluid (high grade) to a boil.  Add gastrolith and teeth/claws after boiling, add the blood, stir counterclockwise for a minute while chanting standard polymorph spell.  Continue until concoction has a slight glow.  Add the bear meat, remove from heat, cover for 24 hours.
Bear MUST eat all 8 pounds of the meat (claws and gastrolith optional).
---
*I've finally gotten my hands on enough polar bear meat.  The grizzly variations are a bit lackluster.*

candidates.source:
Starting a camp doesn't take much time, and you can use a faction camp to keep your companions fed without needing to regularly give them food, so it's a good idea to establish a minimal camp anywhere you intend to be for a while.
  How much you want to expand your camps is up to you.  A modular field camp can be very resource intensive, but building one up allows you to send companions off to hunt and farm for you, so there's quite the pay-off.  What kind of camp (or camps) you want to build depends both on what you intend to focus on and whether you want to be stationary or roaming with stops in areas only for some time before moving on.  If nothing else, you should consider building a water well as soon as you can, which may require you to perform construction prerequisites.
  If you have access to a fire station or evac shelter, you may want to build your camp in them.  Both of those camps are very compact, but have much of the same functionality as an upgraded field camp without requiring so many resources.
  If you are adding expansions to your camp, consider starting with a farm, canteen, or fabrication workshop.  The farm makes it easy to grow your own food if you don't have any ready plowed farms nearby, the canteen provides you with a well and root cellars after some upgrades, while the fabrication workshop can allow you to craft some of the resources you need to upgrade your camp.
  The livestock area and the storage area probably shouldn't be your first expansions, but they both have their uses.
candidates.target:
建立一个营地不需要花费太多时间，而且你可以使用分营地来喂饱你的伙伴们，无需定期给他们食物，所以在你打算待一段时间的任何地方建立一个基本的营地都是一个好主意。

你想要多大程度地扩展你的营地完全取决于你。一个模块化野外营地可能会消耗很多资源，但建立它可以让你派遣伙伴去为你狩猎和耕种，所以有很大的回报。你想要建立什么样的营地（或营地）取决于你打算专注于什么以及你是想要固定在一个地方还是游牧，只在某些地区停留一段时间后再移动。

至少你应该考虑尽快建造一个水井，这可能需要你进行一些建筑前期准备。

如果你有消防站或疏散避难所的通道，你可能想要在里面建立你的营地。这两种营地都非常紧凑，但具有升级后的野外营地的大部分功能，却不需要消耗那么多资源。

如果你正在为你的营地添加扩展，可以考虑从农场、食堂或造物工坊开始。农场可以在你附近没有准备好的耕种农场的情况下轻松种植自己的食物，食堂在升级后可以为你提供水井和根窖，而造物工坊可以让你制作一些你需要的资源，以升级你的营地。

牲畜区和存储区可能不应该是你的第一个扩展，但它们都有自己的用途。

你想要扩展营地多少，取决于你。一个模块化野营地可能非常消耗资源，但建立起来后，你可以让同伴去狩猎和耕种，所以回报相当可观。你想要建造什么样的营地（或营地）取决于你打算专注于什么以及你是否希望固定不动，还是在特定区域停留一段时间后再移动。 至少，你应该尽快建造一个水井，这可能需要你完成一些建造先决条件。

如果你有消防站或避难所，你可能想在里面建立你的营地。这两个营地都非常紧凑，但功能与升级后的野营地相似，但所需的资源较少。

如果你正在扩展你的营地，可以从农场、餐厅或制造车间开始。农场可以让你在附近没有可耕种的农田的情况下种植自己的食物，餐厅升级后可以为你提供水井和地下室，而制造车间则可以让你制作升级营地的所需资源。

牲畜区和储藏区可能不应该成为你第一批扩展，但它们都有各自的用途。

candidates.source:
Starting a camp doesn't take much time, and you can use a faction camp to keep your companions fed without needing to regularly give them food, so it's a good idea to establish a minimal camp anywhere you intend to be for a while.
  How much you want to expand your camps is up to you.  A modular field camp can be very resource intensive, but building one up allows you to send companions off to hunt and farm for you, so there's quite the pay-off.  What kind of camp (or camps) you want to build depends both on what you intend to focus on and whether you want to be stationary or roaming with stops in areas only for some time before moving on.  If nothing else, you should consider building a water well as soon as you can, which may require you to perform construction prerequisites.
  If you have access to a fire station or evac shelter, you may want to build your camp in them.  Both of those camps are very compact, but have much of the same functionality as an upgraded field camp without requiring so many resources.
  If you are adding expansions to your camp, consider starting with a farm, canteen, or fabrication workshop.  The farm makes it easy to grow your own food if you don't have any ready plowed farms nearby, the canteen provides you with a well and root cellars after some upgrades, while the fabrication workshop can allow you to craft some of the resources you need to upgrade your camp.
  The livestock area and the storage area probably shouldn't be your first expansions, but they both have their uses.
candidates.target:
建立营地并不需要太多时间，你可以利用派系营地来持续为同伴提供食物，而无需定期手动投喂，因此在你计划停留一段时间的任何地方，建立一个基础营地都是明智之举。  
营地扩张的规模由你决定。模块化野战营地虽然资源消耗较大，但建成后可以让同伴外出狩猎和耕种，回报相当可观。你选择建造何种营地（或多个营地），既取决于你的发展重点，也取决于你倾向于固定驻守还是四处游历、仅在特定区域短暂停留后再转移。无论如何，应尽快考虑建造水井，这可能需要你先完成某些建造前置条件。  
如果你能进入消防站或疏散避难所，不妨将营地建在其中。这两类营地结构紧凑，却具备与升级后野战营地相近的功能，且所需资源更少。  
若你计划为营地添加扩展设施，建议优先考虑农场、食堂或制造工坊。农场能让你在附近没有现成耕地时轻松自产食物；食堂在升级后可提供水井和地窖；制造工坊则能帮助你制作升级营地所需的部分资源。  
牲畜区和仓储区可能不适合作为首选扩展，但它们各自都有其用途。

candidates.source: Uncle Sam's still kicking!  Yes, I was just as surprised as y'all listening probably are.  That is, unless you happen to be an uncle named Sam, in which case I'm DJ Dustbowl, this is my canine co-host, who's also Sam, and we want to tell you good job for making it this far.  Jesus fuck, Sam, I think that was our most brain-dead intro.  Anyways, moving swiftly along, members of the federal government are still out there, folks.  Just this morning, a big old heli flew past, pretty as can be.  I managed to hail them and found out that they were ferrying some supplies over to what they're calling the "Old Guard's First Fleet."  Tap some wood, people, but it sounds like a bunch of Navy and private ships are tootling along the coastline, cruising and looking to clear some safe zones.
candidates.target: 山姆叔叔还在努力！是的，我和你们一样感到惊讶。除非你叫山姆，那就不奇怪了。我是DJ Dustbowl，这是我的狗伙伴，也叫山姆。我们想告诉你，能坚持到现在做得好！靠！山姆，我觉得这是我们最脑残的开场白了。不管怎样，联邦政府的人还在努力。今天早上，一架大直升机飞过，非常壮观。我成功地和他们联系上了，他们说正在运送物资给他们称为“老卫队的先遣舰队”。大家敲敲木头，但听起来海军和私人船只沿着海岸线航行，寻找安全区域。

An almost offensively bright soundtrack assaults your ears as this video opens—a piano, a drum set, and what sounds suspiciously like a saxophone rubbing shoulders in the background and playing over the words of an animated unicorn that stands in the foreground.  Dressed in a jumper with "FEMA" printed across the chest in bright colors, the character's voice has less to do with a magically glowing equine and more to do with a buttery Anglo-American male with a cadence deeper than the Grand Canyon, more reverberant than a set of church bells, and possessing an upbeat tone that belies the subject content.

"What to do?"  The unicorn muses, leaning an elbow contemplatively upon a desk.

"It's a question that everybody's asking during these unhappy times, and that many folks are giving wrong answers to.  With all the mean people going around, you might find yourself, or might have even already been, in some pretty scary situations!  So, let me tell you what to do.  Don't be an Andrew."

The scene shifts, showing an anthropomorphic mouse huddling within a cartoon evacuation shelter as the unicorn's voice narrates over the top.

"This is Andrew.  Andrew needs to wait for people to come and take him to safety, and he's currently in what we call an evacuation shelter, but Andrew's decided that he's going to try and leave on his own!"

The mouse proceeds to peek out the shelter's door before trotting casually into the road beyond.  This particular venture lasts for all of 3 seconds before he summarily gets trampled by an on-coming pony, flattening into a furry pancake upon the street as the unicorn resumes.

"Don't, do, this!  If you're in a safe area—a shelter, basement, or communal gathering point—do not leave it for any reason.  People can't protect you if they can't find you, so wait for grownups to come and take you to a safe place."

As the mouse peals himself off the street, a bus driven by a squirrel wearing a cartoon army helmet motors up, and the rodent boards the vehicle.

"Don't be scared of the people sent to evacuate you.  They might look scary with all the guns, but their only job is to keep you safe."

The clip proceeds in this fashion for several more minutes, demonstrating, among other matters, the importance of donning gas masks when venturing outside—always, as the unicorn jovially reminds, "with the aid of an adult," boiling water before drinking, and maintaining a blackout curfew—all points helpfully illustrated by the titular Andrew dramatically failing to adhere to all of the above.  The last frame of the video concludes with a shot of the mouse safely installed within a brightly colored tent complex, a number of other animals poised at the perimeters in cartoon military uniforms, and a smattering of other characters dotted about the tents.  The legend, "THE FEDERAL EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT AGENCY, HERE TO PROTECT YOUR SAFETY," spans the frame in block capitals.

一段几乎刺耳的背景音乐响起，钢琴、鼓点和听起来像萨克斯管的乐器在背景中交织，覆盖着一个动画独角兽的旁白，它站在画面前景中。这只独角兽穿着一件印有“FEMA”的毛衣，声音听起来不像魔法闪亮的骏马，更像一个油腻的英美男性，声音低沉得像大峡谷，回响得像教堂的钟声，语调轻快，与内容形成鲜明对比。

“要做什么？”独角兽沉思着，把手肘放在桌子上。

“这是在这些不开心的日子里大家都在问的问题，而且很多人给出了错误的答案。有了这么多坏人在周围，你可能会发现自己，或者可能已经处于一些相当可怕的境地！所以，让我告诉你该怎么做。不要做安德鲁。”

场景切换，显示一只拟人化的老鼠躲在一个卡通疏散避难所里，独角兽的声音在上面讲述。

“这是安德鲁。安德鲁需要等待别人来接他去安全的地方，他现在在一个我们叫做疏散避难所的地方，但安德鲁决定自己尝试离开！”

老鼠从避难所的门口探出头去，然后悠闲地跑到路边。这次冒险持续了3秒钟，就被一辆迎面而来的小马踩扁，变成一个毛茸茸的饼干躺在马路上，独角兽继续讲述。

“不要这样做！如果你在一个安全的地方——避难所、地下室或社区聚集点——不要因为任何原因离开。如果人们找不到你，他们就无法保护你，所以等待大人们来接你去安全的地方。”

当老鼠从马路上爬起来时，一辆由戴着卡通军帽的松鼠驾驶的巴士开过来，小鼠上了车。

“不要害怕来疏散你的人。他们可能看起来很可怕，带着枪，但他们的工作只有一个，就是保护你的安全。”

这段视频以这种方式持续了几分钟，展示了其他一些重要事项，例如在外出时必须戴上防毒面具——独角兽开心地提醒，总是“在成人的帮助下”，喝水前要烧开水，以及遵守停电宵禁——所有这些要点都由主角安德鲁戏剧性地失败来展示。视频的最后一帧展示了老鼠安全地安置在一个彩色帐篷群中，其他动物身着卡通军装站在帐篷周围，其他角色点缀在帐篷周围。字幕“联邦紧急事务管理局，保护您的安全”用粗体大写字母跨越整个画面。

“该怎么办？”独角兽若有所思地将手肘支在桌上，喃喃自语。

“这是在这个不幸时期每个人都在问的问题，而许多人却给出了错误的答案。面对四处游荡的恶意之人，你可能会发现自己——甚至可能已经身处——一些相当可怕的境地！所以，让我告诉你该怎么做：别当安德鲁。”

场景切换，一只拟人化的老鼠蜷缩在一座卡通风格的疏散避难所内，独角兽的画外音继续叙述：

“这是安德鲁。安德鲁需要等待人们前来将他带往安全地带，他目前身处我们所说的疏散避难所，但他却决定擅自离开！”

老鼠随即探出头，从避难所门缝向外张望，随后悠闲地小跑着踏入外面的道路。这次冒险仅持续了短短 3 秒，他便被一匹迎面而来的小马踩踏，瞬间被压成街上一块毛茸茸的“煎饼”。此时，独角兽的声音再次响起：

“千万别这样做！如果你身处安全区域——无论是避难所、地下室还是集体集结点——切勿因任何原因离开。如果人们找不到你，就无法保护你，因此请等待成年人前来将你带往安全地点。”

当老鼠从街道上挣扎起身时，一辆由戴着卡通军盔的松鼠驾驶的巴士驶来，老鼠随即登车。

“不要害怕前来疏散你的人。他们或许因携带枪支而显得可怕，但他们的唯一职责就是确保你的安全。”

candidates.source: No, not The Enemy, but might be their trouble n' strife.  If ye' go, just wait n' see.  It'll ask.  It knows what shape to wear, or it just takes it, anyhow. candidates.source: Brilliant white sands unfold under the view of this particular video, grains of grit lightly swirling in the breeze and the rhythmic voice of ocean waves murmuring in the background.  Pattering across the sand, with its wet fur rendered yellowish white by the gravel that coats it, a large dog bounds ahead of the camera with its snoot all but excavating a trench in the beach.  As the view pursues the Labrador's progress, the perspective bouncing with each of the unseen cameraman's steps, you can distinctly hear furtive, child-like giggles escorting each of the canine's obsessive sniffs.  The mirth swiftly perishes as the footage's forward momentum is arrested, the dog having abruptly paused in its tracks with its muzzle raised in the air and nostrils agitatedly flaring.  A series of puzzled murmurings accompany the film as the quadruped slowly edges away from some unseen entity; its hackles raised and chest vibrating with an escalating growl that culminates in an outburst of furious howls.  As a small hand reaches from off-screen to calm the maddened hound, the view gradually pans upwards.  The shift in elevation reveals a deep trench scored horizontally down the width of the beach, terminating at the lapping waterline.  It almost resembles the type of gouge that a sizable, flat-bottomed boat would have left in the sand had such a craft been dragged into the sea.  Almost.  The viscous pool of crusty, greenish-yellow cytoplasm that cakes the trough places that particular assessment into question.

candidates.source:
"Please state your name and ID for the record."

"Dr. Maria Catarina Gonzales, S-7531."

"Thank you, Doctor.  You know why we're here, don't you?  Please tell us about your previous project supervisor."

"Ruslan was…"

"Ruslan?"

"I'm sorry, Dr. Lavochkin was extremely enthusiastic about our research when I arrived in the facility.  That enthusiasm had a way of dragging people with him, you know?  We wanted to see our subjects as he did, full of wonder and untapped potential."

"Did he ever tell you what it was that you were working on?"

"Not really, no.  We were to "characterize the effects of need-to-knowium on a wide range of living subjects" was his little joke, back when he made jokes."

"When did that change?"

"He became a lot more distant when we began testing PE050 and PE150, the intravenous formulation.  He sent us back to the pods way before he left the lab, and he started muttering about "preparing the world" for something under his breath.  That coincided with him requisitioning more… exotic test subjects."

"How did he rationalize those?"

"He could be very convincing, and we were happy to see that spark again.  You want to hear about the centipedes, right?  L.coeculus are parthenogenetic and completely lack social behavior, making them a reasonable long-term subjects for PE050's "societal predisposition" effects, as we liked to call it."

"Do you still consider that decision "reasonable"?"

"Not in the light of what happened, I suppose.  But your people kicking in the observation room's door and starting shooting wasn't the most reasonable course of action either, if we're being honest."

"We're not here to review the actions of Security on that day.  Did he ever mention anywhere he could be hiding?"

"We weren't close, so no he didn't share the location of his secret treehouse.  With those things in tow he shouldn't be too hard to find though -- just follow the song of the centipedes."

"Thank you for the advice, Doctor.  I am to inform you that you are restricted to your residential pod until the review of your involvement in the incident is concluded.  You are expected to finish any remaining reports in the meantime, but your workstation will be isolated from the facility network otherwise."
candidates.target:
“请为记录起见，报出您的姓名和身份证号码。”

“玛丽亚·卡塔琳娜·冈萨雷斯博士，S-7531。”

“谢谢您，博士。您知道我们为什么来这里，对吧？请告诉我们关于您之前项目主管的情况。”

“鲁斯兰……”

“鲁斯兰？”

“抱歉，当我到达设施时，拉沃奇金博士对我们的研究充满了极大的热情。那种热情有种把人带动起来的力量，您知道的？我们希望像他一样看待我们的受试者，充满了奇迹和未开发的潜力。”

“他有没有告诉过您你们在做什么？”

“没有，没有。我们的工作是‘研究需要知道的物质对各种活体受试者的影响’，这是他早期开的一个小玩笑。”

“什么时候开始改变的？”

“当我们开始测试PE050和PE150，静脉注射配方时，他变得更加冷淡了。他让我们在离开实验室之前就回到实验舱，开始低声嘟囔着关于‘为世界做准备’的事情。这与他为实验征用更多……异国受试者相吻合。”

“他怎么解释那些的？”

“他可以非常有说服力，我们很高兴看到他再次有那种激情。您想听关于马陆的事情，对吧？L.coeculus是单性生殖的，完全没有社会行为，这使它们成为PE050的‘社会倾向’效果的合理长期受试者，我们喜欢这样称呼它。”

“在发生的事情光芒下，您还认为那个决定‘合理’吗？”

“我想不到了。但您的人员撞开观察室的门并开始射击，也不是最合理的行动，如果我们说实话。”

“我们不是来审查那天安保人员行动的。他有没有提到他可能藏身的任何地方？”

“我们关系不近，所以他没有分享他秘密树屋的位置。带着那些东西，找到他不应该太难——只需跟随马陆的歌声。”

“谢谢您的建议，博士。我要通知您，在审查您参与事件的过程结束之前，您将被限制在居住舱内。在此期间，您预计要完成任何剩余的报告，但您的工作站将与设施网络隔离。”

The video starts with a shaky view of a deserted city street, filmed through a pane of glass framed by drawn curtains.  The grind of tracks and base-growl of an engine dominate the choppy audio as an Abrams tank rumbles into view, flanked by several squads of armed soldiers running beside the vehicle.  Locked behind the rubber shell of a gas mask, each man carries an automatic rifle, skulking carefully along the sides of the tank as the group proceeds down the road.  As the view pans, a soldier leading the column briefly pauses by a blown-open cellar, the cameraman audibly whispering hurried prayers as the infantryman trains their rifle on the abyss.  The view jerks sharply as a glistening, artery-like appendage writhes from an unseen point, crashing through the soldier's mask and bursting out the back of their skull before yanking them from the ground.  The desperate liturgies grow louder as the view tilts up and reveals the opposite building's roof line, thickly coated in a crust of churning cytoplasm and organ-like flesh, and over which the hapless soldier's body is dragged out of sight, before a waterfall of blood erupts and spurts across the convoy.  As the cameraman whimpers in terror, a nightmarish, spidery amalgamation of flesh and bones clambers over the roof's edge and plunges into the amassed soldiers.  The scene erupts in a mass of gunfire and frantic screams.

视频以一个摇晃的城市街道景象开始，透过一块玻璃拍摄，玻璃两边是拉上的窗帘。 刺耳的铁轨声和引擎的低沉轰鸣声占据了断断续续的音频，一辆艾布拉姆斯坦克隆隆开来，两侧有几组全副武装的士兵在车辆旁边奔跑。 每个人都戴着橡胶面罩，面罩后隐藏着自动步枪，他们小心翼翼地沿着坦克两侧前进。 当镜头扫过，队伍最前面的士兵短暂地停在一间被炸开的地下室旁，摄像师可以听见自己急促地低声祈祷，士兵将步枪对准了深渊。 镜头突然一晃，一个闪亮的、像动脉一样的触手从一个看不见的地方蠕动出来，撞穿了士兵的面罩，从后脑勺突破，然后将士兵从地上拖走。 绝望的祈祷声变得越来越响，当镜头仰望时，对面建筑的屋顶线清晰可见，上面覆盖着厚厚的搅拌的细胞质和器官般的肉，不幸的士兵的尸体被拖出了视线，然后一股血流喷射出来，溅满了车队。 当摄像师惊恐地呜咽时，一个令人毛骨悚然的、像蜘蛛一样的肉骨混合体从屋顶边缘爬上，跳入聚集的士兵中。 场景爆发出一片枪声和惊恐的尖叫声。

An immaculately polished room fills the video's perspective, with various metal workspaces lining the metallic walls and the camera angled downward towards a stainless steel operating table.  Sprawled across the surface rests an enormous, vaguely cylindrical form, its shapeless pink flesh encased within an insectoid exoskeleton and sets of clawed appendages marching up the length of its segmented body.  Membranous wings spread out from beneath the organism's bulk, and a pyramidal construct, formed from petal-like ravels of flesh, crowns it.

Asian voices softly converse in the background as latex-gloved hands appear from off frame and busy themselves with delicately cutting around one of the creature's armored plates, the entire scene gently swaying as though the room were located aboard an ocean-going vessel.  After much surgical manipulation, the segment of exoskeleton eventually relinquishes its grasp before the scalpel's insistent slicing, detaching with an unpleasantly wet, peeling sound.  Trailing strands of connective tissue, the plate is set aside as the blades dig into the comparatively delicate flesh beneath, laying the internals bare with a trickle of seeping fluid and a wave of excited gabbles from the unseen surgical crew.

The beast's insides are a paradox of ordered chaos, with stacks of hairy, finger-like structures extending deep within the creature and, like the spokes of a wheel, connecting to a network of four interjoined sacks clustered in a square at the core.  A cartilaginous latticework encircles the sacks, a complicated network of piping running from the organs to various points about the body.  Two constructs, which vaguely resemble the general outline of a traditional lung but are composed of meaty disks connected to a central stock, fill the upper half of the creature's form, with a large amount of sickly yellow fluid flooding the entirety of its internal cavity.

The rest of the video consists of various parts of the creature's anatomy being extricated and examined, with a thick, resin-like substance extruding from one of the sacks as it's sliced open.

LOCAL WIZARD DIES, INVESTIGATION CONTINUES

Investigations are continuing into the death of local wizard Sivi, daughter of Ḥalmet of Clan Redaxe, who was found dead in her home last month.  No foul play is suspected at this time.  An initial report by medical examiners at Massachusetts General Hospital indicated the cause of death as multiple organ failure following a sudden illness.  "It's very strange", said a source close to the matter, "Her organs all looked like those of an elderly person, even though 96 is barely middle-age for a dwarf.  She could have expected to live another hundred years easily.  If you ask me, it's all that research she was doing into the effects of Haste magic.  Probably hasted herself right through to the end of her life.  We've seen side effects in Haste over-usage before but never to a fatal degree."  When asked for comment, Dr. Olivia Wright, a professor of control thaumaturgy at MIT&M, said, "The idea of "haste-death" shows up in rumors repeatedly but there has never been a single confirmed case.  Haste places stress on the body, of course, but the stress is accounted for as part of the effects of the spell.  Ms. Sivi's death was tragic, but fearmongering about the effects of magic helps no one."

当地女巫西维去世，调查仍在继续

对当地女巫西维的死亡调查仍在继续，她是部落红斧家族的哈勒姆特的女儿，上个月在家中被发现死亡。目前没有发现可疑情况。马萨诸塞总医院的法医初步报告显示，死亡原因为突然疾病导致的多器官衰竭。“这很奇怪”，一位知情人士说，“她的器官看起来都像老年人的，尽管96岁对矮人来说才刚刚中年。她本可以轻松再活一百年。我觉得都是她研究加速魔法的副作用。她可能用加速魔法加速了自己的生命结束。我们之前见过加速魔法过度使用的副作用，但从未见过致命的。”当被问及评论时，麻省理工学院和魔法学院的控制魔法教授奥利维亚·赖特博士说：“‘加速死亡’的想法在谣言中反复出现，但从未有一例证实的病例。加速魔法当然会给身体带来压力，但这种压力是魔法效果的一部分。西维女士的死亡很悲剧，但散布关于魔法副作用的恐惧只会误导他人。”

Investigations are continuing into the death of local wizard Sivi, daughter of Ḥalmet of Clan Redaxe, who was found dead in her home last month.  No foul play is suspected at this time.  An initial report by medical examiners at Massachusetts General Hospital indicated the cause of death as multiple organ failure following a sudden illness.  "It's very strange", said a source close to the matter, "Her organs all looked like those of an elderly person, even though 96 is barely middle-age for a dwarf.  She could have expected to live another hundred years easily.  If you ask me, it's all that research she was doing into the effects of Haste magic.  Probably hasted herself right through to the end of her life.  We've seen side effects in Haste over-usage before but never to a fatal degree."  When asked for comment, Dr. Olivia Wright, a professor of control thaumaturgy at MIT&M, said, "The idea of "haste-death" shows up in rumors repeatedly but there has never been a single confirmed case.  Haste places stress on the body, of course, but the stress is accounted for as part of the effects of the spell.  Ms. Sivi's death was tragic, but fearmongering about the effects of magic helps no one."
candidates.target:
当地法师去世，调查仍在进行中

有关当地法师西维的死亡调查仍在继续。西维是红斧氏族哈尔梅特的女儿，上个月在家中被发现死亡。目前暂无证据表明存在任何犯罪行为。马萨诸塞总医院的法医初步报告显示，死因是突发疾病导致的多个器官衰竭。一位知情人士表示：“这非常奇怪，她的器官看起来都像老年人的器官，尽管96岁对于矮人来说才刚刚进入中年。她本可以再活一百年。如果让我说，这很可能是她对快速魔法效果的研究造成的。她可能因快速魔法加速了自己直到生命的终点。我们之前见过快速魔法过度使用的副作用，但从未出现过致命的情况。” 当被要求评论时，麻省理工学院与魔法学院的控制魔法学教授奥利维亚·赖特博士表示：““快速死亡”的想法在传言中反复出现，但从未有过单一的确认病例。快速魔法当然会对身体造成压力，但这种压力被认为是咒语效果的一部分。西维女士的去世令人悲痛，但散布关于魔法效果的恐慌对任何人都没有帮助。”

麻省法师死亡，警方调查不止

近日， 麻省发生了一起神秘的法师死亡案件，死者西维是雷达西氏族赫尔梅的女儿，上个月被发现死于家中。目前，警方正在对此案进行深入调查，尚未发现任何谋杀嫌疑。

据马萨诸塞州总医院验尸官的初步报告显示，西维死于突发性疾病导致的多器官衰竭。然而，知情人士透露，西维的器官状况如同老者，这实在让人惊讶。西维年仅96岁，对于一个侏儒来说，这一年龄还不到中年。

西维的死亡原因引发众人猜测。有传言称，西维或因过度研究急速魔法的效果而导致死亡。有专家表示，急速药可能会对身体施加压力，但这种压力是作为法术效果的一部分来计算的。西维的死亡被认为是一个悲剧，但也有观点认为，对魔法副作用的恐惧并不利于社会的稳定。

麻省理工大学控制肿瘤学教授奥利维亚·赖特(Olivia Wright)在接受记者采访时表示，急速药确实会对身体施加压力，但这种压力是作为法术效果的一部分来计算的。她强调，西维的死是个悲剧，但散布对魔法副作用的恐惧对任何人都没有帮助。

目前，西维的死亡调查仍在继续，警方将竭尽全力查明真相。对于这起案件，我们将持续关注。

Dear Colleagues,

It is with a heavy heart that I have to inform you all of the passing of the head of the supply chain department, Rob Dixon.  He was at the office late last night trying to ensure that everything was under control when he was caught in one of the riots that have been happening all over the city.  Despite all the efforts, Rob did not make it.
Rob was more than just a boss to us, he was a friend and a mentor to many of us.  Rob always put the company and its employees first and he will be deeply missed.
Please keep Rob's family and loved ones in your thoughts and prayers during this difficult time.  The company is working closely with the authorities to ensure that Rob's death is fully investigated.

In the meantime, all of Rob's responsibilities will be temporarily handled by James Sullivan, his senior assistant.  If you have any urgent matters, please reach out to James.
We will provide updates as they become available and further details on arrangements to celebrate Rob's life.

Sincerely,
Dahila Nance
Head of HR department.

诚挚地，
达希拉·南斯

我们将及时通报事件进展，并另行通知追思罗布生平的纪念活动安排。

诚挚的，
达莉哈·南希
人力资源部主管。

I've seen enough Earth kids come through here to know you type.  Here to bite it just like they did?

candidates.source: I grew up in Louisiana with my grandmother.  Great cook.  Made the best boudin I've ever had.  Each night, she would tell me stories; mostly folklore and myths, like about the rougarou, or the Honey Island Swamp monster but… she sometimes told me about me about the Song, and the bones.  The way she talked about it was… different, serious.  Didn't give it much thought back then; I was just a child, after all.  I moved here a few years back for work, before the Cataclysm, before everything changed.  I do miss home sometimes, but at least the rats here are smaller.  Never could stand the things.  Anyway… thank you for asking.  Been a while since I could simply talk to someone.
candidates.target: 我在路易斯安那州和祖母一起长大。她是一位很棒的厨师，做过我吃过的最好吃的布丁。每晚，她都会给我讲故事，大多是民间故事和神话，比如关于鲁加鲁或者哈尼岛沼泽怪兽的，但……有时她也会告诉我关于歌曲和骨头的事。她谈论的方式……不同，很严肃。那时我没多想，毕竟我只是一个孩子。我几年前为了工作搬到了这里，在灾难之前，在一切改变之前。有时我会想念家，但至少这里的老鼠较小。我一直不喜欢那些东西。不管怎样……谢谢你问我。很久没能和人简单地聊聊了。

candidates.source: EDITORIAL: MY MOM, THE RIOTER.  My mother was one of the first of the rioters in Jacksonville.  I've been wondering for a long time how a retired sixty-seven year old woman with a passion for day lilies and knitting wound up allegedly beating a police officer to death and getting thrown in a containment tank.  Last week, against all odds and at great personal risk, I managed to get her released into my care.  I thought I could calm her down.  When they gave her to me, she was straitjacketed and masked, like Hannibal Lecter.  When I got her home I tried to remove the bindings, and she almost immediately tried to strangle me.  It was all I could do to tie her back up and put her in the guest room.  She still eats and drinks when I give her food, but I haven't seen her sleep.  I don't know what that thing is in there, but it's not my mom.  I hope she comes back soon.
candidates.target: 社论：我的妈妈，暴徒。我妈妈是杰克逊维尔第一批暴徒之一。很久以来，我一直在想，一个热爱日百合和编织的退休六十七岁老妇怎么会涉嫌殴打警察致死，并被扔进一个隔离箱。上周，我不顾一切风险和个人危险，设法让她被释放到我照顾下。我以为我能让她冷静下来。当他们把她交给我时，她被束缚着，戴着面具，就像汉尼拔·莱克特。当我把她带回家时，我试图解开她的束缚，她几乎立即试图勒死我。我只能把她重新绑起来，把她关在客房里。她仍然吃喝我给她的食物，但我没见过她睡觉。我不知道那东西是什么，但那不是我的妈妈。我希望她很快回来。

candidates.source:
1.  Faction camps used to require a second companion to act as overseer and camp manager, but that's been replaced by the bulletin board and two-way radio.
2.  It used to be impossible to upgrade faction camps if there was a vehicle, even a cart, on the same map.  You can now upgrade camps even if there is a vehicle on the map, as long as the upgrade doesn't change the area under the vehicle.
3.  Faction camps used to upgrade by completely redrawing the map.  Damage to the camp would be replaced when the camp was upgraded.  Now upgrades only change the actual area being upgraded, and you will have to repair damage to the camp yourself.
4.  There used to be a single path for upgrading the main camp.  Now, after you have completed the first tent, you will have many options for your next upgrade, and you can have different companions working on different upgrades of the main camp at the same time.
5.  Companions who are near a camp will feed themselves from the camp's food stores, and if the camp has a well, they'll use it to quench their thirst.
6.  You can now set up faction camps in select buildings.  The list of available buildings is constantly growing, so you'll have to experiment.
7.  The oldest type of camp, known as the primitive field camp or "Old Camp", is no longer supported and will be removed entirely in the future.
8.  Most camps abided by a restriction that allowed them to add expansions to the camps only when camp constructions had added a sufficient number of beds to the camp (2 per expansion), but this restriction has been removed from all camps.
9.  Field base camps and standard expansions used to be available for fields only.  They can now be placed on fields (as before), hay fields, farm fields, and field dirt roads.
candidates.target:
1. 派系营地曾经需要一名同伴作为监督和营地管理员，但现在已被公告板和对讲机所取代。
2. 以前如果地图上有一辆车，即使是马车，也无法升级派系营地。现在，即使地图上有车辆，只要升级不会改变车辆下面的区域，您也可以升级营地。
3. 派系营地以前是通过完全重新绘制地图来升级的。营地的损坏会在升级时得到修复。现在，升级只改变实际升级的区域，您需要自己修复营地的损坏。
4. 以前只有一个升级主营地的路径。现在，在完成第一个帐篷后，您将有许多选择来决定下一个升级，并且您可以让不同的同伴同时负责主营地的不同升级。
5. 靠近营地的同伴将从营地的食物储备中喂食自己，如果营地有水井，他们会用它来解渴。
6. 现在您可以在选定的建筑中设置派系营地。可用的建筑列表不断扩大，所以您需要进行实验。
7. 最古老的营地类型，称为原始野外营地或“旧营地”，不再受支持，未来将被完全移除。
8. 大多数营地遵守一项限制，即只有在营地建设添加了足够数量的床位（每个扩展2张）时才能添加扩展，但这项限制已从所有营地中移除。
9. 野外基地营地和标准扩展以前只适用于田地。现在，它们可以放置在田地（如以前）、草田、农场田地和田间土路。

candidates.source:
Subject: Danio rerio

Compound: PE065

Objective: Establish PE065's phenotypic range using a well-understood and nonthreatening subject

Protocol: Full-sized aquatic enclosure with reinforced glass observation ports and a small terrestrial area, 3 dosages of nutrient pellets containing test compound. candidates.source: The video starts with an exhausted-looking white woman with shaggy brown hair clumsily setting her phone onto what you assume to be a table.  She then sits back, leaving her face and upper body in frame with a stained wallpaper behind her.  "Hello, my name is Fergie Hensen, I am 47 years old and have worked the last 10 years of my life as a neonatal nurse.  By the time you see this video, I've committed suicide."  She winces and gasps in pain lifting up her left arm - showing a massive bite mark leaking with muddy green pus.  "I don't have long before I die - and before I do, I have to say something important, something you MUST remember."  She looks back at the camera with a pained half-smile and gritted teeth, speaking with a low but sincere tone.  "You, you watching this video, don't ever give up, keep pushing, don't call it quits by killing yourself.  Keep going for as long as you can."  Her voice trembles and her eyes get watery, "I… believe there are people out there in this hell, people like you, who can make things better."  The woman is trying her best to hold back the agonized tears streaming down her disheveled face as her voice starts to crack.  "Find happiness and friends wherever you can, and remember you've got a purpose, and that purpose is not only to survive, it's to thrive."  She lets out an anguished gasp, nearly doubling over in pain before stammering out "Promise me, please, j-just promise me whoever you are, that you'll do that, please."  She then tries to grab the phone off the table to stop recording, but it falls onto the floor the video doesn't end until 7 seconds later.  In the time remaining, she languorously picks the phone off the floor and holds it close to her face - it is only then you register just how bloodshot her eyes are.
