The press release stated that efficacy had broken 90% and a full cure had been achieved for the first time.  "Magic doesn't have a mind of its own," said AAMB representative Dr. Ssmthisk, "it has to be adapted to new circumstances just as any other art or science does.  Just as new weapons called for refinement of protection spells, new diseases require new thaumaturgical treatments."  Dr. Ssmthisk also stressed the importance of the ongoing vaccination effort in overcoming COVID-19.  " I know it's not the news everyone wants to hear, but a vaccine is really the only way out.  Even if every biomancer in the country licensed to practice medicine spent every waking hour and all of our mana curing COVID-19, it would still take us over a decade just to cure the people who have it now, and that's not counting any new infections in the meantime and takes us away from any other treatments we could do.  So please follow the appropriate precautions."

candidates.source: I keep dreaming the same dream ever since Dr. Yin's final session.  The same one she described with that vivid enthusiasm, like she could see it in the waking world as well.  I didn't understand the beauty of it back then, so I just took my notes as usual when one of them vents about the horrible things we encourage them to feel good about -- it is what I'm getting paid for, after all.  Looking at the transcript now, its dryness feels blasphemous: "connected branches of gray vines" he writes, unable to imagine the transcendence of the Whole stretching across infinity, connecting large and small, familiar and unknowable; "moldy fuzz in a positive connotation - rural childhood?" like an armchair psychotherapist grasping at straws, as if the eternal fractal was anything less than divine.  I am grateful for her allowing me to dream the same dream on for her, I only wish it came to me before I hastily reported the session to the bloodhounds at Security.  I remember being terrified of something, but the feeling melted in the radiance of my first night's sleep.  I will need to seek out others of a similar mind, to connect with them, to show them what we can become with time, but I need to be more careful than she was.
candidates.target: 自从尹博士的最后一堂课以来，我一直做着同一个梦。那是她用那种生动的热情描述的梦，仿佛她也能在清醒的世界中看到它。当时我没有理解它的美好，所以我只是像往常一样记下笔记，当他们中的一人抱怨我们鼓励他们感到高兴的那些可怕的事情时——毕竟这是我得到报酬的原因。现在看着这份记录，它的枯燥让我感到亵渎：“灰色的藤蔓相连的枝条”，他写道，无法想象无限延伸的整体的超越，连接大小、熟悉与未知；“带有正面含义的发霉的绒毛——乡村童年？”就像一个坐在沙发上的心理治疗师抓着稻草，仿佛永恒的分形模式不是一件神圣的事物。我很感激她让我为她继续做同一个梦，只希望它在我匆忙向安全部门的血猎犬报告那次课程之前就能出现。我记得我很害怕一些事情，但那感觉在我第一晚睡眠的辐射中融化了。我需要寻找思想相似的人，与他们联系，向他们展示我们随着时间的推移可以成为什么，但我需要比她更小心。

This appears to be a locally saved livestream archive, with the feed filming a decrepit backstreet.  An older, bespectacled man and a middle-aged Latina woman stand huddled in a line against the wall, their legs lashed to each other and their hands bound to the front.  Beaming like a ray of sunshine, a man dressed in tactical gear prances before them, a baseball bat resting conspicuously upon his shoulder as he greets the camera.  "Hey guys," he says, "this is Andre Diliman, and we're going to be putting our detective hats on and figuring out who's to blame for all the shit going on, and we're going to do that, with the help of these beautiful people right here, so please, introduce yourselves."

Exchanging resigned glances, the two captives lower their heads as the woman mutters, "I'm Dr. Martha Sharma."

"And I'm Dr. Conrad Sharma," her compatriot glumly adds.

"And both you fuckers work at Jameson Biotech," the spokesman concludes in a sing-song cadence as he saunters before the couple.  "We're going to start easy.  The CDC has been saying that something's messing with people's brains: making them act all aggressive.  Now, my question to you is simple: What did y'all cook up in those labs of yours?"

Lifting her head and making eye contact with her questioner, the woman shakes her head incredulously.  "You fucking idiot."

Nodding understandingly, the man turns away from the couple.  "I see we might need some harder persuasion, that's not too surprising.  Alexander, Tomas, and Mary, bring in the kid… and the wire!"

Amidst a flurry of horrified protests from the captives, a gaunt man appears from off-frame, a goofy grin creasing his unshaven face as he lugs a squalling baby in his arms.  A second man and a woman follow him into view… uncoiling a length of barbed wire.  Wrapping the rusted steel about the infant's midsection, heedless of the pained wails emanating as the barbs scrape its skin, the duo stand apart, gripping opposite ends of the makeshift garrote.  "Ok guys," the ringleader gleefully instructs, "on my mark, we'll give the little shit a light squeezing.  If the good doctors don't want to talk after that… then I want it rendered into mincemeat!  3, 2, 1…"

Spouts of blood spurt in all directions as bullet-riddled bodies collapse to the ground, the camera toppling rearwards as a bark of automatic gunfire echoes through the audio, accompanied by the approaching, hurried stomps of soldiers' boots.

这似乎是一个本地保存的直播档案，镜头对准了一条破旧的小巷。一个戴眼镜的老人和一个中年拉美裔女子紧贴着墙壁站成一排，他们的腿被捆在一起，双手被绑在前方。一个穿着战术装备的人像阳光般灿烂地出现在他们面前，肩上明显地搭着一根棒球棒，他向摄像机打招呼。

“嘿，各位，”他说，“我是安德烈·迪利曼，我们要戴上侦探帽，找出所有这些事情的罪魁祸首，我们将依靠这些美丽的人们来完成，所以请自我介绍一下。”

交换了几眼无奈的眼神，两个被俘虏的人低下了头，女人低声说：“我是玛莎·沙玛博士。”

“我是康拉德·沙玛博士，”她的同伙沮丧地补充道。

“你们两个都是在詹姆斯生物科技公司工作的，”发言人以唱诗般的语调总结道，他在这对夫妇面前悠闲地走来走去。“我们从简单的问题开始。疾病控制中心一直在说，有什么东西在影响人们的大脑，让他们变得非常侵略性。现在，我想问你们一个简单的问题：你们在实验室里煮了什么？”

抬起头并与提问者对视，女人摇了摇头，难以置信地说：“你这个傻瓜。”

点了点头，男人转过身来，远离了这对夫妇。“我看我们可能需要一些更强硬的手段，这并不令人惊讶。亚历山大、托马斯和玛丽，把孩子带进来...还有铁丝！”

在俘虏们惊恐的抗议声中，一个瘦弱的男人从画外出现，他脸上挂着傻笑，怀里抱着一个哭闹的婴儿。第二个男人和一个女人跟着他进入镜头...卷着一根带刺的铁丝。他们把生锈的钢丝缠绕在婴儿的腰部，无视着刺痛的哭喊声，因为刺儿刮擦着它的皮肤，这对人站开，抓住了临时绞绳的两端。

“好了，各位，”头目高兴地指示道，“在我的口令下，我们会轻轻地挤挤这个小家伙。如果这些好医生不愿意说话，那么我要把它切成肉酱！3，2，1...”

当弹孔遍布的尸体倒在地上时，血溅四射，摄像机向后倾倒，自动武器的枪声在音频中回荡，伴随着士兵靴子急促的脚步声。

candidates.source:
Faction camps require food, but simplify managing your companions.
  When you activate a camp's bulletin board, you'll be required to make some zones if you haven't already.  One of those zones must be a camp food zone.  If you drop food in the camp food zone and select the 'Distribute Food' mission, then the food will disappear and be converted into stored kcalories.
  When you send companions out on camp missions, they'll eat from the stored food when they return at the rate of 2,500 kcalories per day.  Some missions have variable length, and companions will become upset if there isn't enough food when they come back, so try to keep a healthy surplus of food on hand.
  Companions who aren't on camp missions, but who are following you, will also eat from the camp food stores whenever they're hungry and within 2 overmap tiles of the camp.  This drastically simplifies keeping your followers fed, so it's worthwhile to build a minimal faction camp just for this feature.
  You can upgrade a camp to include a water well.  If you do, your followers will also drink from the well when they're thirsty.
candidates.target:
派系营地需要食物，但简化了管理同伴的流程。

当你激活营地的布告板时，如果你还没有设置区域，系统会要求你创建一些区域。其中必须有一个是营地食物区域。如果你将食物放置在营地食物区域并选择“分配食物”任务，那么食物就会消失，并转化为存储的卡路里。

当你派遣同伴执行营地任务时，他们返回时会在每天消耗2,500卡路里的食物。有些任务长度可变，如果返回时没有足够的食物，同伴会感到不满，所以尽量保持充足的食物储备。

没有执行营地任务但跟随你的同伴，只要他们饿了并在营地附近2个大地图格内，也会从营地食物储备中进食。这极大地简化了喂养追随者的过程，所以只为这个功能建造一个最简单的派系营地是值得的。

你可以升级营地以包含一个水井。如果有水井，你的同伴在口渴时也会从水井饮水。

candidates.source: Peasey, truly.  You'll still be mostly mince, like ol' Rubik here.  Even much'a muscle n' bone.  Human inside.  But yer wiggles and wobs, that is yer limbs and digits, will be mostly steel."  Rubik motions to your eyes.  "Yer berry pies, too.  Ye'll keep the see-ey bits, but they'll be part'a the new interface.  So, arms, legs, eyes, it'll all need power to work.  They'll work without, but tassed it isn't nice."  Rubik motions to your torso and head.  "Now, yer chest n' lump, and everything in'em, will go inside the tidy bell.  Yer heart n' lungs n' all of that will keep going as it is now, no need for power.  All in all, you'll be more sturdy, n' the steel'll do the hard work for ye.  No more losin' breath on a scramble with the dead… if ye can stay powered n' in fine repair.

No more losin' breath on a scramble with the dead… if ye can stay powered n' in fine repair.
candidates.target: 皮西，说真的。你依然会大部分是“碎肉”，就像老鲁比克一样。即便只剩肌肉与骨骼，你依然是个活人。但你的肢体与指节，将主要由钢铁构成。”鲁比克指了指你的眼睛，“你的眼球也一样。你会保留那些‘看得见’的部分，但它们将成为新接口的一部分。所以，手臂、双腿、眼睛，都需要电力才能运作。它们确实能在断电时勉强工作，但那样可不太妙。”鲁比克又指了指你的躯干与头部，“现在，你的胸膛与头颅，连同里面的一切，都将装入那整洁的‘钟形舱’中。你的心、肺以及所有内脏，都会像现在一样继续运作，无需额外供电。总而言之，你会更加坚固，而钢铁将替你承担繁重的劳作。不再会在与死者的缠斗中因失血而窒息——前提是你能持续供电并保持良好状态。

I can help with some tasks if you show me where to work.
  Use the zone manager (keybind 'Y') to set up sorting zones for your loot, or to draw blueprints for a building, or to define where you want to plant some crops, or where you'd like some trees cut down, or where you want a vehicle dismantled or repaired, or a good fishing spot.  Then talk to me about my current activity and tell me to sort stuff, or build stuff, or cut down trees, or repair or dismantle a vehicle, or do farmwork, or catch some fish, and I'll go off and do my best to get what you want done.
  If I need tools, you should leave them in a loot zone near where you want me to work - axes for logging, shovels and seeds and fertilizer for farming, wrenches and hacksaws or a toolbox to take apart a vehicle.  I promise to put stuff back in an unsorted loot zone when I'm finished.
  I can pretty much sort out our stuff without needing tools, but keep the piles of unsorted and sorted stuff kind of close together because I don't want to walk back and forth carrying junk too much.
candidates.target:
如果您能指明任务，我可以帮忙完成一些工作。

您可以使用区域管理器（快捷键 'Y'）来设置战利品分类区域，绘制建筑蓝图，标记种植农作物的区域，标记需要砍伐的树木，或者标记需要拆卸或维修的车辆，甚至标记理想的钓鱼地点。然后，您可以告诉我您当前的活动，并指示我分类物品、建造结构、砍伐树木、维修或拆卸车辆、进行农活或捕鱼。我会尽力完成您交托的任务。

如果我需要工具，请将它们放置在靠近工作地点的未分类战利品区域中——例如，砍伐树木需要斧头，农活需要铲子和种子，拆卸车辆需要扳手、钢锯或工具箱。我承诺在完成任务后将物品放回未分类战利品区域。

我几乎可以无需工具地整理我们的物品，但请将未分类和已分类的物品堆放得稍微近一些，因为我不想来回走动携带杂物。

candidates.source: 'cuz I know how cops think.  If you can call it that.  Early days, they were still going after alarms in case it meant, I dunno, survivors.  You smack some fucker's sports car, it starts wailing, the cops come to take a look and you can walk right behind 'em.  That's the thing about cops; they follow orders, right?  Even when the world's comin' apart.  I kept my head down until I got past the worst of it, but then, lucky me, I got sergeant brainiac.  Figured out why someone would trip an alarm on purpose, had them case all up and down the streets for me.  I wound up on the edge of town layin' low under an abandoned RV for a few hours.  By then… well, they had some other big problems to deal with.  For a little bit.  Might've survived if they hadn't blown their wads chasing me around the block.
candidates.target: 因为我知道警察的思维方式。如果可以这么说的话。早期，他们还在追查报警信号，以防万一有幸存者。你撞了某人的跑车，警报响起，警察会来查看，你可以跟在他们后面走。这就是警察的优点；他们听从命令，对吧？即使世界已经乱成一团。我低调行事，直到度过了最危险的时期，但幸运的是，我遇到了一个聪明精明的警司。他想到了有人会故意触发警报的原因，让警察在街道上四处搜寻。我最终躲在镇边的一辆废弃房车下待了几个小时。到那时……好吧，他们有其他更大的问题要处理。短暂的时间里。如果他们没有花精力在街区里追捕我，他们可能活下来了。

你好，Monica！我是从 Tony 那里得到你的联系方式，因为我正在洽谈购买你位于郊区的其中一处房产。我有一家小型开发公司，已准备好破土动工，但想了解一下该区域是否存在放射性物质或其他地质情况？我知道这听起来有些奇怪，但某些因素可能会让我完全无法在此建设。  

另外，鉴于该区域自挂牌以来出现的新情况，是否有可能对价格进行一定程度的下调？我曾向 Tony 询问，他表示需要与你确认。谢谢！

candidates.source:
&To: monica evers
Subject: Interest in property

Hello, Monica!  I got your information from Tony because I'm in talks to buy one of your properties out of town.  I have a small development firm ready to break ground, but I was wondering if you had any details on radioactive materials or other geology in the area?  I know this is a strange question but certain things will prevent me from building at all.

Also, given the recent developments in the area since the listing, would it be possible to reduce the price at all?  I asked Tony but he said he would have to run it by you.  Thank you.

candidates.source: What happened?  I'm not really sure.  You must know about the riots and all that, that the government and the police totally failed to contain.  I don't have a good guess what caused that.  I thought it was the usual stuff at first, and I gotta admit, I was sort of excited and scared it was the start of a revolution.  Not excited enough to join in though, and I guess anyone who was is probably dead now.  I tried to wait it out at home, packed a little bug-out bag, but then the internet started showing videos of rioters getting back up and fighting with crazy injuries.  I don't know how many people really believed it at first, but I took that as my sign and ditched town for the evac shelter.  I don't know exactly what happened after that.  The center I was in was heavily vandalized and empty, and I never saw anyone else.  The cell phone grid was locked up, except for one emergency message that came through around a day later saying the government had fallen.  Power went out a few days later.
candidates.target: 发生了什么事？我也不太确定。你肯定知道那些政府和警察完全控制不住的骚乱吧。我猜不透是什么原因导致了那一切。起初我以为是常有的那一套，得承认，我有点兴奋，还害怕那是革命的开始。尽管如此，我并没有加入其中，我想那些加入的人现在可能都已经死了。我最初在家里等待，准备了一个小小的应急包，但后来互联网上开始出现暴徒们带着疯狂伤口重新站起来战斗的视频。我不知道一开始有多少人相信了那一切，但我把那当成了我的信号，逃离了小镇，去了疏散避难所。我也不知道那之后具体发生了什么。我所在的中心被严重破坏，已经空无一人，我再也没有见到其他人。手机信号被锁定了，除了大约一天之后收到的一条紧急信息，说政府已经倒台了。几天后，电力也中断了。

candidates.source:
This appears to be a segment of bodycam footage, with the perspective shaking as the wearer jogs through a dimly lit corridor, a drawn pistol's muzzle leading the way.  Rounding a bend, any forward progress is promptly arrested as a formally dressed woman comes into the shot.  Hefting a large sledgehammer and crushing the skulls of zombie after zombie clambering through a shattered window, an expression of childish glee is plastered across her face.

Glancing towards the camera, her maniacal grin grows wider as she abandons her post and, stumbling on high heels, rushes towards the view.  Heedless of the bullets that plunge into her gore-caked body, the enraptured look upon the woman's face as she swings the mallet and blood spurts across the lens is going to haunt you in your sleep.
candidates.target:
这似乎是一段警用摄像机录下的画面，镜头随着佩戴者跑过昏暗走廊而摇晃，枪口在前面引路。转过一个弯，一个穿着正式服装的女人进入镜头，任何前进的尝试都立即停止了。她举起一把大锤，将一具又一具僵尸从破碎的窗户砸下，脸上洋溢着童趣般的欢欣。

她向摄像机瞥了一眼，疯狂的笑容在脸上扩大，她放弃了岗位，踉跄地穿着高跟鞋向镜头冲来。她无视射入她满是鲜血的身体的子弹，她挥舞着大锤，血溅在镜头上，她如痴如醉的表情将让你在睡眠中惊恐不已。

candidates.source: Yeah, it was like a… like a big soft shelled crab, with tentacle mouths, and it kept talking in different voices.  I saw it before it saw me, and I capped it with my blunderbuss.  That just pissed it off, but I got another shot off while it charged me.  It got me, but I managed to end it first.  I figured out shit had hit the oyster shell, somehow.  Headed to my shelter and camped out there for a while, but I had to skip out when a bunch of giant bees showed up and trashed the place.  I ran into you not much later.

Headed to my shelter and camped out there for a while, but I had to skip out when a bunch of giant bees showed up and trashed the place.  I ran into you not much later.

candidates.source:
If I'm better at a skill than you, I can help you improve.  But it's boring to teach a lot, so I'm not going to do it very often.  And I'm not going to do it when we're in danger or if I'm hungry or tired or if you're driving.
  If we're someplace safe and you're reading a book that improves skills, I'll listen if I don't have that skill.  You can even read me books for skills that you already have.
  If you give me a book that teaches a skill and that's accessible to someone with my current skill, you can ask me about my current activity and tell me to read it, and I'll learn from the book.  But while I'm reading, I won't be following you around, so make sure I'm in a safe place.
  And don't bother asking me about learning or teaching martial arts styles.  My brain just doesn't work that way, so I don't know any to teach you and it's pointless trying to get me to learn any.
candidates.target:
如果我某项技能比你好，我可以帮助你提高。但是，教很多东西很无聊，所以我不会经常这样做。我也不会在我们处于危险中、我饿了、累了，或者你在开车的时候教你。

如果我们在安全的地方，你在读一本可以提高技能的书，我会听你读，如果我没有那项技能。你甚至可以给我读一些你已经掌握的技能的书。

如果你给我一本教某项技能的书，并且这本书对我当前的技能水平是可及的，你可以问我当前在做什么，然后让我读这本书，我会从中学习。但是，在我阅读的时候，我不会跟着你跑，所以确保我在一个安全的地方。

而且，别再问我关于学习或教授武术的问题。我的脑子就是不适合这样，所以我不知道有什么可以教你，试图让我学习也是徒劳的。

candidates.source:
BOSTON WAND BUST NABS THREE

Officers with the Bureau of Alcohol, Thaumaturgy, and Firearms have seized almost 60 wands, including greater combat wands, during the arrest of three Italian nationals in Boston yesterday.  Davide Messina, 34, Michele Pellegrino, 29, and Lokúr Santoro, 128, all of Rome, Italy, are being charged with three counts of wand trafficking as well as two counts of conspiracy.  The charges allege that Messina, Pellegrino, and Santoro met with an unnamed party as part of a smuggling operation to transport combat wands through America to final destinations in Central and South America.

酒精、魔法和枪支局（Bureau of Alcohol, Thaumaturgy, and Firearms）的警员昨日在波士顿逮捕三名意大利公民时，缴获了近60根魔杖，包括几根战斗魔杖。戴维德·梅西纳（Davide Messina），34岁；米凯勒·佩莱格里诺（Michele Pellegrino），29岁；以及洛库尔·桑托罗（Lokúr Santoro），128岁，均来自意大利罗马，被指控三项魔杖走私罪和两项阴谋罪。指控称，梅西纳、佩莱格里诺和桑托罗与一名未透露姓名的当事人会面，作为走私战斗魔杖的行动的一部分，将魔杖通过美国运往中美洲和南美洲的最终目的地。

波士顿酒精、神术与火器局（Bureau of Alcohol, Thaumaturgy, and Firearms）执法人员昨日在逮捕三名意大利籍人士时，缴获了近 60 根魔杖，其中包括多根用于实战的魔杖。被指控者均为罗马人：34 岁的达维德·梅西纳（Davide Messina）、29 岁的米凯莱·佩莱格里诺（Michele Pellegrino）以及 128 岁的洛库尔·桑托罗（Lokúr Santoro）。三人因涉嫌三项魔杖走私罪及两项共谋罪被起诉。检方指控称，梅西纳、佩莱格里诺和桑托罗与一名未具名人员接触，参与一项走私活动，旨在将实战魔杖运入美国，最终转送至中美洲和南美洲。

candidates.source:
BOSTON WAND BUST NABS THREE

Officers with the Bureau of Alcohol, Thaumaturgy, and Firearms have seized almost 60 wands, including greater combat wands, during the arrest of three Italian nationals in Boston yesterday.  Davide Messina, 34, Michele Pellegrino, 29, and Lokúr Santoro, 128, all of Rome, Italy, are being charged with three counts of wand trafficking as well as two counts of conspiracy.  The charges allege that Messina, Pellegrino, and Santoro met with an unnamed party as part of a smuggling operation to transport combat wands through America to final destinations in Central and South America.

candidates.source: That's a tougher question than you might think.  I've had quite the life.  My dad was a mechanic, and when I was young I used to help around the shop quite a bit.  I started out thinking I was going to get into that line of work, but then I got sidetracked and wound up getting into computers and electrical work for a long time.  Did part of an electrical engineering degree, then decided it wasn't for me and quit that.  Spent a bit of time doing freelance electrical and programming work, then got recruited by a startup that was designing and programming medical equipment.  I was supposed to be a general technician, but through a weird series of events I wound up in sales, then management.  I hated management, and I'd made a big nest egg from my share stock, so I cashed out and tried to retire young.  That was a dumb move, I was bored as hell, so I finished off my degree and started doing on-call teaching work for shop, computers, math, and things like that at a college and high school level.  Just part time, and I spent the rest of my time outdoors, hiking and whatnot.
candidates.target: 这是一个比你想象中要困难的问题。我经历过不少事情。我父亲是个机械师，我小的时候经常在店里帮忙。我起初以为我会走上那条路，但后来偏离了轨道，最终从事了很长一段时间的计算机和电气工作。我读了部分电气工程学位，后来决定那不是我的菜，就放弃了。我做了一些自由职业的电气和编程工作，然后被一家设计和编程医疗设备的初创公司招募了。我本该成为一名普通的技术员，但经过一系列奇怪的事件，我最终走上了销售和管理岗位。我讨厌管理工作，我从股票中赚了不少钱，所以我卖掉了一切，试图年轻退休。那是一个愚蠢的决定，我无比无聊，所以我完成了我的学位，开始在大学和高中水平的商店、计算机、数学等方面做兼职教学工作。我只做兼职，剩下的时间我都在户外徒步旅行等等。

candidates.source: We never even made it to Newport.  The truck got stomped by something gigantic.  I didn't even see it, just saw this huge black-and-green spiny leg jam through the ceiling, through the el-tee.  Heard the tires grinding, felt the truck lift up.  We were kicked off the leg like dog shit off a sneaker.  I don't know how I survived.  The thing rolled over, killed most of us right there.  I musta blacked out for a bit.  Came to, and while I was getting myself out, the others started getting back up.  Long story short, I lived, they didn't, and I ran.
candidates.target: 我们甚至没到过纽波特。卡车被什么巨大的东西踩扁了。我没看到，只看到一条巨大的黑绿色的带刺的腿穿过车顶，穿过车顶。听到轮胎在磨，感觉卡车被抬起来。我们被踢得像狗屎一样飞了出去。我不知道我是怎么活下来的。那个东西翻了个身，当场把大多数人压死了。我可能短暂失去了知觉。我醒来时，正在自己从卡车里爬出来，其他人也开始站起来。总之，我活了下来，他们没活，我跑了。

candidates.source: In your dream, you are on the top of a mountain in the wilderness, with no lights nearby and countless stars wheeling overhead.  You lie down in the grass and let the cool night breeze wash over you as you look for the familiar constellations.  You find the Big Dipper with ease and trace a line across to Orion only to do a double-take.  One of the stars on Orion's Belt is missing.  As you look at Cassiopeia, you see the W is broken by a missing star, and then as you look at Leo one of the stars vanishes.  You frantically search the sky as stars wink out, one after the other, until there's only one left.  Polaris, the North Star, steadfast guide of sailors for millennia.  You stand and take a step, not sure what you're hoping to accomplish, and then the last star goes out and you wake up in a cold sweat.
candidates.target: 在你的梦中，你身处荒野山顶，四周没有灯光，头顶却是无数闪烁的星星。你躺在草地上，任由凉爽的夜风拂过，一边寻找着熟悉的星座。你轻易地找到了大熊座，沿着一条线望去，找到了猎户座，却突然惊讶地发现，猎户座腰带上的星星缺了一颗。当你看向仙女座时，你看到“W”形的星座被缺失的一颗星星打破了，然后当你看向狮子座时，其中一颗星星也消失了。你焦急地搜寻着天空，星星一颗接一颗地熄灭，直到只剩下最后一颗——北极星，千百年来航海者的忠实向导。你站起身来，不确定自己想要做什么，就在这时，最后一颗星星也熄灭了，你一身冷汗地醒来。

You frantically search the sky as stars wink out, one after the other, until there's only one left.  Polaris, the North Star, steadfast guide of sailors for millennia.  You stand and take a step, not sure what you're hoping to accomplish, and then the last star goes out and you wake up in a cold sweat.
candidates.target: 在梦中，你在荒野的山顶上，附近没有灯光，无数的星星在头顶旋转。你躺在草地上，任凭凉爽的夜风吹拂，寻找熟悉的星座。你轻而易举地找到了北斗七星，并沿着一条线找到了猎户座，但却不禁两眼发直。猎户座腰带上的一颗星星不见了。当你看到仙后座时，你发现W被一颗丢失的星星打破了，然后当你看到狮子座时，其中一颗星星消失了。你疯狂地搜索天空，星星一颗接一颗地消失，直到只剩下一颗。北极星，北极星，千百年来水手们坚定的向导。你站在原地，迈开步子，不知道自己想要完成什么，然后最后一颗星星熄灭了，你在冷汗中醒来。

This appears to be a promo video for Food Place brand food, depicting a nondescript drive-through with an idling open-topped convertible containing a family of four.  As the driver is handed a paper bag of generic fast food, a sudden bolt of lightning arcs from the night sky, striking the bag and reducing it to ashes.  With the family left exchanging wide-eyed glances, the growl of an engine becomes audible over a steadily rising crescendo of music.  The soundtrack eventually resolves into a rock iteration of the American anthem as a purple motorcycle bursts onto the scene, the Food Place logo stamped upon the side, and its caped rider bearing the noble visage… of Food Person!  Swiftly mounting the car's hood, the motorcycle soars in a slow-motion arc across the convertible, its rider depositing a giant bag of Food Place food into the arms of the cheering family.  Large, metallic text stamps boldly across the view as the bike lands and roars into the distance.

"Food Place: The hero your stomach doesn't deserve… but needs!"

The text dissolves, replaced by three figures holding appropriately massive hamburgers: Abraham Lincoln, Martin Luther King, and, in between them… Jesus?

"Food Place: food made by great Americans… for great Americans!"

这似乎是Food Place品牌食品的宣传视频，展示了一个普通的得来速餐厅，一辆四口之家的敞篷车静静地停在那里。当司机收到一个装有普通快餐的纸袋时，一道闪电突然从夜空中划过，击中了纸袋，将其烧成灰烬。一家人惊讶地对视着，引擎的轰鸣声在逐渐升高的音乐中变得清晰可闻。配乐最终转变为摇滚版的美国国歌，一辆紫色的摩托车出现在画面中，车身上印有Food Place的标志，骑手戴着斗篷，英姿飒爽……是Food人！摩托车迅速跃上汽车的引擎盖，在敞篷车上划出一个慢动作弧线，骑手将一个巨大的Food Place食品袋子递给欢呼的家人。当摩托车落地并轰隆声中驶远时，大而鲜明的金属文字出现在画面上。

“Food Place：你的胃不配拥有，但需要的英雄！”

文字消失，被三个拿着超大汉堡的人取代：亚伯拉罕·林肯、马丁·路德·金，中间是……耶稣？

“Food Place：由伟大的美国人制作……为伟大的美国人！”

candidates.source:
Well, no.  It was obvious they just wanted to get rid of me, but I decided I wanted to show that I was useful.  They tell me to find a crashed drone somewhere in the surrounding area and bring it back here.  No directions, of course.  Y'know, go find this drone in the middle of the woods, it'll be easy.  But I had some tools in my bag, right?  And yours truly has repaired some drones in the park service."

"So it takes me a whole-ass afternoon, but I find their stupid drone stuck in a tree.  I can see the camera's still on, so I pick it up and I tell the lens: 'Hey, you want me to fix it too?'  And I do.  It was just a cracked frame and the wiring to the rotors was sliced up.  The propellers themselves were fine.  So I bring it out of the woods and turn it off.  Then I open up the casing, solder up the wires, and use superglue to hold the frame together, which wasn't perfect, but I figured it'd hold until it got back home.  Then I turned it back on, and wouldn't you know, it immediately starts up and sits there for a minute, like 'What the fuck?  Why am I working again?'  And then it flies away, and I walk my smug ass back home.
candidates.target:
好吧，不是这样的。很明显他们只是想摆脱我，但我决定要证明自己有用。他们让我在附近找一台坠毁的无人机并把它带回来。当然没有具体方向。你知道的，去森林深处找这台无人机，这很简单。但我的包里有一些工具，对吧？而且我在公园管理处修过一些无人机。

所以我花了整整一个下午，终于找到了他们那愚蠢的无人机，卡在树上。我看到摄像头还在工作，于是我拿起它，对镜头说：“嘿，你也想让我修吗？”然后我就修好了。只是一个破碎的机框，连接到转子的电线被剪断了。螺旋桨本身没问题。于是我把它从森林里带出来，关掉它。然后我打开机壳，焊接电线，用超级胶水固定机框，虽然不完美，但我想它应该能坚持到回家。然后我再次打开它，你猜怎么着，它立即启动，在那里待了一分钟，像是在想“什么鬼？为什么我又工作了？”然后它飞走了，我得意地走回家了。

candidates.source:
To reach the space where the aforementioned shard can be found, you will need a few chunks of sulfur, a bottle of strong alcohol, red meat from an animal, meat from a mutant, meat from a human and meat from a Fae.  With all these components, the ritual will be possible to accomplish.

However, do not initiate the ritual if you aren't in the condition to fight through hordes of foes, as it is what awaits you once you have completed the ritual.  You will be swallowed instantly by a nightmarish being known as the Abyssal Hunger and end up somewhere within it, where things akin to the cells of a body will attack you.

As you progress through the layers of its body, resistance will increase as you get closer to what constitutes its brain.  Within it, shards can be found.  Extract one, and you will return in our world at the exact place where you left it.

Try to stay away from the red globules, they're incredibly powerful but almost fully blind.  The green globules will try to drag you closer to the red ones so be ready to kill all of them as quickly as you can.  Preparing ways to do so is a good idea, and so is bringing a source of light and preparing for a half-hour where the only thing you will do is fighting for your life.
candidates.target:
要到达可以找到上述碎片的空间，你需要一些硫磺块、一瓶强酒精、动物的红肉、变异体的肉、人类的肉和精灵的肉。有了这些成分，仪式就可以进行了。

但是，如果你没有能力对抗成群的敌人，就不要开始仪式，因为完成仪式后，你将面临的是被一个被称为“深渊之饥”的恐怖生物吞噬，并最终出现在它的体内，那里有像身体细胞一样的东西会攻击你。

当你穿过它的身体层层组织时，抵抗力会随着你接近它的“大脑”而增强。在它的脑内，你可以找到碎片。取出一个，你就会回到我们的世界，回到你离开的地方。

尽量避开红色的球体，它们极其强大，但几乎完全是盲的。绿色的球体会试图把你拉向红色的球体，所以要准备好迅速杀死它们。提前准备好应对方法是个好主意，带上光源，并为持续半小时的战斗做好准备，因为在那段时间里，你唯一要做的是为生存而战。

candidates.source: What's the alternative?  You take the hand you're dealt.  I've given eulogies for two of the people I love most on this earth, and the third wrote me off.  I've already been through the end of the world.  Came out the other side with my bits intact.  And you know, I've been pretty lonely since my wife passed.  Here I've got friends.  We might be hungry but we're close.  Reena's been teaching me math and science, Luo is one of the smartest folks I've ever met - she's got a doctorate you know - and Yusuke is the only one here that can beat me at poker.  And Dave, well, he's Dave.  There's more goin' on under the surface there, mark my words.  We may be unfit, but we aren't worthless.
candidates.target: 没有选择。你只能接受手上的牌。我已经为我最爱的人中的两个做了悼词，第三个则离我而去。我已经经历了世界末日。我从中走出来，仍然完整。你知道，自从妻子去世后，我一直很孤独。在这里，我有朋友。我们可能很饥饿，但我们很亲近。雷娜一直在教我数学和科学，罗是我遇过最聪明的人之一——她有博士学位，你知道的——优介是这里唯一能赢我的扑克牌高手。而戴夫，嗯，他是戴夫。相信我，他内心深处还有更多。我们可能不适合，但我们并不无用。

Overlooking a stage formed from a shipping crate placed upon a harbor wharf, the view depicts a man dressed in combat fatigues standing atop the container, two militiamen flanking him, and a line of bound and gagged civilians kneeling in a line at the structure's edge: a potbellied man, an athletic-looking woman, an adolescent girl, and a boy.  Crowds of people are gathered at the container's foot, gazing up as the uniformed man speaks.

"My fellow Rhodians," he booms.  "On behalf of the Narragansett government, I stand before you to announce that, this morning, these individuals," he pronounces, gesturing towards the bound captives with a flourish of a drawn pistol, "were detained as they attempted to cross our borders, doubtlessly intended to be installed as sleeper agents during this time of emergency.  That the United States would seek to invest in our destruction, even as their own countrymen are falling before the undead, is nothing short of disgusting.  Let the fates of these intruders serve as an example to any who would challenge the sovereignty of Rhode Island!"

Stepping behind the restrained man, the speaker presses his pistol against his head.  "This man," he declares, "was found to carry a weapon within his vehicle and is doubtlessly a soldier of the United States."  The echo of a solitary shot reverberates through the audio as the man's lifeless corpse rolls from the container and plunges into the water below amidst muffled shrieks from his fellow captives.

"This woman," the executioner thunders, stepping behind the prisoner in question, "was registered as possessing land within our borders.  Land, my friends, upon which a bunker was built!"  A second shot and a spray of brains herald the woman's end as her body plunges to join her compatriot before the man marches behind the huddled children.

"These kids aren't responsible for the actions of their government," he somberly announces.  "Yet, they will grow to be enemies of Rhode Island and must be dealt with; the law bends for no one."

Two more gunshots and two smaller splashes bring the video to an end.

视频展示了一个从集装箱组成的舞台，集装箱被放置在港口码头上，画面中一名穿着战斗迷彩服的男子站在集装箱顶端，两名民兵站在他两侧，一排被捆绑和堵嘴的平民跪在结构的边缘：一个胖肚子男人、一个体格健壮的女人、一个青少年女孩和一个男孩。人群聚集在集装箱底部，仰望着制服男子的演讲。

“我的罗得岛同胞们，”他大声说道。“代表纳拉甘塞特政府，我站在这里宣布，今天早上，这些人，”他挥舞着手枪，指向被捆绑的俘虏，“在试图越过我们的边境时被拘留，无疑是打算在这个紧急时刻被安插为卧底特工。即使他们的同胞在僵尸面前倒下，美国也试图破坏我们，这令人不齿。让这些入侵者的命运成为任何挑战罗得岛主权者的警示！”

演讲者走到被约束的男人身后，将手枪顶在他的头上。“这个人，”他宣布，“在车内被发现携带武器，无疑是美国的士兵。”枪声回响，男子的尸体从集装箱上滚落，掉进了水里，伴随着同伴的压抑尖叫声。

“这个女人，”行刑者走到那个囚犯身后，大声说道，“被登记为在我们边境内拥有土地！土地，朋友们，上面建了一个地下室！”第二枪声和脑浆四溅标志着女人的终结，她的身体掉下来，加入她的同伙，然后男人走到聚集的孩子们身后。

“这些孩子不对他们政府的行为负责，”他严肃地宣布。“然而，他们会成长为罗得岛的敌人，必须对他们采取行动；法律对任何人都没有屈服。”

两声枪响和两个小水花标志着视频的结束。

说话者走到被缚男子身后，将手枪抵住其头部。“此人，”他宣称，“在其车辆内被发现藏有武器，毫无疑问是美国士兵。”一声枪响在音频中回荡，男子的尸体从集装箱上滚落，坠入下方水中，其余俘虏发出被压抑的尖叫。

“这名女子，”行刑者厉声喝道，随即走到该囚犯身后，“已被登记为在我们境内拥有土地。朋友们，那片土地上竟建有一座地堡！”第二声枪响伴随着脑浆飞溅，宣告了女子的终结；她的身体坠下，与同伴汇合。随后，行刑者走向蜷缩在一起的孩子们。

“这些孩子无需为其政府的行为负责，”他沉痛地宣布，“然而，他们终将成长为罗德岛的敌人，必须予以处置；法律面前，无人例外。”

两声枪响，两声较小的水花声，视频至此结束。

Overlooking a stage formed from a shipping crate placed upon a harbor wharf, the view depicts a man dressed in combat fatigues standing atop the container, two militiamen flanking him, and a line of bound and gagged civilians kneeling in a line at the structure's edge: a potbellied man, an athletic-looking woman, an adolescent girl, and a boy.  Crowds of people are gathered at the container's foot, gazing up as the uniformed man speaks.

"My fellow Rhodians," he booms.  "On behalf of the Narragansett government, I stand before you to announce that, this morning, these individuals," he pronounces, gesturing towards the bound captives with a flourish of a drawn pistol, "were detained as they attempted to cross our borders, doubtlessly intended to be installed as sleeper agents during this time of emergency.  That the United States would seek to invest in our destruction, even as their own countrymen are falling before the undead, is nothing short of disgusting.  Let the fates of these intruders serve as an example to any who would challenge the sovereignty of Rhode Island!"

Stepping behind the restrained man, the speaker presses his pistol against his head.  "This man," he declares, "was found to carry a weapon within his vehicle and is doubtlessly a soldier of the United States."  The echo of a solitary shot reverberates through the audio as the man's lifeless corpse rolls from the container and plunges into the water below amidst muffled shrieks from his fellow captives.

"This woman," the executioner thunders, stepping behind the prisoner in question, "was registered as possessing land within our borders.  Land, my friends, upon which a bunker was built!"  A second shot and a spray of brains herald the woman's end as her body plunges to join her compatriot before the man marches behind the huddled children.

"These kids aren't responsible for the actions of their government," he somberly announces.  "Yet, they will grow to be enemies of Rhode Island and must be dealt with; the law bends for no one."

Two more gunshots and two smaller splashes bring the video to an end.

俯瞰由一艘置于码头货舱上形成的舞台，画面中一名身着作战服的男人站在集装箱顶端，两侧各有一名民兵护卫，而在该结构边缘则跪着一排被捆绑并封口的平民：一位大腹便便的男子、一位体格健硕的女子、一名少女和一名男孩。人群聚集在集装箱底部，仰望着这名制服男子发表演说。

“各位罗德岛同胞，”他洪亮地宣告，“我代表纳拉甘西特政府在此宣布：今晨，这些人，”他一边说着，一边用握枪的手势指向被捆绑的俘虏，“因试图跨越我们的边境而被拘留，无疑意在成为此次紧急状态下的潜伏特工。美国竟企图投资我们的毁灭，而与此同时，他们自己的同胞却倒在了行尸的脚下，这简直令人作呕。就让这些入侵者的命运成为任何挑战罗德岛主权的挑战者的警示！”

说话者走到被束缚男子身后，将手枪抵在他的头上。“此人，”他宣布道，“在其车辆内被发现携带武器，无疑是一名美国士兵。”随着一声孤零零的枪声在音频中回荡，这名男子的尸体从集装箱中滚落，坠入下方的水中，与此同时，其他俘虏发出闷哼般的尖叫。

“这位女士，”行刑者怒吼道，走到该囚犯身后，“她在我们的边境内拥有土地登记。土地，朋友们，上面还建有掩体！”第二声枪响伴随着脑浆飞溅，宣告了这位女士的终结，她的身体随之坠落，与她的同胞合二为一，随后男子走向那群蜷缩的孩子。

“这些孩子不能为其政府的行为负责，”他沉重地宣布，“但他们终将成长为罗德岛的敌人，必须予以处理；法律对任何人都没有弹性。”

又两声枪响和两声较小的水花声，视频至此结束。

“罗德岛的同胞们！”他声如洪钟，“我代表纳拉甘西特政府宣布——”手枪“咔嗒”上膛，枪管划过被缚者的方向，“今晨抓获的这批人企图偷越边境，显然是要在紧急状态下安插潜伏特工。当美国本土都沦陷于行尸走肉时，他们竟妄图摧毁我们，简直令人作呕！让这些入侵者的下场，成为挑战罗德岛主权者的榜样！”

演讲者踱到被缚男子身后，枪口抵住太阳穴：“此人车内藏有武器，必是美国军人。”孤零零的枪声在码头回荡，尸体滚落集装箱坠入海中，其他俘虏发出沉闷的惊叫。

“而这个女人——”行刑者大步跨到女囚身后，“登记在我们境内的土地上竟建有地堡！”第二声枪响伴随着脑浆迸裂，尸体追随同伴坠入海中。军官最后走向蜷缩的孩童。

“孩子不该为政府行为负责，”他沉痛宣布，“但长大后终将成为罗德岛之敌。法律面前，没有例外。”

两声枪响和两朵较小的水花后，视频戛然而止。

candidates.source: Hoo boy, yes they did, and let me tell you, they were not happy campers about me crashing on their couch.  Now, these people don't tell me who they are, but they tell me to get off the premises immediately.  I wasn't having that.  I had been through hell and come out the other end, and I don't remember what I said to them, but it was along the lines of 'I have nowhere to go, and your building is nice and cozy, so if you want me to leave, you can come out here and make me.'"  They laugh.  "They weren't expecting me to bite back.  So I turn off the intercom and I go eat lunch.  When I go back again, the first thing they ask is if I want a job.
candidates.target: 哎呀，是的，他们确实这样做了，让我告诉你，他们对我睡在他们的沙发上可不高兴。现在，这些人没有告诉我他们是谁，但他们让我立即离开。我不同意。我经历了地狱般的折磨，并从中走出来，我不记得我当时对他们说了什么，但大意是：“我没有地方去，你们的楼房又好又舒适，所以如果你们想让我离开，那你们可以出来逼我离开。”他们笑了。“他们没想到我会反驳。于是我关掉对讲机，去吃午饭。当我回去时，他们首先问我是否想要一份工作。

candidates.source: Well now, my friend-o!  You just asked a mighty fine question.  Folks have been missing the little things in life.  New shoes, new cellphones, can't exactly go shopping, or, well, I guess you sorta can, if you mind the broken glass.  I left my wallet in an outdoorsman's store when I 'bought' this warmer coat.  Figured that's kinda it, you know?  It didn't matter anymore.  I don't think my insurance's going to pay out for any health care I get now.  I did what you see in the movies though, I rolled a joint with a hundred dollar bill.  Ended up coughing and rerolling it in regular paper though.  Was too harsh.  Just letting you know in case you get the smart idea of trying it.
candidates.target: 好吧，我的朋友！你刚刚问了一个非常好问题。人们一直忽略了生活中的小事。新鞋子、新手机，现在不能去购物，或者，嗯，我想你可以，如果你不介意碎玻璃。我在户外用品店留下了钱包，当时我“买”了这件保暖外套。我想这就是这样了，你知道的？这已经不重要了。我不认为我的保险会为我现在的医疗费用买单。我做了你在电影中看到的那种事，我用一张百元大钞卷了一个大麻卷。但最终我咳嗽了，然后用普通纸重新卷了起来。太刺激了。只是想告诉你，以防你有聪明的想法去尝试。

candidates.source:
“I met a traveller from an antique land
 Who said: Two vast and trunkless legs of stone
 Stand in the desert. Near them on the sand,
 Half sunk, a shatter'd visage lies, whose frown
 And wrinkled lip and sneer of cold command
 Tell that its sculptor well those passions read
 Which yet survive, stamp'd on these lifeless things,
 The hand that mock'd them and the heart that fed.
 And on the pedestal these words appear:
 ‘My name is Ozymandias, king of kings:
 Look on my works, ye Mighty, and despair!’
 Nothing beside remains: round the decay
 Of that colossal wreck, boundless and bare,
 The lone and level sands stretch far away.”
    -Percy Bysshe Shelley, “Ozymandias”. 1818.
candidates.target:
我遇见了一个来自古老国度的旅行者，
他说：在沙漠中矗立着两块巨大的、没有身躯的石腿，
在它们附近，沙地上半埋着一张破碎的面容，
那皱眉、那卷曲的嘴唇和冷酷的命令的冷笑，
表明了它的雕塑家很了解那些仍然存活的情感，
这些情感被印在这些没有生命的东西上，
那双嘲讽它们的双手和滋养它们的内心。
在基座上刻着这些文字：
“我的名字是奥西曼迪亚斯，国王中的国王，
看看我的作品，你们这些强者，绝望吧！”
除了这些，什么也没剩下：在那巨大的废墟周围，
无边无际、空旷而平静的沙丘延伸到远方。

 看看我的作品吧，伟人，你们就该绝望吧！’
 没有任何东西剩下：围绕着那座巨大的废墟，
 无垠的荒漠延伸着，遥远无边。”

    - 培里·拜西·雪莱，《奥西曼第亚斯》，1818年。

candidates.source:
“I met a traveller from an antique land
 Who said: Two vast and trunkless legs of stone
 Stand in the desert. Near them on the sand,
 Half sunk, a shatter'd visage lies, whose frown
 And wrinkled lip and sneer of cold command
 Tell that its sculptor well those passions read
 Which yet survive, stamp'd on these lifeless things,
 The hand that mock'd them and the heart that fed.
 And on the pedestal these words appear:
 ‘My name is Ozymandias, king of kings:
 Look on my works, ye Mighty, and despair!’
 Nothing beside remains: round the decay
 Of that colossal wreck, boundless and bare,
 The lone and level sands stretch far away.”
    -Percy Bysshe Shelley, “Ozymandias”. 1818.
candidates.target:
“我遇见一位来自古国的旅人，
他说：两尊巨大而无躯的石腿，
矗立在沙漠之中。在它们附近的沙地上，
半掩着一张破碎的面容，那紧锁的眉头、
皱起的嘴唇和冷峻威严的讥笑，
昭示着那位雕塑家曾深刻洞察那些情感，
它们至今犹存，镌刻在这些无生命的物体上，
那嘲弄它们的手，与滋养它们的心。
而在基座上，刻着这样的文字：
‘吾名奥兹曼迪亚斯，万王之王：
看吾功业，众强者，当绝望！’
除此之外，一无所有：在那巨大残骸的衰败四周，
无边无际、空旷荒凉，
孤寂而平坦的沙地，向远方无限延展。”
——珀西·比希·雪莱，《奥兹曼迪亚斯》，1818 年。

“客自海外归，曾见沙漠王国
 有石像半毁，唯余巨腿
 蹲立沙砾间。像头旁落，
 半遭沙埋，但人面依然可畏，
 那冷笑，那发号施令的高傲，
 足见雕匠看透了主人的心，
 才把那石头刻得神情唯肖，
 而刻像的手和像主的心
 早成灰烬。像座上大字在目：
 ’吾乃万王之王是也，
 盖世功业，敢叫天公折服！’
 此外无一物，但见废墟周围，
 寂寞平沙空莽莽，
 伸向荒凉的四方。”
    -珀西·比希·雪莱，”奥西曼提斯“。1818。

candidates.source: That is a hard question to ask a man, in these times."  He looks you up and down carefully for a moment, shifting a little on his feet.  "To be honest with you, I made a delivery run here a few months ago to drop off some office supplies.  When I saw the state the world was in, I thought perhaps this would be a safer place to go than many, and so we made our way here.  It was a difficult journey, but I'm sure you've heard many tales of that time, and have your own.  We were nearly gunned down at a road stop, but I knew a back route and managed to slip away.  There was a pickup truck with a travel trailer that tried to take the back route, though, and overturned.  It nearly blocked the road, and the trailer had been full of people.  Many of them were now returned, and were stumbling around.  We made it through, barely, but the car was damaged then.  You get the idea."  He sighs, rubbing his beard idly, his expression flat.  "Somehow, we made it.  What's more, all three of us made it, and again made it through the disaster in the back room here.  We were very lucky.
candidates.target: “这是一个在这种时代向一个男人提出的问题。”他仔细地打量着你片刻，脚下稍微移动了一下。“说实话，几个月前我来这里送了一些办公用品。当我看到世界状况时，我想这里可能比许多地方都安全，所以我们就来到了这里。这是一段艰难的旅程，但我确定你听过许多关于那段时间的传说，你自己也有自己的故事。我们在路障差点被枪杀，但我知道一条后路，设法逃脱了。有一辆皮卡车拉着一个旅行拖车也试图走后路，但翻车了。它几乎堵住了路，而拖车里装满了人。他们中的许多人现在已经回来了，在周围徘徊。我们好不容易才通过，但车子在那时受损了。你明白我的意思。”他叹了口气，随意地揉了揉胡子，表情平静。“无论如何，我们做到了。更重要的是，我们三个都做到了，并且再次度过了这里后房间的灾难。我们非常幸运。”

candidates.source: They're pretty big.  This isn't something you'd carry around with you.  They fire .30 cal bullets using compressed air that we'd make inside the basement and then pipe up to individual storage tanks for the guns that would be good for a few hundred shots each.  The design should be capable of auto or semi-auto fire, at a range that's pretty comparable to a gunpowder-based weapon.  It takes out some of the most limited parts of ranged weapons: no gunpowder, no brass casings, just lead that we melt into my mold.  It's not soundless, but it's not as loud as a chemical weapon.  There are tons of advantages.  Only trouble is, I can't convince the Free Merchants to give me the parts I need, even though it's for our own defense."  She grimaces.  "Being one of the 'surface people' is so frustrating.  I'm pretty sure they talk about these decisions downstairs, behind our backs, and we're just not part of the process and can't advocate for our own projects.

candidates.source: Not where you might think."  He sets aside his ledger and pulls out a page of bullet-point notes written in neat block letters.  "Everyone is on board with the idea and the amount of actual building to get it online is small enough that the carpenters are willing to help out, so I don't need any assistance with design.  For the really short term I basically just need materials.  I've been collecting spare wood, but to get a good wood-fired oven I need to secure a source of firebrick.  In the longer run, Dana knows the principles of milling, but I need a resource book if I want to set up a functioning mill, first a muscle-powered one and then a windmill for long term.  I wish I'd thought of asking Jenny.  She's a mechanical engineer, but she would probably know how to get me started at least.  I'm also still looking into how to make a good vermin-proof cellar.  Longer term, I will need to work my way around our reliance on sugar, salt, and vinegar from before the Cataclysm, but our stocks of those will hold out for months while I sort things out.
candidates.target: “不是你想的那个地方。”他放下账本，拿出一张写满了圆珠笔小点的笔记页，字迹工整。“大家都同意这个想法，实际的建造量小到木匠们都愿意帮忙，所以我不需要任何设计上的帮助。短期内我基本上只需要材料。我一直在收集多余的木头，但要建一个好的柴火烤炉，我需要找到耐火砖的来源。从长远来看，达娜了解磨坊的原理，但如果我想建立一个功能性的磨坊，首先是人力驱动的，然后是长期的风车，我需要一本资源书。我真希望我早点想到了问珍妮。她是机械工程师，但她至少会知道如何帮助我入门。我还在调查如何建造一个好的防鼠地下室。从长远来看，我需要减少对糖、盐和醋的依赖，这些都是灾难前储存的，但我们的库存可以维持几个月，让我有时间整理这些事情。

candidates.source: *pauses for a moment, and lets out a slow sigh, speaking hesitantly as they catch themselves in idioms.  "Make no contact.  We ken… we think the abroad o'… the outside o' the bunker be safe an'… be safe to explore, for one such as ye, who harks as from this'n land.  A wander in and escolt… a look around we ken as no… no risk.  If ye think ye been spotted, wave along and make no mention of ol' Rubik and the Exodii.  Not afore we be razzed some more o' this rattlin'… this bunker."
candidates.target: 停顿了一会儿，慢慢地叹了口气，语气中带着犹豫，仿佛在小心翼翼地挑选词语。“不要有任何接触。我们认为……我们觉得 bunker 外面……外面的环境是安全的，对像你这样的异乡人来说，是可以安全探索的。我们可以进去看看，带你转一转，应该没有风险。如果你觉得被发现了，就挥挥手，别提 Rubik 和 Exodii 的事。先别让我们再经历这种震动……这种 bunker 了。”

candidates.source: You got it.  I know, it feels really contrived, doesn't it?  It's exactly like the old movies in every way, like someone had designed it to be.  I don't know if it's every bite or what, but Chris just had one that barely broke the skin and you see where that ended up.  Took about three days.  My advice is, we don't let these things teeth anywhere near our skin.  They're pretty clumsy bastards, though.  They definitely can't just nibble you as they go by, they've gotta grab you first.  Unfortunately, seems like they're pretty fuckin' good at that.  Once you get grabbed, best bet is to go full ham on the zombie grabbing you with everything you've got, and try to shake loose, but honestly it's better to not get grabbed.
candidates.target: 你明白了。我知道，这感觉真的很做作，对吧？各方面都像老电影里演的一样，就像有人设计好了一样。我不知道是不是每一次咬都会这样，但克里斯上次只被咬了一口，只是划破了皮，你看看结果怎么样。花了大约三天的时间。我的建议是，我们不要让这些东西的牙齿靠近我们的皮肤。它们很笨拙。它们绝对不能在经过你的时候随意咬你，它们必须先抓住你。不幸的是，它们似乎在这方面很擅长。一旦被抓住，最好的办法就是用你所有的力气反击抓住你的僵尸，尝试挣脱，但老实说，最好不要被抓住。

candidates.source:
"We are seen.  It's not long until we will be touched."

"Touched by what, exactly?"

"Touched.  Chewed.  Tasted.  Digested.  Processed.  Excreted."

"Ramin, focus, please.  What is doing all that?  Or rather, what do you feel will be doing those things?"

"It's big.  Bigger than the Sun.  Smaller than an atom."

"And what does this large small thing want, beyond touching us?"

"It just is.  It needs no reason.  It needs only to exist.  It needs only to expand."

"Do you want to talk about Immersion 132R?"

"There's nothing to talk about.  I wasn't there.  It didn't touch me.  I didn't look.  It didn't look back.  It didn't smile with a million rotten worlds in its mouth."

"Have you been taking your medication?"

"Like they would help.  I tried, Doc, I really did.  But the truth is, I like having these thoughts.  They give me a certainty, and I am thankful for knowing how it will all end.  That we all belong to something, and nothing can take us from it now."
candidates.target:
“我们被看见了。我们被触碰的日子也不远了。”

“被什么触碰，具体说来？”

“被触碰。被咀嚼。被品尝。被消化。被处理。被排泄。”

“拉明，请集中注意力。是什么在做所有这些？或者说，你觉得什么东西会做那些事？”

“它很大。比太阳大。比原子小。”

“那么，这个大又小的东西除了触碰我们之外，还想做什么？”

“它只是存在。它不需要理由。它只需要存在。它只需要扩张。”

“你想谈谈浸入式体验132R？”

“没什么好谈的。我没在那里。它没触碰我。我没看。它也没回头看。它也没用百万个腐烂的世界在它嘴里微笑。”

“你有在吃药吗？”

“药有什么用呢。医生，我真的试过了。但事实是，我喜欢有这些想法。它们给我一种确定性，我很感激知道一切都会如何结束。我们都属于某样东西，现在没有什么能把我们从中带走。”

"And what does this large small thing want, beyond touching us?"

"It just is.  It needs no reason.  It needs only to exist.  It needs only to expand."

"Do you want to talk about Immersion 132R?"

"There's nothing to talk about.  I wasn't there.  It didn't touch me.  I didn't look.  It didn't look back.  It didn't smile with a million rotten worlds in its mouth."

"Have you been taking your medication?"

"Like they would help.  I tried, Doc, I really did.  But the truth is, I like having these thoughts.  They give me a certainty, and I am thankful for knowing how it will all end.  That we all belong to something, and nothing can take us from it now."

The quality of this footage is both choppy and filled with the background fluctuations of static, with the view being angled upwards through the shattered beams of what used to have been a roof.  The structure looks as though it's been the recipient of a mortar bombardment, with large swaths of the roiling gray sky visible through the gaps and stifling volumes of heavy fog rolling in over the edges.  Unsteadily zooming past the wreckage, the camera focuses on the distant profile of a helicopter raveled in the depths of the filth-tinged clouds, the drone of its rotors audible as the aircraft beats its way through the bank of fog.  In the airspace around the machine, you can vaguely detect bands of ebony black undulating through the clouds—strands of oily darkness waning and fattening about its fuselage like writhing sea serpents.

Just as you fancy that the tendrils were bulging into outlines, shadowy limbs extending from them, and, for a split second, appearing like suspended ranks of unnaturally lanky figures, the whole view devolves into the screech of static.  It takes you a moment to realize that what you originally took to be the shriek of interference was actually just the video's audio.

For the last 45 seconds, it transmits the distant sounds of many hundreds of nearing, drawn-out screams.

candidates.source:
If there's a friendly horse with a saddle nearby, you tell me to mount up, I'll go over and get on it.  You may need to feed a feral horse some cattle fodder to get it act tame and friendly, and e'x'amine it while you have a saddle in your inventory in order to put the saddle on.  You can also ride yourself, if you know how.
  You want me to get off a horse, you just tell me.  You can get off a horse with the vehicle control key (keybind '^').
  While we're on horses, we'll just move normally, but a lot faster.  It's a good way to get places more quickly than we could on our own two feet.
candidates.target:
如果附近有一匹温顺的马有马鞍，你告诉我上马，我会过去骑上它。你可能需要给野马一些牛饲料让它变得温顺友好，并在你库存中有马鞍的情况下检查它以装上马鞍。如果你知道如何，你也可以自己骑马。

你要我下马，只要告诉我就行。你可以用车辆控制键（快捷键'^'）下马。

我们骑马时，会像平常一样移动，但速度快得多。这是比我们用双脚走路更快到达目的地的好方法。

candidates.source:
&Your awareness of the outside world fades as you fall into Rubik's mind.

You see a child in a thriving metropolis, doing odd jobs for spare coins, playing in the alleys with friends, coming home at dusk for supper.  You see a young adult running from a group of zombies.  You see this castle, or near enough--some towers are missing, some missing towers are there, but obviously the same--and its denizens fending off an attack from a group of winged things.  You see a conversation in a language you've never heard before among a group of Exodii, before everyone files into rooms, secures themselves with restraints, and there's a brief moment of searing pain and then darkness, filled with static and bursts of light half-glimpsed in your peripheral vision.

You see worlds.  World after world, in a procession over…decades?  Centuries?  You can't tell; you have no sense of time during the vision.  Most worlds were less advanced than the Earth, and the few survivors fought the dead with human wave tactics and trench warfare, or lines of musketeers, or archers from behind the trees.  Sometimes, doughty warriors clad in iron or bronze hurled themselves at the enemy with sword and shield in hand, until they fell and their corpses rose again.  In one world, the survivors fought with powered armor and particle-beam weapons.  But on every world, slowly, inexorably, the dead or the fungus or the walking trees or things you have no name for ground down the defenders until humanity was on the brink of extinction and, with a few survivors in tow, the Exodii powered up their jump devices and continued the Long Retreat.

In the end, not once, in a dozen or a hundred or you know not how many worlds, was there anything left to save.
candidates.target:
随着你陷入鲁比克的思维，你对外部世界的感知逐渐模糊。

你看到一个孩子在繁华都市中做着零工换取零钱，在小巷里和朋友玩耍，黄昏时回家吃晚饭。你看到一个年轻人逃离一群僵尸的追赶。你看到这座城堡，或者说很接近——有些塔楼不见了，有些原本不存在的塔楼却出现了，但显然是同一个地方——它的居民们抵御着一群有翅膀的生物的攻击。你听到一群异族人在用一种你从未听过的语言交谈，然后每个人都进入房间，用束缚物束缚自己，紧接着是一瞬间的灼痛，然后是充满静电和边缘闪烁光亮的黑暗。

你看到一个又一个世界，一个接一个地，持续了……几十年？几个世纪？你在幻象中没有时间感。大多数世界比地球落后，少数幸存者用人海战术、战壕战、肌肉枪手排成一线，或弓箭手藏在树后与死人战斗。有时，身着铁甲或青铜甲的勇士们手持剑盾，奋不顾身地冲向敌人，直到他们倒下，尸体再次站起来。在一个世界里，幸存者们用动力装甲和粒子束武器战斗。但在每个世界里，慢慢地，不可避免地，死人、真菌、行走的树木或你无法命名的生物最终战胜了守卫者，人类濒临灭绝，异族人们带着少数幸存者启动了他们的跳跃装置，继续着漫长的撤退。

最终，在你看到的无数个世界中，没有一次有什么值得拯救的东西留下。

你看到一个在繁华大都市中生活的孩子，为几个硬币做些零活，与朋友在小巷里玩耍，黄昏时分回家吃晚饭。你看到一个年轻人在一群僵尸面前逃跑。你看到这座城堡，或者说差不多——有些塔楼缺失，有些缺失的塔楼却又存在，但显然是同一座城堡——以及它的居民抵御着一群长着翅膀的生物的攻击。你看到一群埃克索迪人说着你从未听过的语言进行对话，随后大家进入房间，用束缚装置固定自己，短暂的剧痛之后便是一片黑暗，黑暗中充满了静电和光芒，光芒只在你的余光中一闪而过。

你看到了世界。一个又一个世界，在…几十年？几个世纪？的时间里不断涌现？你无法分辨；在这幻象中你对时间毫无概念。大多数世界的发展水平都低于地球，而少数幸存者用人海战术和堑壕战，或者火枪手排成一列，或者躲在树后的弓箭手与亡灵战斗。有时，英勇的战士身穿铁甲或青铜甲，挥舞着剑和盾牌冲向敌人，直到他们倒下，他们的尸体又复活了。在一个世界里，幸存者们使用动力装甲和粒子束武器作战。但在每个世界，缓慢而不可避免地，亡灵、真菌、行走的树木或你无法命名的东西将防御者击垮，直到人类濒临灭绝，带着少数幸存者，埃克索迪人启动了他们的跳跃装置，继续着漫长的撤退。

最终，一次也没有，在十几个、一百个或者你不知道多少个世界里，还有任何值得拯救的东西。

candidates.source:
&Your awareness of the outside world fades as you fall into Rubik's mind.

You see a child in a thriving metropolis, doing odd jobs for spare coins, playing in the alleys with friends, coming home at dusk for supper.  You see a young adult running from a group of zombies.  You see this castle, or near enough--some towers are missing, some missing towers are there, but obviously the same--and its denizens fending off an attack from a group of winged things.  You see a conversation in a language you've never heard before among a group of Exodii, before everyone files into rooms, secures themselves with restraints, and there's a brief moment of searing pain and then darkness, filled with static and bursts of light half-glimpsed in your peripheral vision.

You see worlds.  World after world, in a procession over…decades?  Centuries?  You can't tell; you have no sense of time during the vision.  Most worlds were less advanced than the Earth, and the few survivors fought the dead with human wave tactics and trench warfare, or lines of musketeers, or archers from behind the trees.  Sometimes, doughty warriors clad in iron or bronze hurled themselves at the enemy with sword and shield in hand, until they fell and their corpses rose again.  In one world, the survivors fought with powered armor and particle-beam weapons.  But on every world, slowly, inexorably, the dead or the fungus or the walking trees or things you have no name for ground down the defenders until humanity was on the brink of extinction and, with a few survivors in tow, the Exodii powered up their jump devices and continued the Long Retreat.

In the end, not once, in a dozen or a hundred or you know not how many worlds, was there anything left to save.

你看到世界。一个又一个世界，像一场巡游，持续了…几十年？几个世纪？你无法分辨；在这一场幻象中，你失去了对时间的感知。大多数世界比地球更落后，而少数幸存者则用人海战术、堑壕战，或者树木后方射箭的队伍，来对抗亡者。有时，身披铁或青铜盔甲的英勇战士手持剑盾，奋力冲向敌人，直到他们倒下，尸体又站了起来。在一个世界里，幸存者使用动力装甲和粒子束武器作战。但无论在哪个世界，缓慢而不可避免地，亡者、真菌、行走的树木，或者你无法命名的事物，磨损着防御者，直到人类濒临灭绝，并且带着少数幸存者，埃克索迪亚启动了他们的跳跃装置，继续长撤退。

最终，在无数个世界中，也许是十几个、一百个，甚至你不知道有多少个世界，都没有什么值得拯救的东西了。

你看见世界。一个又一个世界，在漫长的队列中依次展开……是数十年？还是数世纪？你无法分辨；在幻象之中，你毫无时间感。大多数世界比地球更为落后，寥寥无几的幸存者以人海战术和堑壕战对抗死者，或以火枪队列、或从树后以弓箭迎敌。有时，身披铁甲或青铜的勇猛战士手持刀剑与盾牌，向敌人发起冲锋，直至倒下，而他们的尸身又再度站起。在一个世界里，幸存者身着动力装甲， wielding 粒子束武器作战。但在每一个世界上，死者、真菌、行走的树木，或是你无法名状之物，都缓慢而不可阻挡地消磨着守军，直至人类濒临灭绝；于是，出离者带着少数幸存者启动跃迁装置，继续那场漫长的退却。

最终，在数十个、上百个，或你无从知晓其数的世界里，从未有过任何值得拯救之物留存。

The Platform is complete.  As a reminder, the HWP will not function as a weapon without a conversion kit installed.  Transferring the requested items now."

The tray shakes as several heavy objects are dropped into it, and it slides open.  Inside: the Hybrid Weapons Platform.  On its own, it doesn't look like much; it resembles the body of a service rifle without a stock or barrel, colored in sleek black with blue highlights around the magazine well.  Small yellow arrows and inscriptions are present at certain points, highlighting the fasteners used to assemble the thing in earnest.  Accompanying the Platform itself is a series of four bundles of parts for it, each held together using velcro strips and tagged by caliber.  A drawstring nylon bag, embroidered with the Hub's logo and filled with proprietary tools, completes the whole package.

All in all, not a bad deal.

"Should you require magazines of any given caliber, we are willing to provide them through standard requisitions.  We hope you find its performance to be satisfactory.
candidates.target:
平台已经组装完成。请注意，没有安装转换套件的混合武器平台无法作为武器使用。现在开始传输您所要求的物品。

托盘晃动了几下，几个沉重的物体被放了进去，然后它滑开了。里面是混合武器平台。单独看，它并不起眼；它看起来像一把没有枪托和枪管的服役步枪的机身，机身是光滑的黑色，弹匣井周围有蓝色的突出部分。在特定位置有小黄箭头和铭文，标明了组装时使用的固定件。平台旁边有四个零件包，每个零件包都用钩环带固定在一起，并按口径标记。一个带有枢纽标志的抽绳尼龙袋，装有专有工具，完成了整个套件。

总的来说，这不是一件坏事。

“如果您需要任何规格的弹匣，我们愿意通过标准请购单提供。希望您对它的性能感到满意。

candidates.target: 散播吧，穿过那些颤动的波纹，只是我们并不知晓如何做到。当绿色与棕色化为灰黑，如此说来，鲁比克早已远去。稍等片刻，我们族人曾向那片荒原送还过一件恋人的长袍，却再未有人归来。而我清楚，从此刻起，只有一条路可走。

candidates.source: &The clerk picks up a small device, "Alright, I just need to do a preliminary scan.  If you please."  They gesture to your arm and you allow them to place the device against your skin.  There is a moment while the clerk watches the screen and then their eyebrows shoot up.  "Whoa, esper heritage?  They told me to keep an eye out but I've never seen that before.  Where did I put that disclaimer they gave me…"  The clerk turns and consults their console for a short while before they begin reciting, "While we can guarantee that all Mercurial Genetch products have been tested in a wide variety of conditions and on a wide variety of subjects, Hyperspace Era noetic treatments are notoriously prone to degradation when further genetic modifications are applied.  Mercurial is not responsible for any reduction of esper potential or capability that may or may not occur as a result of our Genetech treatments.  If you have any concerns about your esper potential, we urge you to consult a licensed physician with a specialty in esper families."  They pause.  "And no, before you ask, there isn't one in the system.  It's up to you if you think it's worth the risk."
candidates.target: 职员拿起一个小设备，说：“好了，我只需要做一个初步扫描。请稍等。”他们向你的胳膊做了一个手势，你允许他们把设备放在你的皮肤上。过了一会儿，职员看着屏幕，然后他们的眉毛扬了起来。“哇，超能力者血统？他们让我留意这个，但我从没见过。我把他们给我的免责声明放哪里了……”职员转身查看他们的控制台，过了一会儿才开始念道：“虽然我们可以保证所有水星基因科技产品都经过了各种条件和各种主题的测试，但超空间时代的神经治疗方法在进行进一步基因修改时，往往会出现退化。水星公司不对因我们的基因科技治疗可能导致的能力或能力下降负责。如果你对自己的超能力潜力有任何疑虑，我们建议你咨询一位有超能力者家族专业的执照医生。”他们停顿了一下。 “而且，在你问之前我就说，系统里没有这样的医生。你自己决定是否值得冒险。”

candidates.source:
Subject: Rattus norvegicus domestica, 450 g

PE012 priming: Yes

Compound: PE027

Objective: Establish PE027's phenotypic range for subject species, evaluate cost/benefit of subjects trained for voluntary self-dosage

Protocol: Enclosure with a water pool, voluntary dosage from food dispenser

Live observation: Trained subject, first dosage after 5 minutes.  After an initial calm period subject rubs off their fur on the enclosure's wall, revealing metallic scales.  Three dosages in short succession, after which subject falls over.  Subject is placed in the water by robotic arm, where it began swimming.

Dissection findings: phenotypic changes consistent with PE027's usual profile - in this case the gills replaced the upper lobes of the subject's lungs, opening to the outside over the scapula.  Digestive track shortened considerably, liver atrophic, teeth replaced by needles reminiscent of an anglerfish.  Blue fluorescent organ between the hemispheres.
candidates.target:
主题：家鼠（Rattus norvegicus domestica），450克

PE012 预处理：是

化合物：PE027

目标：确定PE027对主题物种的表型范围，评估受训自愿自剂量的主体的成本/收益

协议：带有水池的封闭空间，自愿从食物分配器中剂量

现场观察：受训主体，首次剂量后5分钟。在初始平静期后，主体将它们的毛发擦在封闭空间的墙上，露出金属鳞片。短时间内连续三次剂量，之后主体倒下。主体被机器人手臂放入水中，开始游泳。

解剖发现：表型变化与PE027的常规特征一致——在本例中，主体的上肺叶被鳃替换，在肩胛骨上方打开到外部。消化道显著缩短，肝脏萎缩，牙齿被类似钓鱼的针取代。在半球之间有一个蓝荧光器官。

That's right, bounty.  No doubt you've heard of the aliens known as the "Exodii", right?  Big killer-robot-vibes, am I right?  Well, I've spun off an initiative adjacent to our Cybernetic Enhancements Program.  The basic strategy is simple: learn what we can, synergize with our strengths, and fight fire with fire.

So here's the play: I'm actively sourcing "decommissioned" Exodii hardware for teardown and reverse engineering.

It's simple: you bring inactivated Exodii here, and I'll pay you for each one.  Think of yourself as a citizen scientist, yeah?  A community R&D effort.

Small note, though.  None of those "zomborg" things - the walking corpses with devices jammed into them.  Another team is running that pipeline, and honestly, the signals out of that aren't so great.

Right now, the highest value pickups are worker drones, the big four-legged robots, and turret platforms.  They're hard to come by, but trust me, I'll pay a good price.

对的，赏金。你肯定听说过被称为“异星族”的外星人，对吧？给人一种大型杀手机器人的感觉，对吗？好吧，我从我们的网络增强计划中衍生出一个相关的计划。基本策略很简单：学习我们能学到的，发挥我们的优势，以火攻火。

所以，这就是计划：我正在积极寻找“退役”的异星族硬件，进行拆解和反向工程。

很简单：你把失活的异星族带到这里，我会为每个付钱。把自己当成一个公民科学家，好吗？一个社区研发的努力。

不过，有一个小注意事项。那些“僵尸堡”之类的东西不要带过来——那些被塞进装置的行尸走肉。另一个团队正在处理那一块，老实说，那边的信号不是很好。

目前价值最高的目标是工作无人机、那些大型四足机器人，以及炮塔平台。它们很难找到，但相信我，我会付一个好价钱。

candidates.source: Oh yeah, that was a hell of a shitstorm.  We were waiting back there for 'processing' for hours and hours, with the sick and wounded.  One guy died, we all thought he was sleeping until he got back up.  That started a panic, gunshots in a closed area, that kind of stuff.  In just a few minutes, a bunch more people were dead.  Then the assholes called it an 'outbreak' and tried to barricade us in… took us way too long to convince the panicking guards that we were alive and needed to get out.  I'll give the one guy credit, Sean: when he found out they'd locked living people in with zombies, he came in himself, as some of the newly dead were starting to get back up, and he held them off for us to escape.  That… that was probably the only actual good thing I've seen since before the end of the world: he owned his error and he put himself in harm's way to make up for it.  Massive respect to that guy.  So, of course, he's a zombie now.  Fuck, thanks for reminding me of all that sunny fun.
candidates.target: 哦，是啊，那是一场糟透了的混乱。我们在那里等了几个小时，和病人和伤员一起“处理”。一个人死了，我们都以为他在睡觉，直到他起来了。这引发了一场恐慌，在封闭的区域里开枪，那种情况。就几分钟的时间，更多的人死了。然后那些混蛋把它称为“爆发”，试图把我们关在里面……我们花了很长时间才让那些惊慌失措的守卫相信我们是活着的，需要出来。我得给那个叫肖恩的家伙一些信用：当他发现他们把活人关在僵尸里时，他自己进去了，因为一些新死的人开始起来了，他挡住了他们，让我们逃脱。那……那可能是我自世界末日以来看到的唯一真正好的事情：他承认了自己的错误，并冒险补救。对那个家伙表示极大的尊重。所以，当然，他现在成了僵尸。靠，谢谢你让我想起所有那些阳光乐趣。

WHEN I DID MY TIME.  We spoke to Dan Huang, the Chinese-American author of the New York Times bestselling exposé "When I Did my Time", the story of his three years living with his extended family in China, immersed in what he describes as "The ever-escalating anti-American propaganda of the East."

"It's a real threat," said Huang.  "They are being taught to hate our freedom, and our technology.  Mark my words: there is going to be a reckoning, and we need to be ready."
candidates.target:
当我度过我的时间。我们采访了《纽约时报》畅销书《当我度过我的时间》的作者黄丹，这本书揭露了他在中国的三年生活，与他的大家庭生活在一起，沉浸在他所描述的“东方不断升级的反美宣传”中。

“这是一个真正的威胁，”黄说。“他们被教导去仇恨我们的自由和技术。记住我的话：将会有一场清算，我们需要做好准备。”

candidates.source:
If we're next to each other, you can just bump into me and we'll start talking, right?  But if I'm farther away, you're going to have to shout a bit (use the 'C'hat command) for me to hear you.  You'll need to see me for us to have a conversation.  Or we can talk by radios if we both have them.
  When we talk, you can give me instructions about how to fight or when to sleep or whatever.  I'll mostly do them, and you can ask me what my current instructions are.  Sometimes you'll give me two sets of instructions: a normal set, and an override for a specific situation.  I'll tell you which instructions are overridden.  You can set and clear overrides with shouted commands.

candidates.source: Have you seen mi-go architecture?  They make these living, organic structures out of resin.  Kind of cool.  And disturbing, I guess.  Of course, they'll cut you to pieces if you gawk at it too long.  I'll mark the location of one of these places on your map for one denarius.  I heard a story, not sure if it was true, but allegedly one guy tried to use the mi-go building resin as armor.  Apparently, it bore into the poor guy's flesh!  Like lichen!  His friends tried to tear it off, but it wouldn't bulge.  He was in so much pain they decided to put him out of his misery.  But they couldn't do it, because the armor was too good!  So I guess that in a sense it worked.  Heh.  The mental image still keeps me awake at night, occasionally.  And now you have it too.  You're welcome.
candidates.target: 你见过米戈建筑吗？他们用树脂造出这些活生生的有机结构。挺酷的，也挺可怕的。当然，如果你盯着看太久，他们会把你切成碎片。我可以在你的地图上标出一个这样地方的位置，一块钱。我听过一个故事，不确定是真是假，据说有一个人试图用米戈建筑的树脂做成盔甲。显然，它刺进了那可怜人的肉里！就像地衣一样！他的朋友们试图把他撕下来，但丝毫不动。他痛得厉害，他们决定让他死得快一点。但他们做不到，因为盔甲太坚固了！所以我想，从某种意义上说，它起到了作用。哈哈。这个画面时不时地让我失眠。现在你也有了。不客气。

candidates.source: Now up the top o' Mount Greenwood there used to be a nice campin' place, that woulda been before you were born.  Whole area burnt up that one year, they said it were lightnin' but you an' I both know it were just kids partyin'.  Rusty G an' I left ol' yeller behind and wen' in to check it out.  Burnt out woods looked haunted, we figgered there were some o' them damn kids rummagin' around in there, neckin' or whatnot.  Rusty G brought his boom stick, and lucky thing cuz o' what we saw.
candidates.target: 现在格林伍德山山顶上曾经有一个不错的露营地，那是在你出生之前的事了。有一年，整个地区被烧光了，他们说是因为闪电，但你我都知道那只是孩子们在搞派对。拉斯特G和我把老黄狗留在后面，进去查看情况。烧焦的树林看起来像鬼上身，我们猜测那里肯定有那些该死的孩子们在翻找东西，亲热什么的。拉斯特G带了他的枪，幸好有它，不然我们看到的东西会更糟。

candidates.source: I saw it all pretty early, before it all really started.  I worked at the hospital.  It started with a jump in the number of code whites - that's an aggressive patient.  Wasn't my training so I didn't hear about it until later… but rumors started flying about hyperaggressive delirious patients that coded and seemed to die, then started attacking staff, and wouldn't respond to anything we hit them with.  Then a friend of mine was killed by one of them, and I realized it wasn't just a few weird reports.  I called in sick the next day.

candidates.source: &His eyebrows shoot up, briefly surprised, then he smiles.  "You nailed it in one.  Yeah, we're talking about a rural farmer in the nineties, here.  My dad never understood me, even before he knew, and he did find out, although I tried to keep the closet door closed.  Jack, though, he always saw me for me.  Never let it change our relationship.  That's real love, and that's what made me come back when he needed me.  Meanwhile, the man I thought I'd marry, back in Bunyan, he couldn't be assed even to come out and see the family farm, let alone think about moving here.  He was dead weight, and I've never doubted that decision."  He shrugs.  "There's folks like me wherever you go, I've had a few relationships since then.  Just nothing that stuck, and I'm okay with that.  If nothing else, it proved what I already knew: aside from my old man, none of my family treated me or them any different for it.  They're good people."
candidates.target: 他的眉毛挑了挑，略带惊讶，然后笑了。“你一针见血地说中了。是的，我们说的是一个九十年代的农村农民。我爸爸即使在他还不知道之前就从来不理解我，尽管我试图把衣柜门关上，但他还是发现了。但是杰克，他总是看到真正的我。从来没有让这影响我们的关系。这才是真正的爱，也是让我在需要时回到他身边的理由。与此同时，我以为我会嫁的那个人，在布尼亚，连来看看家庭农场都不愿意，更别提搬过来这里了。他是累赘，我从不后悔那个决定。”他耸了耸肩。“无论你去哪里，都会有像我这样的人，我从那以后也有过几段关系。只是没有一段能持续下去，我可以接受这个事实。至少，这证明了我已经知道的事情：除了我老爸之外，我的家人都没有因为这个而对我或他们有任何不同对待。他们是好人。”

If we don't know what something is and how to kill it, we steer wide and clear.  One time I saw this flaming eyeball a long way off, I was scouting from a cell phone tower.  It made eye contact with me and I just started hallucinating shit.  Darius stopped me from falling right off the tower.  Stuff like that is why I think you have to be a bit off your rocker to travel these days unless you have no choice.  Anything we don't know, we turn around and pedal hard.  So far, we haven't met anything our bikes can't outrun.
candidates.target: 哦，天啊，是的。世界真的烂透了，不是吗？好吧，我见过一些奇怪的外星生物。我们的规则是“害怕比死好”。如果我们不知道某样东西是什么以及如何杀死它，我们就远离它。有一次，我从手机塔上侦察时，远处看到一个燃烧的眼球。它和我对视，我开始幻觉。达里乌斯救了我，让我没从塔上掉下来。像这样的事情让我觉得，除非迫不得已，否则现在旅行需要有点精神不正常。对于我们不知道的任何东西，我们转身就走。到目前为止，我们还没有遇到过我们骑车无法逃脱的东西。

candidates.source: The bare bones camp is the most flexible kind of camp as you can build them anywhere while still having access to almost all camp capabilities, leaving it completely up to you how you design them (the missed functionality is tied to the construction of a radio tower).  You start by ordering a companion to build the camp, then construct a bulletin board within it yourself or by ordering your companion to make a zone construction for it, after which you can use the board to order companions to execute camp missions without construction preconditions.  You still have to meet all the usual restrictions for companion crafting missions, such as access to fire, tools, etc, but facilities constructed by you or your companions should be available for crafting provided you have covered them with Camp: Supply zones.  How you want to construct the camp in your chosen location is up to you, with construction zones available should you want to give the task to your companions.
candidates.target: 简易营地是最灵活的营地类型，因为你可以在任何地方建造它们，同时仍然拥有几乎所有的营地功能，完全由你来决定如何设计它们（缺失的功能与建造无线电塔有关）。你可以通过命令同伴建造营地开始，然后在营地内自己建造布告板或者命令同伴为它建立区域建造，之后你可以使用布告板命令同伴执行营地任务，而无需建造前提条件。你仍然需要满足同伴制作任务的一般限制，例如获得火源、工具等，但你或你的同伴建造的设施应该可以在你用营地补给区覆盖它们的情况下进行制作。你想要如何在选定的位置建造营地完全由你决定，如果你想让同伴完成任务，建造区域是可用的。

candidates.source: In your dream, you lie on an operating table, surrounded by doctors.  They remove something from your body, then start yelling and screaming as the thing they've cut out of you begins to tear them apart.  You find yourself unable to move or even scream as it finishes with the doctors and comes for you…

candidates.source: SURGEON GENERAL: DEAD ARE STAYING DEAD: "Stories about the dead rising are completely unfounded and medically impossible.", the office of the surgeon general said in a press conference today.  "It's an obvious hoax by people just looking for five minutes of fame, or to scare people in these uncertain times.  After all, remember the clown thing a few years ago?"  A critic pointed to the increasingly widespread viral videos of rioters with clearly fatal injuries rising to return to the rioting.  "Within ten hours, someone will have deep faked this video to make me look like a Star Wars character," replied the spokesperson, "and you're confused by a bit of home grown CGI showing zombies?"

candidates.source: MORE ORDAINED MINISTERS NEEDED.  Wedlock is down, but last minute nuptials, elopements, vow-renewals and 'micromonies' have been on the rise, supposedly in response to many of the recent events and uneasing developments as more people are feeling less secure about dating in these troubled times, therefore rushing to the altar in preparation for the worst, or to cross items off the bucket list before it's too late.  As a result, the nation is experiencing a shortage of marriage officiants. candidates.source: Where was I?  I don't even know, what day do you think it all ended?  When I thought shit was hitting the fan I took some vacation time at the airline.  Next day, somebody bombed them.  No shit, just like Oklahoma city in '95.  Thought that was a good sign to get out so I emailed some family out in the country that I was coming over and got on the road.  Didn't even make it to the interstate before I ran into the cops setting up a roadblock.  I drove off the road and it all gets fuzzy from there.  Next town I got to was already lynching people from the streetlights… I didn't stop for gas.  Lost the car at some point, lost track of the days too.  Not sure I ever got a reply to my email.
candidates.target: 我在哪里？我甚至不知道，你觉得这一切什么时候结束的？当我觉得事情不妙时，我在航空公司请了几天假。第二天，有人炸了他们。没错，就像1995年的俄克拉荷马城一样。我觉得这是离开的好兆头，所以我给乡下的家人发了封邮件，说我要过去，然后上路了。我还没上高速就遇到了警察在设置路障。我开车驶离了公路，之后的事情有点模糊了。我到达的下一个城镇已经开始在路灯上吊人了……我没停下来加过油。我在某个时候丢了车，也失去了对日期的追踪。不确定我是否收到了对那封邮件的回复。

candidates.target: 然后我花了半个小时才找到下路，因为地板上到处都是洞，当我终于找到的时候，我发现自己身处一个该死的血肉坑里，水漫到我的脚踝。更糟糕的是，天花板上垂着我因浓气而无法看清的内脏，这些内脏能把我吹飞十英尺，让我开始溺水。而且，到处都是数十个人融合成一团的血肉块。对了，我提到毒气了吗？它们也充满了毒气，所以一切都散发着恶臭，感觉就像身处一个巨大的、充满人的肠子里一样。

candidates.source: Sure.  After what you did for me, I'd equip an army for you.  I'll need some money to negotiate with the caravans and scavengers that come by.  What level of protection are you thinking?  I can do 2mm, 4mm, and 6mm suits depending on how much you want to resemble a tank, or I can make you a suit of chainmail instead if you want a little more flexibility. I can do 2mm, 4mm, and 6mm suits depending on how much you want to resemble a tank, or I can make you a suit of chainmail instead if you want a little more flexibility.  Materials costs are 300 merch to pay for the food I need to do the labor plus 100 merch per 2mm or 50 merch for the chainmail.  Whatever I save in non-scaling bits like the chain and leather, I get gouged in looking for so much bulk metal.
candidates.target: 没问题。鉴于你为我所做的一切，我甚至愿意为你装备一支军队。不过，我需要一些资金来与路过的商队和拾荒者进行谈判。你希望防护等级达到什么程度？我可以根据你的需求制作 2 毫米、4 毫米或 6 毫米的装甲服，具体取决于你希望把自己打造得有多像一辆坦克；或者，如果你更看重灵活性，我也可以为你打造一套锁子甲。材料成本为 300 商值，用于支付我劳动期间所需的食物，此外每增加 2 毫米厚度需额外 100 商值，而锁子甲则只需 50 商值。我在链条和皮革等非规模化部件上省下的钱，都因为要寻找大量金属而亏空了。

candidates.source: FBI EXPOSES "ZOMBIE" VIDEO HOAXES.  The FBI's Cyber Division announced the results of a months-long investigation into what it called "one of the most sophisticated disinformation campaigns in recent memory," revealing that dozens of the most viral "zombie attack" videos were carefully staged productions using professional makeup effects and willing participants.  The bureau released behind-the-scenes footage of eleven of the clips, showing teams of makeup artists applying prosthetics and actors rehearsing their stumbling walks before filming.  The hoax videos gained traction at an unfortunate time, with reports of unusual violence climbing across the country and emergency rooms dealing with a surge in patients presenting with extreme aggressive behavior.
candidates.target: FBI揭露“僵尸”视频骗局。联邦调查局网络安全部门宣布了数月来对所谓的“近期最精心策划的虚假信息运动”的调查结果，揭示了数十个最火的“僵尸袭击”视频是使用专业化妆效果和愿意参与者的精心策划的表演。该局发布了11段视频背后的镜头，展示化妆师们在拍摄前给演员们贴上假肢，演员们排练着他们蹒跚的步伐。这些骗局视频在不巧的时间传播开来，随着全国范围内异常暴力的报道增加，急诊室也迎来了表现出极端攻击性行为的患者激增。

candidates.source: You dream of standing in a dark forest.  The trees are so thick that not even moonlight penetrates to the forest floor, and despite waving your arm you can't see your hand in front of your face.  As you slowly walk, trying to pick your way through the forest, you hear the sounds of the insects and the wind slowly die.  The forest is utterly still except for your own breathing, and as you stop and strain your ears, you hear brush rustling in the distance.  Something is coming closer, slowly and inexorably, and when you try to run you almost immediately slam into a tree and fall flat on your back.  Despite the sound of your crashing into the forest floor, the approaching noises do not speed up.  As you try to stand, you hear the rustle of leaves and a wet sloshing on the ground nearby.  As it touches you, you start up in bed.
candidates.target: 你梦见自己站在一片黑暗的森林中。树木如此茂密，连月光也无法穿透到森林地面，尽管你挥动手臂，也看不见手在自己面前的样子。当你慢慢前行，试图在森林中穿行时，你听见昆虫和风的声音逐渐消失。森林除了你自己的呼吸声外，完全安静无声，当你停下来屏住呼吸时，你听见远处有灌木丛沙沙作响。有什么东西正慢慢地、不可避免地靠近，当你试图逃跑时，你几乎立刻就撞到一棵树上，摔倒在地。尽管你摔倒时发出巨大的声响，但靠近的声音并没有加快。当你试图站起来时，你听见树叶沙沙作响，附近地面上还传来水溅的声响。当它触碰到你时，你从床上惊醒。

candidates.source:
Just about everyone is dead, but some people survived, right?  But just like you go around breaking into houses and taking whatever you think you need or want, well, other survivors do the same thing.  And that stack of loot you've been accumulating looks just like some random dead person's loot when it's left alone.  If some other scavenger comes around and sees that loot, and you or I or another ally isn't around to claim it, that other survivor is just going to take it.  So try to detail someone to watch your stuff - whether its at a base or in a vehicle.
  Also, we've teamed up to better our chances of survival.  Other people are going to do the same, forming little factions just like we did.  If you open the faction manager (keybind '#'), you can see a list of all your allies, as well as all the other factions you've met so far.  Some factions are really just some guy trying to survive on his own, but other factions have dozens of members and fortified bases and such.  You might want to find some of them and try to make friends with them.
candidates.target:
几乎所有人都死了，但有些人幸存下来了，对吧？就像你四处闯入房子，拿走你认为需要或想要的东西一样，其他幸存者也会这样做。你积累的那堆战利品，当它独自留在那里时，看起来就像某个随机死者的战利品。如果另一个搜刮者经过，看到那堆战利品，而你、我或其他盟友不在场声称它，另一个幸存者会直接拿走它。所以试着安排一个人看管你的东西——无论是在基地还是在车辆里。

另外，我们联合起来是为了提高生存的机会。其他人和我们一样，也会形成小派系。如果你打开派系管理器（快捷键'#'），你可以看到你所有盟友的名单，以及你遇到的所有其他派系。有些派系只是一个人试图独自生存，但其他派系有数十名成员和加固的基地等等。你可能想找到他们中的一些，试着和他们交朋友。

candidates.source: Well, look at you.  Asking after random folks like some sort of shepherd!  No, don't take offense now… I mean it well.  We could use more folks askin' after other folks.  I figure it makes the world go round, now, more than ever.  I'm well, friend, considering I have both of my legs and much of my health left to me.  A bit of pain in the back, but can't really complain much if that's the worst of it, right?  You look like you've had a story of your own to tell, just getting here.  I'm writing it in my imagination right now.  Fought through countless hordes, run ragged, chased at every turn, yeah, no thank-you any more of that for me!
candidates.target: 好吧，看看你。像某种牧羊人一样随意问候别人！别误会，我不是贬低你，我说的是好话。现在比以往任何时候都更需要人们关心彼此。我还好，朋友，考虑到我还两条腿，还有大部分健康。背有点疼，但如果这是最糟糕的事情，我真不能抱怨太多，对吧？你看起来像经历了很多才到这里。我现在在想象中写下你的故事。战斗过无数人，筋疲力尽，四面楚歌，是吧？我可不想再经历那些了！

candidates.source: Right, well that explains where our missing warehouses and robots went.  You came clean, and Rubik appreciates that.  Yeah, we can remove it, but not without risk.  Might leave you with a little less brain than before, I'm afraid.  But despite your honesty, we can't trade with you or let you stick around if you refuse, now.  So we can take it out, and you might be a bit duller, or you can keep it, and I'll give you a ten minute head start before the stompys come after you.  Sorry that it has to be this way.
candidates.target: 对，这解释了我们失踪的仓库和机器人去向。你坦白了，鲁比克很感激。是可以把它移除，但不是没有风险的。可能会让你比以前少一点脑子，我怕是这样。但尽管你诚实，如果你拒绝，我们不能和你交易或让你留下。所以我们可以把它取出来，你可能会有点迟钝，或者你可以保留它，我会给你十分钟的领先时间，然后“大脚怪”会来追你。很抱歉必须这样做。

candidates.source: Hey, people of the wasteland, it's DJ Dustbowl on Dark Days Radio, and I've got two words for y'all that are listening in: tear gas.  We've all heard of these giant bugs that are crawling around, and if you haven't… I hate to break it to you, my sweet summer child, but wake up and sniff the bug juice; they're a thing.  Regardless, people, keep cool if you've got some tear gas canisters on tap.  That crap lays a creepy crawler out like they got told their free trial of life was up.  Sam's now got a whole bunch of fresh bug meat to snack on after I had to try it out on some uninvited guests climbing across my front door.
candidates.target: 嘿，荒野的人们，我是黑暗时代电台的DJ Dustbowl，我有两个词要送给正在收听的你们：催泪瓦斯。我们都听说过这些巨大的虫子在爬行，如果你没有...我很遗憾地告诉你，我亲爱的夏日孩子，但请醒醒，闻闻虫子的汁液；它们是真实存在的。无论如何，人们，如果你们有催泪瓦斯罐头，请保持冷静。那玩意儿能让那些令人毛骨悚然的虫子倒下，就像被告诉它们免费生命试用期结束了一样。Sam现在有一大堆新鲜的虫肉可以吃了，因为我不得不把它试用在一些在我前门上爬行的未邀请的客人身上。

candidates.source: That's right, I did.  My mother's mother was a woman of the old kind, and so was my father's father.  My father's mother, she was a grandma, a little piece of old London-Town, but I had a jaryi and a taita and a tamoi (these are words for grandparents in a guarani dialect).  They were all there, right to the end.  Standing by, we were, one and all.  No time for stories, though.  Back to the here and now.
candidates.target: 没错，我有。我母亲的母亲是个传统的老派女性，我父亲的父亲也是。我父亲的母亲，她是我奶奶，是伦敦老城里的一小部分，但我有瓜拉尼方言中对祖父母的称呼：jaryi、taita和tamoi。他们都在那里，直到最后。我们都站在一边，全体到齐。虽然没有时间讲故事了。回到现在吧。

candidates.source: Ha!  I wonder how long that's going to be one of our go-to small talk questions.  It's perfect, isn't it?  Doesn't make you talk about the worst stuff but stays on theme for what's on everyone's mind.  Okay, I'll bite.  Have you heard any of the really wild stories?  Giant monsters the size of skyscrapers kicking over tanks and stuff, during the worst days?  I think somehow our planet got moved into another dimension, probably some kind of experimental process gone wrong.  During transit, some of those things came across, but they left when we arrived wherever we are now.  The rules are different here, and maybe we're superimposed with whatever version of Earth was here to start with, and that's why we hear about aliens and other unbelievable stuff out there along with the zombies."  She grins.  "And before you say that's implausible, bear in mind that *the dead walk now*, so plausibility is off the table.
candidates.target: 哈！我很好奇这将成为我们常用寒暄话题多久。它完美极了，不是吗？不让你谈论最糟糕的事情，但又保持了大家心中所想的主题。好吧，我上钩了。你听说过那些真的很疯狂的故事吗？在最糟糕的日子里，有巨型怪物像摩天大楼一样踢翻坦克之类的故事，我认为我们的星球以某种方式被移动到另一个维度，可能是某种实验过程出错了。在转移过程中，有些东西穿了过来，但它们在我们到达现在这个地方时离开了。这里的规则是不同的，也许我们与最初在这里存在的地球版本重叠了，这就是为什么我们会听到关于外星人和其他不可思议的事情，还有僵尸。她露出了微笑。“在你说这不可信之前，请记住，*死者现在在行走*，所以可信度已经不重要了。

candidates.source: We never even made it there.  The unit got stomped by something gigantic.  I didn't even see it, just saw this huge black-and-green spiny leg slam down and crush the guy in front of me.  Then the guy behind me got sucked up into some kind of giant sweaty tube.  I don't know how I survived.  The thing rolled over, killed most of us right there.  I musta blacked out for a bit.  Came to, and while I was getting myself up, the others started getting back up.  Long story short, I lived, they didn't, and I ran.
candidates.target: 我们甚至没到那儿。我们的单位被某种巨大的东西踩扁了。我没看到，只看到一条巨大的黑绿色的带刺的腿砸下来，把我面前的人压死了。然后我身后的那个人被吸进了某种巨大的汗腻的管子里。我不知道我是怎么活下来的。那东西翻了个身，当场把我们大部分人压死了。我可能短暂失去了知觉。我醒来时，正在挣扎着站起来，其他人也开始站起来。总之，我活了下来，他们没活，我跑了。

candidates.source:
“I am the way into the city of woe.
 I am the way to a forsaken people.
 I am the way into eternal sorrow.

 Sacred justice moved my architect.
 I was raised here by divine omnipotence,
 Primordial love and ultimate intellect.

 Only those elements time cannot wear
 Were made before me, and beyond time I stand.
 Abandon all hope, ye who enter here.”
    -Dante Alighieri, _The Divine Comedy_, “Inferno”, Canto III. ca. 1315.
     trans. John Ciardi, 1954.
candidates.target:
“我是通向苦难之城的路。
我是通向被遗弃之民的路。
我是通向永恒悲伤的路。

神圣的正义促使我的建筑师。
我被神圣的全能所创造，
原始的爱和终极的智慧。

只有时间无法磨灭的元素
在我之前被创造，我超越了时间。
进入此门的人，请放弃所有希望。”
——但丁·阿利吉耶里，《神曲》，《地狱篇》，第三篇，约1315年。
约翰·西亚迪，1954年译。
