candidates.source: I'm DJ Dustbowl, this is my co-host, Sam, and my survival tip for today, folks, is simply to be resourceful.  This sounds like a whole lot of vague bullshit, I know, but I managed to find another survivor broadcasting on ham radio.  We got to talking, and this crazy motherfucker has apparently made a complete suit of armor from sheet metal padded with ripped-up body pillows, a mace from plumbing pipes, and has retooled their old hatchback into a fucking armored brick. 韦伯夫人是一名 74 岁的高加索女性，身高 5 英尺 1 英寸，体重 160 磅，灰色的短卷发，戴着老花镜，最后一次露面时身穿紫色背心、蓝色牛仔裤和黑色运动凉鞋。

家人报告说韦伯夫人患有痴呆症。失踪者于上午 11 点至 13 点离开她位于马萨诸塞州曼斯菲尔德肯尼迪大院 2354 号的住所。她的亲人非常担心，并请求你帮助找到她。

candidates.source:
I guess I am, yeah.  It feels nice to be putting all my skills to use instead of working an underpaid job to walk around the same woods flying a quadcopter around and being a glorified PR rep to cranky parents who are only at the park because they promised their kids they'd go.  Mind you, I'd still go back to it if I could."  Their expression falters a little.  "We all had our struggles, but things are different now, you know?  We get to worry about the future in a whole new way; an existential way that we never had to consider before, not really.  Sure, there was the occasional nuke scare, but as a society, we had things pretty good.  Unless the dead stop getting back up, I… don't think things are going to ever go back to normal."

Cranberry pauses for a moment, then shakes it off.  "But… right now, I'm feeling at peace with everything, despite it all.  Maybe I'm just in shock, and it'll all come crashing down one of these days.  Things might get worse, and they may never get better.  But I feel alright.  And I think that's enough for me.
candidates.target:
我想我是吧。能把所有技能都用上，而不是去做一份低薪工作，在同一个森林里转来转去，开着四轴飞行器，当一个被脾气暴躁的家长们吹毛求疵的公关代表，这感觉真不错。尽管如此，如果可以，我还是会回去的。他们的表情有点犹豫。“我们都有过挣扎，但现在不同了，你知道吗？我们以一种全新的方式，一种存在主义的方式来担忧未来，这是我们之前从没真正考虑过的。当然，偶尔会有核威胁，但作为一个社会，我们过得挺好的。除非死者不再复生，我……不认为事情会回到正常状态。”

蔓越莓停顿了一下，然后摇了摇头。“但……现在，尽管一切都这样，我却感觉内心平静。也许我只是处于震惊状态，有一天都会崩溃。事情可能会变得更糟，也许永远不会好转。但我感觉还好。我想这对我来说已经足够了。

candidates.source:
To extract the two liters of Fae essence the ritual requires, you will need to have one lump of steel and one lump of cast iron on your person or nearby enough to be included in the ritual, Fae parts and a container for the liquid essence.

Iron, and to a lesser extend steel, are anathema to the Fae, a fact that the following ritual takes advantage of to separate the essence from the butchered corpse by temporarily amplifying their Fae-bane properties, pushing the essence out of the remains.

Any Fae part will do, as long as their level of relative physics is higher than nothing.
candidates.target:
为了提取仪式需要的两升精灵精华，你需要在你身上或附近有钢块一块和生铁块一块，还有精灵的身体部位以及一个盛液体精华的容器。

铁，以及某种程度上钢，对精灵来说是致命的，这点被以下仪式利用，通过暂时增强它们驱散精灵特性的能力，将精华从尸体中驱赶出来。

任何精灵的身体部位都可以，只要它们的物理水平相对来说高于零。

candidates.source:
*makes a stiff, bowing gesture and leads you out of the shop and down a stone pathway towards one of the larger buildings in the compound.  A thick steel door slides aside to reveal a gloomy, rust-dusted corridor.  At the end of the corridor is a clean appearing surgical suite, not too different from any other surgical suite aside from the dim lighting and the surgeon itself.  At the head of the surgical table is a contraption reminiscent of an upside-down spider, its multiple glistening medical limbs curling gently in eager anticipation of your approach.  You have little time to question your choices before you feel a sharp pinch in your left shoulder, and the world drifts away.

You awaken on a comfortable bed, your chest and throat sore but otherwise well.  As the haze of anesthesia fades, you notice several tiny, sore wounds on your chest and arms.  A humanoid cyborg, not Rubik, notices that you are awake and wordlessly gestures you to follow, leading you back to Rubik's store.

"Ah, an' you're with the stars 'n lights again, an I'm ken.  'Tis grand.  Those wee CBMs will do ye little an fine, but they are a start.  Now us'n can sell you all you like, an' help with install, should ye wish."
candidates.target:
他做了一个僵硬的鞠躬手势，把你从店里领出，沿着一条石子小路走向院子里的一栋较大的建筑。一扇厚重的钢门滑开，露出一个阴暗、布满铁锈的走廊。走廊尽头是一间看起来很干净的手术室，除了灯光昏暗和外科医生本人外，与其他手术室没什么两样。手术台上方有一个像倒挂蜘蛛一样的装置，它多条闪亮的医疗机械臂轻轻地蜷缩着，迫不及待地等待着你的靠近。你几乎没有时间质疑自己的选择，就感觉到左肩有一阵刺痛，然后世界逐渐模糊。

你在舒适的床上醒来，胸口和喉咙有点疼，但除此之外身体状况良好。当麻醉的迷雾逐渐消散，你注意到胸口和手臂上有几个小伤口，感觉有点疼。一个类人机械体，不是鲁比克，注意到你醒了过来，无声地向你示意，把你领回了鲁比克的店里。

candidates.source: This appears to be a screen shot of a social media blog post, with the view dominated by a full-color picture of a futuristic-looking wind turbine standing tall against a backdrop of rolling hills and verdant pastures.  Looming atop a distant mound squats a large nuclear energy facility, with a forbiddingly dark mushroom cloud blossoming in the air above it and the surrounding land a toxic, radioactive-green wasteland.  Regally poised atop one of the turbine's blades stands a diminutive figure, bark-like skin cladding them like armor and flowering buds crowning their scalp. candidates.source: Vanessa… I'm doing my best, I really am, but we just do not get along.  One of these days one of us is probably going to brain the other with a tire iron, and I'm just grateful I spend more time around the tire irons.  Uyen and Rhyzaea are both excellent people, and I genuinely like them, but I can't stand this ongoing political bullshit they've got going on.  Alonso is just a… he's… there's no polite word for what he is.  A lot of the others are fine with it, and okay, sure, I guess.  John is a walking stereotype, but he's a great poker buddy.  I admit I kinda like him.
candidates.target: Vanessa……我真的尽力了，但我们就是不合拍。总有一天，我们其中之一可能会用千斤顶把另一个人的脑袋敲烂，而我只感到庆幸，因为我更多时间都在千斤顶附近。Uyen和Rhyzaea都是很优秀的人，我真正喜欢他们，但我无法忍受他们持续的政治胡闹。Alonso就是……他就是……没什么礼貌的话可以形容他。很多其他人都可以接受，好吧，我也没意见。John是一个活生生的刻板印象，但他是一个很棒的扑克牌伙伴。我承认，我有点喜欢他。

candidates.source: From the bus?  A few of us made it in the end; the Singh family were on that bus with us.  We were some of the last refugees to arrive."  He gestures to three people gathered together a short distance away.  "They put us into a room for processing, where a bunch of the wounded were being handled as best as they could manage.  They were short staffed though, and they missed one.  We all thought he was just having a nap, but he wasn't," Pablo wipes his face with his hand and pauses for a moment.  "When he got back up as a zombie, there was a huge panic.  Gunshots in a small, crowded room, and trampling… it was really ugly.  We were close to the door and managed to get out right away, but then a couple panicking people closed the place off and left innocent people in there for what seemed like ages, calling it an 'outbreak'.  By the time leveler heads prevailed, there weren't many people left in there to recover.
candidates.target: 从公交车上？我们几个人最终成功了；辛格一家人和我们在同一辆公交车上。我们是最后几批到达的难民。”他朝不远处聚集的三个人比了个手势。“他们把我们带进了一个处理室，那里有好多伤员，他们尽可能地救治他们。但是人手不足，他们错过了一个。我们都以为他在小睡一会儿，但他没有。”巴勃罗用手擦了擦脸，停顿了一下。“当他变成僵尸重新站起来时，引发了一阵大乱。在狭小拥挤的房间里开枪，还有人踩踏…真是惨不忍睹。我们离门近，马上就冲了出去，但当时有几个慌乱的人把门关上了，把无辜的人困在里面很久，称那里为‘爆发区’。等到情况得到控制，里面已经没剩下多少人可以救治了。

candidates.source:

Rest is a haze of bloody screams and a hail of bullets and plasma.  Few that got out died later of blood loss or froze from suits full o' holes."
Veronica removes her glove revealing a metallic hand that glints brightly in the dim light of the structure.

candidates.source:
I was on my way to visit my parents back in Burlington, waiting at a bus station, when the evacuation notices started sounding.  I'd been a little out of touch for a bit and didn't realize how bad the rioting was getting.  When my bus arrived it got repurposed into an evacuation vehicle, and took me here.  I… I didn't used to be very religious, it's just something I was born to, but since this happened I've been thinking a lot more about God, and how grateful I am for His help in surviving.  With things still so difficult, it helps to know He's got some plan for me.

Anyway, mine was the second bus to arrive, and they were just getting some triage and processing stuff set up.  I was put in charge of helping with the wounded, along with Uyen.  Things went a little strange later on… one of the women doing triage and processing had a bit of a hang-up about particular, um, colors of people being allowed into the center.  She claimed to have lost our 'papers', along with a lot of other peoples'.  Thankfully because we'd helped so many we were able to argue that they couldn't leave us out, but there was no space left downstairs by the time we got that sorted, so here we are.
candidates.target:
我当时正前往伯灵顿探望父母，在公交车站等车，这时开始响起疏散通知。我有点脱网，没意识到骚乱有多严重。我的公交车到来了，却被改作疏散车辆，把我带到这里。我……以前不是很虔诚，只是天生信仰宗教，但自从发生这件事以来，我更常思考上帝，感激祂让我幸存下来。在如此艰难的情况下，知道祂有计划让我活下去，这很安慰。

总之，我的公交车是第二辆到来的，他们正搭建临时医疗点和处理点。我和云英负责帮助伤员。后来情况有点奇怪……其中一个负责分诊和处理的女士对特定“肤色”的人进入中心有点偏见。她声称丢了我们的“文件”，还有很多其他人的。幸好因为我们帮助了那么多人，我们可以争辩说他们不能把我们排除在外，但到我们解决好时，楼下已经没位置了，所以我们就在这里。

我当时正赶往伯灵顿看望我的父母，在公交车站等车的时候，疏散警报就开始响了。我最近有点与世隔绝，没意识到骚乱已经变得这么严重。我的公交车到了之后就被改造成了疏散车辆，把我带到了这里。我……我以前不太信教，只是从小就耳濡目染，但自从这件事发生后，我一直在思考上帝，以及我为能够幸存而感到多么的感激。 尽管情况仍然很困难，知道祂为我有所安排，这让我感到安心。

总之，我的车是第二辆到达的公交车，他们正在设置一些临时医疗和处理手续的场所。我和乌恩一起负责协助救治伤员。后来情况变得有点奇怪……负责医疗和处理手续的其中一位女性对某些人种的颜色有偏见，不允许他们进入中心。她声称我们和许多其他人的‘文件’都丢失了。谢天谢地，因为我们帮助了这么多人，我们能够争辩说他们不能把我们排除在外，但等到事情解决好之后，楼下已经没有位置了，所以我们只好在这里了。

Things went a little strange later on… one of the women doing triage and processing had a bit of a hang-up about particular, um, colors of people being allowed into the center.  She claimed to have lost our 'papers', along with a lot of other peoples'.  Thankfully because we'd helped so many we were able to argue that they couldn't leave us out, but there was no space left downstairs by the time we got that sorted, so here we are.

我正准备去伯灵顿看望父母，在车站等巴士的时候，疏散通知响了。当时我有点迟钝，没意识到事情有多糟糕。然后巴士来了，但是辆疏散用车，把我带到了这里。我……以前的我不是很虔诚，从出生起就那样，但是经历过这一切之后，我一直在考虑关于神的事情，感谢祂保佑我活下来。虽然一切都很艰难，但光是知道自己对祂还有用就让我心安。

接着，我们是第二辆到这里的车，他们刚刚开始对到达人员进行鉴别审核的流程，我和玉鸳一起帮助伤员，之后发生了一些……奇怪的事情。其中一个女负责人，试着阻挠有肤色的人进入难民中心。她声称我们这些人的“证明文件”丢了。值得庆幸的是，因为我们帮过很多人，最后吵了一架让我们没被留在外面，但当我们被审核好时，楼下已经没有空间了，所以我们现在只能呆在这里。

candidates.source: Cute things, aren't they!  Like big birds with big appetites.  The plant eaters are okay unless they get spooked - then it's time to hide on the roof for a while until they calm down.  I gave one some cattle feed and it seemed to like it fine, let me pet it and followed me around some.  I bet you could tame them if they're young, maybe even some of the grown ones.  A man came out here a while ago saying they were coming, that it was their time and we needed to get with them or get out of the way.  The man said I should follow him to the Swamper church, but I'm too busy here.  A whole lot of people went with him though.
candidates.target: 可爱的小家伙们，不是吗！就像大鸟一样，食量很大。食草动物还好，除非它们被吓到了——那时候就得躲在屋顶上一段时间，等它们平静下来。我给其中一只喂了一些牛食，它好像很喜欢，让我抚摸它，还跟着我转了一会儿。我敢打赌，如果它们还年轻，甚至一些成年人也可以驯服。之前有个男人来过这里，说它们快来了，这是它们的时间，我们要么配合它们，要么让开道路。那个人让我跟他去沼泽教堂，但我这里太忙了。不过，很多人跟他去了。

candidates.source: Cute things, aren't they!  Like big birds with big appetites.  The plant eaters are okay unless they get spooked - then it's time to hide on the roof for a while until they calm down.  I gave one some cattle feed and it seemed to like it fine, let me pet it and followed me around some.  I bet you could tame them if they're young, maybe even some of the grown ones.  A man came out here a while ago saying they were coming, that it was their time and we needed to get with them or get out of the way.  The man said I should follow him to the Swamper church, but I'm too busy here.  A whole lot of people went with him though.
candidates.target: 多可爱的东西啊！就像那些体型硕大、胃口也大的大鸟。食草动物通常没什么问题，除非它们受惊——那就得躲到屋顶上去，等它们平静下来再说。我给其中一只喂了些牛饲料，它似乎挺喜欢，还让我摸了摸，随后跟着我转悠了一阵。我想，如果它们还年幼，应该能驯化；说不定连一些成年个体也行。之前有个男人从这儿出来，说它们要来了，是时候了，我们要么与它们同行，要么就得让路。那人让我跟他去沼泽教堂，但我这儿太忙了。不过还是有不少人跟着他走了。

candidates.source: POPULAR 'ALIEN AUTOPSY' DEBUNKED.  A widely circulated video, making the rounds everywhere from FriendFace to television news, has been debunked as a fake.  This extremely realistic and graphic alien autopsy shows an insect-like creature being dismantled by Japanese researchers, who comment on its anatomy in Japanese throughout the video.  Early observations that the creature was suspiciously similar to those described in the popular works of horror author HP Lovecraft were not sufficient to dislodge the video's viral status.  Yesterday, on the popular social media website Eddit, a 'making of' video was posted, clearly exposing the work as the final film project of a small group of students at UCLA.
candidates.target: 广为流传的“外星人尸检”被揭穿为伪造。一段在从“好友脸”到电视新闻等各个平台上广泛传播的视频被证实是假的。这段极其真实且血腥的外星人尸检视频展示了一群日本研究人员正在拆解一只类似昆虫的生物，他们在整个视频中用日语评论其解剖结构。早期观察到该生物与恐怖小说作家H.P.洛夫克拉夫特的作品中描述的生物令人怀疑，但这并不足以阻止该视频的病毒式传播。昨天，在流行的社会媒体网站“埃迪特”上，一段“制作花絮”视频被发布，清楚地揭露了这段视频是加州大学洛杉矶分校的一小群学生的最终电影项目。

candidates.source: WAREHOUSE FULL OF BLOOD DRAINED BODIES FOUND IN BOSTON: A horrific discovery in Boston this morning with a discovery of a downtown warehouse full of dead bodies.  The bodies were found in two states, completely drained of blood or decapitated with the hearts torn out.  The police haven't released the total number of bodies discovered but it is believed that this must the work of a gang war.  Our source said that they believe that the two different body states suggest that one type of death is for people who are in the gang versus those who are outside of the gang but work for it.
candidates.target: 波士顿发现满是被抽干血液和被砍头的尸体仓库：今天早上，波士顿发生了一起令人毛骨悚然的发现，在市中心的一家仓库里发现了大量尸体。这些尸体有两种状态，要么被完全抽干了血液，要么被砍头，心脏被挖出。警方尚未公布发现的尸体总数，但据信这必定是帮派战争的结果。我们的消息来源称，他们认为两种不同的尸体状态表明，一种死亡方式是针对帮派成员，另一种是针对为帮派工作但不在帮派内的的人。

candidates.source: Took us three days and four hard-working hands to clear this humble little land.  It's a far-cry from my old garden, it really is.  I heard theories, from Tom of course, that really messed with my head.  You can never know what's in one of them toxic clouds, can ya?  I suspect goo-puker blood.  That putrid oil is a sure way to make any soil infertile, or so that nitwit says.  Here I go again, ramblin' once more.  One of my bad habits.
candidates.target: 我们花了三天时间和四只辛勤的手才清理了这片小土地。这和我以前的花园简直天差地别。我听汤姆说了一些理论，真的让我头疼。你永远不知道那些有毒云雾里有什么，对吧？我怀疑是恶心血。那种恶臭的油绝对会让土壤变得不毛，那个傻瓜这么说。我又开始胡言乱语了，这是我的坏习惯之一。

candidates.source: "To whoever may find this, I've had enough of cowering and hiding.  I have realized I can't outlast whatever this is.  I saw something different at the grocery store down the block.  Skulking around on all four, faster than all the others.  It jumped at me from behind a car.  It's as if they were all changing.  I'm sure I'll see many more of these as time goes on.  I'm leaving.  Whatever you want, take it."
candidates.target: “找到这封信的人，我已经受够了畏缩和隐藏。我意识到我无法坚持下去了。我在街角的杂货店里看到了一些不同的东西。它四肢着地，比其他所有东西都快。它从车后跳了出来。好像它们都在改变。我确定随着时间的推移，我会看到更多这样的东西。我要离开了。你想要什么，就拿去吧。”

candidates.source: The roads further on were muddy: soon, we couldn't walk any further.  Our pace was enough to keep us ahead of the dead, but I feared for our safety should we stop.  We went on until we had no choice.  Our feet blistered in shoes not meant for such a journey, and our packs weighed us down; we knew that if we met any more zombies, we couldn't escape nor fight them.  At last, a long-abandoned shack gave us refuge, its roof collapsed and its windows boarded up."  He flares his nostrils.  "I had expected some awful smell, and animal dung, but to be honest, it was still surprisingly dry and dusty inside.  We had a packed lunch, and feasted on cold, leftover samosa that night."  With a little wink, he pats his belly.  "I suppose it was the last time I enjoyed my wife's home cooking, in a way.  It was hard to enjoy it.  Under no circumstances could we risk a fire.  We each took a turn guarding in the dark, and got what sleep we could in the cold of that old ruin."  Glancing around at the cramped shelter room, he pauses for a moment.  "It seems almost like a memory that didn't happen, too outlandish to fit with the rest of my mundane life.  The next day dawned, damp and cold, but without pursuers.  By then I was confident we'd lost the zombies."  He gives you a solemn look.  "That is, truly, the end of this story.  Once the sun was up, we made our way through the forest, onto the road, and from there it was a short walk to this center.
candidates.target: 道路越往前走越泥泞，我们很快就走不动了。我们的步速足以让我们领先于死者，但我担心如果我们停下来，安全就会有危险。我们走到了没有选择的地步。我们的脚在不适合这种旅程的鞋子里起了一层层水泡，背包也让我们负重难行；我们知道，如果再遇到更多的僵尸，我们既无法逃脱，也无法战斗。最后，一座被遗弃已久的破屋给了我们庇护，它的屋顶塌了，窗户也被封上了木板。“他皱着鼻子。 “我原本以为会有一股难闻的味道，会有动物粪便，但老实说，里面出乎意料地干净，尘土飞扬。我们吃了带来的午餐，那天晚上，我们美餐了一顿冷的、剩的萨摩萨。”他眨了眨眼，拍了拍肚子。“我想，以一种奇怪的方式，那可能是我最后一次享受妻子的家常便饭。很难享受它。在任何情况下，我们都不能冒险生火。我们轮流在黑暗中守夜，在那座古老的废墟里，我们在寒冷中勉强睡了一会儿。”他环顾这间狭小的避难室，停顿了一下。“这似乎像是一个没有发生的记忆，太离奇了，不适合我平凡的生活其余部分。第二天，阴冷潮湿的天空终于亮了起来，但没有追捕者。到那时，我已经确信我们摆脱了僵尸。”他给你一个严肃的眼神。“这真的是这个故事的结尾。太阳升起后，我们穿过森林，走上公路，从那里到这个中心只需短短的步行。”

candidates.source:
hunternetlinda.mp4
Electronic music plays on a black screen.  Text appears on the screen
'Stand still, pause clocks, we can make the world stop'
A video montage follows a woman across multiple days and outfits.  On errands, at work, traveling in different cities.  About a minute into the montage of video there are short cuts to her violently attacking people in secluded settings.  Those gradually become the dominant images until it's only video of her feasting on the blood of her fallen victims.  The final image is her looking up; face covered, blood dripping down onto her ruined outfit; eyes staring straight into the camera as the image freezes.  On the now black screen, a name and address appear.
candidates.target:
《hunternetlinda.mp4》

电子音乐在黑色屏幕上播放。屏幕上出现文字：“静止不动，停止时钟，我们可以让世界停止”。

一段视频剪辑展示了一个女子在多天多套服装中的生活。她跑腿、工作、在不同城市旅行。大约在视频剪辑进行到一分钟时，画面开始插入她在偏僻处暴力袭击他人的短镜头。这些镜头逐渐成为主导，直到画面只剩下她享用倒下受害者鲜血的视频。最后，画面定格在她抬头看向镜头的瞬间：她的脸被鲜血覆盖，血滴滴落到她被弄脏的衣服上；她的眼睛直视镜头。

此时，黑色屏幕上出现一个名字和地址。

candidates.source: Would you believe that they don't!  Not a one in the whole place.  Well, maybe downstairs, but that's a different matter, isn't it?  Say, you're not planning on sticking around, right?  You're a free-roller, not a settler, seems like to me.  Don't know if I could beg or cajole you into maybe keepin' an ear out for a new guitar for me?  There gotta still be plenty out there not gettin' any love these days.  Whattya say?  Help an old man play some blues?  Would be good to have some real music around this place.  Be good for PEOPLE, you know what I'm sayin'?
candidates.target: 你会相信他们没有！这个地方一个都没有。好吧，也许楼下有，但那是另一回事，对吧？喏，你可不打算留下来，对吧？你是个自由之身，不是定居者，对吧？我不知道我能不能请求或哄你帮忙留意一下新吉他？外面肯定还有很多吉他没有得到爱护。你说呢？帮个老头弹点蓝调？这个地方有真实的音乐会很好，你知道我的意思吧？对人们来说会是件好事，你懂的。

candidates.source: Activating this will add the Arcade Mode achievement unlocking all starting scenarios and professions for all worlds.  You will need to save the character in order to record this.  Achievements are tracked from the 'achievements' folder if you need to get rid of this (and the 'memorial' folder if you need to get rid of this from a dead character in a legacy save).  Activating this will spoil factions and situations you may otherwise stumble upon naturally while playing.  Some scenarios are frustrating for the uninitiated, and some professions skip portions of the game's content.  If new to the game, meta progression will help you be introduced to mechanics at a reasonable pace.

candidates.source:
In Impossible difficulty, time limits are extremely tight.
Warp pulses occur every 5 minutes.  This means warp sickness sets in after only 40 minutes of being earthside, and disintegration at 1 hour.  Reaching the extract alive will take all the time you can spare, and warp sickness will be common.  You will not be given mercy!
candidates.target:
在不可能难度下，时间限制极其严格。
每5分钟就会发生一次空间跳跃脉冲。这意味着在地球上待40分钟后就会出现空间病，1小时后就会解体。到达提取点活着需要你所能用的所有时间，空间病将非常常见。你不会得到任何宽恕！

candidates.source: I saw it all pretty early, before it all really started.  I worked as a healer.  It started with a jump in the number of code whites - that's an aggressive patient.  Wasn't my training so I didn't hear about it until later… but rumors started flying about hyperaggressive delirious patients that coded and seemed to die, then started attacking people, and wouldn't respond to anything we hit them with.  Then a friend of mine was killed by one of them, and I realized it wasn't just a few weird reports.  I called in sick the next day.
candidates.target: 我很早就看到了，在一切真正开始之前。我当时是一名治疗师。首先是白码数量的激增——那是攻击性患者。那不是我的专业，所以我后来才听说。但关于超级攻击性、精神错乱的患者传来了消息，他们出现代码并似乎死亡，然后开始攻击人们，对我们给他们的任何东西都不起作用。然后，我的一个朋友被他们之一杀死了，我意识到这不仅仅是一些奇怪的报道。第二天我打电话请病假。

candidates.source: RIOT IN BANKSLEY.  Irony was hot and dangerous in Banksley, Vermont today, where a fight broke out in a local coffee shop, reportedly starting over a dispute about the details of a similar riot in Carlhaven, Nebraska.  Within an hour, the fight had expanded to engulf the local downtown core.  Danielle Louiston, a server who fled the scene, was available for phone interview.  "It was like nothin' I've ever seen," describes Danielle.  "One minute it's a normal Friday morning, the next it's a bar brawl.  By the time I got outta there, most of the restaurant was involved.  I got in my car and just bolted home, then called the cops.  Turns out they're all in the fight!  The secretary and I, we got hold of the military and finally they came in and cleared things up."  Stabilizing the riots required the dispatch of three National Guard units.  Casualty reports are, as yet, unavailable.
candidates.target: 班克斯利暴乱。今天，在佛蒙特州的班克斯利，讽刺气氛紧张而危险，一家当地咖啡馆爆发了斗殴事件，据报道，起因是关于内布拉斯加州卡尔黑文类似暴乱的细节存在争议。在一个小时内，这场斗殴扩大，波及了整个市中心。丹妮尔·路易斯顿，一位逃离现场的服务员，接受了电话采访。“这简直是我从未见过的场景，”丹妮尔描述道。“一会儿是普通的周五早晨，下一刻就变成酒吧斗殴。等我逃出去时，大部分餐厅的人都卷入了其中。我跳进车里，直接开回家，然后报了警。结果，警察们都在打架中！我和秘书一起联系了军队，他们最终介入并平息了事态。”稳定暴乱需要派遣三个国民警卫队单位。目前，伤亡报告尚不可用。

Irony was hot and dangerous in Banksley, Vermont today, where a fight broke out in a local coffee shop, reportedly starting over a dispute about the details of a similar riot in Carlhaven, Nebraska.  Within an hour, the fight had expanded to engulf the local downtown core.  Danielle Louiston, a server who fled the scene, was available for phone interview.  "It was like nothin' I've ever seen," describes Danielle.  "One minute it's a normal Friday morning, the next it's a bar brawl.  By the time I got outta there, most of the restaurant was involved.  I got in my car and just bolted home, then called the cops.  Turns out they're all in the fight!  The secretary and I, we got hold of the military and finally they came in and cleared things up."  Stabilizing the riots required the dispatch of three National Guard units.  Casualty reports are, as yet, unavailable.

candidates.source: GOVERNMENT ANNOUNCES NEW RESEARCH DIVISION.  The US government has announced a new research push into esoteric and fringe sciences.  "We've decided that based on the new medicines and treatments that have been coming out of Asia from leads in Traditional Chinese Medicine and other Asian cultural histories to institute some additional research into less recent avenues.  This research group is receiving it's funding as part of the budget windfall brought on by rare mineral deposits near the Canadian border."  Many geologists are still asking for access to these mineral deposits as these formations fly in the face of previously known geology.
candidates.target: 政府宣布成立新的研究部门。美国政府宣布将对神秘和边缘科学领域进行新的研究推动。"我们决定，基于从亚洲传统中医和其他亚洲文化历史中获得的新药物和治疗方法，对一些不太近期的途径进行额外研究。这个研究团队将获得来自加拿大边境附近稀有矿产带来的预算红利的资金支持。"许多地质学家仍在要求进入这些矿产地，因为这些地质构造与之前已知的地质学知识相悖。

candidates.source: Yes we are.  The center had a good stock of those awful soy bars, but between all of us, it went fast.  We're making do with what we can skim off the edge of towns, but mostly we rely on trade from people like you.  Speaking of, we'll pay top dollar for anything preserved - canned, salted, dried, whatever.  Just talk to the broker in the back.

candidates.source: IN WINSLOW, A BUILDING BOOM WITH NO CLEAR EXPLANATION.  The facility, which sits on approximately forty acres of land purchased by the federal government through a series of transactions that were not publicly disclosed until local reporters obtained the records through a Freedom of Information Act request, consists of at least six large buildings, several of which have no windows.  A seventh structure, partially underground, is visible only from the air.  The General Services Administration described the project in procurement documents as a "research and logistics facility" and listed the client agency only as "DOD-Other."  Route 137, which passes the facility's main entrance, has been subject to intermittent closures that the sheriff's office has attributed to "utility work," though residents say the closures often coincide with the arrival of flatbed trucks carrying equipment under tarps and unmarked white vans arriving in convoys of three or four.
candidates.target: 在温斯洛，一场没有明确解释的建筑热潮。该设施坐落在联邦政府通过一系列交易购买的约四十英亩土地上，这些交易直到当地记者通过《信息自由法》请求获得记录后才公开。该设施由至少六座大型建筑组成，其中几座没有窗户。第七座部分地下结构只能从空中看到。总务管理局在采购文件中将该项目描述为“研究和后勤设施”，并仅将客户机构列为“国防部分-其他”。经过设施主入口的137号公路曾数次间歇性关闭，警长办公室将其归因于“公用事业工作”，尽管居民们说，关闭往往与载有遮盖着的设备的平板卡车和未标明车牌的白色面包车的三四辆车队到达同时发生。

candidates.source:
This appears to be a screenshot from a newsreel: a reporter standing in the foreground before the night-enveloped backdrop of a rubble-strewn crossroad, the caption, "Maine disaster area," printed in the upper corner.  Several military transport vehicles idle in the midground, the white beams of their headlights illuminating groups of civilians dressed in a shabby assortment of streetwear and night clothes.  Clutching bundled possessions, children, and pets, it's evident that they're being ushered towards the waiting vehicles, with teams of heavily armed soldiers forming protective flanks and lines of machinegun-equipped sandbags cordoning off roadways at the frame's extremities.

Stooping behind a building's window and peeking through partly opened curtains, observing the humans' flight with beady, unblinking eyes, you can make out an amorphous, white shape.  You're not sure what's stranger: that the creature's somehow evaded notice by the dozens of watchful soldiers, or that, for all the world, it resembles an inhumanly tall, muscular penguin.
candidates.target:
这似乎是一张新闻影片的截图：一名记者站在前景中，身后是夜幕笼罩的满目疮痍的十字路口，画面上角印着“缅因州灾区”的字幕。几辆军用运输车辆停在中景中，它们白色的车头灯照亮了穿着破旧街头服和睡衣的平民群体。他们紧握着捆绑的物品、孩子和宠物，显然正被护送到等待的车辆中，全副武装的士兵队伍形成保护侧翼，配备机枪的沙袋排成一排，在画面两端封锁道路。

一个模糊的白色形状在建筑物的窗户后面蹲下，透过半开的窗帘窥视，用警惕的、不眨眼的眼睛观察着人类的逃亡。你不知道什么更奇怪：是这种生物如何逃过数十名警惕士兵的察觉，还是它看起来像一只不可思议的高大、肌肉发达的企鹅。

candidates.source: Ha, this thing!"  She dusts the flour off her hands and tucks a loose lock of hair back behind her ear.  "You remember, we signed on as caravan hands to get us out here.  Well, we had a bunch of stops along the way first.  We were headed to a little group of survivors that snagged themselves a huge stock of dry food somehow, and passed this trailer sales yard smack dab in the middle of nowhere, nobody to be seen for miles.  Pablo managed to sweet talk the group into taking a rest stop there.  We searched the yard, and a lot of the stuff wasn't suitable, but this baby was ready to go.  Long story short, we got the keys to that vintage truck outside, hitched this thing up, and upgraded our caravan.
candidates.target: “哈，这东西！”她拍了拍手上的面粉，将一缕散落在耳前的头发别回去，“你记得吗，我们以运输队成员的身份加入了这个队伍，是为了来到这里。我们一路上有很多站要经过。我们要去一个幸存者小队那里，他们不知从哪里弄来了一大堆干粮，就在荒野中间的一个拖车销售场停下来，附近几英里内一个人都没有。帕布罗设法说服了那群人在那里休息一下。我们搜索了场地，很多东西都不合适，但这辆车已经准备好了。简而言之，我们拿到了那辆老式卡车的外钥匙，把这辆车拖了过来，升级了我们的运输队。”

candidates.source: Long story short, I played for them every night like the contract said, it was a good bit better than starving to death.  I saw and heard some of the craziest things while I was there and other humans came and made deals and went.  They told me that this particular 'sith' had strict rules about how to treat people and that I was quite lucky to be here.  It didn't feel like they considered themselves 'people'.  Anyway when my contract was up they said they'd quite enjoyed my time with them and gave me some gifts to help me get along once I'd left their island.  When society broke down I thought about heading there to see if they were still there.  I chickened out when I realized how far it was compared to my evacuation point.  Course, here I am among the unwanted masses, maybe you'll find them there if you decide to go look.
candidates.target: 简而言之，我按照合同每晚为他们表演，这总比饿死好。在那里，我见识了很多疯狂的事，也见过其他来此交易的人。他们告诉我，这个特定的“西特”对如何对待人们有严格的规定，我很幸运能在那里。但他们似乎并不把自己当成“人”。总之，当我的合同期满时，他们说很享受和我共度的时光，并给我一些礼物，帮助我离开他们的岛屿后生活。当社会崩溃时，我想去看看他们是否还在，但当我意识到距离我的撤离点有多远时，我退缩了。当然，我现在在不被需要的大众中，也许你会找到他们，如果你决定去找的话。

candidates.source: While looking through the device's collection of mundane photos and videos, you stumble across a recording of some undated late-night CCTV footage taken in a trashed suburban neighborhood.  10 seconds into the video, an alarmed young woman sprints into view quickly followed by a feral man covered in blood and muck.  He quickly catches up to her and grapples her left arm.  They scuffle for quite some time until the woman manages to break his grip.  Reaching hastily into her purse, she pulls a small can of pepper spray - generously spraying it onto his face then shoulder-bashing the man onto the pavement.  The man gurgles and fidgets in pain as the woman sprints into the distance, out of the camera's view.

candidates.source: Pretty sure I did, but I do love hearing the sound of my own voice.  I got evacuated on to the local concentration center, then picked up on a repurposed school bus and dragged out to that shithole.  We heard the place was getting more people than they could fit, and the few who'd got there first had set up some sort of self-appointed processing lineup.  The chick processing me to get in saw my Chinese name and conveniently 'lost' my paperwork.  I was sent out to the lobby to wait for 'further processing', while I watched busloads of people get processed and taken in.  By the time they 'found' my paperwork, wouldn't you know it, the place was too full for me.  They oh-so-kindly let me camp out in the front since I'd been on one of the first buses.
candidates.target: 我很确定我有，但我确实很喜欢听自己的声音。我被疏散到当地的集中中心，然后被一辆改装的校车拉到那个鬼地方。我们听说那里的人口已经超出了容纳范围，先到的人已经建立了一种自我任命的处理队伍。处理我入场的那位女工作人员看到我的中文名字，方便地“丢失”了我的文件。我被送到大厅等待“进一步处理”，同时我看着一车车的人被处理并带进去。等他们“找到”我的文件时，你猜怎么着，那地方已经满员了。他们非常“友好”地让我在前面露营，因为我坐的是第一批巴士之一。

I got evacuated on to the local concentration center, then picked up on a repurposed school bus and dragged out to that shithole.  We heard the place was getting more people than they could fit, and the few who'd got there first had set up some sort of self-appointed processing lineup.  The chick processing me to get in saw my Chinese name and conveniently 'lost' my paperwork.  I was sent out to the lobby to wait for 'further processing', while I watched busloads of people get processed and taken in.  By the time they 'found' my paperwork, wouldn't you know it, the place was too full for me.  They oh-so-kindly let me camp out in the front since I'd been on one of the first buses.

candidates.source: What happened?  I'm not really sure.  You must know about the riots and all that, that the leadership totally failed to contain.  I don't have a good guess what caused that.  I thought it was the usual stuff at first, and I gotta admit, I was sort of excited and scared it was the start of a revolution.  Not excited enough to join in though, and I guess anyone who was is probably dead now.  I tried to wait it alone, packed a little bag, but I saw a rioter get back up and fight with crazy injuries.  I don't know how many people really believed it at first, but I took that as my sign and ran for a nearby cave I knew.  I don't know exactly what happened after that.  I thought others would be there but it was just me.
candidates.target: 发生了什么事？我不太确定。你应该知道那些骚乱和所有那些领导完全未能控制的事情。我猜不透是什么原因导致了那一切。起初我以为是平常的事，必须承认，我有点兴奋，还害怕那是革命的开始。尽管如此，我并没有加入其中，我想那些加入的人现在可能已经死了。我尝试独自等待，收拾了一个小包，但我看到一个骚乱者尽管伤得很重却又站起来战斗。我不知道一开始有多少人真正相信那一切，但我把那当成我的信号，向我知道的一个附近的洞穴跑去。我不知道之后发生了什么确切的事情。我以为会有其他人在那里，但只有我一个。

candidates.source: Well, I might as well be honest with you.  I ran mostly, ran like the devil was chasin' me.  I was at one of the police stations in town, when we were called out to handle a violent mob on the loose.  When we got there, the people were crazy, smashing and killing everything in their way.  They had these bloodshot eyes and a weird goo in their mouths.  We pulled out all the stops to handle them.  When tear gas wouldn't work, the chief told us to draw guns and kill them all.  We did…  There was so much blood…  That maneuver killed a lot of them, but not all.  One snuck up behind a lady who worked with us, tore a whole section of her spine out.  She never even had time to scream, just slumped over the cruiser door…  So I jumped post and ran, never looked back.  God, I can still hear the cries…
candidates.target: 好吧，我还是老实告诉你吧。我大部分时间都在跑，就像被恶魔追赶一样。我当时在镇上的警察局，我们接到报警处理一起暴徒逃脱的事件。当我们到达时，人们已经失控了，砸碎并杀死了他们路上的所有东西。他们有血红的眼睛和嘴里有奇怪的粘液。我们尽全力对付他们。当催泪瓦斯无效时，局长让我们拔枪杀了他们。我们做了...那里到处是血...这次行动杀死了很多人，但不是所有人。有一个人从背后偷袭了一位和我们一起工作的女士，把她脊椎的一大块撕了下来。她甚至没时间尖叫，只是瘫在了警车门上...所以我逃离了岗位并跑开了，没有回头看。天啊，我仍然能听到那些哭喊声...

candidates.source: Came in with a crew trying to cozy up 'ere on the DL.  It was a shit plan from the start, told 'em as much.  But those scrap-for brains couldn't see the forest for the trees.  Figured they pull a fortune of ship parts from the graveyards and skip planet fat and happy.
candidates.target: 带着一帮人试图在这里偷偷摸摸地混进来。这从一开始就是一个烂计划，我已经告诉过他们了。但是，那些脑子里全是废物的家伙们看不清大局。他们以为可以从墓地里拉一大堆船的零件，然后肥肥爽爽地离开星球。

candidates.source: Oh, same old story at first.  I got evacuated on to the local concentration center, then picked up on a repurposed school bus and dragged out here.  Then the chick processing me to get in saw my face and Chinese name and conveniently 'lost' my paperwork. candidates.source: While we were out on a hunting party a couple of those big ugly ones came back and ate a whole mob of the dead I wanted to take out.  We lost a lot of soldiers too while we were out too, good ones, and they died bad.  Slow.  I made sure of it, the traitors.  These dinosaurs have gone too far.  They're making us crazy.  We need to rack up some serious numbers to catch up.  We need some serious risk taking, I'm talking explosives and fire and drugs and rock and roll here.  I don't care if it's living dinos or dead, they all need to be taken down.
candidates.target: 当我们外出狩猎时，几只那些大而丑陋的恐龙回来了，吃掉了我本想处理的一大群死尸。我们也失去了很多士兵，都是好人，他们死得很惨。很慢。我确保了那些叛徒的死。这些恐龙已经过分了。它们让我们发疯。我们需要迅速增加人数来追赶。我们需要一些严重的冒险，我说的是爆炸物和火和毒品和摇滚乐。我不管是活恐龙还是死恐龙，它们都需要被消灭。

candidates.source: *smiles, very briefly, and nods.  "Very well.  The blockage had forced us to go through the woods, and our rusty old sedan was not suited to it.  We must have jarred something loose, because we were not far past the trailer when there was a loud bang, and the wheels stopped turning.  The engine spun and the axles rattled, but it was all sound and fury, signifying nothing.  We'd moved far enough from the overturned trailer to buy time, but as we got out of the vehicle, we could hear their moans on the wind, drawing closer."  As he dives into the story, Mandeep becomes more animated, his resonant accented voice carrying naturally over the rolling cadence of his words.  "I am no mechanic, and even if I were, there was no time for repairs.  We took what we owned and carried on on foot.  The center was not far, I knew, and at least Guneet and I had our kirpan, should we be forced to defend ourselves."  He touches the handle of the sword at his side, giving you a moment to interrupt if you want.

My brother… he wasn't so lucky.

candidates.source:
&The garishly-dressed hunter greets you with an easy smile and a haughty accent.  Their exotic-looking rifle is resting against the table.  "Excellent, excellent, come chat, talk, and see.  You, yes you.  I'm a hunter, you see, and I've been stalking those infernal tin nightmares - you know the ones - since the very first tear in the sky.  Capital sport, I assure you.  Splendid chase, even when they shoot back."

"Well, I am told we've developed a rather practical appetite for their innards.  So, I've taken the liberty of collecting and cleaning a few choice specimens.  Do have a look.  These are the finest cuts of alien machinery you're likely to find this side of oblivion."
candidates.target:
穿着花哨服装的猎人用轻松的微笑和傲慢的口吻向你打招呼。他那看起来很异国情调的步枪靠在桌子上。“太好了，太好了，来聊聊，说说，看看。你，就是你。我是一个猎人，你看，我一直在追踪那些该死的金属恶梦——你知道的，从天空中出现的第一个裂缝开始。这是一项很棒的运动，我向你保证。即使它们还击，追逐也非常精彩。”

“嗯，我听说我们对它们的内脏产生了相当实用的食欲。所以，我自作主张地收集和清洗了一些优质的标本。来瞧瞧吧。这些是你在这个世界可能找到的最优质的外星机械部件。”

candidates.source: I was home alone during the ongoing riots.  My parents chose the worst possible time to reconnect, which sucks, but I'm also kinda happy for them.  Anyway, they were part of the NECC people, so they knew about this place and their plans and all.  Thing is, it was, like, really far away.  I kinda didn't want to go alone but I also didn't want the rioters to eat me, so I asked Sonia - my neighbor - to evacuate with me, I guess.  So that was fun; escaping my hometown, walking down the country road, waiting for a horror to ambush us.  Spoiler alert: we were attacked.  So this zombie shambles in front of us and Sonia whacks it real hard with her guitar!  Its brain splatters all over the pavement, I threw up 'cause it was so disgusting.  We got here soon after that.  My parents weren't here, obviously.  Oh man, they must worry about me so much…
candidates.target: 我在持续的骚乱期间独自在家。我父母选择了最糟糕的时间来重聚，这很糟糕，但我也为他们感到高兴。总之，他们是NECC的人，所以他们知道这个地方和他们的计划。问题是，那地方非常远。我不想独自去，但我也不想被骚乱者吃掉，所以我问了我的邻居索尼亚一起撤离，我想。所以那很有趣；逃离家乡，沿着乡村道路走，等待恐怖的伏击。剧透：我们被攻击了。所以这个僵尸在我们面前摇晃着，索尼亚用她的吉他狠狠地打它！它的脑浆洒在人行道上，我因为太恶心而呕吐。我们很快就到了这里。我父母显然不在。哦，天啊，他们一定很担心我……

candidates.source:
Well, this conversation is pretty new!  But there's been some other changes.
  I've been able to install CBMs on you, and have passive bionics installed in me, for a while.  But now I can use some active bionics, and I can explain some details on how I use bionics.
  I can also ride horses, and you can give me orders to do things like farmwork, cutting trees, or even building houses from a blueprint.
  I can even read books to improve my skills, so you don't have to spend time reading to me.
  If you've got a faction camp, and we're near it, I'll eat from the camp's food reserves when I'm hungry.  And if the camp has a well, I'll drink from the well when thirsty.  Be careful, though - if other people are out on missions, I may eat the food they expected to eat when they got done!

我还会骑马，你可以命令我做一些事情，比如农活、砍树，甚至根据蓝图建造房屋。

candidates.source: I don't know if you've met Jay yet, but he and I split a garden out here.  We both work - well, worked - in technology, and we were convinced the world was ending so we both got property outside town.  We met when he moved in next door.  So this is our little homestead with a few upgrades.  We aren't really sweating property lines at this point.

candidates.source:
PROJECT PROCEDURES: Big Pappy
 PAGE 1

 1) Review patients for possible induction.  As a failsafe, patients selected for this program should have minimal or no contact with outside individuals and should additionally not be removed from their assigned rooms for longer than two days.  See 'Chapter 1: Induction' for greater detail.
 2) Administer standard alchemical dosage according to patient profile.  See 'Chapter 2: Dosages' on typical process.
 3) Monitor results over 7 days.  Patient will remain in general population outside of scheduled physicals unless determined otherwise by SVP Research & Development.
 4) Patients deemed unworthy for general population are to remain in Secure lab room for special monitoring.  Official documentation will denote hospitalization in this circumstance to mitigate chance of suspicion.
 5) To ensure unbiased compliance, selected patients and their families will not be informed of this process.

第1页

1) 审查可能接受诱导的患者。作为安全措施，被选入该项目的患者应与外界人员接触最少或根本不接触，且不应在其分配的房间外停留超过两天。详情请见“第一章：诱导”。

5) 为了确保不偏不倚的合规性，被选中的患者及其家人不会被告知此过程。

candidates.source:
To create a dream-drainer mosquito's heart, you'll need to gather some doses of lotus blossom, a handful of wyld candies, a small pile of dreamdross and a liter of Fae blood to create the dream-draining catalyst.

Once it is completed, find a mosquito and activate the catalyst while no farther than five meters away from it.  It must be a mosquito, anything else won't work.  The mosquito will then gorge itself on the catalyst and will suddenly transform into a dream-eating nightmare.

Once the dream-drainer mosquito appears, kill it and the heart will be yours.

Be careful, as this mosquito wields powers akin to those of the Eaters of Dreams such as the ability to heal its wounds and throw piercing projectiles at you.
candidates.target:
要创造一个吸梦蚊子的心脏，你需要收集一些荷花花瓣、一把野糖、一小堆梦渣和一升精灵血来制作吸梦催化剂。

完成后，找到一只蚊子并在距离它不超过五米的地方激活催化剂。必须是蚊子，其他生物不行。蚊子会贪婪地吸食催化剂，并突然变成一只吃梦的噩梦。

当吸梦蚊子出现后，杀死它，心脏就属于你了。

小心，因为这只蚊子拥有类似于梦食者的能力，例如可以治愈自己的伤口并向你投掷穿透性射物。

candidates.source: LOWELL PD CREDITS NEW SOFTWARE WITH DROP IN PROPERTY CRIME.  Four months into a pilot program with tech firm Cyonage, the Lowell Police Department is reporting a nineteen percent drop in property crime and a marked improvement in response times.  Chief Anita Cordeiro praised the AI-assisted dispatch system at a Monday press conference, calling it "the best tool we've added in years."  The system analyzes patrol data to flag potential trouble spots, allowing officers to be positioned before incidents escalate.  Lowell is one of several New England departments to adopt Cyonage's software, with Brockton and Fall River expected to begin their own pilots next quarter.
candidates.target: 洛威尔警察局将新软件归功于财产犯罪率的下降。在与科技公司 Cyonage 合作试点项目运行四个月后，洛威尔警察局报告称财产犯罪率下降了 19%，响应时间也有显著改善。首席安吉塔·科迪罗在周一的新闻发布会上赞扬了这一人工智能辅助调度系统，称其为“近年来最好的工具”。该系统分析巡逻数据，以标记潜在的麻烦区域，使警察能够在事件升级前就定位。洛威尔是新英格兰地区采用 Cyonage 软件的几个部门之一，布鲁克顿和福里弗预计将在下季度启动自己的试点项目。

Chief Anita Cordeiro praised the AI-assisted dispatch system at a Monday press conference, calling it "the best tool we've added in years."  The system analyzes patrol data to flag potential trouble spots, allowing officers to be positioned before incidents escalate.  Lowell is one of several New England departments to adopt Cyonage's software, with Brockton and Fall River expected to begin their own pilots next quarter.
candidates.target: 洛厄尔警方称，新软件助力财产犯罪率下降。在与科技公司 Cyonage 开展试点项目四个月后，洛厄尔警察局报告财产犯罪率下降了 19%，响应时间也显著改善。周一的新闻发布会上，局长安妮塔·科代罗盛赞该人工智能辅助调度系统，称其为“多年来我们引入的最佳工具”。该系统通过分析巡逻数据，识别潜在风险区域，使警员能够在事态升级前提前部署。洛厄尔是多个采用 Cyonage 软件的新英格兰地区警局之一，布罗克顿和福尔里弗预计将于下一季度启动各自的试点项目。

&The intercom's tray slides open, filled with your payment.  "Excellent.  In addition to your contracting fee you may keep the HOUND.  We would appreciate periodic reports on its field performance."

You hear a THUNK as something covers the microphone, and through scratches and muffled words, you heard "Permission--tell-----okay."

You then hear the intercom click off, there is a moment of silence, and it clicks on again.  "Ahem, so, as discussed earlier, we think this unit will lead to some important developments that will need field testing.  If things go as planned we will happily offer you a place in our field testing program.  Please occasionally check with us about project status."
candidates.target:
对讲机的托盘滑开，里面装满了你的报酬。“很好。除了你的合同费外，你可以保留猎犬。我们希望你能定期报告它的实地表现。”

你听到“砰”的一声，似乎有东西盖住了麦克风，通过模糊不清的声音，你听到“许可——告诉——可以。”

然后，对讲机“嘟”的一声关掉，过了一会儿又响起。“咳，所以，正如之前讨论的，我们认为这个单位将带来一些需要实地测试的重要发展。如果一切按计划进行，我们很乐意邀请你加入我们的实地测试计划。请不时地向我们了解项目进度。”

candidates.source: At first I wanted to help.  The riots, fighting in the streets, it was too much for me to just sit in my house and hear about it on the news.  Then a buddy of mine called me from just off the front lines.  He'd been hurt and he wasn't making much sense, but what he told me… well, you can imagine the kind of stuff he told me.  Everything the worst of the internet was making up, and more.  Instead of packing up to try to volunteer back onto active duty, I took his advice and packed up to leave.  My house was on the edge of town and the riots hadn't reached it yet, but from what I'd heard it was smarter to get out than to hold tight.  I slipped out that night, took my quad out, and camped a few days in the woods, waiting for it to blow over.  It never did.
candidates.target: 起初我想帮助。街头的骚乱、战斗，我不能只是坐在家里听新闻。然后我一个朋友从前线附近打电话给我。他受伤了，说的话也不太连贯，但他说的话……你可以想象他告诉我的那些事情。所有互联网上最糟糕的谣言，还有更多。而不是收拾行李试图重返现役，我听取了他的建议，收拾行李离开了。我的房子在镇的边缘，骚乱还没有到达那里，但根据我听到的，离开比坚守更明智。那天晚上我悄悄地溜走，骑着我的四轮摩托车，在树林里露营了几天，等待骚乱平息。但它从未平息。

candidates.source: High-tech armor?  And there's a whole group of them down in a bunker?  Probably best to keep people like that on our good side.  What they're saying seems to check out.  Reality does seem pretty fucked.  Kinda makes me wonder how involved THEY were if they know all that, though.
candidates.target: 高科技装甲？还有一个小组在地下掩体里？最好把这样的人留在我们这边。他们说的似乎是真的。现实似乎确实很糟糕。不过，如果他们知道这么多，我不禁想知道他们涉及的程度。

candidates.source: Fellow travelers between realities, those ones.  At first I thought they would be competition, but they seem to have little interest in the things we at the forge value.  Nowadays we barely interact with them, except in the rare occasions when we find a group of them marooned in between the worlds.  Poor things are almost always driven completely insane by the time we can mount a rescue.  Nevertheless, it's the law of the sea out there, as far as Valzain is concerned.  They seem to have set up shop not too far from here.  I'll mark it on your map for one denarius.  You might wanna check the magic item store for an Amulet of Comprehend Languages before you go.  Then again, we might be out of that right now.
candidates.target: 现实之间的旅伴，那些家伙。起初我以为他们会是竞争对手，但他们似乎对我们在锻造厂珍视的东西几乎没有兴趣。现在我们几乎不与他们互动，除非在极少数情况下发现他们被困在两个世界之间。到我们能够实施救援时，可怜的他们几乎都已经完全疯掉了。尽管如此，根据瓦尔扎因的说法，那里的法则就是如此。他们似乎在不远处设立了据点。我会在你的地图上标注，一个第纳尔就行。你去之前可能想检查一下魔法物品商店，看看有没有语言理解护符。不过，我们现在可能也没货。

candidates.source: You find a faint signal: 'This is [unintelligible] bringing you Darkest of the Hillside Thickets' new single Don't Talk with the Voice in the Storm!  I'm not really sure how new this single is as I never heard it before the Cataclysm and it showed up in an envelope stapled to the station door one morning after a reality storm.  I suppose there are creepier ways to bring me new music but I don't know what they are, and I'm begging you not to enact them.

candidates.source: Here's the thing: A while back one of our patrol vehicles got totalled when some junior officers took it for a joy ride.  We are in queue to get a replacement issued to us and High Command just wants the old one broken down for parts.  Well the chief and I agree that's a little wasteful.  So I patched the damn thing back together with the parts we had on hand.  And now we're looking for a way to make it, disappear.  You follow?

candidates.source: Well, I guess that was the Rapture.  It didn't play out how I thought it would.  They made me think it was gonna be a flash of light and then *poof*, everyone's gone.  Instead it was messy and dirty.  Riots in the streets, the leadership serving the Antichrist to cut the people down like - what was it my dad used to say - like wheat before the chaff?  Then when we'd really showed our Sin, God came in with the real plagues.  The dead started walking, getting up with holes in them to fight, and then people started turning on each other too.  After that, the legions of Hell itself came out.  Huge monsters, worse than anything I'd ever imagined, just tore through ripping everything to shreds.  Then they started dying off as quick as they'd arrived, and we were left trying to run and hide from the undead.
candidates.target: 好吧，我想那就是启示录了。它并没有像我想象的那样发生。他们让我以为会是一道闪光，然后“嗖”的一声，所有人都消失了。但实际上却是混乱肮脏的。街道上爆发了骚乱，领导者们为了镇压民众，侍奉着敌基督。就像我父亲曾经说过的那样，把人们像麦子一样从秸秆中分离出来。然后，当我们真正展现出我们的罪恶时，上帝带着真正的灾难降临了。死者开始行走，带着洞口起身战斗，然后人们也开始互相残杀。之后，地狱本身的军团出现了。巨大的怪物，比我曾经想象的还要可怕，它们撕裂着一切。然后，它们像出现时一样迅速地死去，我们只能试图逃离和隐藏于亡灵之中。

candidates.source:
People started freaking out.  I did, too.  I don't know how bad things got elsewhere, but shit was flying off the shelves where I lived.  Empty racks at grocery stores everywhere you looked.  I had enough food for a few weeks, so it wasn't a problem for me, but it still shook me up bad.  Every day some horrible new shit was happening somewhere in the world, and things got just worse and worse.  Then that insanity with Rhode Island happened, and once the national emergency came out, I knew that okay, this is happening, it's actually happening."

"Did you know that I was still going to work that entire time?  I don't know, it just felt meditative.  I lived in a pretty rural area, so there wasn't the kind of chaos in the cities and congestion on the roads.  I could just take a side road there and have a day of quiet. candidates.source:
&The intercom is silent a long moment, and then you hear a keyboard clacking and the tray slides open, filled with your payment.  "Yes, this will do.  In addition to your contracting fee you may of course keep the HOUND.  We would appreciate periodic reports on its field performance."

You hear a THUNK as something covers the microphone, and through scratches and muffled words, you heard "Permission--tell-----okay."

You then hear the intercom click off, there is a moment of silence, and it clicks on again.  "Ahem, so, as discussed earlier, we think this unit will lead to some important developments that will need field testing.  If things go as planned we will happily offer you a place in our field testing program.  Please occasionally check with us about project status."
candidates.target:
对讲机沉默了一会儿，然后你听到键盘的敲击声，托盘滑开了，里面装满了你的报酬。“是的，这个可以了。除了你的合同费外，你当然可以保留HOUND。我们希望你能定期报告它的实地表现。”

你听到“砰”的一声，好像有东西盖住了麦克风，通过模糊不清的声音，你听到“许可——告诉——可以。”

然后对讲机“嘀嗒”一声关了，过了一会儿又响了起来。“咳，所以，正如之前讨论的，我们认为这个单位将带来一些需要实地测试的重要发展。如果一切按计划进行，我们很乐意邀请你加入我们的实地测试计划。请不时地向我们了解项目进度。”

candidates.source:
You and me, we better stick together to survive, right?  But that doesn't mean I'll tolerate infinite abuse.  Mistreat me too much, or especially fail to keep me fed, and I'll like you less and less.  If it gets bad enough, I'll mutiny - and if you have anyone else following you, I may convince some of them to join my mutiny and we'll form our own little band.
  Obviously, if I quit in a huff, there's going to be bad blood between us, and you're probably going to want to kill me for betrayal and I may need to kill you to get my fair share of the loot.  So keep me fed and satisfied so it doesn't come to that.
candidates.target:
你和我，我们最好团结在一起才能生存，对吧？但这并不意味着我会容忍无限的虐待。如果你虐待我太过分，或者尤其是在我饥饿时不给我食物，我会越来越不喜欢你。如果情况恶化，我会发动叛乱——如果你有其他人跟随你，我可能会说服他们加入我的叛乱，我们会形成自己的小团体。

显然，如果我气得离去，我们之间就会产生矛盾，你可能因为背叛而想杀了我，而我可能需要杀了你才能得到我应得的财物。所以，为了避免这种情况发生，请确保我有足够的食物和满足感。

candidates.source:
Use the Warp Obelisk to reach the surface and begin an expedition to a random place on the surface.  Find the exit marked on your map and get there in time with all the loot you can carry and to bring it back to the island!
Dying on expedition will return you home safely, but you will lose EVERYTHING you had with you.  Keep spare gear at home so you can quickly resupply!

The time limit is enforced by warp pulses, which hit you at regular intervals.  After 8 pulses, you suffer warpsickness, which rapidly reduces your stats with each pulse.  After 12 pulses, your body begins to disintegrate, taking damage until you die.  Get home safely to reset the pulses!

Certain upgrades can unlock new varieties of expeditions, or improve your survivability.
candidates.target:
使用扭曲方尖碑到达地表，开始前往地表随机地点的探险。找到地图上标记的出口，并及时到达那里，带上你能携带的所有战利品，并将它们带回岛屿！

在探险中死亡会安全地将你送回家中，但你会失去身边的全部物品。在家里备好备用装备，以便快速补充！

时间限制由扭曲脉冲强制执行，它们会定期击中你。经过8次脉冲后，你会患上扭曲病，你的属性会随着每次脉冲快速降低。经过12次脉冲后，你的身体开始分解，受到持续伤害，直到死亡。安全回家以重置脉冲！

某些升级可以解锁新的探险类型，或提高你的生存能力。

candidates.source: Huh, well, the short story is, I got my wife and kids out of town in the really, really early days.  She's got great intuition for stuff and when she told me to get ready to leave town, I figured at worst we'd have an unnecessary early spring vacation in my dad's old cabin, you know?  Obviously, turns out trusting her gut saved us all and then some.  Things were still tough, but from what I've heard, I might be the only person left on the Eastern Seaboard who still has his whole nuclear family.  Still got a lot of survivor's guilt for that… still lost everyone else.  Anyway, one thing led to another and we gathered a few other people that we watch out for.  My man Darius, he joined up early on and he and I do the scouting and scavenging and watch each others' backs.
candidates.target: 嗯，简单来说，在很早很早的时候，我就把妻子和孩子们带出了城。她对事情有很敏锐的直觉，当她告诉我准备离开城市时，我想，最坏的情况就是我们会有一个不必要的早春假期，去我爸爸老家的木屋，你知道的。显然，结果证明相信她的直觉救了我们一命。事情还是很艰难，但根据我所听到的，我可能是东海岸唯一一个还拥有完整核心家庭的人。为此我仍然感到很多幸存者的内疚...我还是失去了所有其他人。不管怎样，事情一步步发展，我们又聚集了一些我们互相照应的人。我朋友达里乌斯很早就加入了，他和我一起负责侦察和搜刮，互相保护。

candidates.source: I carried a spear.  Just a new recruit.  I wasn't even done with the basics, they actually called me out of boot camp to serve once the shit hit the fan.  I barely knew which end of the blunderbuss the bullets came out of, and they jammed me into a grass skirt and sent me out to 'assist in the evacuation efforts'.  Our orders barely made sense, our superiors were as confused as we were.

candidates.source: No, not The Enemy, but something like their wife (Rubik is trying to be funny).  If you go, you'll see.  It'll talk to you.  It knows what shape to take, or it just takes it, anyway.  For me, an old friend, in a Temple of ale I barely remember.  For others, other things.  But, if it starts talking to you in a familiar way?  It it offers you safety?  Leave, quick and quiet.  It's a lie.  Death by another name.

candidates.source: ADMINISTRATION PUSHES BACK ON "FUSION GAP".  Press Secretary Hyland pushed back on what she called "irresponsible speculation" about the United States falling behind China in energy technology, telling reporters that domestic research programs "remain the most advanced in the world" and that the administration sees "no cause for alarm."  She declined to address questions about the classified intelligence briefing requested by members of the Senate Armed Services Committee last week.
candidates.target: 行政部门对“融合差距”表示反对。新闻秘书海兰德对所谓的“不负责任的猜测”表示反对，即美国在能源技术上落后于中国，她告诉记者，国内研究项目“仍然是世界上最先进的”，并且行政部门“没有理由感到惊慌”。她拒绝回答关于上周参议院军事委员会成员要求的机密情报简报的问题。

candidates.source:
"It's always a different dream, but always kind of the same.  I stand in a hallway and knock on a door for a joke, but I can't turn and run when the doorknob starts turning.  I stand up mockingly in class while the teacher's back is turned, but can't seem to sit back down as they turn back to look at me.   I dive into the beautiful, clear ocean, but freeze in place just below the surface as something rises from below to meet me."

"Do you feel any guilt about the work you do here, Jason?"

"You know I'm not allowed to talk about any specifics."

"Of course, but I haven't asked what you're doing, I asked how you feel about it."

"I don't feel like we're doing anything wrong here.  On the contrary, I think leaving the work undone would be a thing to feel guilty about.  The untapped potential, the understanding we're building… it will change how we think of the world.  That has to be a good thing, right?"

"And yet, in your dreams you feel like a kid caught with their hands in the cookie jar."

"I'd rather we drop this line of discussion, Doctor."

"Naturally, Jason.  Or would "Chief Investigator" make you feel more in control?"
candidates.target:
“这总是不同的梦，但总有一种相似之处。我站在走廊里，敲门开玩笑，但当门把手开始转动时，我却无法转身跑开。我在课堂上嘲笑地站起来，当老师转过身时，我却似乎坐不下来，他们转过身来看着我。我跳入美丽清澈的海中，但在水面下刚一冻结，就有一种东西从下面升起与我相遇。”

“你对在这里做的工作有任何内疚感吗，杰森？”

“你知道我不能谈论任何具体内容。”

“当然，但我没有问你在做什么，我问的是你对它有什么感觉。”

“我不觉得我们在这里做任何错事。相反，我认为留下未完成的工作才应该感到内疚。未开发的潜力，我们正在建立理解...这将改变我们对世界的思考方式。这一定是好事，对吧？”

candidates.source: But like, I was a park ranger.  I wasn't exactly making six figures, and you know how bad rent was.  I couldn't buy a ton of canned food, but what I *could* do is can things myself.  Not in tin cans, but in jars; the old way.  So every paycheck, I'd use a little bit to buy one or two big glass jars, and on the weekends I'd spend a few hours filling them up with food and sealing them.  I started brushing up at the range too.  Proud gun owner, baby.
candidates.target: 但是，我以前是公园管理员。我并没有赚到六位数的收入，你也知道房租有多贵。我买不起大量的罐头食品，但我可以自己罐制食物。不是用铁罐，而是用玻璃罐；老一辈人的方式。所以每发工资，我会用一部分钱买一两个大玻璃罐，周末我会花几个小时把食物装进去并密封好。我也开始练习射击了。自豪的枪支拥有者，宝宝。

candidates.source: Well, I assume you know about the riots and the freakin' nightmare monsters walking the earth beside zombies, right?  If you're asking what I think caused it all, well, I dunno.  My best guess it was some huge overreach, maybe some kind of experimental weapon that got away.  They tried to lie so much at the start about everything that was going on, I don't think any of it measures up.  They were trying to cover something up.  As for the real end times, maybe the rest of the world tried to contain it.  I heard about all kinds of wild stuff.  To me that seems like somewhere else trying to get whatever is going on here contained.  Maybe it even worked.  It's bad now but it's not like it was.
candidates.target: 好吧，我想你知道关于骚乱和那些该死的噩梦般的怪物在地球上与僵尸一起游荡的事情，对吧？如果你问我认为所有这些是怎么引起的，嗯，我不知道。我最好的猜测是某种巨大的过度扩展，也许是一种某种实验性武器失控了。他们在开始时试图对发生的一切说谎，我认为任何解释都不合理。他们试图掩盖一些事情。至于真正的末日，也许世界其他地方试图遏制它。我听说了各种各样疯狂的事情。对我来说，这看起来像是其他地方试图控制这里发生的事情。也许他们甚至成功了。现在很糟糕，但它不再像从前那样。

In Hard difficulty, time limits are strict.
Warp pulses occur every 10 minutes.  This means warp sickness sets in after only 1 hour 20 minutes of being earthside, and disintegration at 2 hours.  You will have much less time to spare and must make getting to the exit your immediate priority.
candidates.target:
在困难模式下，时间限制非常严格。

你将有更少的时间可以浪费，必须立即优先考虑到达出口。

candidates.source: For now, the perimeter of the Refugee Center is free of threats.  That means we can afford to divert our attention to others in need of help.  However, our communication with the wasteland is lacking at best and nonexistent at worst.  We need to broaden our reach to intercept and send radio broadcasts.  Unfortunately Radio Towers are out of the question to widen our broadcasts, as the emergency grid for them is out of action.  However, Radio Stations in towns or urban areas should still have some juice left. candidates.source: I bought fruit and veggies from the store for my greens, but I figured those didn't really have enough calories for the long-term, so I hunted.  To be more accurate, I poached in the park I worked at.  It was never anything huge; I had to be able to conceal this stuff, remember.  But we were on a shoestring budget as it is and we never had the people we needed, so it was trivial to bag an animal using a rifle from one of the ranger stations.  I'd dress the carcass, then leave it in a place that I could either bring with me in my truck that day or come back later to sneak it out.  I never got caught.  I'm not proud of it, but I'm not really ashamed of it, either.  Besides, venison is great.
candidates.target: 我从商店买了水果和蔬菜作为我的绿色蔬菜，但我觉得这些热量长期来看不够，所以我去打猎。更准确地说，我在我工作的公园里偷猎。从来没有什么巨大的猎物；我必须能够隐藏这些东西，记住。我们本来就预算紧张，而且从来没有我们需要的人手，所以用公园管理员站里的步枪射杀动物很容易。我会处理动物的尸体，然后把它放在我当天可以带走的地方，或者稍后回来偷偷带走。我从来没有被抓过。我不为此自豪，但我也不感到特别羞愧。而且，鹿肉很好吃。

candidates.source: Yeah… the… the accident got him, but when I came to he was already coming back.  Thank god, right?  He was screeching and flapping around.  I thought he was just hurt at first, but he just kept coming at me while I tried to talk to him.  His arm was badly hurt already and instead of unbuckling himself he started… he was ripping it right off pulling against the giant chunk of burned meat on him.  That, and the crazy shit with the eyeball, was when I realized just how fucked up things had got.  I grabbed my hunting knife and ran, but my brother got out and started crawling after me.
candidates.target: 是啊……事故把他撞到了，但当我醒来时，他已经在爬起来了。感谢上帝，对吧？他尖叫着，扑腾着。我起初以为他只是受伤了，但当我试图和他说话时，他却一直向我冲过来。他的手臂已经受伤严重，但他没有解开安全带，反而开始……他挣扎着把手臂从烧焦的肉块中撕了下来。这还不算，他那疯狂的眼神让我意识到事情已经糟透了。我抓起猎刀就跑，但我哥哥却从车里爬出来，开始向我爬来。

candidates.source: Fair enough, you asked for it."  He stretches his arms out.  "Jack and I stayed close, even after my old man and I fell out, so when it looked like he was going to be saddled with the entire farm to run, I took a good long look at my life and realized I hated it.  It was never the farm I was trying to get away from, you know?  I packed up my things, quit my job, and came out to help Jack.  Never looked back."  He chuckles.  "Damn hard finding a partner for a guy like me out here though.  I was in a long-term relationship when I left, but that fell apart.  I haven't been too lonely though, I've got my people.
candidates.target: 公平点说，你要的就是这个。“他伸展着双臂。 ”杰克和我一直很亲近，即使在我和我老爹闹翻之后，所以当看起来他要独自承担整个农场的经营时，我好好地审视了一下自己的生活，意识到我恨透了它。你知道的，我试图逃离的从来不是农场。我收拾好行李，辞了职，来到这里帮助杰克。从没回头看过。”他咯咯地笑着。“不过，像我这样的家伙在这里找个伴可不容易。我离开时有个长期的伴侣，但那结束了。不过我并不太孤单，我有我的朋友们。

candidates.source: I was a paramedic."  She idly touches her forehead to brush aside a bit of hair, then notices it's already tucked back.  "I was there through some of the absolute worst of it, to this day I can't tell you how I made it out.  One thing led to another and I got pushed onto a bus to help take care of a couple people who needed assistance for travel.  Broken arms, that kinda stuff.  I got here early, I was one of the first to arrive.  Then, this woman in processing 'lost' my paperwork while I was busy helping a guy with a bad gash on his head.  If I hadn't made a stink about it, I'd probably be out in the lobby with those poor souls that couldn't get in at all.
candidates.target: 我以前是急救人员。“她随意地碰了碰额头，想把头发拨到耳后，然后发现头发已经整理好了。“我经历过最糟糕的一些情况，直到今天我都无法告诉你我是怎么逃出来的。事情一桩接一桩，我被推上了一辆巴士，去照顾需要旅行协助的几个人。断臂之类的伤。我来得很早，我是第一批到达的人。然后，在我忙着帮一个头上受了重创的男人时，处理事务的女士‘弄丢了’我的文件。如果我当时没有大吵大闹，我可能现在还在外面的大厅里，和那些可怜进不来的人们在一起。

candidates.source:
You're fuckin' right it's a proper setup, but damn, I could say the same about you!  Look at ya'!"  The Doc walks over to the spider-like surgical robot, and pats the soft, cushioned examination table.  He wipes his brow with his sleeve and gulps.  "Right.  Hop up here, and let's plug into your interface there, and see what we're working with.  I suspect we'll have to swap it out."  The Doc then starts to unclasp a set of wrist and ankle ties attached to the exam table.

"Hope this is alright.  We'll tie down your limbs.  Never worked on… well… someone like you, before.  Guess I haven't worked on that many people in any case.  No worries.  I can do it.  Just don't want you, uh, bugging out and hurting yourself, got it?
candidates.target:
你说得对，这是一个标准的设置，但该说你也一样！看看你！” 医生走到像蜘蛛一样的外科机器人旁边，拍了拍柔软的检查床。他用袖子擦了擦额头，吞了吞口水。

“对，上来吧，让我们连接到那里的接口，看看我们有什么。我怀疑我们可能需要更换它。” 医生开始解开检查床上附着的手腕和脚踝固定带。

“希望这样可以。我们会把你的四肢绑起来。我从来没有给……好吧，像你这样的人做过手术。我想我不管对多少人做过手术，都不会有太大差别。别担心。我可以做到。只是不想让你，嗯，惊慌失措，伤害到自己，明白了吗？”

candidates.source: I was at work trying to heal the sick, when it all went down.  It's a bit of a blur.  For a while there were weird rumors, stuff that sounded unbelievable about people getting back up after dying, but mostly things normal.  Then, towards the end, stuff just skyrocketed.  We thought it was some kind of attack, and that's what we were being told.  People coming in crazed, covered in wounds.  About halfway through my shift I… well, I broke.
candidates.target: 我在工作中试图治愈病人，当时一切都发生了。有点模糊。有一段时间，有奇怪的谣言，听起来不可思议的事情，关于人们死后来复生，但大部分事情都是正常的。然后，在最后，事情就急转直下。我们以为是某种攻击，这也是我们被告知的。人们疯狂地进来，身上满是伤口。在我的轮班时间过半时，我...嗯，我崩溃了。

candidates.target: 我当时正在工作，试图治疗病人，突然一切都崩溃了。有点模糊不清。一开始有些奇怪的传闻，听起来难以置信，关于人们死后又复活的事情，但大部分都是正常的。然后，到了最后，情况突然爆发。我们以为这是某种袭击，而且我们也被告知是这样。人们疯狂地涌入，浑身是伤。在我上班的一半时间，我…嗯，我崩溃了。

candidates.source:
Where did you… I- I don't know what to say."  Jay takes the rifle reverently.  "What did they do to this thing?  The receiver's all chopped up!"  He turns it over so carefully that you could mistake him for holding a child instead of a gun.  "This thing was beautiful.  Modern rails, ergonomic furniture, recoil balancing system… At least it's all still here.  I know Cody thinks that she did something wrong, but all I remember is being so angry… just blindingly furious.  Then I was running.  When I woke up, everything was fine."

"Thank you for letting me see this, and for getting Cody and I talking.  If you could help me out with something for Cody, I'll make this rifle right, and hook you up with a casket mag and a box of the good ammo for it.  Stuff from my reserves.
candidates.target:
“你……我……我不知道该说什么。” 杰伊恭敬地拿起步枪。“他们把这玩意儿弄成了什么样子？机匣都给弄坏了！”他拿着枪的方式如此小心，以至于你几乎会以为他抱着的是一个孩子，而不是步枪。“这把枪原本很漂亮，现代化的导轨、人体工程学枪托、后座力平衡系统……至少这些都还在。我知道科迪以为自己做错了什么，但我只记得当时非常生气……愤怒到什么都看不清。然后我就开始跑，醒来时一切都结束了。”

“谢谢你让我看了这把枪，也谢谢你让我和科迪沟通。如果你能帮我做一件事，我会把这把枪修好，还给你一个大容量弹匣和一盒好子弹，是我储备的。”

candidates.source: EDITORIAL: THE RISE OF THE RIGHT HAS BROUGHT US HERE.  As the wounded white male ego becomes more and more of a self-stereotype, we see the cost of allowing right-wing sentiment echoed all around us.  Through closet capitulation to the demands of the most extremist right-wing groups, President Oswald has made policies that allow foreign drugs to run rampant through our nation.  Hiding under the guise of generally increased crime rates, conservative extremists have taken over our cities, stalking the streets at night and enacting vicious vigilante-style beatings on anyone they deem different.
candidates.target: 社论：右翼的崛起将我们带到了这里。随着受伤的白种男性自我认同越来越强烈，我们看到了允许右翼情绪蔓延的代价在我们周围回响。通过暗中屈服于最极端右翼团体的要求，奥斯瓦尔德总统制定了政策，允许外国毒品在我们的国家肆意泛滥。在总体犯罪率上升的掩护下，保守派极端分子占领了我们的城市，在夜间游荡街头，对他们认为与众不同的人实施残暴的私刑式殴打。

candidates.source: We managed to convince them Melchior is smarter than it really is, which will at least get them off our backs for a while.  How did we do it, you ask?  We cut down the number of dimensions scanned per second, which drops its accuracy by a few orders of magnitude, but the power savings let us scan a wider time range.  That counts for about ten percent.  The other ninety percent was getting Davids to shell out for a much sexier sounding voice synth package.
candidates.target: 我们设法让他们相信梅西洛尔比实际聪明，这至少可以让他们一段时间不来烦我们。你问我们是怎么做到的？我们减少了每秒扫描的维度数量，这降低了它的准确性几个数量级，但电量节省让我们可以扫描更广泛的时间范围。这占了大约百分之十。另外百分之九十是让戴维们为一个听起来更性感的声音合成包掏钱。

candidates.source: You dream of slowly, patiently, plodding through the world to go from goal to goal, unrushed and unworried, for you are far too large and tough to kill for anyone or anything to bother trying to attack.  And if they do… it'll be the last mistake of their life.  Waking up gives you a brief jolt of fear and dysphoria, for your body feels so weak and fragile and incorrect compared to the powerful thing you know you are.
candidates.target: 你梦想着慢慢地、耐心地、一步步地走过世界，从一个目标走向另一个目标，不急不躁，不担心，因为你太大、太坚韧了，没有人或没有什么东西会想去攻击你。如果有人或有什么东西真的这么做……那将是他们生命中的最后一个错误。醒来时，你会感到一阵恐惧和不适，因为你的身体感觉如此虚弱、脆弱，与你知道的强大的自我相比是错误的。

candidates.source: I was at work at the hospital, when it all went down.  It's a bit of a blur.  For a while there were weird reports, stuff that sounded unbelievable about patients getting back up after dying, but mostly things were business as usual.  Then, towards the end, stuff just skyrocketed.  We thought it was a Chinese attack, and that's what we were being told.  People coming in crazed, covered in wounds from bullets and bites.  About halfway through my shift I… well, I broke.
candidates.target: 我在医院工作的时候，一切都发生了。那段时间有点模糊。有一段时间，有奇怪的报道，听起来不可思议的关于病人死后来复生的事情，但大部分时间都是正常的工作。然后，在最后，一切都失控了。我们以为那是中国的攻击，这也是我们被告知的。人们疯狂地跑进来，身上布满了枪伤和咬伤。在我轮班的途中，我...嗯，我崩溃了。

candidates.source: It doesn't feel that way, but I guess so.  I don't know if I ever told you, but my dad was quite the weirdo prepper.  He built the cabin and when I was a kid we'd head out and do drills for the end of the world.  It's part of why I was kinda whacked out on apocalypse stuff when you and I first met, back when we made the plan for where to meet up and all.  He taught me archery and some survival skills but I never really took to it, partly because my ol' man was a real piece of work."  He stares off for a minute.  "To be honest, though, now that we're in the middle of a real-ass apocalypse, I can see a lot of what he taught me was just crap anyway.
candidates.target: 感觉不是这样的，但我猜是吧。我不记得我有没有告诉过你，我爸爸是个相当古怪的准备者。他建造了那间小屋，当我还是个孩子的时候，我们会出去进行世界末日演练。这就是为什么当你和我第一次见面时，我对末日之类的事情有点着迷，当时我们制定了见面计划。他教我射箭和一些生存技能，但我从来没有真正掌握，部分原因是我老爸真是个难搞的人。他停顿了一下。“说实话，现在我们身处真正的末日危机中，我发现他教给我的很多东西其实都是废话。”

candidates.source:
If you call me by radio, you can tell me to come to you.  If you've got some basecamps set up, you can tell me to go to one of them.  I'll start walking, and when I get to where I'm going, I'll guard it.
  Now depending on where I am and where I'm going, it may take me a while to get there.  I'll dodge any dangers on the way, don't worry about that, but if you're way the heck away from me and tell me to come, it may be a while until I get to you.
  I'll move faster if I'm horseback.
candidates.target:
如果你用无线电呼叫我，你可以让我到你那里去。如果你已经建立了几个基地，你可以让我去其中之一。我会开始行走，当我到达目的地时，我会守卫那里。

根据我所在的位置和目的地，我可能需要一些时间才能到达。我会避开路上的危险，不用担心那方面，但如果你离我很远很远，让我过去，我可能需要一段时间才能到达你那里。

如果我骑马，我会移动得更快。

candidates.source: Ah yes, the extradimensional fungal dispersed intelligence known as the Mycus.  Quite a menace to interdimensional travelers, I tell you.  Some see them as a god.  Some see them as an existential threat.  And yet others see them as a good source of plant fibers.  Their cellular structure makes them highly adaptive to a wide variety of levels of reality, much like other fungal lifeforms.  Should you find yourself infected and without antifungal medicine, you can try rubbing sulphur on your skin.  It might not work, and it might irritate your skin, but anything is preferable to letting it run its course.  Should medication fail, don't bother with a bullet through your head.  It won't save you from your impending fate.  Instead, use fire, that's my advice.  Now then, the Mycus have a few different manifestations.  Which one are you interested in?
candidates.target: 啊是的，被称为“Mycus”的超维度真菌分散型智能体。我告诉你，它们对跨维度旅行者来说是一种相当大的威胁。有些人把它们当成神灵，有些人把它们视为存在性的威胁，还有些人则把它们视为一种良好的植物纤维来源。它们的细胞结构使它们能够高度适应各种现实层次，就像其他真菌生命体一样。如果你被感染了却没有抗真菌药物，可以试着在皮肤上涂抹硫磺。它可能不起作用，也可能刺激皮肤，但这比让感染发展下去好。如果药物无效，别想着用子弹射穿头部。那不会拯救你免于即将到来的命运。相反，用火，这是我的建议。那么，Mycus有几种不同的表现形式，你对哪一种感兴趣？

candidates.source: &The cameraperson sighs.  The view slowly zooms out for a few seconds, but then suddenly jerks to the left.  "Ay… hey, look at these motherfuckers!"  The camera zooms in on two teenagers next to a car in the parking lot.  They're both laughing and shouting very loudly, almost seemingly intoxicated…  One kid takes a step back, then kicks in the taillight of the car.  The other appears from around the other side of it, dragging their keys along it, scratching up the paint.  The boy who was kicking begins violently punching the window with his bare fist.  The cameraperson lets out an astonished gasp, "Like New York…"  One punch, two punch, and with a third smash his arm goes through the glass!  He stares at the other teenager and they both let out a burst of laughter that lasts a little too long.  The cameraperson mutters a concerned "Uhhh…" and sets the camera on the seat.  The recording abruptly ends.
candidates.target: 摄影师叹了口气。镜头缓缓地推远了几秒，然后突然向左猛地一晃。"哎……嘿，看看这些混蛋！" 镜头放大，聚焦在停车场里两旁的一辆车旁边的两个青少年。他们都在大笑和大声喊叫，几乎看起来像喝醉了一样……一个孩子退了一步，然后踢了车尾灯一脚。另一个从车的另一边出现，用钥匙在车上划来划去，划伤了油漆。踢车的人开始用赤裸的拳头猛敲车窗。摄影师惊讶地"啊"了一声，"像纽约……"一拳，两拳，第三拳下去，他的手臂打破了玻璃！他看着另一个青少年，他们都发出了一阵持续得有点太长的笑声。摄影师担忧地嘟囔着"哎……"把相机放在座位上。录像突然结束了。

candidates.source: Honestly my friend, this is the kinda stuff I hoped we'd be doing when we offered to help these guys out.  Fresh air, great views, climbing on things we'd have gotten in trouble for in the old days, maybe pushing a zombie off the edge of a maintenance platform to see how big a splat it leaves at the bottom.  Sounds wicked.  Let's bring a couple cold ones up to the top and crack a brew while we survey the wasteland, hey?
candidates.target: 老兄，说实话，这正是我们当初愿意帮助这些家伙的原因。新鲜空气、美景、攀爬那些我们在过去会因爬上而惹上麻烦的东西，甚至推一个僵尸从维护平台的边缘掉下来，看看它掉到底部会溅起多大的水花。听起来很刺激。我们带几瓶冰镇啤酒到顶端，边喝边观察这片废墟，好吗？

We can take a bit, but too much… one time, I felt a bit of that, and I'm not in any rush to try it again.

candidates.source: You're asking me what I think caused all this?  It was all over the news.  Some kind of Chinese bio-weapon.  It's no different from the pandemic a few years back, but this time they got the formula right.  Maybe too right.  Doesn't matter anyway, I hear it got out on them and wiped them out too.  Serves em right.
candidates.target: 你问我认为这是什么原因造成的？这可是在新闻上都报道过的。某种中国生物武器。和几年前的大流行病没什么两样，但这次他们得到了正确的配方。也许太正确了。不管怎样，我听说它已经失控，也把他们自己消灭了。活该。

candidates.source: "Dear Diary, I was at the park today with Percy.  Danny always told me that she was very sad when her dog died, so I broke Percy's neck because I wanted to see how I'd feel.  I think I was sad for a little, but I kept playing with him but I had to stop after too many pieces fell off and Percy became gross.  I buried him in the park so mom and dad wouldn't find out, but Mr. Luca and Mrs Annaliese saw me.  I'm scared they'll tell on me.  Daddy thinks I don't know where he keeps the keys to his gun safe."

candidates.source: NEW STREET DRUG: There is a new drug flooding New England.  DEA Agent Walter Grayfield made the following comment "It appears to be produced locally somewhere in New England probably in a lab in Boston."  The drug called 'faewild' causes extreme hyperfocus with a resultant loss of manual dexterity and slowed movements.

candidates.source: Yeah… the… the accident got him, but when I came to he was already coming back.  Thank god for seatbelts, right?  He was screeching and flapping around, hanging upside down.  I thought he was just hurt at first, but he just kept coming at me while I tried to talk to him.  His arm was badly hurt already and instead of unbuckling himself he started… he was ripping it right off pulling against the seatbelt.  That, and the crazy shit with the chopper, was when I realized just how fucked up things had got.  I grabbed my hunting knife and ran, but my brother got out and started crawling after me.
candidates.target: 是啊……事故把他撞了，但当我醒来时，他已经在回来了。多亏有安全带，是吧？他尖叫着，在车里乱撞，挂在安全带上倒挂着。我起初以为他只是受伤了，但当我试图和他说话时，他却一直向我冲过来。他的手臂已经受伤了，但他却没有解开安全带，反而开始……他用力拉扯，把手臂从安全带上撕了下来。这还不算，直升机那一幕也让我意识到事情已经糟透了。我抓起猎刀就跑，但我哥哥却从车里爬出来，开始向我爬来。

candidates.source: Oh, we did have a President, Mx. Rose.  As things were starting to get bad they locked themself into the administrative building with all of the senior staff.  It's a good thing too because that building is full of the dead now, just like the rest except the library here.  For now everyone is still trying to operate under the old library structure, so I guess I'm in charge now as the most senior library staff left, though we have some survivors here from the other buildings from other divisions.  Callista Rupp from Academics is here, she taught physics.  I think she was at MIT for a while.  And Jack Springer from Facilities is here too, he's probably the only really practical person here, very handy!  It was his idea to board up the other buildings.
candidates.target: 哦，我们以前有个校长，叫罗斯先生/女士。当事情开始变得糟糕时，他们和所有高级职员一起把自己锁在了行政楼里。这件事很好，因为现在那栋楼里全是死者，和其他地方一样，除了这里的图书馆。目前，每个人都在尝试按照旧的图书馆结构运作，所以我想我现在是负责的人了，因为我是剩下的最高级的图书馆职员，尽管我们这里还有其他部门的幸存者。学术部的卡丽斯塔·鲁普也在这里，她教物理。我想她以前在麻省理工学院待过一段时间。设施部的杰克·斯普林纳也在这里，他可能是这里唯一真正有实际能力的人，非常有用！是他提出把其他建筑封起来的。

candidates.source: The photo depicts a serene and well-maintained terrace basked in warm, clear weather.  The central part of the picture is an intriguing sight, where a section of the terrace and a portion of the building behind it appear to have been cleanly removed, as if erased from reality.  To the side, there is a shattered flower pot, spilling out its soil and a plant with long, broad leaves, some of which have also been cut away in a sharp, clean fashion, almost as if sliced with a knife.
candidates.target: 照片描绘了一个宁静、保养良好的露台，沐浴在温暖、晴朗的天气中。 画面中心是一个引人入胜的景象，露台的一小部分和身后建筑的一部分似乎被干净利落地移除，仿佛从现实中抹去了。 旁边有一个破碎的花盆，土壤和长而宽的叶子植物从中倾洒出来，其中一些叶子也被锋利、干净地切掉，几乎像是用刀片切开的一样。

candidates.source: If only, huh?  No, not quite.  About five miles away I hit a bad pothole and skidded off the road and got stuck.  That's not a problem on its own, but a few minutes into trying to get it unstuck, I saw a big furrow of dirt coming towards me and decided, you know what, maybe I should get off the side of the road.  So I grab my bugout bag from the cabin and a little food from the bed, and I book it onto the road.  Now, I don't know what this thing was, but it hit the truck from below and *flipped it over*.  That was enough to make me say 'Nope, I can go on foot.'
candidates.target: 如果只有这样就好了？不，情况并不完全如此。在离我大约五英里的地方，我遇到了一个很大的坑，车子打滑偏离了道路并陷入了泥泞中。这本身并不算什么问题，但在我尝试让车脱困几分钟后，我看到一条大土沟向我靠近，于是我想，你知道吗，也许我应该离开路边。于是我从车内拿起我的应急包和一些食物，然后迅速跑到路边。现在，我不知道这是什么东西，但它从下面撞上了我的卡车并把它*翻了个底朝天*。这让我决定“不，我可以步行。”

candidates.source: A young mother.  I know she was a mother, because I delivered her baby.  Sweet girl, she… she had a good sense of humor.  She came in, spitting that black goo, fighting the orderlies, dead from a bullet wound through the chest.  That's when I… I don't know if I woke up, finally, or if I finally went crazy.  Either way, I broke.  I broke a lot earlier than my colleagues, and that's the only reason I lived.  I skipped out, went to a dead corner of the hospital I used to hide in when I was a resident.  An old stairwell leading to a closed-off unit the maintenance staff were using to store old equipment.  I hid there for hours, while I listened to the world crumbling outside and inside.
candidates.target: 一位年轻的母亲。我知道她是母亲，因为我接生了她的孩子。甜美的女孩，她……她有很好的幽默感。她走进来，吐着黑色的粘液，与护工们搏斗，胸部中弹身亡。那时我……我不知道我是终于醒了，还是终于疯了。无论如何，我崩溃了。我比我的同事们早得多崩溃，这才是我活下来的唯一原因。我溜了出来，去了医院的一个死角，那是我当住院医生时藏身的地方。一个通往维护人员用来存放旧设备的封闭病区的老旧楼梯井。我躲在那里几个小时，听着外面和里面世界崩塌的声音。

candidates.source: The Lampetia Method of compliance training has been a resounding success, with science staffs of the participating facilities consistently scoring lower on the Berms Risk-Aversion Scale as well as the Carlson Empathy test sequence.  Interestingly, the most significant difference was shown in the facilities working on cadaver studies (according to our Security liaison, this being a triple-blinded study).  Prior score had little correlation to the scores recorded after intervention, however in three examined facilities there were instances of a particularly well-responding individual exponentially enhancing the Method's effect on close acquaintances.  Recruitment of these individuals into furthering the training's development is pending Administration approval.
candidates.target: Lampetia 方法的合规性培训取得了巨大成功，参与机构的科学人员在Berms 风险规避量表和Carlson 同理心测试序列上持续得分较低。有趣的是，在进行尸体研究的机构中表现出最显著的差异（根据我们的安全联络人，这是一个三盲研究）。之前的得分与干预后记录的分数几乎没有相关性，然而，在三个接受检查的机构中，有个别反应特别好的个体显著增强了该方法对亲近者的影响。招募这些个体以进一步发展培训有待管理层批准。

candidates.source:
When the portal storms started, the government issued an evacuation order for critical personnel and sent convoys to retrieve them, with our head of AI research among the recalled.  We recently discovered that he died when the convoy transferring him was ambushed in the initial chaos, but his corpse and belongings might remain intact enough to benefit from his research."

"We want you to travel to the convoy and locate the body, if possible.  His evacuation protocol included retrieving and storing as much of the data from his facility as possible, to be stored in a code-locked hard case.  If this hard case is present, retrieve it, and bring it back here."

"We offer the standard hazard pay of 4 HGC for this contract.
candidates.target:
当传送门风暴开始时，政府为关键人员发出撤离命令，并派遣车队接应他们，我们的AI研究主管也在被召回的人员之列。我们最近发现，他在转移他的车队在最初的混乱中遭到伏击时死亡，但他的尸体和个人物品可能完好无损，可以从他的研究中受益。

“我们希望你前往车队，尽可能找到他的尸体。他的撤离协议包括获取和存储他设施尽可能多的数据，并将其存放在一个密码锁定的硬壳箱中。如果这个硬壳箱在场，请将其取回并带回这里。”

“我们为这个合同提供标准的危险津贴，即4个HGC。

"We want you to travel to the convoy and locate the body, if possible.  His evacuation protocol included retrieving and storing as much of the data from his facility as possible, to be stored in a code-locked hard case.  If this hard case is present, retrieve it, and bring it back here."
