candidates.source: He lived desperately in the Cataclysm for a few years before meeting a female survivor while digging through a dumpster.  Both were wary of one another and were soon at each other's throats.  Neither side secured a victory.  Wounded and scarred, they each went to their respective hideouts.  Not long after, they met again.  The woman initiated a conversation with him, asking for his help.  It was foolish to fight when they could work together instead.  He acquiesced.  In this cruel and forlorn world, they soon fell in love.  If they had each other, everything would be all right.  Decades passed and they grew old holding hands.  One day, the wife fell ill, and with her dying breath, she said she was happy all these years with him.  Stay strong without me.  The husband wept and laid down beside his wife.  Without you, nothing else matters.  He swallowed a bitter poison and departed this world to find his wife who was waiting for him.
candidates.target: 他在浩劫中绝望地生活了几年，直到在一个垃圾桶里挖掘时遇到了一个女性幸存者。他们彼此警惕，很快就争吵起来。双方都没有取得胜利。受伤并留下伤疤后，他们各自回到了自己的藏身处。不久之后，他们再次相遇。那位女性主动与他交谈，请求他的帮助。他们本可以合作而不是战斗，这样做是愚蠢的。他同意了。在这个残酷而凄凉的世界里，他们很快坠入爱河。只要有彼此，一切都会好起来的。几十年过去了，他们手牵手变老。一天，妻子病了，在临终时，她说这些年里她和他一起很幸福。没有我也要坚强。丈夫哭了，躺在妻子身边。没有你，其他都无所谓。他吞下了一剂苦毒，离开了这个世界，去寻找等待他的妻子。

In this cruel and forlorn world, they soon fell in love.  If they had each other, everything would be all right.  Decades passed and they grew old holding hands.  One day, the wife fell ill, and with her dying breath, she said she was happy all these years with him.  Stay strong without me.  The husband wept and laid down beside his wife.  Without you, nothing else matters.  He swallowed a bitter poison and departed this world to find his wife who was waiting for him.

candidates.source: Not really.  Government fed us all kinds of conflicting stories, and there was some absolutely heinous stuff going on.  I mean, you can't have missed that video of the woman killing her own baby, right?  God, that still gives me nightmares.  I don't know what it was about it, something about the look on her face.  Worse stuff came out of course, and now we've both seen worse things with our own eyes, but that one still comes back to haunt me.  Anyway, they never could control the riots, and by the time the rioters started turning into undead it was way too late.  I don't know if morale just broke or what but I heard rumors the military and police started turning on each other as much as the crowds.  What actually made the dead come back to life though?  I haven't got a clue.
candidates.target: 不，政府给我们喂了各种互相矛盾的故事，当时有些极其可怕的事情正在发生。我的意思是，你肯定没错过那个女人杀死自己孩子的视频，对吧？天啊，那至今仍让我噩梦连连。我不知道是什么让我那么害怕，可能是她脸上的表情。当然，更糟糕的事情后来也曝光了，现在我们亲眼见过更可怕的场景，但那个视频仍然让我心有余悸。总之，他们永远无法控制骚乱，等到骚乱者开始变成活死人时，已经太晚了。我不知道是士气低落还是什么原因，但我听说军队和警察也开始互相攻击，就像对付人群一样。不过，到底是什么让死人复活的呢？我完全不知道。

If new to the game, meta progression will help you be introduced to mechanics at a reasonable pace.

candidates.source: At some point, I felt like I was waking up.  It was around the time they were busting out those big groups of guys spears.  Says something about my frame of mind that I don't even remember if I'd seen them before that point.  Anyway I heard the shouting and just kinda realized I was on the edges of a mob charging a line of spear tips pointed at us.  That's when I started seeing the mob for what it was, seeing the wild-eyed animals, even the zombies.  I turned and ran.
candidates.target: 在某个时刻，我感觉自己好像醒了过来。那大约是在他们冲出来那些大群持矛男子的时候。这说明了我当时的精神状态，以至于我甚至不记得在那之前是否见过他们。不管怎样，我听到了喊叫声，然后意识到自己正处于一个暴徒群中，他们正向我们冲来，手中的矛尖直指我们。那时我才开始意识到这个暴徒群的本质，看到那些眼神狂热的动物，甚至是僵尸。我转身就跑。

candidates.source: Yes, it's done.  Don't waste time thinking about what's different.  You're still there, just inside a tough steel case.  It won't be easy to adapt, but keep a stiff upper lip - or be brave - as you might say.  Try to keep everything intact, but if you get any damage, come back here.  Venn'll do repairs in exchange for materials.
candidates.target: 是的，已经完成了。别浪费时间去想有什么不同。你还在，只是被困在一个坚硬的钢壳里。适应起来不会容易，但要坚强一点，或者说，勇敢一点。试着保持一切完好，但如果你受到了任何损坏，就回来这里。Venn会用材料来修理。

candidates.source: I was at school.  I'm a senior.  We'd heard about riots… it started with a kid showing videos of one of the big riots in Providence.  You've probably seen it, the one where the woman turns to the camera and you can see her whole lower lip has been ripped off, and is just flapping there?  It got so bad, they went over the PA system to tell us about Chinese drugs in the water supply.  Right… does anyone buy that explanation?
candidates.target: 我在学校。我是个高年级学生。我们听说过骚乱……从一个孩子展示视频开始，是关于普罗维登斯的一次大骚乱。你可能见过，那个女人转向摄像头，你可以看到她的整个下唇被撕裂，只剩下个皮翻着？情况变得很糟，他们通过公共广播系统告诉我们水供应里有中国毒品。对……有人相信这个解释吗？

candidates.source: Facilities security has been scrambling to hold onto their security contractors due to the massive uptick in fatalities; a decision was made to procure a number of semi-autonomous turrets and to increase safety.  Few of us are comfortable working with a gun over our shoulders being run electronically by a glorified mall cop, but we're assured it's safer for all of us.  We'll get Melchior to assist with AI threat recognition, which will make everyone a little more comfortable I think.
candidates.target: 由于死亡人数急剧增加，设施安保部门正努力留住他们的安保承包商；决定采购一批半自主炮塔并加强安全措施。我们中很少有人愿意在肩上扛着由一个被美化的商场保安电子操作的枪工作，但我们被告知这对我们所有人来说更安全。我们将让梅兰西奥协助进行人工智能威胁识别，我认为这会让每个人都更舒服一些。

candidates.source: I was in the army.  Just a new recruit.  I wasn't even done basic training, they actually called me out of boot camp to serve once the shit hit the fan.  I barely knew which end of the gun the bullets came out of, and they jammed me into a truck and drove me to Newport to 'assist in the evacuation efforts'.  Our orders barely made sense, our officers were as confused as we were.
candidates.target: 我曾经在军队里。只是一个新兵。我甚至还没完成基础训练，当事情变得糟糕时，他们直接从新兵营里把我叫出来执行任务。我连枪的子弹从哪端出来都分不清，他们把我塞进一辆卡车，开往纽波特“协助撤离工作”。我们的命令几乎无法理解，我们的军官和我们一样困惑。

candidates.source:
ENTRY 47:
Our normal mining routine has unearthed a hollow chamber.  This would not be out of the ordinary, save for the odd, perfectly vertical faultline found.  This faultline has several odd concavities in it which have the more superstitious crew members alarmed; they seem to be of human origin.
ENTRY 48:
The concavities are between 10 and 20 feet tall, and run the length of the faultline.  Each one is vaguely human in shape, but with the proportions of the limbs, neck and head greatly distended, all twisted and curled in on themselves.
candidates.target:
条目 47：
我们的常规采矿作业发现了一个空心室。如果不是发现了那条奇怪的、完全垂直的断层，这本不算什么异常。这条断层上有几个奇怪的凹陷，让一些迷信的船员感到不安；这些凹陷似乎是人工刻成的。
条目 48：
这些凹陷高约 10 到 20 英尺，沿着断层延伸。每个凹陷都模糊地呈现出人类形状，但肢体、颈部和头部的比例被严重扭曲和伸长，卷曲成一团。

candidates.source:
ENTRY 47:
Our normal mining routine has unearthed a hollow chamber.  This would not be out of the ordinary, save for the odd, perfectly vertical faultline found.  This faultline has several odd concavities in it which have the more superstitious crew members alarmed; they seem to be of human origin.
ENTRY 48:
The concavities are between 10 and 20 feet tall, and run the length of the faultline.  Each one is vaguely human in shape, but with the proportions of the limbs, neck and head greatly distended, all twisted and curled in on themselves.
candidates.target:
记录 47：
我们正常的采矿例行工作发现了一个空腔。这本身并不罕见，但令人奇怪的是，发现了一条笔直的断层线。这条断层线上有几个奇怪的凹陷，这让一些迷信的船员感到不安；它们似乎是人造的。

记录 48：
这些凹陷高约 3 到 6 米，沿着断层线的长度延伸。每一个都大致呈现人形，但四肢、颈部和头部比例都极度夸张，全都扭曲并卷曲在自身之上。

条目47：
我们在日常采掘作业中发现了一个规模庞大的石窟。这本来并不奇怪，奇怪的是，我们在石窟尽头发现了一完全垂直的断壁。断面上有很多怪异的凹坑，让那些迷信的矿工惊惧异常；它们看上去像是人造的。

candidates.source: It is a 3D-printed pack frame, much like those used to move equipment for more… traditional field work.  We've designed an ergonomic frame to accommodate your HEW unit, a small tent, a rollmat, as well as waterproof compartments for essential electronics: one UPS, one folding solar panel, and one standard laptop.  It is cumbersome, and you won't be able to store anything in it other than the specific equipment, but it is lightweight and efficient.  We will provide only frame and some solar panels for field charging your HEW unit.

candidates.source: It was terrifying.  We were shipped there on a repurposed school bus, about thirty of us.  You can probably see the issues right away.  A few of the folks on board the bus had injuries, and some schmuck who had seen too many B-movies tried to insist that anyone who 'had been bitten' was going to 'turn'.  Fucking idiot, right?  I've been bitten a dozen times now and the worst I got was a gross infection.
candidates.target: 那是令人恐惧的。我们大约三十个人被塞进了一辆改造成救护车的旧校车。你可能立刻能想到问题在哪里。车上几个人有伤，一个看过太多B级片的傻瓜坚持认为任何被“咬到”的人都会“变”。真是个蠢货，对吧？我现在已经被咬过十几次了，最严重的一次就是感染了。

candidates.source: I did.  Took a few hours to get an opening.  And you wanna know the fucked up part?  Like, out of all this?  My husband was still alive.  He'd been in the basement the whole time, pinned under a collapsed piece of floor.  And he'd lost a ton of blood, he was delirious by the time I found him.  I couldn't get him out, so I gave him food and water and just stayed with him and held his hand until he passed.  And then… well, then I did what you have to do to the dead now.  And then I packed up the last few fragments of my life, and I try to never look back.
candidates.target: 我做到了。花了几个小时才找到一个出口。你想知道最糟糕的部分吗？在所有这些中，我丈夫还活着。他一直被困在地下室，被倒塌的地板压住。他失血过多，当我找到他时，他已经神志不清了。我无法把他救出来，所以我给他食物和水，只是陪在他身边，握着他的手，直到他去世。然后……然后我做了现在必须对死者做的事情。然后我收拾了我生活中剩下的最后一点碎片，并尽量不回头看。

candidates.source: Contrary to popular belief, goblins are not actually orcs.  Its the other way around.  Orcs are goblins who have taken one too many unlabeled potions and lived to tell the tale.  Sometimes this awakens powers much like my own.  Well, not exactly, if it did I'd be out of a job faster than a Magus could cast Phase Door.  Luckily for you, you shouldn't have to delve too deep into a forest to see for yourself.  I'll mark one of their outposts on your map for one denarius.
candidates.target: 与人们的普遍认知不同，半兽人其实不是哥布林。反过来，哥布林才是半兽人。那些喝了太多未标标签的药水却还活下来并讲述故事的半兽人，有时会觉醒出与我相似的能力。当然，不完全一样，要是这样的话，我早就失业了，比魔法师施展瞬间传送术还快。幸运的是，你不需要深入森林太深的地方，就能亲眼见到他们。我可以在你的地图上标注一个他们的据点，只要一枚金币。

candidates.source: You're kitted out better than most… would you be interested in making this world a little better for the rest of us?  The towns have enough supplies for us survivors to start securing a foothold but we don't have anyone with the skills and equipment to thin the masses of undead.  I'll lend you a hand to the best of my ability but you really showed promise taking out that other beast.  You, I, and a 100 zombies laid to rest, what do you say?
candidates.target: 你装备比大多数人要好... 你愿意帮我们让这个世界变得更好吗？城镇里有足够的物资让我们这些幸存者开始站稳脚跟，但我们没有人有技能和装备来减少大量僵尸。我会尽我所能帮助你，但你真的很有潜力，之前就把那个怪物干掉了。你、我，还有100个僵尸被消灭，你说怎么样？

I'll lend you a hand to the best of my ability but you really showed promise taking out that other beast.  You, I, and a 100 zombies laid to rest, what do you say?
candidates.target: 你装备比大多数人都好……有没有兴趣为我们这些幸存者改善一下这个世界？城镇里有足够的物资让我们开始站稳脚跟，但我们没有拥有技能和装备来消灭大量不死生物的人。我会尽我所能帮助你，但你刚才消灭那个怪物时表现出了很大的潜力。你、我，还有一百只被消灭的僵尸，你意下如何？

candidates.source: Renounced the adventurous lifestyle after your death and chose to start a family with a fellow survivor in an abandoned hunting cabin.  Survival was grim but the family grew through the years until she had three sons and a daughter.  Her end came when the horrors finally located her homestead… she and her husband were able to distract the monster as her children escaped.
candidates.target: 在你死后，放弃了冒险的生活方式，选择与一个幸存的同伴在一个废弃的狩猎小屋里开始家庭生活。生存条件艰苦，但多年来家庭逐渐壮大，直到她有了三个儿子和一个女儿。当那些恐怖的生物最终找到她的家时，她的生命走到了尽头……她和她的丈夫设法转移了怪物的注意力，让他们的孩子们得以逃脱。

candidates.source: I gotta be honest with you, I heard a lot of stories back at the shelter, and only one of them really stuck.  This is some kind of science experiment gone wrong.  I don't know what caused the riots and the undead in the first place, but there's no way it's this out of control everywhere.  Yeah, I got the same 'the government has fallen' text as everyone, but it doesn't make *sense* that it could be so widespread so fast.  I think we're in some sort of exclusion zone, where they're letting whatever is going on run its course to see how it works so they can fight it better next time.  Somewhere out there, outside the zone, it's more or less business as usual.
candidates.target: 我得对你老实说，我在避难所里听过很多故事，只有一个真正让我信服。这是一场科学实验出错了。我不知道最初是什么原因引发了骚乱和僵尸，但它不可能在各地都失控到这种地步。是的，我也收到了和大家一样的“政府已经倒台”的短信，但它传播得如此迅速且范围如此广泛，这实在不合情理。我认为我们处于某种隔离区，他们让这里的情况继续恶化，是为了观察它如何发展，以便下次更好地应对。在某个地方，在隔离区之外，一切都还基本正常。

candidates.source: Besides the acid rain, I mostly saw people fleeing for safety.  I didn't want to get lost in the woods, so I stuck to the deep margins where I could keep an eye out without getting involved.  I saw tons of evacuees.  Plenty went right on, but a lot got hurt and had to stop.  Stopping was a death sentence, because these giant ants were coming along behind picking off the survivors.
candidates.target: 除了酸雨，我看到大部分人都在逃离以求安全。我不想在森林里迷路，所以我待在深边上，可以观察而不必参与其中。我看到了许多撤离的人。许多人继续前进，但很多人受伤了，不得不停下来。停下来就意味着死刑，因为这些巨大的蚂蚁从后面过来，将幸存者一个个消灭。

candidates.source: I ran until I felt like my lungs were going to jump right out of my mouth.  I holed up in the forest for the night, under a fir tree.  In the morning I heard someone talking, so I went to see.  I was playing it pretty careful though, there were still a lot of psychos and rioters around.  I snuck up on some kind of thing, some monster worse than any zombie.  Some huge bug thing, saying random phrases like some kind of broken tape recorder.  It was dragging a few human bodies behind it, I couldn't tell if they were dead or unconscious.  Honestly I didn't wait to find out, I ducked into the bushes and tried not to breath until I couldn't hear it anymore.
candidates.target: 我跑得肺都快要从嘴里跳出来了。我在森林里过夜，躲在一棵松树下。早上我听到有人说话，所以我去看看。虽然我很小心，但周围还是有很多精神变态者和暴徒。我悄悄地靠近了一团东西，比任何僵尸都可怕的怪物。那是一个巨大的虫子，像坏了的磁带录音机一样胡言乱语。它拖着几具人体在后面，我不知道他们是死的还是昏迷的。老实说，我没有等到知道结果，我躲进灌木丛，尽量不呼吸，直到听不见它了。

candidates.source: Simple, really.  You'll still be human on the inside.  Most of your meat will be there.  Even a lot of your muscle and bone.  But your arms and legs will mostly be robotic.  Your eyes, too.  You'll keep the inside parts, but they'll be part of the armored interface.  They'll all need power to work properly.  It'll all still work a bit without it, but it's not pleasant.  Your torso and head, and everything in them, will be integrated into the shell itself.  Your body will keep everything going as it is now, so no need for power there.  You'll be more sturdy, and the machines will do most of the hard work for you, so no more worrying about getting out of breath while running from the dead.  But that's only if you keep it powered and in good repair.
candidates.target: 简单来说，你内在还是个人。你的大部分肉体都会在，甚至很多肌肉和骨头也都会保留。但你的手臂和腿大部分会是机械的。你的眼睛也是。你会保留内脏，但它们会成为装甲接口的一部分。它们都需要电力才能正常工作。没有电力的话，它们也能稍微运作一下，但并不舒服。你的躯干和头部，以及它们里面的所有东西，都会被整合到外壳中。你的身体会保持现在这样运转，所以不需要在那儿供电。你会更坚固，机器会为你做大部分辛苦的工作，所以不用再担心跑步逃避丧尸时会气喘吁吁。但这只是在你保持它有电和良好维护的情况下。

candidates.source: Oh.  Well, I think it follows the good word in Revelations, if I remember right.  I haven't talked to a preacher in a bit, you know.  There were the plagues… the first one was the one a couple years ago, that big pandemic, that was when people started talking about the end being near.  Then there was a plague of blood, or was it violence?  That was the riots.  Then the seas turned red with blood, that was from all the people being shot.  Then a plague of fire, I remember that one for sure, that was when there were bombs and things going off everywhere to try to contain the riots.  And then demons and monsters walked the Earth, and the dead rose from their graves, and finally the meek inherited.  Clear as day.
candidates.target: 哦。好吧，如果我没记错，我认为这符合启示录中的好话。我已经有一段时间没有和牧师谈过了。你知道的，有那些瘟疫……第一个是几年前的那场大流行病，那时人们开始说世界末日即将到来。然后是血的瘟疫，还是暴力的瘟疫？那是骚乱。然后大海变成了血红色，那是由于许多人被枪杀。然后是火的瘟疫，我记得很清楚，那时到处都是炸弹和其他东西在爆炸，试图控制骚乱。然后恶魔和怪物在地球上行走，死者从坟墓中复活，最后温顺的人继承了地球。清清楚楚的。

candidates.source: He was at home when the bombs started dropping and the world went to hell.  I was at work.  I tried to make it to our house, but the city was a war zone. candidates.source: Us're here to live and breathe, kennit?  After our last otherland got a li'l too dead an' all.  So, us'n came to a new place.  This'n.  An I'm ken, it's not so long dead round here jus' yet.
candidates.target: 我们活著，呼吸著，对吧？上次那个异世界死得太惨了。所以，我们来到了一个新地方——这里。我知道，这儿还没完全死透。

candidates.source: Us're here to live and breathe, kennit?  After our last otherland got a li'l too dead an' all.  So, us'n came to a new place.  This'n.  An I'm ken, it's not so long dead round here jus' yet.
candidates.target: 我们的是来这里生活和呼吸的，懂了没的？在我们上次去的他乡后，没多久也死了的。于是，我们来到了一个新地方的。这个的。我记下的，这里还没死多久的。

candidates.source: 金星老儿老是一套招安招安 天庭威严被他丢尽
candidates.target: The old man Venus is always trying to appease the heavens, but he's lost all their dignity.

candidates.source: 金星老儿老是一套招安招安 天庭威严被他丢尽
candidates.target: The Venus Elder is always on about pardons and amnesty, he's completely ruined the Heavenly Court's dignity.

candidates.source: 金星老儿老是一套招安招安 天庭威严被他丢尽
candidates.target: Old Jin Xing always uses the same old tricks of pacification and surrender. He has completely disregarded the majesty of Heaven.

candidates.source: 金星老儿老是一套招安招安 天庭威严被他丢尽
candidates.target: Jin Xing Lao Er is a set of “Zha’an, Zha’an” – Heaven’s majesty was completely discarded by him.

candidates.source: 金星老儿老是一套招安招安 天庭威严被他丢尽
candidates.target: Old Venus always resorts to the same tactic of co-optation; he has utterly squandered the majesty of the Heavenly Court.

candidates.source: 金星老儿老是一套招安招安 天庭威严被他丢尽
candidates.target: The old Venusian is set on pacification and pacification; he has utterly discarded the majesty of the Heavenly Court.

candidates.source: 金星老儿老是一套招安招安 天庭威严被他丢尽
candidates.target: Old Jin Xing always resorts to amnesty; he has utterly disgraced the majesty of the Heavenly Court.

candidates.source: 金星老儿老是一套招安招安 天庭威严被他丢尽
candidates.target: He's loosening Heaven's laws.

candidates.source: 启奏万岁 今有妖猴孙悟空 蛮横无理 大闹龙宫 拔去我镇海之宝
candidates.target: Your Majesty, there is a demon monkey named Sun Wukong who has been acting rampantly and causing chaos in the Dragon Palace, plucking away my treasure that guards the sea.

candidates.source: 启奏万岁 今有妖猴孙悟空 蛮横无理 大闹龙宫 拔去我镇海之宝
candidates.target: To the Immortal Emperor, I report: A rebellious monkey, Sun Wukong, has acted outrageously and disrupted the Dragon Palace, stealing the treasured artifact that secures the seas.

candidates.source: 启奏万岁 今有妖猴孙悟空 蛮横无理 大闹龙宫 拔去我镇海之宝
candidates.target: Reporting to Your Majesty, there is a demonic monkey, Sun Wukong, who is unruly and unreasonable. He has caused a great disturbance in the Dragon Palace and uprooted my treasured pearl that calms the seas.

candidates.source: 启奏万岁 今有妖猴孙悟空 蛮横无理 大闹龙宫 拔去我镇海之宝
candidates.target: I prostrate myself before the Emperor for eternity. Today, there is a mischievous monkey, Sun Wukong, acting wildly and causing chaos in the Dragon Palace, and he has stolen my treasure, the Jewel of the Seas.

candidates.source: 启奏万岁 今有妖猴孙悟空 蛮横无理 大闹龙宫 拔去我镇海之宝
candidates.target: Your Majesty, I humbly report that the demonic monkey Sun Wukong, acting with insolence and lawlessness, has caused chaos in the Dragon Palace and uprooted our treasure that calms the seas.

candidates.source: 启奏万岁 今有妖猴孙悟空 蛮横无理 大闹龙宫 拔去我镇海之宝
candidates.target: Report to the Emperor: There is a demon monkey named Sun Wukong, who is arrogant and unreasonable. He has caused a great disturbance in the Dragon Palace and plucked my treasure that calms the sea.

candidates.source: 启奏万岁 今有妖猴孙悟空 蛮横无理 大闹龙宫 拔去我镇海之宝
candidates.target: Your Majesty, I report that the demon monkey Sun Wukong has acted arrogantly and without reason, causing a disturbance in the Dragon Palace and plucking out my treasure that calms the sea.

candidates.source: 启奏万岁 今有妖猴孙悟空 蛮横无理 大闹龙宫 拔去我镇海之宝
candidates.target: Your majesty, the monkey Sun Wukong outrageously made havoc in my Palace, and robbed me of my Gold Cudgel, which is used to calm the sea.

candidates.source: 万岁 贫道为万岁所炼的九转金丹 被那个孙悟空偷吃得一干二净
candidates.target: Long live the Emperor! The nine-turn golden pill that I, the humble Daoist, refined for your majesty has been stolen clean by that Sun Wukong.

candidates.source: 万岁 贫道为万岁所炼的九转金丹 被那个孙悟空偷吃得一干二净
candidates.target: Long live! This poor monk's Nine Transformation Golden Pill, refined for the Emperor, was completely stolen and eaten by that Sun Wukong.

candidates.source: 万岁 贫道为万岁所炼的九转金丹 被那个孙悟空偷吃得一干二净
candidates.target: Long live the Emperor! The Nine-Turn Golden Elixir that I, a humble Taoist, refined for His Majesty was completely stolen and devoured by that Sun Wukong!

candidates.source: 万岁 贫道为万岁所炼的九转金丹 被那个孙悟空偷吃得一干二净
candidates.target: Long live! The poor Daoist was refining a nine-turn golden elixir for the Great Emperor, and that Sun Wukong stole and devoured it completely.

candidates.source: 万岁 贫道为万岁所炼的九转金丹 被那个孙悟空偷吃得一干二净
candidates.target: Long live the Emperor! The Nine-Revolution Golden Elixir that this humble Daoist prepared for Your Majesty has been entirely stolen and consumed by that Sun Wukong.

candidates.source: 万岁 贫道为万岁所炼的九转金丹 被那个孙悟空偷吃得一干二净
candidates.target: Your Majesty, the Nine-Transform Golden Pill that I, a Daoist, forged for Your Majesty has been completely stolen and consumed by that Monkey King, Sun Wukong.

candidates.source: 万岁 贫道为万岁所炼的九转金丹 被那个孙悟空偷吃得一干二净
candidates.target: Long live the Emperor! The Nine-Turn Golden Pill that I, a humble Daoist, forged for Your Majesty has been completely stolen and consumed by that Sun Wukong.

candidates.source: 万岁 贫道为万岁所炼的九转金丹 被那个孙悟空偷吃得一干二净
candidates.target: Your Majesty, Sun Wukong ate up all of the Golden Elixir Pills I made for you.

candidates.source: 那弼马温在花果山挂起旗号 自称齐天大圣 还要与万岁平起平坐
candidates.target: The horse-tamer raised his flag on Mount Huaguo, proclaimed himself the Great Sage Equal to Heaven, and even demanded to sit on an equal footing with the Emperor.

candidates.source: 那弼马温在花果山挂起旗号 自称齐天大圣 还要与万岁平起平坐
candidates.target: That buffoon on Peach Blossom Mountain raised a banner, declaring himself the Great Sage Equal to Heaven and demanding to be on par with the Eternal.

candidates.source: 那弼马温在花果山挂起旗号 自称齐天大圣 还要与万岁平起平坐
candidates.target: That Sun Wukong raised his banner on Flower Fruit Mountain, proclaimed himself the Great Sage Equal to Heaven, and even wanted to be on equal footing with the Emperor.

candidates.source: 那弼马温在花果山挂起旗号 自称齐天大圣 还要与万岁平起平坐
candidates.target: Then, Bi Ma Wen hung up his banner, proclaiming himself the Great Sage of Heaven, and insisted on sitting at the same level as the Emperor.

candidates.source: 那弼马温在花果山挂起旗号 自称齐天大圣 还要与万岁平起平坐
candidates.target: That Bimawen raised his banner on Flower-Fruit Mountain, proclaimed himself the Great Sage Equal to Heaven, and demanded to sit on equal footing with Your Majesty.

candidates.source: 那弼马温在花果山挂起旗号 自称齐天大圣 还要与万岁平起平坐
candidates.target: Then Bi Ma Wen raised the banner at Flower-Fruit Mountain, declaring himself the Great Sage Equal to Heaven, and demanding to sit at the same level as the Son of Heaven.

candidates.source: 那弼马温在花果山挂起旗号 自称齐天大圣 还要与万岁平起平坐
candidates.target: That Bi Ma Wen raised a banner at Flower Fruit Mountain, proclaimed himself the Great Sage Equal to Heaven, and demanded to sit on equal footing with the Emperor.

candidates.source: 那弼马温在花果山挂起旗号 自称齐天大圣 还要与万岁平起平坐
candidates.target: The Stable Keeper put up a banner at the Mountain of Flowers and Fruits declaring himself 'Great Sage Equal of Heaven'.

candidates.source: 玉帝老儿 你眼里没有俺齐天大圣 如今俺老孙倒坐了个首席
candidates.target: The Jade Emperor, you have no eyes for the Great Sage Equaling Heaven. Now, old Sun has taken the seat of honor.

candidates.source: 玉帝老儿 你眼里没有俺齐天大圣 如今俺老孙倒坐了个首席
candidates.target: Son of the Jade Emperor, you don't see me,齐 Tian Dasheng? Now I, your old Sun, have taken the chief seat.

candidates.source: 玉帝老儿 你眼里没有俺齐天大圣 如今俺老孙倒坐了个首席
candidates.target: Jade Emperor, you don't have me, the Great Sage Equal to Heaven, in your eyes! Now, I, your old Sun Wukong, have been given the first seat!

candidates.source: 玉帝老儿 你眼里没有俺齐天大圣 如今俺老孙倒坐了个首席
candidates.target: Old Emperor Jade, you don't see me, Sun Wukong, the Great Sage of the West. Now, I, your old grandson, have been seated as First in Command.

candidates.source: 玉帝老儿 你眼里没有俺齐天大圣 如今俺老孙倒坐了个首席
candidates.target: Old Jade Emperor, you never held the Great Sage Equal to Heaven in your eyes. Now, I, Old Sun, have taken the seat of honor.

candidates.source: 玉帝老儿 你眼里没有俺齐天大圣 如今俺老孙倒坐了个首席
candidates.target: Old Jade Emperor, you have no regard for me, the Great Sage Equal to Heaven. Now, I, Old Sun, have taken the top seat.

candidates.source: 玉帝老儿 你眼里没有俺齐天大圣 如今俺老孙倒坐了个首席
candidates.target: Old Sky Emperor, you have no eyes for me, the Great Sage Equal to Heaven. Now, I, Old Sun, sit in the prime seat.

candidates.source: 玉帝老儿 你眼里没有俺齐天大圣 如今俺老孙倒坐了个首席
candidates.target: Old Jade Emperor, you keep mocking me, the Great Sage, Equal of Heaven. But I'm going to sit on your throne today, here in the Peach Banquet.

candidates.source: 自从弼马温来此以后 天马 匹匹精壮驯服
candidates.target: Since the horse trainer came, every horse here has become strong and tame.

candidates.source: 自从弼马温来此以后 天马 匹匹精壮驯服
candidates.target: Since the groom arrived here, the horses have become strong, spirited, and well-trained.

candidates.source: 自从弼马温来此以后 天马 匹匹精壮驯服
candidates.target:
Since Bi Mawen arrived, the horses have all become strong, robust, and well-trained. 

(Note: Bi Mawen is a reference to Sun Wukong/The Monkey King in Journey to the West, who was initially given the title "Pima Wen" - Groom of the Heavenly Horses - and improved the horses' condition.)

candidates.source: 自从弼马温来此以后 天马 匹匹精壮驯服
candidates.target: Since Bi Ma Wen came here, the Pegasus has grown strong and docile.

candidates.source: 自从弼马温来此以后 天马 匹匹精壮驯服
candidates.target: Since the arrival of the Stable Keeper, every heavenly steed has become robust and well-tamed.

candidates.source: 自从弼马温来此以后 天马 匹匹精壮驯服
candidates.target: Since the Horse-Taming Official arrived here, every celestial steed has become vigorous, well-trained, and obedient.

candidates.source: 自从弼马温来此以后 天马 匹匹精壮驯服
candidates.target: Since Bi Ma Wen arrived, every heavenly steed has become strong, well-trained, and obedient.

candidates.source: 自从弼马温来此以后 天马 匹匹精壮驯服
candidates.target: Since you came here the Heaven horses have been very happy and comfortable.

candidates.source: 说什么在蟠桃会上吃 俺现在就吃 有何不可
candidates.target: What's wrong with eating now what we would eat at the banquet?

candidates.source: 说什么在蟠桃会上吃 俺现在就吃 有何不可
candidates.target: What are you saying about eating peaches at the Peach Banquet? I'll eat them now. What's wrong with that?

candidates.source: 说什么在蟠桃会上吃 俺现在就吃 有何不可
candidates.target:
What's so special about eating at the Peach Banquet? I'll eat now, what's wrong with that? 

(Or, more colloquially: "You say you only eat at the Peach Banquet? I'll eat now, what of it?") 

**Note:** The "蟠桃会" (Pántáo Huì) refers to a mythical peach banquet held by the Queen Mother of the West in Chinese mythology, where peaches of immortality are served. The phrase implies exclusivity and privilege. The speaker is challenging that exclusivity.

candidates.source: 说什么在蟠桃会上吃 俺现在就吃 有何不可
candidates.target: What’s wrong with me eating at the peach blossom festival? I’m eating now.

candidates.source: 说什么在蟠桃会上吃 俺现在就吃 有何不可
candidates.target: They say one eats at the Peach Banquet, but why not eat right now? What's wrong with that?

candidates.source: 说什么在蟠桃会上吃 俺现在就吃 有何不可
candidates.target: What's wrong with eating at the Panyao Banquet right now?

candidates.source: 说什么在蟠桃会上吃 俺现在就吃 有何不可
candidates.target: What? They say to eat at the Peach Banquet? I'll eat right now. What's wrong with that?

candidates.source: 说什么在蟠桃会上吃 俺现在就吃 有何不可
candidates.target: Why wait until the banquet when I can eat it right now?

candidates.source: 原来是乌龟 虾米二将 俺老孙要见老龙王 快快通报
candidates.target: It's me, Sun Wukong. I want to see the Old Dragon King. Please announce me quickly.

candidates.source: 原来是乌龟 虾米二将 俺老孙要见老龙王 快快通报
candidates.target: So it was the Turtle and the Shrimp! Old Sun Wukong is going to see the Dragon King. Quickly report this!

candidates.source: 原来是乌龟 虾米二将 俺老孙要见老龙王 快快通报
candidates.target: Turns out it's the Tortoise and Shrimp Generals. Old Sun wants to see the Dragon King! Quickly report it!

candidates.source: 原来是乌龟 虾米二将 俺老孙要见老龙王 快快通报
candidates.target: It turns out it’s the turtle, Shrimp Two, and Old Sun wants to see the Old Dragon King. Report quickly!

candidates.source: 原来是乌龟 虾米二将 俺老孙要见老龙王 快快通报
candidates.target: So it's the Turtle and the Shrimp Generals! I, the Great Sage, wish to see the Old Dragon King. Announce my presence at once!

candidates.source: 原来是乌龟 虾米二将 俺老孙要见老龙王 快快通报
candidates.target: It's the Tortoise and the Crab generals. I, Sun Wukong, wish to see the Dragon King. Inform him at once.

candidates.source: 原来是乌龟 虾米二将 俺老孙要见老龙王 快快通报
candidates.target: It's the turtle and shrimp generals! I, the Old Monkey, wish to see the Dragon King. Announce my arrival quickly!

candidates.source: 原来是乌龟 虾米二将 俺老孙要见老龙王 快快通报
candidates.target: So it's General Turtle and General Shrimp. I need to see the Dragon King. Please tell him quickly.

candidates.source: 俺老孙上天入地无所不能 哪儿有去不得的地方
candidates.target: I, Sun Wukong, can go anywhere, whether in the heavens or underground. Where can't I go?

candidates.source: 俺老孙上天入地无所不能 哪儿有去不得的地方
candidates.target: Old Sun, I, can do anything under and above the heavens; there's nowhere I can't go.

candidates.source: 俺老孙上天入地无所不能 哪儿有去不得的地方
candidates.target: I, Sun Wukong, can go anywhere, both heaven and earth – there's no place I can't reach.

candidates.source: 俺老孙上天入地无所不能 哪儿有去不得的地方
candidates.target: Old Sun can do anything, anywhere he goes.

candidates.source: 俺老孙上天入地无所不能 哪儿有去不得的地方
candidates.target: I, Old Sun, can traverse heaven and earth with boundless power; is there any place I cannot go?

candidates.source: 俺老孙上天入地无所不能 哪儿有去不得的地方
candidates.target: I am the Great Sage, capable of ascending to heaven and descending to earth; there is no place I cannot reach.

candidates.source: 俺老孙上天入地无所不能 哪儿有去不得的地方
candidates.target: I, the Great Sage, can ascend to heaven and descend to earth; there is no place I cannot reach.

candidates.source: 俺老孙上天入地无所不能 哪儿有去不得的地方
candidates.target: I can fly up to Heaven and burrow into the deepest ground. There's no place I can't go.

candidates.source: 哼 你有多 大本领 敢自称齐天大圣 先吃我一枪
candidates.target: Hmph, how dare you call yourself the Great Sage Equaling Heaven with such feeble skills? Let me give you a taste of my gun!

candidates.source: 哼 你有多 大本领 敢自称齐天大圣 先吃我一枪
candidates.target: Hmph, what qualifications do you have to call yourself the Great Sage Equal to Heaven? Take this shot first!

candidates.source: 哼 你有多 大本领 敢自称齐天大圣 先吃我一枪
candidates.target: Hmph, just how capable are you to dare call yourself the Great Sage Equal to Heaven? Eat this shot of mine first!

candidates.source: 哼 你有多 大本领 敢自称齐天大圣 先吃我一枪
candidates.target: Pah! How much power do you have to call yourself the Great Sage of Heaven? Shoot me first!

candidates.source: 哼 你有多 大本领 敢自称齐天大圣 先吃我一枪
candidates.target: Hmph! What power do you possess to dare call yourself the Great Sage Equal to Heaven? Take this spear thrust!

candidates.source: 哼 你有多 大本领 敢自称齐天大圣 先吃我一枪
candidates.target: Hmph! How dare you claim to be the Great Sage Equal to Heaven? Take this shot!

candidates.source: 哼 你有多 大本领 敢自称齐天大圣 先吃我一枪
candidates.target: Hmph! What qualifications do you have to call yourself the Great Sage Equal to Heaven? First, take this spear!

candidates.source: 哼 你有多 大本领 敢自称齐天大圣 先吃我一枪
candidates.target: Who are you to declare yourself The Great Sage? Eat this!

candidates.source: 力能降龙伏虎 移山倒海 万岁切不可轻视啊
candidates.target: The power to subdue dragons and tigers, to move mountains and overturn seas, must never be underestimated.

candidates.source: 力能降龙伏虎 移山倒海 万岁切不可轻视啊
candidates.target: With strength enough to subdue dragons and tigers, and move mountains and seas, long may you live, but never underestimate [this/it]!

candidates.source: 力能降龙伏虎 移山倒海 万岁切不可轻视啊
candidates.target: Strength can subdue dragons and tigers, move mountains and overturn the seas. Long live [the emperor/a powerful figure], but must never be taken lightly!

candidates.source: 力能降龙伏虎 移山倒海 万岁切不可轻视啊
candidates.target: Strength can subdue dragons and tigers, move mountains and overturn seas. A thousand years should not be disregarded!

candidates.source: 力能降龙伏虎 移山倒海 万岁切不可轻视啊
candidates.target: His power can subdue dragons and tigers, move mountains, and overturn seas. Your Majesty must never underestimate him.

candidates.source: 力能降龙伏虎 移山倒海 万岁切不可轻视啊
candidates.target: This power can subdue dragons and tigers, move mountains and overturn seas; do not underestimate it, my liege.

candidates.source: 力能降龙伏虎 移山倒海 万岁切不可轻视啊
candidates.target: With power to subdue dragons and tigers, move mountains and overturn seas, the Ten-Thousand-Year Emperor must never be underestimated.

candidates.source: 力能降龙伏虎 移山倒海 万岁切不可轻视啊
candidates.target: He can subdue tigers and dragons, move mountains, and empty seas. Your majesty, you can't take it lightly.

candidates.source: 哼哼 别忙叫热 这热嘛还在后头呢
candidates.target: Hmm, don't get too hot yet, the real heat is still to come.

candidates.source: 哼哼 别忙叫热 这热嘛还在后头呢
candidates.target: Hmph, don't rush to say it's hot. The real heat is still to come.

candidates.source: 哼哼 别忙叫热 这热嘛还在后头呢
candidates.target:
Heh, don't be so quick to call it hot, the real heat is yet to come. 

(Or, more colloquially: Heh, don't get excited yet, the worst is still to come.)

candidates.source: 哼哼 别忙叫热 这热嘛还在后头呢
candidates.target: Hmph. Don't shout about the heat yet. That heat is still to come.

candidates.source: 哼哼 别忙叫热 这热嘛还在后头呢
candidates.target: Heh, don't rush to say it's hot yet—the real heat is still to come.

candidates.source: 哼哼 别忙叫热 这热嘛还在后头呢
candidates.target: Hmph, don't rush to complain about the heat; it's still ahead.

candidates.source: 哼哼 别忙叫热 这热嘛还在后头呢
candidates.target: Heh, don't rush to call it hot; the heat is just coming.

candidates.source: 哼哼 别忙叫热 这热嘛还在后头呢
candidates.target: Don't bother, there will be more heat.

candidates.source: 封孙悟空为弼马温掌管御马监 下殿去吧
candidates.target: Seal Sun Wukong as the Director of the Imperial Stud, and send him down to the lower court.

candidates.source: 封孙悟空为弼马温掌管御马监 下殿去吧
candidates.target: Appoint Sun Wukong as the Director of the Imperial Stables, a minor post. Go back to the lower halls.

candidates.source: 封孙悟空为弼马温掌管御马监 下殿去吧
candidates.target: Appoint Sun Wukong as the Stable Boy in charge of the Horse Stable. You may leave the hall.

candidates.source: 封孙悟空为弼马温掌管御马监 下殿去吧
candidates.target: Appoint Sun Wukong as Keeper of the Horses, and go to the lower hall.

candidates.source: 封孙悟空为弼马温掌管御马监 下殿去吧
candidates.target: Seal Sun Wukong as the Bimawen, placing him in charge of the Imperial Stable. Descend from the hall.

candidates.source: 封孙悟空为弼马温掌管御马监 下殿去吧
candidates.target: Appoint Sun Wukong as the Master of the Imperial Stables to oversee the Imperial Stables, and now, leave the hall.

candidates.source: 封孙悟空为弼马温掌管御马监 下殿去吧
candidates.target: Appoint Sun Wukong as the Bi Ma Wen to oversee the Imperial Horse Stable; now, take your leave from the hall.

candidates.source: 封孙悟空为弼马温掌管御马监 下殿去吧
candidates.target: Appoint Sun Wukong as Keeper of the Imperial Stables. You may leave.

candidates.source: 不费一兵一卒 把他哄上天来严加管束 如不服管 也好就地擒拿
candidates.target: Without sending a single soldier or moving a single weapon, we can bring him to heel through deception and strict control. If he refuses to submit, we can capture him on the spot.

candidates.source: 不费一兵一卒 把他哄上天来严加管束 如不服管 也好就地擒拿
candidates.target: Without expending a single soldier or troop, lure him up here and strictly control him. If he resists control, then simply capture him on the spot.

candidates.source: 不费一兵一卒 把他哄上天来严加管束 如不服管 也好就地擒拿
candidates.target: Without deploying a single soldier, lure him here and strictly control him. If he refuses to be controlled, simply arrest him on the spot.

candidates.source: 不费一兵一卒 把他哄上天来严加管束 如不服管 也好就地擒拿
candidates.target: Without spending a single soldier or a single drop of effort, he was tricked into believing he was in heaven and tightly controlled; if he didn't submit to being controlled, he would be captured alive.

candidates.source: 不费一兵一卒 把他哄上天来严加管束 如不服管 也好就地擒拿
candidates.target: Without deploying a single soldier, we shall coax him to ascend to the heavens and place him under strict supervision; should he refuse to comply, we can apprehend him on the spot.

candidates.source: 不费一兵一卒 把他哄上天来严加管束 如不服管 也好就地擒拿
candidates.target: Without deploying a single soldier, we will coax him into submission and place him under strict control; if he refuses to comply, we will arrest him on the spot.

candidates.source: 不费一兵一卒 把他哄上天来严加管束 如不服管 也好就地擒拿
candidates.target: Without losing a single soldier, coax him up to the heavens for strict supervision; should he refuse to obey, arrest him on the spot.

candidates.source: 不费一兵一卒 把他哄上天来严加管束 如不服管 也好就地擒拿
candidates.target: We'll restrain the monkey here in Heaven, and it will be easy for us to capture him, if he commits crimes.

candidates.source: 那弼马温打伤了马天君 捣毁了御马监 闯出了南天门 逃回花果山去了
candidates.target: Then Pílimǎwēn injured Mǎtiānjūn, destroyed the Imperial Stud, broke through the South Heavenly Gate, and escaped back to Huāguǒshān.

candidates.source: 那弼马温打伤了马天君 捣毁了御马监 闯出了南天门 逃回花果山去了
candidates.target: That buffoon Sun Wukong injured Tiangong, destroyed the Imperial Stables, broke through the Southern Heavenly Gate, and fled back to Flower Fruit Mountain.

candidates.source: 那弼马温打伤了马天君 捣毁了御马监 闯出了南天门 逃回花果山去了
candidates.target: That mischievous monkey injured Matian Jun, destroyed the Imperial Horse Agency, broke through the Southern Heaven Gate, and fled back to Flower Fruit Mountain.

candidates.source: 那弼马温打伤了马天君 捣毁了御马监 闯出了南天门 逃回花果山去了
candidates.target: That Bi Ma Wen injured Ma Tian Jun, destroyed the Imperial Horse Guard, broke through the Southern Heavenly Gate, and fled back to Hua Guo Shan.

candidates.source: 那弼马温打伤了马天君 捣毁了御马监 闯出了南天门 逃回花果山去了
candidates.target: That Bimawen injured the Heavenly Lord of Horses, destroyed the Imperial Stable, broke through the Southern Heavenly Gate, and fled back to Flower-Fruit Mountain.

candidates.source: 那弼马温打伤了马天君 捣毁了御马监 闯出了南天门 逃回花果山去了
candidates.target: That Bi Ma Wen injured the Horse God, destroyed the Imperial Stable, breached the South Heavenly Gate, and fled back to Flower-Fruit Mountain.

candidates.source: 那弼马温打伤了马天君 捣毁了御马监 闯出了南天门 逃回花果山去了
candidates.target: Then Bi Ma Wen injured the Lord of the Heavenly Horses, smashed the Imperial Horse Registry, burst through the Southern Heavenly Gate, and fled back to Flower-Fruit Mountain.

candidates.source: 那弼马温打伤了马天君 捣毁了御马监 闯出了南天门 逃回花果山去了
candidates.target: The Stable Keeper injured the Horse General, ruined the Heavenly Stables, left through the Southern Gate, and went back to the Mountain of Flowers and Fruits.

candidates.source: - 住口 难道没有俺齐天大圣的座位
candidates.target: - Be quiet! Is there no seat for the Great Sage, Equal of Heaven?

candidates.source: - 住口 难道没有俺齐天大圣的座位
candidates.target: Stop talking! Don't you have a seat for the Great Sage Equal to Heaven?

candidates.source: - 住口 难道没有俺齐天大圣的座位
candidates.target: Shut your mouth! Don't you know there's no seat for me, the Great Sage Equal to Heaven?

candidates.source: - 住口 难道没有俺齐天大圣的座位
candidates.target: Sit down. Don't you have a seat as the Heavenly King?

candidates.source: - 住口 难道没有俺齐天大圣的座位
candidates.target: - Hold your tongue! Is there no seat for me, the Great Sage Equal to Heaven?

candidates.source: - 住口 难道没有俺齐天大圣的座位
candidates.target: - Shut up! Is there no seat for me, the Great Sage Equal to Heaven?

candidates.source: - 住口 难道没有俺齐天大圣的座位
candidates.target: - Hold your tongue! Is there no seat for the Great Sage Equal to Heaven?

candidates.source: - 住口 难道没有俺齐天大圣的座位
candidates.target: Shut up! Why wasn't I, the Great Sage Equal of Heaven, invited?

candidates.source: 哪吒 巨灵神均不能取胜 望万岁再加兵将
candidates.target: Neither Nezha nor Jilingshen could gain the upper hand. I hope Your Majesty will send more troops.

candidates.source: 哪吒 巨灵神均不能取胜 望万岁再加兵将
candidates.target: Neither Nezha nor the Giant Spirit God could achieve victory. I implore Your Majesty to send reinforcements.

candidates.source: 哪吒 巨灵神均不能取胜 望万岁再加兵将
candidates.target: Nezha and Jiling Shen both cannot achieve victory. I hope Your Majesty will send more generals and soldiers.

candidates.source: 哪吒 巨灵神均不能取胜 望万岁再加兵将
candidates.target: Nezha, the Great Spirit God, couldn't prevail. Pray for more troops and generals to be added to the army.

candidates.source: 哪吒 巨灵神均不能取胜 望万岁再加兵将
candidates.target: Neither Nezha nor the Giant Spirit God could secure victory; we beseech Your Majesty to dispatch additional troops and generals.

candidates.source: 哪吒 巨灵神均不能取胜 望万岁再加兵将
candidates.target: Neither Nezha nor the Giant Spirit God can prevail; may Your Majesty dispatch additional troops and commanders.

candidates.source: 哪吒 巨灵神均不能取胜 望万岁再加兵将
candidates.target: Neither Nezha nor the Giant Spirit God could prevail; may Your Majesty add more troops and generals.

candidates.source: 哪吒 巨灵神均不能取胜 望万岁再加兵将
candidates.target: Nezha and the Mighty Magic Spirit are incapable of victory. Your Majesty, you must send more troops.

candidates.source: 众位仙姑驾到 小神未曾远迎 有罪有罪
candidates.target: The immortal ladies have arrived. This lowly spirit did not go far enough to greet them. I am guilty, I am guilty.

candidates.source: 众位仙姑驾到 小神未曾远迎 有罪有罪
candidates.target: Respected Immortal Matrons have arrived. This humble one failed to greet you properly. I am at fault, at fault.

candidates.source: 众位仙姑驾到 小神未曾远迎 有罪有罪
candidates.target: Honorable immortals, your arrival is graced upon us. This humble spirit did not greet you from afar, a great offense, a great offense.

candidates.source: 众位仙姑驾到 小神未曾远迎 有罪有罪
candidates.target: Ladies and ladies of the divine, please enter. The little deity has not greeted you from afar. Guilty, guilty.

candidates.source: 众位仙姑驾到 小神未曾远迎 有罪有罪
candidates.target: The fair immortals have arrived; this humble deity failed to welcome you from afar. I am at fault, truly at fault.

candidates.source: 众位仙姑驾到 小神未曾远迎 有罪有罪
candidates.target: All the immortal ladies have arrived. The humble spirit has not come to greet them in person; I am at fault, truly at fault.

candidates.source: 众位仙姑驾到 小神未曾远迎 有罪有罪
candidates.target: May the fairies arrive! This humble deity failed to welcome you from afar; I am guilty, I am guilty.

candidates.source: 众位仙姑驾到 小神未曾远迎 有罪有罪
candidates.target: The goddesses are here. I didn't come to greet you, please forgive me.

candidates.source: 你这猴头 胆子可不小 竟敢在天上偷桃偷酒 又偷吃老君的金丹
candidates.target: You rascal, you dare to steal peaches and wine from heaven, and even eat the golden pills of the Old Lord!

candidates.source: 你这猴头 胆子可不小 竟敢在天上偷桃偷酒 又偷吃老君的金丹
candidates.target: You cheeky monkey, you've got a lot of nerve! You dare steal peaches and wine from the heavens, and even eat Lao Jun's Golden Elixir.

candidates.source: 你这猴头 胆子可不小 竟敢在天上偷桃偷酒 又偷吃老君的金丹
candidates.target: You cheeky monkey, you're quite bold! Daring to steal peaches and wine in heaven, and even eat the Golden Pills of the Old Lord!

candidates.source: 你这猴头 胆子可不小 竟敢在天上偷桃偷酒 又偷吃老君的金丹
candidates.target: You monkey-headed fool, your guts are awfully big—you dare to steal peaches and wine in the sky, and even steal the elixir of immortality from Laozi!

candidates.source: 你这猴头 胆子可不小 竟敢在天上偷桃偷酒 又偷吃老君的金丹
candidates.target: You mischievous monkey, your audacity knows no bounds! You dare to steal peaches and wine from the heavens, and even devour the Golden Elixir of the Old Lord Laozi!

candidates.source: 你这猴头 胆子可不小 竟敢在天上偷桃偷酒 又偷吃老君的金丹
candidates.target: You monkey-headed rascal, your audacity is no small thing! You dare steal peaches and wine from the heavens, and even devour Laojun's golden elixir.

candidates.source: 你这猴头 胆子可不小 竟敢在天上偷桃偷酒 又偷吃老君的金丹
candidates.target: You impudent monkey, your audacity is truly great! How dare you steal peaches and wine from the heavens, and even devour the Golden Pill of the Lord of the Golden Furnace!

candidates.source: 你这猴头 胆子可不小 竟敢在天上偷桃偷酒 又偷吃老君的金丹
candidates.target: You're a savage monkey to ruin the Peach Party and eat up all of Lord Lao Zi's Golden Elixir Pills.

candidates.source: 到处金璧辉煌 遍地奇花异草
candidates.target: Everywhere is golden and glittering, with strange flowers and exotic plants everywhere.

candidates.source: 到处金璧辉煌 遍地奇花异草
candidates.target: Everywhere glistens with gold and jade; the ground is covered with rare and exotic flowers and plants.

candidates.source: 到处金璧辉煌 遍地奇花异草
candidates.target: Everywhere is golden and splendid, and all around are exotic flowers and rare plants.

candidates.source: 到处金璧辉煌 遍地奇花异草
candidates.target: Everywhere, golden walls shimmer; everywhere, wondrous and strange flowers and grasses bloom.

candidates.source: 到处金璧辉煌 遍地奇花异草
candidates.target: Everywhere shines with golden splendor; rare flowers and exotic plants cover the ground.

candidates.source: 到处金璧辉煌 遍地奇花异草
candidates.target: Everywhere, golden and jade treasures shine; everywhere, rare and exotic flowers and grasses bloom.

candidates.source: 到处金璧辉煌 遍地奇花异草
candidates.target: Everywhere shines with golden splendor; everywhere bloom strange and exotic flowers.

candidates.source: 到处金璧辉煌 遍地奇花异草
candidates.target: In Heaven, everything is resplendent and magnificent and is decorated by exotic flowers.

candidates.source: 万岁真是圣明 待老臣再去哄他上天
candidates.target: Long live the wise ruler; may I go and deceive him into heaven.

candidates.source: 万岁真是圣明 待老臣再去哄他上天
candidates.target: Long live the Emperor, so wise and benevolent. Let your old minister go and flatter him into the heavens once more.

candidates.source: 万岁真是圣明 待老臣再去哄他上天
candidates.target: Long live the Emperor, truly wise and enlightened. I, an old minister, will go and flatter him into ascending to heaven again.

candidates.source: 万岁真是圣明 待老臣再去哄他上天
candidates.target: Long live the Emperor! Truly wise and enlightened. I, an old minister, will go again to coax him to ascend to heaven.

candidates.source: 万岁真是圣明 待老臣再去哄他上天
candidates.target: Your Majesty is truly wise. Allow this old minister to coax him into ascending to heaven once more.

candidates.source: 万岁真是圣明 待老臣再去哄他上天
candidates.target: Your Majesty is truly wise; let me go up and coax him into the heavens.

candidates.source: 万岁真是圣明 待老臣再去哄他上天
candidates.target: Long Live the Emperor, truly wise! Let me go coax him into the heavens once more.

candidates.source: 万岁真是圣明 待老臣再去哄他上天
candidates.target: Reasonable choice, Your Majesty. I'll go and trick him to Heaven again.

candidates.source: 大胆猴头 玉帝派你管马 你竟敢把天马放了
candidates.target: Bold Monkey King, Heaven's Emperor entrusted you with the horse, yet you dared to set it free.

candidates.source: 大胆猴头 玉帝派你管马 你竟敢把天马放了
candidates.target: Bold monkey head! The Jade Emperor sent you to manage the horses, and you dared to release the celestial steeds!

candidates.source: 大胆猴头 玉帝派你管马 你竟敢把天马放了
candidates.target: Bold monkey, the Jade Emperor sent you to manage the horses, and you dared to release the celestial horses!

candidates.source: 大胆猴头 玉帝派你管马 你竟敢把天马放了
candidates.target: Bold monkey head! Yu Di sent you to oversee the horses, and you dared to release the Celestial Horse!

candidates.source: 大胆猴头 玉帝派你管马 你竟敢把天马放了
candidates.target: Bold Monkey, the Jade Emperor sent you to guard the horses, yet you dared to release the Heavenly Steed!

candidates.source: 大胆猴头 玉帝派你管马 你竟敢把天马放了
candidates.target: Daring Monkey Head! The Jade Emperor sent you to manage the horses, yet you dared to release the Heavenly Horse!

candidates.source: 大胆猴头 玉帝派你管马 你竟敢把天马放了
candidates.target: Bold Monkey Head! The Jade Emperor sent you to manage the horses, yet you dare to release the heavenly steed!

candidates.source: 大胆猴头 玉帝派你管马 你竟敢把天马放了
candidates.target: How dare you, demon head? The Jade Emperor appoints you to look after the horses and you release them?

candidates.source: 大胆弼马温 你眼睛里还有没有玉帝呀
candidates.target: Bold and fearless, is the Jade Emperor still in your eyes?

candidates.source: 大胆弼马温 你眼睛里还有没有玉帝呀
candidates.target: Bold official, do you still see the Jade Emperor in your eyes?

candidates.source: 大胆弼马温 你眼睛里还有没有玉帝呀
candidates.target:
Bold Sun Wukong, do you still have any respect for the Jade Emperor in your eyes? 

(Or, a more colloquial translation: Bold Monkey King, have you lost all respect for the Jade Emperor?)

candidates.source: 大胆弼马温 你眼睛里还有没有玉帝呀
candidates.target: Dare to be bold, you brazen fool! Still have Emperor Jade in your eyes?

candidates.source: 大胆弼马温 你眼睛里还有没有玉帝呀
candidates.target: Bold Bimawen, do you still have the Jade Emperor in your eyes?

candidates.source: 大胆弼马温 你眼睛里还有没有玉帝呀
candidates.target: Daredevil Bi Ma Wen, do you still have the Jade Emperor in your eyes?

candidates.source: 大胆弼马温 你眼睛里还有没有玉帝呀
candidates.target: Bold Monkey King, do you still have any respect for the Jade Emperor in your eyes?

candidates.source: 大胆弼马温 你眼睛里还有没有玉帝呀
candidates.target: How dare you? Do you have any respect for the Jade Emperor?

candidates.source: 这天上乃是神仙境界 与你们这花果山可是大不相 同啊
candidates.target: This heavenly realm is vastly different from your Flower Fruit Mountain.

candidates.source: 这天上乃是神仙境界 与你们这花果山可是大不相 同啊
candidates.target: This heaven is a realm of immortals, vastly different from your Flower Fruit Mountain.

candidates.source: 这天上乃是神仙境界 与你们这花果山可是大不相 同啊
candidates.target: This heavenly realm is the domain of the immortals, vastly different from your Flower Fruit Mountain.

candidates.source: 这天上乃是神仙境界 与你们这花果山可是大不相 同啊
candidates.target: This realm up there is a divine level, completely different from your Flower and Fruit Mountain!

candidates.source: 这天上乃是神仙境界 与你们这花果山可是大不相 同啊
candidates.target: The heavens above are a realm of immortals, vastly different from your Flower-Fruit Mountain.

candidates.source: 这天上乃是神仙境界 与你们这花果山可是大不相 同啊
candidates.target: This realm is the abode of immortals, vastly different from your Flower-Fruit Mountain.

candidates.source: 这天上乃是神仙境界 与你们这花果山可是大不相 同啊
candidates.target: This realm above is the domain of immortals, vastly different from your Flower-Fruit Mountain.

candidates.source: 这天上乃是神仙境界 与你们这花果山可是大不相 同啊
candidates.target: Heaven is the place where we gods live and is completely different from here in the Mountain of Flowers and Fruits.

candidates.source: 告诉你那玉帝老儿 答应俺老孙这个称号便罢
candidates.target: Tell that Jade Emperor, if he agrees to this title, it's fine by me.

candidates.source: 告诉你那玉帝老儿 答应俺老孙这个称号便罢
candidates.target: Tell that old Jade Emperor, once he agrees to this title for me, that's enough.

candidates.source: 告诉你那玉帝老儿 答应俺老孙这个称号便罢
candidates.target: Tell that Jade Emperor old man that he can grant me this title and be done with it.

candidates.source: 告诉你那玉帝老儿 答应俺老孙这个称号便罢
candidates.target: Tell him that the Jade Emperor has agreed to bestow this title upon me, and that’s that.

candidates.source: 告诉你那玉帝老儿 答应俺老孙这个称号便罢
candidates.target: Tell that old Jade Emperor to grant me this title, or else!

candidates.source: 告诉你那玉帝老儿 答应俺老孙这个称号便罢
candidates.target: Tell that Jade Emperor old fellow: if he agrees to this title for me, then so be it.

candidates.source: 告诉你那玉帝老儿 答应俺老孙这个称号便罢
candidates.target: Tell that Jade Emperor old fellow: if he agrees to grant me this title, then I'll accept it.

candidates.source: 告诉你那玉帝老儿 答应俺老孙这个称号便罢
candidates.target: Tell that old Jade Emperor of yours to grant me the title 'The Great Sage'.

candidates.source: 万岁 他还口出狂言 自称齐天大圣
candidates.target: Long live him, he talks big, claiming to be the Great Sage, Equal of Heaven.

candidates.source: 万岁 他还口出狂言 自称齐天大圣
candidates.target: Long live! He also spouted arrogant words, claiming to be the Great Sage Equal to Heaven.

candidates.source: 万岁 他还口出狂言 自称齐天大圣
candidates.target: Long live him! He even made wild boasts, calling himself the Great Sage Equal to Heaven.

candidates.source: 万岁 他还口出狂言 自称齐天大圣
candidates.target: Long live him! He still speaks gibberish and claims to be the Great Sage of Mount Tian.

candidates.source: 万岁 他还口出狂言 自称齐天大圣
candidates.target: Long live the Emperor! He still speaks arrogantly, calling himself the Great Sage Equal to Heaven.

candidates.source: 万岁 他还口出狂言 自称齐天大圣
candidates.target: Long live the Emperor! He still speaks in arrogance, claiming to be the Great Sage Equal to Heaven.

candidates.source: 万岁 他还口出狂言 自称齐天大圣
